name: 795. Paloheinämaraton
description: Paloheinä Marathon is a long-running marathon event that gives runners the opportunity to enjoy a varied course in Helsinki’s Paloheinä. The event is held on several dates throughout the year and offers multiple start times, including midweek. The route runs in the Kehä I area and offers a varied experience in terms of both scenery and running. Aid stations and changing facilities are also available to participants.
course_highlights: The route runs in the Kehä I area, starting on Pakilantie and continuing to Kuusmiehentie
The route is marked with orange, green, and yellow marking pins
Alternative start times are available midweek, including as early as the middle of the night
additional: It is possible to store gear in the organizer’s car. There are no lockable lockers in the changing rooms at the cabin, so valuables should be left behind. The marathon has several start times, including 13.30, 15.15, 15.30, and 16.00; a 04.00 start has also been offered in the past.

name: Kadrina kadripäeva kadrijooks
location: Kadrina Stadium, Kadrina, Lääne-Viru County, Estonia
description: Kadrina’s St. Catherine’s Day run is an enjoyable 5 km run in Kadrina around St. Catherine’s Day. The race starts at Kadrina Stadium and is suitable for both recreational runners and schoolchildren, who have been able to participate for free. The run follows St. Catherine’s Day traditions.
course_highlights: A 5 km run starting at Kadrina Stadium
The race takes place in the Kadrina area
Clothing must include a white element, in keeping with the tradition of the kadri figures
additional: Race bib collection and on-site registration take place from 10:30 to 11:30 at the Kadrina Youth Centre, next to the stadium. After the run, you can use the sauna at Kadrina Sports Hall. Clothing must include a white element.

name: Team Fillinge Ultras Terränglopp
location: Gummiverkstaden, Bankekind, Linköping Municipality, Östergötland, Sweden
description: Team Fillinge Ultra’s trail race is a friendly, local event organized by Team Fillinge Ultra. The race is approximately 10 km long and consists mostly of scenic gravel roads and lovely trails just outside Fillinge, south of Bankekind/Linköping. The event is being held for the second year and has a relaxed, welcoming atmosphere for trail runners who want to enjoy nature. Meet at Gummiverkstaden (gathering at 10:40); the race starts at 11:00.
course_highlights: Approximately 10 km
Mostly scenic gravel roads and lovely forest trails
Gathering and start at Gummiverkstaden, south of Bankekind (near Fillinge/Linköping)
additional: Information meeting at 10:40 at Gummiverkstaden; start at 11:00. The race is organized by Team Fillinge Ultra (contact: marcuslundin@gmail.com). Website operator/event partner: Trailrunning Sweden AB (info@trailrunningsweden.se). New course route for 2025 and all 100 entries sold out one week before the race; new hiking prize “The Golden Toaster”; logistics information includes a bus from Linköping toward Åtvidaberg (get off at Sandtorp) and parking at Gummiverkstaden (limited space; carpooling encouraged).

name: Hammarby Alpin Marathon
location: Vindskyddet i Barnbacken, Hammarbybacken, Stockholm, Sweden
description: Hammarby Alpin Marathon is a unique alpine marathon in the heart of Stockholm, running up, over and around Hammarbybacken. The race consists of 22 laps and is slightly longer than a standard marathon—a microultra that, in the organiser’s words, could also be called Sweden’s probably slowest marathon. The course is technical and spectator-friendly, with the lap point and finish at the shelter in the children’s slope. The event is a festive Advent celebration organised by Stockholm Multisportklubb.
course_highlights: 22 laps around Hammarbybacken (start, lap point and finish at the shelter in the children’s slope)
Start at the bottom of the hill (to the left of the lift when facing the summit) and climb over the “Trysil” section by the jetty
Technical sections: down along the service road, around the chimney, through Indianparken, inside the allotment gardens and along the cycle path
additional: Organiser: Stockholm Multisportklubb. Registration takes place at the lap point/finish (the shelter in the children’s slope). Nearest metro station: Hammarbyhöjden. Start location: at the bottom of the hill, to the left of the lift. Registration is via RaceID, according to the registration page. Registration and finish are at the shelter in the children’s slope; bags can be left at the foot of the hill; a tarpaulin is provided in case of rain; toilets are behind the car park; the right of public access applies; results are published after the race (top 10 faster).

name: Rantasaunan Lenkki
description: Rantasaunan Lenkki and Osmo Runs take place on Friday, June 8. The Osmo Runs start at 6:00 p.m., and runners are placed in age categories. After registration, runners are assigned to suitable heats, and race numbers are handed out at around 6:00 p.m. The Hintrekin run starts at 7:30 p.m. Prizes are awarded after the races, including a prize donated by Avain Säästöpankki, and ice cream is provided to all participants.

images.alt_text: Juoksija maalissa kohottaa nyrkkiä ja hymyilee.

name: Adventsjoggen
description:
Experience a magical start to the festive season with Adventsjoggen at Stora Hjortstorps Gård in Örebro on 29 November! Bring your friends, family or colleagues for a day filled with exercise, community and delicious food. Choose between a scenic 7.2 km or a challenging 15 km. There’s also a 600 m Kidsrun for the youngest participants.

After the race, a warming reward awaits: hearty goulash and freshly baked bread, all included in the entry fee! The course takes you through beautiful surroundings, starting and finishing at the farm, along idyllic landscapes past Rävgången and Naturens Hus.

images.alt_text: Löpare i juliga kläder på en stig under Stora Hjortstorps Adventsjoggen i Örebro.
Löpare springer på skogsstig under Adventsjoggen i grått väder.
Löpare springer på en stig i skogen under Adventsjoggen-loppet
Barn som springer på en grusväg under Adventsjoggen-loppet i skogen

name: Skriešanas seriāls “Ugāle”, III posms
description: The “Ugāle” running series is a running event organized by the Ventspils Municipality Sports School, bringing together runners of different ages and ability levels. The series’ third stage will take place in Ugāle, giving participants the opportunity to compete and improve their results. The event is part of the Latvian Athletics Association calendar and is organized to a high professional standard, providing a quality competition environment.

name: Järvenpään Maraton
description: The Järvenpää Marathon has been held since 1994. The half marathon and marathon courses are officially measured and run mainly on a paved shared-use path around Lake Tuusula. For the first time, the route follows Tuusula’s Rantatie, offering cultural experiences for both runners and spectators. The area has excellent transport connections, and there is plenty of parking nearby. Welcome to Tuusula and Järvenpää!

name: Mispo talvemaraton
description: Mispo Talvemaraton is a winter running event in Vändra, with the 23rd edition on Saturday 5 December 2026. Runners can choose a marathon (42.195 km), a half marathon (21.097 km), or a 14 km or 7 km run or fitness walk. The start is at 11:00 by Vändra stadium at Pärnu-Paide mnt 2. Every finisher gets a drink, food, sauna, a diploma and a medal.
course_highlights: Marathon, half marathon, 14 km and 7 km
Start and finish by Vändra stadium
Drink, food, sauna, diploma and medal at the finish
additional: Pre-registration closes one day before the race, and on-site registration is possible on race morning. The race office opens at 9:00. From 1 October 2026 the fee is 20 euros (7 km) to 35 euros (marathon), 5 euros more on race day. The organiser is Terviseklubi MISPO.

name: 23. Mispo Winter Marathon, skrējiens
location: Vändra Stadium, Pärnu-Paide maantee 2, Vändra, Estonia
description: The 23rd Mispo Winter Marathon is a winter running event held at Vändra Stadium in Estonia. Runners are invited to enjoy the atmosphere at the stadium and spend an active day together during the winter season.
course_highlights: The race takes place at Vändra Stadium.
The start and finish are in Vändra, Pärnu-Paide maantee 2.
additional: The Sportlat.lv race calendar provides links to the race regulations, registration, map, participant list, and photos.

name: Itsenäisyysmaraton
description: In 2025, Itsenäisyysmaraton celebrates its 44th year and will be held on Saturday, 06.12, in Kuopio at Väinölänniemi. Several distances are offered, including the marathon, half marathon, minimarathon, and the Kultajousi Running 10 km and 5 km races. The route is 5.27 km long, flat, and runs on sand and asphalt. A refreshment station provides runners with water and juice. Participants can register in advance or on race day.

name: HÄJYJEN HALLIMARATONI
description: Häjyjen Hallimaratoni is an indoor running event at Seinäjoki Areena on Sunday 6 December 2026. It is run on an indoor track of about 500 metres, and you can choose a marathon, a half marathon or 10 km. Everyone starts at 10:00 and the time limit is 7 hours. The event is organised by the running club Häjyt ry.
course_highlights: Indoor track of about 500 m at Seinäjoki Areena
Marathon, half marathon and 10 km
Finisher medal for everyone
additional: Classes are M/W, M40/W40, M50/W50 and M60/W60. Early prices apply until 27 November 2026: marathon 50 EUR, half marathon 40 EUR and 10 km 30 EUR. After that and on site the prices are 60, 50 and 40 EUR. The fee is paid to the Häjyt bank account.

name: Omega kiirus
description: Omega kiirus is an indoor running competition at the Lasnamäe athletics arena in Tallinn where young and master athletes (35+) compete in one combined results list. Older athletes' times are adjusted with age grading factors so runners of all ages can race each other. Distances are 60 m, 200 m, 800 m and 3000 m, plus a 4x200 m mixed relay and a 200 m race for children under 14. The top three in each event win prize money.
course_highlights: Sprint and middle distances on an indoor track
Age graded results for masters in one protocol
4x200 m mixed relay with a combined team age of at least 170
additional: The competition runs on 6 December 2026 from 11:00 to 16:00, starting with the children's races. Entry is 15 EUR for the first event and 10 EUR for each additional one, 40 EUR per relay team, 5 EUR for children and free for athletes 70+. Registration is open until 1 December 2026; only relay teams can register on the day. Timing is automatic with photo finish.

name: Dari labu skrienot
location: Sporta klubs SQUAD Hour, Rīga, Latvia

name: Trijstūris — Pagrīdes ielu skrējiens
description: Trijstūris – Underground Street Run is a night run through the streets of Riga. All participants start at the same time, and the winner is the first to return with marks from both checkpoints. The run takes place in all weather, and participants choose their own route between the checkpoints. The event is suitable for runners who can run at least 6 km, with separate prizes for men and women. Participants receive a numbered card and a route map, and must mark their cards at the checkpoints using a perforator.
course_highlights: Night run through the streets of Riga, with a free choice of route between checkpoints
Two checkpoints where participants must mark their cards using a perforator
Start and finish at Ģenerāļa Radziņa skatepark; the route crosses Salu and Akmens bridges
additional: Participants can try the EPIC PRE-INTERVAL caffeine product before the start. The streets are not closed, and traffic regulations must be followed. Participants must be at least 18 years old; younger participants may take part only with parental consent. Participants' names and results are published, and event photos and videos are used on Vadātājs' Instagram and website. The recommended ability for participation is to run 6 km. Participants must be at least 18 years old; younger participants need parental consent.

name: Backyardish Ultra
description: Backyardish Ultra Kuopio follows the traditional backyard ultra format, but it is not an official backyard ultra. The route is a marked loop of approximately 6.7 kilometres through the forest. The event takes place in Neulamäki on Saturday, 16 November 2024, from 9:00 to 21:00. All participants start their first lap at 9:00, and subsequent laps start on the hour. The winner is the first person to finish the final lap. There is no winner if nobody completes the final lap.

images.alt_text: Metsässä juoksevia ihmisiä polulla, juoksukilpailuun liittyvä kuva.

name: Vantaan Maantiejuoksucup 2/5
description: Finland’s largest road running series, Vantaa Road Running Cup, starts again on Saturday at Sotunki School, which returns as the event centre after a few years’ break. The event has a 32-year history, and this year’s new main sponsor is MK FACADE OY. On Saturday, runners will compete over 5 km and 10 km, with starts at 13:00 and 13:10. The route is designed to provide runners with a pleasant and safe environment, and enhanced supervision will ensure safety during the race.

images.alt_text: Juoksukilpailu Vantaalla, jossa joukko ihmisiä juoksee asfaltilla. Taustalla rakennuksia ja puita.

name: Talvisarjajuoksu Rovaniemi
description: The traditional RDS Winter Series Run is back! The first race will take place on Saturday, 4 October at 11:00 on the familiar and safe Koskenkylä route. The third race in the Winter Series will be run on Saturday, 13 December 2025 at 11:00 on the Koskenkylä route. New this year: a 2 km fitness race open to everyone.

name: Teivocup II
description: Teivocup is a winter-season series of test runs, offering the opportunity to take part in running races at all levels, from recreational runners to competitive athletes. The event is held in Ylöjärvi, near the Teivo Race Centre, and is aimed at everyone who enjoys endurance sports. Each race is 5 km, and runners can register on site. The entry fee is €10 per race (€7 for club members). The second race will take place on Saturday, 13 December 2025, followed by a Christmas party for members at Lamminpää Lodge.

name: TreeningPluss Muraste jooks-matk
location: Muraste, Harku Parish, Harju County, Estonia
description: TreeningPluss Muraste Run-Hike is a winter running and hiking festival in the Muraste area, taking place on December 13. The event offers participants the chance to enjoy nature and stay active even in the colder months. The routes pass through beautiful landscapes and are suitable for both running and hiking. The event is for everyone who wants to spend active time outdoors in the fresh air.
course_highlights: Winter run and hike in the Muraste area
Beautiful nature trails and forest roads
Suitable for both running and hiking
additional: Start at 10:00.

name: Noskrien Ziemu 2. posms Koknesē
description: Noskrien Ziemu Stage 2 in Koknese is a winter running event offering the opportunity to take part in various distances and sports. The event is part of the Noskrien Ziemu series, which brings together athletes and active people who want to test their abilities in winter conditions. The race takes place in Koknese, offering a challenge and enjoyment for both individual runners and teams. Registration is open, but participant numbers are limited, so it is also possible to join the waiting list.
additional: Participant numbers are limited, and once the limit is reached, applications are placed on the waiting list. Registration is available only for one current Noskrien Ziemu stage at a time. Participants must provide the required details, including date of birth, gender, club, and place of residence for statistics.

name: Santa Fun Run Šiauliai
description: The Santa Fun Run is a lovely tradition for Šiauliai residents and visitors, with nearly 500 participants dressed as Santa Claus running through the city streets. The run has a noble purpose: all funds raised go to charity. There are no age restrictions, and everyone can easily complete the symbolic 1.3 km distance. At the finish, participants will be in for a surprise: one of Lithuania’s best-known performers, Jovani, will greet the running Santas.

name: Forssan Puistojuoksu
description: Forssa Park Run is an event that gets the whole city moving and has been bringing runners together for 30 years. Held once a month, it typically attracts 100–200 runners of all ages. The beautiful route winds through the scenery along the Loimijoki River. Runners can choose between a 5.8 km and an 11.2 km course, which passes near Forssa city centre through the park of the old cotton mill. The start and finish are on Keskuskatu, in front of the more than 100-year-old Elävien Kuvien cinema.

images.alt_text: Kolme juoksijaa Forssan Puistojuoksussa kauniilla reitillä.
Forssan Puistojuoksun 2024 kausikortti. Juoksijoita ja aikataulu.
Forssan Puistojuoksun kausikortti 2023. Juoksijoita ja kilpailukalenteri.

name: 2026 Audi Vana-aasta jooksupäev
location: Rocca al Mare kool, Tallinn, Harju County, Estonia
description: Audi Vana-aasta jooksupäev is a traditional winter running event taking place on 19 December 2026 in front of Rocca al Mare School in Tallinn. The event centre and start/finish are conveniently located at the school, and the programme includes three distances: a marathon, a relay marathon and an 8.4 km run. The courses run mainly along shared-use paths and are well marked and safe, offering a sporting way to end the year. Participants are provided with medical assistance, timing, medals, and hot tea at the refreshment stations and finish.
course_highlights: The 8.4 km run follows shared-use paths and is marked with signs and course marshals.
The marathon consists of 5 laps, each a 8.44 km paved shared-use path.
The relay marathon consists of 5 legs, each a lap of 8.44 km.
additional: The marathon and relay marathon have participant limits of 100 marathon runners and 150 teams, respectively. The 8.4 km run is limited to 150 runners. Race numbers are distributed on race day at Rocca al Mare School. Medical assistance is available at the start/finish area. Awards are presented after the run or marathon, as applicable. Running on the road is prohibited and may result in disqualification. The course is in an urban setting. Registration and entry fees are listed in detail. The event is held annually and is part of the Estonian running calendar.

name: Panevėžio Kalėdinis Bėgimas
description: On the first Saturday of winter, the annual Eurovaistinė Christmas Run will take place, celebrating its 50th anniversary this year. This running festival will welcome thousands of participants, standing out for its festive atmosphere and distinctive participants dressed in Christmas costumes. The event schedule has been shifted so participants can run after dark, when the magical Christmas spirit comes alive on the streets of Panevėžys. This year, we invite you not only to prepare Christmas costumes but also to add illuminated details that will turn the crowd of runners into a glowing Christmas spectacle.

name: Valestrandsmarka Rundt
description: Valestrandsmarka Rundt is a fun run organized by Osterøy IL, taking place on 24 May 2024. Participants can look forward to a scenic 4.4 km course, with a start time of 18:45. There is a great atmosphere in the svele area, bringing together both experienced and new participants, and awards are given to participants who have completed multiple races.

images.alt_text: Skiløper i aksjon under Valestrandsmarka Rundt juleløp.
To løpere klare for Valestrandsmarka Rundt.
Løpere klare for start i Valestrandsmarka Rundt.
Starten på Valestrandsmarka Rundt juleløp. Mange deltakere klare for løpet.

name: Buugin Pamaus Juoksu
description: Welcome to the first-ever feel-good New Year’s run at Buugi Sports Centre on 31 December 2024 at 18:00! The event is organised jointly by Buugi Sports Centre and Hippoksen Marathon Club, with the aim of offering the best way in Central Finland to start celebrating the New Year in good company with a run and a buffet meal. Participants can choose the 10 km distance, with competitive and recreational categories for women and men.

images.alt_text: Juoksija punaisella juoksuradalla. Hyvän mielen uuden vuoden juoksu.

name: Uudenvuodenjuoksu
location: Tanelinrannan nuoriso- ja urheilukeskus, Lampitie 10, Seinäjoki
description: The New Year’s Run is a wonderful opportunity to enjoy exercise on New Year’s Eve. The event takes place on 31 December 2024 at various locations, including Seinäjoki, Liminka, Lieto and Imatra, and offers participants a range of distances for runners of different ages and abilities. The courses are officially measured and safe, with traffic marshals. The event brings together running enthusiasts and also offers the chance to enjoy coffee and refreshments from kiosks in the area.

name: Naujametinis ruonių maratonas
description: 2026-01-01 Pasvaliečiai invites all club members and friends to the 1st New Year’s SEALS MARATHON, which will take place in Pasvalys. This marathon is part of the traditional 18th ice-swimming event organized in Pasvalys District. After the marathon, a club members’ meeting will be held, during which the club’s most active members will be awarded.

name: Talvijuoksu Lappeenranta
description: Talvijuoksusarja is a winter running event held in Lappeenranta. The event starts and finishes beside Pallo Sports Hall at Tukkikatu 2. Registration takes place at the starting point 20 minutes before the start. Distances offered are 3 km, 5 km, and 7 km. Children can run an approximately 1 km distance. All routes are out-and-back courses along a lit cycle path. The event is free and open to everyone. The temperature limit is -15 C.

name: Sisu 6h
description: Sisu6h is an ultrarunning event held at Joensuu Arena on 16 January 2027. The race lasts six hours and takes place on an officially measured 325.336-metre Mondotrack, with the running direction changing halfway through at 12:00. Distance is measured using a chip system, and results are published in real time during the event. The event is open to both women and men, and the minimum age for participation is 18. Runners have access to a comprehensive refreshment area with drinks and light snacks, as well as a reserved area for their own supplies.
course_highlights: Officially measured 325.336-metre Mondotrack
Running direction changes once, halfway through, at 12:00
Distance measured using a chip system, with live results
additional: The refreshment area offers Tailwind sports drink, water, sparkling water, cola, potato chips, bananas, pickles and coarse sea salt. Plenty of tables and chairs are reserved for runners to use for their own supplies. Parking at Joensuu Arena is paid during the event, but the nearby university car parks are free on weekends. Drinks and snacks are available at the refreshment table, and an area is reserved for runners’ own supplies. The minimum age is 18. Parking at the arena is paid.

name: Noskrien Ziemu 3. tumsas posms Smiltenē
description: Noskrien Ziemu 3rd Night Stage in Smiltene is a winter running race that gives participants the opportunity to test their abilities in wintry and challenging conditions. The race takes place in Smiltene and is part of the Noskrien Ziemu series, which brings together athletes from different places. The event is welcoming to both experienced runners and amateurs, offering various distances and the opportunity to take part in a hike. The organizers provide a convenient registration process and support for participants.
additional: Registration is available only for the current Noskrien Ziemu stage. The number of participants is limited, and once the limit is reached, applications are placed on a waiting list.

name: Polar Night Marathon
description: The Polar Night Marathon is a spectacular race during the blue hour north of the Arctic Circle. Choose from several distances, from 5 km to a full marathon (42.195 km), and experience the magic of the magnificent Arctic landscape. The race takes place in early January, during the polar night, when the sun does not rise above the horizon.

images.alt_text: Nordlys over Tromsø under Mørketidsløpet. Magisk!
Løpere i snø under Mørketidsløpet i Tromsø.
Løpere i Mørketidsløpet i Tromsø. Snø, mørke, og festlige lys.
Løpere ved starten av Mørketidsløpet i Tromsø.

name: Talvijuoksusarja 3/6
description: The 3rd event in the Winter Running Series will take place on 30.12.2023 in Mikkeli, offering runners the opportunity to participate in different distances, including 10 km and 6 km. The event is designed especially for winter conditions and attracts both competitive and recreational runners. Previous races have seen excellent performances, and participants can enjoy the winter running atmosphere.

images.alt_text: KOMIA Talvijuoksusarjan 3/6 osakilpailu Mikkelissä. Juoksijat maantiellä.

name: Forssan Puistojuoksu
description: Forssa Park Run has been promoting the city’s fitness for 30 years. Each month, 100–200 runners of different ages take part. The beautiful route runs through the scenery along the Loimijoki River, with a choice of distances: 5.8 km or 11.2 km. The start and finish are on Keskuskatu, in front of the over-100-year-old Elävien kuvien cinema.

name: XXV bėgimas Laisvės gynėjų dienai paminėti
description: The XXV Run Commemorating Freedom Defenders’ Day in Klaipėda is a traditional running event held to honour those who died and fought for Lithuania’s freedom. The event brings together the city’s community and visitors and takes place in Klaipėda on January 18. Participants can choose between two distances: the main 8 km course and a shorter 3 km course for schoolchildren, seniors and anyone who finds the longer course too challenging. The event starts in the evening, and the routes pass through scenic parts of the city, including a cycle path and the Summer Amphitheatre.
course_highlights: The 8 km course follows a cycle path past Klaipėda Summer Amphitheatre, Liepojos Street and H. Manto Street
Finish near Klaipėda City Municipality (Liepų St. 11)
The 3 km course starts near Klaipėda Summer Amphitheatre and is intended for schoolchildren and seniors
additional: Race bibs have an external timing chip. Picking up race bibs in advance is recommended to avoid queues on event day. Bib pickup for 8 km runners is on a bus near the Rotušė, and for 3 km runners it is near the Summer Amphitheatre. Buses depart for the start locations at 19:00. Individual warm-up: 19:45–19:55. The course closes at 21:20. Medals are awarded to the first 900 finishers. The event is organised with buses and community participation; the start is at the Klaipėda Giruliai Radio and TV Tower.

name: Teivocup III 2027
description: Teivocup III 2027 is a six-part training competition and test-run series held once a month from November to April. The event offers running opportunities for different age and competition categories, with distances of 5 km and 2 km. The course follows a pedestrian and cycling path, with the start and finish at the intersection by Teivo Trotting Centre. Registration takes place at Lamminpää Outdoor Centre, and the race starts at 12:00. The best runners are awarded.
course_highlights: The course follows a pedestrian and cycling path
Start and finish at the intersection by Teivo Trotting Centre
Distances of 5 km and 2 km for different categories
additional: Register at Lamminpää Outdoor Centre by 11:30; arriving early is recommended to avoid queues. Categories: 5 km M/M40/M50/N/N40/N50; 2 km P/T 09/11/13. The best runners are awarded. A six-part running series; registration opens at 11:30 and the race starts at 12:00.

name: Winter Run 2027
description: Winter Run 2027 is a seaside winter run in Narva-Jõesuu, held as part of Estonia Winter Fest. The programme includes a 300 m children’s run and 3.5 km and 7 km distances. The main distances are electronically timed, and every finisher receives a medal. After the run, participants can visit the festival sauna village and attend the main concert free of charge by presenting their bib number.

images.alt_text: Talvine jooksuteade Narva-Jõesuu talvejooksu ja distantsidega 3,5 km ja 7 km lumisel rajal
Talvine jooksurada Narva-Jõesuus 3,5 km distantsil suusarajal ja linnatänavatel

name: Kondimootor 30/50/70: Lahemaa Lumine
description: Kondimootor 30/50/70: Lahemaa Lumine is a series of endurance hikes and ultramarathons held amid Estonia’s beautiful scenery in Lahemaa National Park. It offers the chance to explore various hiking trails, enjoy orienteering and time on your feet, and challenge yourself. The hikes are suitable for everyone who wants to get active in a relaxed atmosphere, meet new people, and enjoy a little friendly competition. Come test yourself and enjoy being active in Estonia’s nature!
course_highlights: Long distances and endurance hikes
Orienteering and time on your feet on the trails of Lahemaa National Park
A relaxed atmosphere, outdoor activity, and a social experience
additional: Sports: running, walking, Nordic walking, hiking, adventure activities. The event is part of the Kondimootor series, which emphasizes challenging yourself and the positive effects of physical activity on mental health. The start is at 08:00. There are drink and snack stations along the route, as well as a larger food station.

name: Götas ungdomsspel
location: Eva Lisa Holtz Arena, Karlstad, Sweden
price_range: 110–120 kr per gren; efteranmälan i mån av plats mot dubbel avgift
description: Götas Youth Indoor Games is an athletics competition for young people, held at the modern Eva Lisa Holtz Arena in Karlstad. The event provides a welcoming and supportive environment for young athletes to compete and develop in various athletics disciplines. The arena is a multifunctional indoor facility with seating for 1,700 spectators, creating a great atmosphere for both participants and spectators. The event is organised by IF Göta Karlstad, one of Sweden’s most successful athletics clubs, and offers a safe and inspiring competition environment.
course_highlights: The competition is held indoors at Eva Lisa Holtz Arena, a modern venue with seating for 1,700 spectators
Multifunctional facility for both competitions and training
Organised by IF Göta Karlstad, a club with a long tradition and a strong record in athletics
additional: The competition takes place at Eva Lisa Holtz Arena, which opened in 2022 and is a modern indoor venue for athletics and physical training. The multifunctional arena is also used for meetings and training courses. IF Göta Karlstad covers the entry fees for a maximum of three events per competition for its members. Entries for children and young people under 14 should be sent to the relevant group email address, or to tavlingsanmalan@ifgota.se if no group email address is available. Enter by 24 January via EasyRecord or gus@ifgota.se. Participants compete in their age category or the senior category.

name: EcoTrail Stockholm Winter
location: Stora Skuggan, Norra Djurgården, Stockholm, Sweden
description: EcoTrail Stockholm Winter is a winter adventure for runners who love nature even when the temperature drops. The race takes place in beautiful Norra Djurgården, starting and finishing at Stora Skuggan. Choose from three distances on snowy trails and enjoy a unique winter medal at the finish. After the race, warm up with a hot drink and refreshments at the after-run with fellow runners.
course_highlights: Rolling snowy trails in Norra Djurgården
Aid stations at 4 km on the 6 km and 12 km courses
Start and finish at Stora Skuggan, easily accessible by metro and bus
additional: Everyone who finishes receives a unique winter medal. Aid stations are at 4 km on the 6 km and 12 km courses. The start and finish are at Stora Skuggan, near the metro and bus. Registration is through the partner EQ Timing and is binding and non-refundable. Refund protection can be purchased as an add-on through Startklar. Registration is open until 29 January 2027.

name: Winter Run (Stockholm)
organizer: Marathongruppen med Hässelby SK och Spårvägens FK

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Barn och ungdomar har ett pris hela perioden fram till evenemanget.

description: Winter Run Stockholm is an atmospheric winter race taking place at Skansen and Djurgården on January 31, 2027. Participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km on a course that combines historic surroundings with beautiful winter scenery, illuminated by fire performers, torches and flares. The race also includes a children’s race for ages 7–11, making it an experience for the whole family. The event is organized by Marathongruppen together with the athletics clubs Hässelby SK and Spårvägens FK, and any surplus goes back to sport.
course_highlights: 5 km course with 57% paved surface and 43% gravel
Just over 1 km through Skansen’s historic surroundings, with the rest around Djurgården
The course is illuminated by flares, fire baskets and a fire show
additional: Children’s race: 1.3 km for ages 7–11. Minimum age: 13 for 5 km (11 when accompanied by a parent or guardian) and 15 for 10 km (13 when accompanied by a parent or guardian). Skansen is a dog-free zone. The course is sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association and officially measured by an approved course measurer. There is a risk of ice on the course, so shoes suitable for winter conditions are recommended. Skansen opens to runners at 14:30. Start times: children’s race 16:30, 5 km 17:00, 10 km 18:00. There is also a children’s race for ages 7–11. Any surplus goes back to sport.

name: Teivocup IV 2027
description: Teivocup IV 2027 is a six-part series of training races and test runs held once a month from November to April. The event’s fourth race takes place on February 6 at Lamminpää Outdoor Recreation Lodge in Ylöjärvi. The series offers several distances for different age groups and divisions, and the route follows a pedestrian and cycle path near the Teivo Race Centre junction. Registration is on site by 11:30, and the start is at 12:00. The top runners will be awarded prizes.
course_highlights: The route follows a pedestrian and cycle path
Start and finish at the Teivo Race Centre junction
Several distances for different age groups and divisions (5 km and 2 km)
additional: Registration is on site at Lamminpää Outdoor Recreation Lodge by 11:30. The distances are 5 km (M/M40/M50/N/N40/N50) and 2 km (P/T 09/11/13). With several competition classes, the event offers an opportunity to take part in winter running in Finnish nature.

name: Vintermossa (Mossaloppet)
description: Vintermossa is a winter edition of Mossarun, a trail race featuring a challenging and technical 21 km loop with more than 600 metres of elevation gain. The race is self-guided and unmanned, meaning participants navigate using a GPX file, with no trail markings. A large fire is kept burning throughout the race to warm cold runners, and participants can grill their own food. Skis are allowed when there is enough snow, making it possible to combine running and skiing on the loop.
course_highlights: 21 km loop with 600+ metres of elevation gain
Technical, hilly terrain with high-quality trails
Unmanned race with self-navigation using a GPX file
additional: The race is unsupported, with no timing or checkpoints. There is no time limit. Mandatory equipment includes an emergency blanket and a headlamp. A large fire is kept burning throughout so participants can warm up between laps. Participants can choose to run one or more laps. Participants are encouraged to Swish any amount they wish to War Child or another organisation of their choice as a donation. This information has not been confirmed on Mossarun’s results page.

name: Sormlands Winter Trail
location: Nävekvarns IP, Nävekvarn, Nyköping Municipality, Sweden
description: Sörmlands Winter Trail is a winter race offering three distances: 43 km, 22 km and 10 km, all starting and finishing at Nävekvarns IP in Nävekvarn. The routes pass through varied terrain, including forest trails, hilly landscapes and scenic coastal sections, providing a challenging and picturesque experience. The race uses electronic timing and has several aid stations with food and drinks along the course. After the finish, all participants are served a hot meal and non-alcoholic recovery beer. Safety is a priority, with mandatory equipment and access to showers and changing rooms at the start.
course_highlights: Varied terrain with forest trails, hilly slopes and coastal paths
Several aid stations with food, hot drinks and Umara Energy
Electronic chip timing and clear cut-off times for each distance
additional: Start times: 43 km at 09:00, 22 km at 10:00, 10 km at 11:00. Maximum cut-off times: 8 hours for 43 km, 5 hours for 22 km, 2 hours for 10 km. Mandatory equipment includes, among other things, a mobile phone, windproof jacket, thermal base layer, hat, gloves, water bottle (at least 500 ml), whistle, emergency blanket and headlamp when running in the dark. Showers, changing rooms and toilets are available at Nävekvarns IP. Parking is available for a fee at the start/finish area. After the race, runners are served a hot meal and non-alcoholic Mineral Brewing Recovery Lager. The distances are 10, 22 and 43 km. Race numbers can be collected at the start area at Nävekvarns IP. Aid stations offer food and hot drinks, and a hot meal is served at the finish. Mandatory equipment includes, among other things, a charged phone, wind jacket, water and trail shoes with good grip. Parking is available for a small fee.

name: Noskrien Ziemu 4. posms
additional: The participant limit has been reached. If an application is submitted after the limit is reached, it will be placed on the waiting list. Registration is possible only for one current Noskrien Ziemu stage.

name: Villasukkajuoksun SM-kisat
organizer: Eräjärven Kehittämisyhdistys ry ja Västilän Voima ry

price_tiers.distance: Naisten ja miesten kilpasarjat 3 km, 6 km ja 9 km

description: The Finnish Wool Sock Running Championships is the year’s most fun event, held at Orivesi sports field and on its forest trails. There are races for different age groups over 3 km, 6 km and 9 km, as well as a team competition. The event offers an enjoyable running experience, hot juice, soup, a race bag and access to the swimming pool on the day of the event. Orivesi is known as Finland’s Wool Sock Capital, and the event is filled with a cheerful atmosphere and wool-sock activities for the whole family.
course_highlights: Run 3 km, 6 km or 9 km on forest trails; the route has 60 m of elevation gain per lap.
The start and finish are at Orivesi sports field, where runners also complete a lap when they finish.
The race offers varied forest trails and an enjoyable running experience.
additional: Registration opens at 9:00 at Orivesi Upper Secondary School. The swimming pool is open on the day of the event from 12:00 to 16:00; the doors close at 15:00. The sauna and swimming pool are open until 16:00. Free parking is limited near the event venue; additional parking is available about one kilometre from the centre. Orivesi is also easily reached by train and bus. Registration is through Tiketti, and a service fee is added to the entry fee. 50% of the fee is refunded if you cancel due to illness or an accident.

name: Vinterjoggen
description:
Run + pizza!!

You’ll be greeted by snow-covered trails, fresh air and a community that warms even the coldest February day—or whatever conditions and weather a February day in Örebro can offer these days :-)

Choose between 10 km if you’re looking for a real challenge, 5 km if you want to enjoy fast-paced winter running, or 500 metres for our youngest runners. Whatever the distance, an experience in Sörbyskogen awaits, with the start and finish in the same place, fresh winter air and a wonderful atmosphere. Can’t choose? Then run both 10 km and 5 km, of course!

After the race, a warming reward awaits: a pizza buffet at Sörens vedugn, all included in the entry fee!

Take the chance to experience winter for real—run, feel the cold, and let your heart rate meet the frost.

name: Bodøs Høyeste - Trappeløp
description: Bodøs Høyeste 2027 is a stair race up the stairs of Scandic Havet, the tallest building in Bodø, on Sunday 14 February 2027. It is a charity race, and all income after costs goes to the Norwegian Childhood Cancer Society through Team Rynkeby Nord's fundraiser for childhood cancer research. From age 12, participants climb 17 floors with timing, while children aged 5 to 11 and seniors over 60 can do 7 floors without timing. The organizer is Nordland Bedriftsidrettskrets.
course_highlights: 17 timed floors in Scandic Havet
Fastest man and woman win a weekend stay at a Scandic hotel of their choice
Prize draw from sponsors
additional: The price is 250 kr for adults and 100 kr for children (6-14) and students. Students must show a student ID when collecting their bib. Registration is open until Friday 12 February at 21:00.

name: Bėgimas varžybos „Bėgame už Laisvę“ 2026
location: Laisvės g. 8, Mažeikiai, Mažeikiai District Municipality, Lithuania
description: “We Run for Freedom” is a February 16 race held in Mažeikiai, bringing together participants of all ages to celebrate Lithuania’s freedom through activity. The event program includes several distances and a relay, so both young runners and experienced athletes can join the festive race. Let’s run together, celebrating community and pride in our country.
course_highlights: 200 m and 1,200 m races are intended for the youngest participants.
The 3.3 km course offers a shorter-distance option.
The program includes a 3 × 3.3 km relay and a 10 km race.
additional: The start is near the Mažeikiai District Municipality building, Laisvės St. 8. Participants receive commemorative medals.

name: Endurance 24h
description: Endurance 24h is a 24-hour running competition held at Esport Arena in Espoo. The race takes place on an indoor track measuring 390.04 metres, with a mondo surface. There are men’s and women’s categories, and the number of participants is limited to 160 runners on a first-come, first-served basis. The event is seeking IAU Silver Label status, and intermediate results are recorded at several distances, including 12 hours, 100 km and 100 miles. Participation may be deferred to the following year with a medical certificate, and entry fees are non-refundable.
course_highlights: 390.04-metre indoor lap on a mondo surface
Indoor race at Esport Arena in Espoo
IAU Silver Label competition in the 24-hour run
additional: Late registration is possible until 11 a.m. on race day, provided the event is not sold out. Transferring an entry to another runner costs €10. The race director is Arto Ahola, tel. +358 40 513 2051. The official sports drink is Tailwind Endurance Fuel. Intermediate results are tracked at 12 hours, 100 km and 100 miles. An entry may be transferred to another runner for a €10 fee; participation may be deferred to the following year once with a medical certificate.

name: Ventspils ziemas sacensības senioriem
location: Olimpiskais centrs Ventspils athletics arena, Ventspils, Latvia
organizer: Ventspils Sporta pārvalde sadarbībā ar Ventspils veterānu sporta klubu
description: The Ventspils Winter Competition for Seniors is a masters athletics event held at the athletics hall of the Olympic Centre “Ventspils.” Masters athletes from Latvia and Lithuania take part, with the event offering seniors a great opportunity to compete in various disciplines such as running, long jump, triple jump and shot put. This traditional event brings together around 75 participants, promoting sporting spirit and a healthy lifestyle among seniors. The competition is organized by the Ventspils Sports Administration in cooperation with the Ventspils Masters Sports Club.
course_highlights: The competition takes place at the athletics hall of the Olympic Centre “Ventspils.”
Participants compete in various athletics disciplines, such as running, long jump and shot put.
Masters athletes from Latvia and Lithuania take part.
additional: The competition is organized by the municipal institution “Ventspils Sports Administration” of Ventspils State City in cooperation with the Ventspils Masters Sports Club. Around 75 masters athletics athletes from Latvia and Lithuania take part in the event. The chief judge of the competition is Aigars Matisons, supported by a team of judges. Athletes from Latvia and Lithuania have taken part in previous competitions.

name: Teveltunet Vinterbackyard
description: Teveltunet Winter Backyard is a winter backyard-format race at Teveltunet in Meråker. Runners start a new 6.7-kilometre loop every hour, with the first start at 10:00. To continue, you must complete the loop within the hour and be back for the next starting signal. The race lasts for up to 12 hours, and you choose how many loops you want to run.
course_highlights: 6.7 kilometres per loop
A new start every hour from 10:00
Winter course at Teveltunet in Meråker
additional: Up to 12 loops (80.4 km). Participants can eat and drink between loops; communal tables, changing rooms, toilets and showers are available. Bring your own chair.

name: LAPONIE Boreal Winter-Trail Trail To Be Alive
description: Laponie Boreal Winter-Trail is a unique winter adventure in Inari, offering participants the chance to experience Arctic nature and the Northern Lights. This winter trail-running event takes runners through stunning scenery in the Lapland wilderness, offering unforgettable experiences immersed in nature. The event is part of the Trail to Be Alive series, known for its high-quality and memorable trail races around the world. Runners can expect a challenging but rewarding course that combines the tranquillity of nature with the beauty of winter.
course_highlights: Arctic winter wilderness in Inari
A chance to see the Northern Lights
A challenging trail-running course immersed in nature
additional: The event is part of an international trail tour, but further details about the course or registration are not available.

name: SFT - Skåne Frozen Trail
description: Skåne Frozen Trail is a trail-running event offering several distances in the beautiful Snogeholm area, with the start and finish at Gydarps gård. The race features challenging and scenic routes on Skåneleden and other trails, with distances of 12 km, 30 km and 50 km ultra. The event is open to all levels and focuses on competing against yourself rather than others, in a warm and welcoming atmosphere. Participants can enjoy well-marked courses, electronic timing, aid stations and warming soup after the finish. SFT is also part of the RUNTGS 70K Challenge 2027.
course_highlights: 30 km loop on Skåneleden and trails in Snogeholm
50 km ultra with 30 km + 20 km loops
New 12 km distance with 150 m elevation gain
additional: Mandatory equipment: emergency blanket and mobile phone. Well-marked course with electronic timing. Staffed aid stations at km 15/45 and an extra station in the finish area for the 50 km. Warm cabin with toilet and shower. Soup with bread after the finish. Limited number of places. Accommodation can be booked near the start/finish via Des ti nation Snogeholm. Elevation gain: 150 m D+ for 12 km, 505 m D+ for 30 km and 830 m D+ for 50 km.

name: Teivocup V 2027
description: Teivocup V is a winter test-run race series held around Teivo Racecourse once a month from November to April. The race covers a 5-kilometre route and is aimed at runners of all levels, from recreational runners to competitive athletes. Registration takes place on site at least one hour before the start. The entry fee is 10 euros per event, or 7 euros for club members. The series has men’s and women’s categories, as well as a team competition.
course_highlights: 5 km running route around Teivo Racecourse
Winter race series running from November to April
Suitable for runners of all levels, from recreational runners to competitive athletes
additional: The event offers the chance to take part in a 5 km run and join the Finnish running community. Entry fees and further details are not currently available.

name: Saimaa Winter Trail
description: Saimaa Winter Trail is a winter trail running and mountain biking event held amid the stunning winter scenery of Ukonniemi in Imatra. The races offer experiences both in the glow of lights on a dark evening and in daylight. The routes follow winter trails groomed in snowy conditions, and the event is suitable for both competitors and those taking it at a more leisurely pace. The Finnish Cycling Fatbike Championships are also held as part of the event. Saimaa Winter Trail is organized by Saimaa Challenge ry.
course_highlights: Winter trails amid the stunning scenery of Ukonniemi
Race in the dark surrounded by lights and flames
Routes are marked with tape, and intersections are signposted
additional: The entry fee includes timing, race numbers (collected at the finish), photos, changing facilities, washing facilities, a sauna, and an ice hole for swimming. A hot tub is also available on Saturday. Aid stations along the routes are provided on the 13 km, 21 km, and 42 km distances, with light snacks and hot drinks. Hot juice is available at the finish. A hot meal is served at Ukonlinna after the race, with lactose-free, gluten-free, and vegetarian options also available. The event disciplines are Night Trail, Trail Run, Night MTB, and MTB.

name: Lapland Arctic Ultra
description: Lapland Arctic Ultra is an extreme winter race held in Överkalix, Swedish Lapland. The race offers several distances from 20 km to 500 km, and participants can choose to compete on foot, on skis or by mountain bike. The routes follow snowmobile trails through frozen rivers, lakes, marshes and forests, with spectacular views and challenging Arctic conditions. The start and finish are at Grand Arctic Resort, and the race crosses the Arctic Circle twice on the 185 km distance. This is a unique challenge for endurance athletes who want to test their limits in Europe’s last wilderness.
course_highlights: Routes follow snowmobile trails through frozen rivers, lakes, marshes and forests
The 185 km distance crosses the Arctic Circle twice
Start and finish at Grand Arctic Resort in Överkalix
additional: A mandatory training camp is required for participants without experience in extreme cold. Transfers are offered from Jockfall to the start, including transport of pulks. There is no prize purse. Drop bags are not available under the rules. The race starts at Grand Arctic Resort in Överkalix, next to the Kalix River. A training course is planned for 2–5 March 2027 and is mandatory for participants without experience in extreme cold.

name: Noskrien Ziemu 5. posms Liepājā
description: Noskrien Ziemu Stage 5 in Liepāja is part of the popular Noskrien Ziemu running race series held during Latvia’s winter season. The race gives athletes and active recreation enthusiasts the opportunity to test their abilities over various distances while enjoying the scenery of Liepāja and its surroundings. The event welcomes both professional runners and amateurs, and promotes a healthy lifestyle and community spirit. Registration is open, but the number of participants is limited, so early registration is recommended.
course_highlights: The race takes place in the city of Liepāja and its surroundings
A variety of distance options for both runners and hiking participants
Stage 5 of the winter running race series
additional: The number of participants is limited, and once the limit is reached, applications are placed on a waiting list. Registration is available only for the current Noskrien Ziemu stage. Participants must provide the required details, including date of birth, gender, club, and municipality of residence.

name: 2026 metų Kovo 11-osios bėgimas, skirtas Lietuvos Nepriklausomybės atkūrimo dienai paminėti
location: Gargždų kultūros centras, Gargždai, Klaipėdos apskritis, Lithuania
price_range: nemokamai iki IV grupės, 4-5 eurai vėlesnėms grupėms
description: The 2026 March 11 Run is dedicated to commemorating Lithuania’s Restoration of Independence Day and aims to encourage the public to take part in sports and identify the strongest runners in various age groups. The event takes place near Gargždai Cultural Centre, and participants can choose from different distances according to their age and fitness level. The run is open to everyone, with participants starting in groups between 10:00 and 10:30. This traditional event promotes physical activity and brings the community together to mark an important date.
course_highlights: Start and finish near Gargždai Cultural Centre
Different distances from 1.3 km to 14.3 km, according to age group
The course consists of laps, with the number run determined by age group
additional: Race bibs can be collected on race day from 8:45 to 9:30. Participants start in two groups: Groups I–III at 10:00, and Groups IV–V at 10:30. Registration is online only and closes on March 10 at 20:00. Participants may not be accompanied by bicycles or other vehicles during the run; directional markers will be placed along the course. Various race courses, online registration, awards, traffic management during the event.

name: Pagalma superskrējiens

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Dalība “Pagalma superskrējienā” ir minimālais ziedojums 30 eiro apmērā Latvijas Bērnu atbalsta fondam (LBAF).

description: The Backyard Super Run is a unique running event that brings together endurance, community spirit, and charity. Participants must complete a 6.7 km run every hour, and each person chooses how many runs to do—from one to twelve—for a maximum distance of 80.4 km in a day. The event takes place in Teika. The first start is at 10:00, with subsequent starts every hour. After finishing, participants receive a special sports shirt featuring superheroes drawn by Latvian children, and all proceeds are donated to the Latvian Children's Support Foundation.
course_highlights: Complete a 6.7 km run every hour
Participants can do 1 to 12 runs, covering up to 80.4 km in a day
The first start is at 10:00, with subsequent starts every hour
additional: Registration on the day of the event opens at 8:30. Participants who complete one run become Sprīdītis, while those who complete all 12 runs earn the title of Lāčplēsis. The sports shirts are provided by Mizuno in cooperation with Sporta punkts.

name: Tiirismaa Winter Trail
description: Tiirismaa Winter Trail is a winter trail-running event held at the Messilä Ski Centre in Hollola. The event offers a variety of routes through the diverse terrain and stunning winter scenery of the Salpausselkä ridge. Runners can enjoy winter trails, varied climbs, and atmospheric forest scenery. The event also includes a Night Trail race, offering a unique experience in the dark by headlamp. The race centre is located near Messilä Hotel, where saunas and showers are also available.
course_highlights: Varied winter trail scenery in the Salpausselkä area
Routes include steep climbs and varied terrain
Night Trail race in the dark by headlamp
additional: Saunas and showers are available at Messilä Hotel at the race centre on both event days. Race materials include a race number with a timing chip and a route map. There is one aid station on the course (Sykekatu). Competitors can leave their belongings in the cloakroom during the race. Studded shoes are recommended for winter running because of slippery conditions. A buffet lunch is included in the entry fee for the daytime event. The event centre is located at the Messilä Ski Centre.

name: Nuotykių lenktynės „Aplink Rėkyvos ežerą“
description: The “Around Lake Rėkyva” adventure race is a Lithuanian Running Cup event held in Šiauliai by Lake Rėkyva. It is a run of approximately 14.5 km, intended for recreational and professional runners, with the aim of promoting running and encouraging a healthy lifestyle. The event takes place in spring and is part of the Lithuanian Running Cup series, which includes various races throughout Lithuania. Participants are invited to test their abilities and enjoy the natural scenery around the lake.
course_highlights: An approximately 14.5 km route around Lake Rėkyva
The race takes place in Šiauliai, surrounded by nature
A Lithuanian Running Cup event for both recreational and professional runners
additional: The entry fee is non-refundable unless the event is cancelled. Participants may change their distance or transfer their registration to another participant until early registration closes, for a €10 change fee. Registration and entry-fee administration is handled by VšĮ Bėgimo taurė. The course is not marked; participants choose their own route, so navigation and tactics are important.

name: Vantaan Maantiejuoksucup 4/5
description: Vantaa Road Running Cup is Finland’s largest and fastest winter running series, offering accessible road races in Hakunila, Vantaa. The series consists of five events, with 5 km and 10 km distances. The races attract a wide range of participants and are run on officially measured courses in sunny spring weather. Buying a series pass makes it easy to take part in all the events without registering separately each time. The event has a long tradition and also offers the opportunity to join running classes and coaching.
course_highlights: Officially measured 5 km and 10 km courses in Hakunila, Vantaa
Fast, high-quality winter races
Races are held in sunny spring weather and attract a wide range of participants
additional: A series pass covers all five events, with no separate registration required. Race numbers must be collected from the race office and returned after each race. Changing distance is possible at the information desk up to half an hour before the start. Members of Kenttäurheilijat-58 ry can take part with a series pass at no cost once their membership fee has been paid. Exact event details and results; no direct mention of the price or any special course features.

name: Skrējiens “Rozentālam pa pēdām”
description: The “In the Footsteps of Rozentāls” run is a trail run held in Saldus and dedicated to local artist Janis Rozentāls. The event brings runners together to enjoy running and pay tribute to the artist. The run has become a traditional event with a friendly atmosphere and beautiful scenery in the surrounding area.
course_highlights: Trail run in the Saldus area
Run dedicated to artist Janis Rozentāls
Traditional event with a friendly atmosphere

description: The “Latvijas valsts mežu Stirnu buks” trail running series is a popular trail running event held on some of Latvia’s most beautiful forest trails, offering a range of distances for participants of different ages and fitness levels. The races are friendly and encourage people to enjoy nature as well as the spirit of athletic competition. The series takes place in various regions of Latvia, and on March 27, 2027, a race will be held in Tērvete. Participants can choose from several distances, from routes for children and young people to longer, more technical courses for adults.
course_highlights: Trails with varied surfaces—pavement, gravel roads, forest trails and off-road
Scenic forest trails in Latvia, surrounded by natural beauty
Separate distances for children, young people and adults
additional: Online registration closes at 12:00 on the Thursday before race week. Late registration is available at the race center on race day until 30 minutes before the distance start. “ENEFIT Taku gājējs” participants start before the runners; hiking participants can set off on the course between 9:00 and 10:30, with no timekeeping. Participants can purchase a discounted season pass. Discounts apply to some distances for juniors, seniors and special groups. Participant profiles can be created using a social media account or email.

name: Bėgimas „Runway Run 2026“
location: Lietuvos oro pajėgų bazė, Šiauliai, Lithuania
description: Runway Run 2026 is a 3 km run held at the Lithuanian Air Force Base in Šiauliai. The event offers a unique opportunity to run on a runway, an unusual and exciting place to race. It is intended for school pupils, college students, the community, and the general public, promoting an active lifestyle and sports. Participants can enjoy a distinctive atmosphere and test themselves on this special course.
course_highlights: 3 km run on a runway
Location: Lithuanian Air Force Base, Šiauliai
A unique running course on airport grounds
additional: Registration is open, but prices and registration deadlines were not provided. Free parking may be available for students. The event takes place in the setting of Šiauliai State College. Event date: April 3, 2027; distance: 3 km; location: Šiauliai, Lithuanian Air Force Base. No registration details were provided.

description: Påsksmällen is a classic road and cross-country race organized by Enhörna IF, starting and finishing at Enhörna Friluftsgård in Södertälje. The race offers several categories for children, youth and adults, with distances ranging from approximately 600 metres to 10 kilometres. This well-established event will be held for the 49th time in 2027 and offers an enjoyable and challenging running experience in scenic surroundings. Participants can look forward to a family-friendly atmosphere, with on-site late registration available. Swedish Athletics Federation competition rules apply.
course_highlights: Classic road and cross-country race
Start and finish at Enhörna Friluftsgård
Several distances from 600 m to 10 km
additional: On-site late registration is available until 60 minutes before each start, for an additional fee (SEK 100 for adult categories, SEK 50 for youth categories). Start times for children’s and youth categories are between 11:00 and 11:35, while adult categories start at 12:30. Results and start lists will be published on the website. Participation constitutes consent to the publication of names and any photographs on the association’s website and social media. Regular registration closes on 27 March. On-site late registration is available until 60 minutes before each start and costs extra. Everyone is welcome in the recreational category.
