name: Kanallöpet
location: Bergvallen, Borensberg, Motala Municipality, Östergötland, Sweden
organizer: Borensbergs IF, OK Skogsströvarna, Vreta SoMK
description: Kanallöpet is an annual running event offering both competitive and recreational categories over half-marathon, 10 km and 5 km distances. All races start at 13:00 from three different locations along National Road 34 between Linköping and Motala, and finish at the Bergvallen sports ground in Borensberg. The race is organised by Borensbergs IF, OK Skogsströvarna and Vreta SoMK, and welcomes runners of different ages and abilities. Buses transport participants from the finish area to the start locations before the race. Late registration is available at the start locations for an additional fee.
course_highlights: Mass start from Ljungsbro, Sjöbacka bridge and Brunneby Musteri
Finish at the Bergvallen sports ground in Borensberg
Bus transport from the finish to the start locations before the race
additional: Race bibs can be collected at the respective start location before the start. Late registration takes place at the start locations between 11:30 and 12:30, with a 50% surcharge on the regular fee. Medals are free for participants aged 16 and under; others can buy a medal at the finish. Refreshments are available at the finish area. The distances are suitable for both competitive runners and recreational runners, with membership required for the competitive category. Registration is via the web, with payment by Swish or bank giro. The race has a long tradition and attracts around 360 participants each year.

name: SäterMaran inkl. DM i halvmaraton
description: SäterMaran is an annual running event in Säter that includes the district championships in the half marathon. The event offers several distances, including the half marathon and 10 km, and welcomes runners of different levels. It is organized by Säters IF FIK and is known for its friendly atmosphere, focus on the joy of running, and sense of local community.
course_highlights: Half marathon and 10 km distances
Low participation in the full marathon, with a focus on the half marathon and 10 km
Held in Säter amid scenic surroundings
additional: Late registration for the full marathon is closed due to low participation, but registration for the half marathon and 10 km remains open as usual.

name: adidas Premiärmilen
description: adidas Premiärmilen is a 10-kilometre race that kicks off the running season in Stockholm. The race follows a course in Norra Djurgården, with the start and finish near Universitetet metro station. Runners can test their fitness ahead of upcoming races or get their running year underway with the help of experienced pacers. The course has been officially measured and features a varied mix of surfaces: asphalt, gravel and paving slabs.
course_highlights: 10 km course in Norra Djurgården with 117 metres of elevation gain
Surfaces: asphalt (64.7%), gravel (29.8%), paving slabs (5.3%) and wooden bridge (0.2%)
Start and finish approximately 500 metres from Universitetet metro station
additional: Time limit: 2 hours from the start. Minimum age: 15 (born in 2012). Walking poles, strollers, inline skates, roller skis, bicycles and racing wheelchairs are not permitted. Wheelchair participation is allowed subject to special conditions, with participants starting in the final start group. Water stations are strategically placed along the course. The provisional start time is 11:00, and the time limit is two hours. Water stations and medical services are available along the course and at the start and finish area.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.stockholmmarathon.se/premiarmilen/): 2027-04-03 — "ANMÄLAN ÄR ÖPPEN – VI SES DEN 3 APRIL 2027" (was estimated 2027-03-27)
pipeline_log.evidence_quote: ANMÄLAN ÄR ÖPPEN – VI SES DEN 3 APRIL 2027

name: Apkārt Māras dīķim 12 h un stafete 6h
organizer: Šri Činmoja Maratona komanda; biedrība “Rīgas Šri Činmoja centrs”
description: The “Pārspēj sevi” (Surpass Yourself) run is a 12-hour individual race and a 6-hour relay held on a loop around Māras Pond in Riga. The event is intended for both amateur and professional runners. Its main goal is to help participants discover and push beyond their abilities with a positive attitude and determination. The loop is 1.355 km long, and the spirit of the race is based on perseverance and enjoyment rather than winning. Participants are encouraged to take part with a smile and keep going as they overcome both internal and external challenges during prolonged exertion.
course_highlights: Certified 1.355 km loop around Māras Pond
Choose between the 12-hour individual race and the 6-hour relay
Relay team members may change an unlimited number of times, but only after a full lap in the start/finish area
additional: Race bibs can be collected on race morning from 6:00 to 6:45 for the 12-hour race and from 12:00 to 12:45 for the 6-hour relay. Pacing is prohibited, and any assistance is allowed only in the start/finish area and in the approximately 100-metre section beyond it. The number of participants is limited, so early registration is recommended. In the relay, team members may change after a full lap in the start/finish area.

name: Tradicinės bėgimo varžybos „Senvagė-2026“
location: Senvagė and Kultūros ir poilsio parkas, Panevėžys, Lithuania
description: The traditional “Senvagė-2026” running competition is part of a Lithuanian Running Cup stage and takes place in Panevėžys, in Senvagė and Culture and Recreation Park. The event brings together running enthusiasts from various cities to promote sports, a healthy lifestyle, and the discovery of the natural and cultural beauty of Lithuania’s regions. The competition is part of the long-standing Lithuanian Running Cup tradition, which has brought together professional and amateur runners across the country since 2009. The event takes place in spring, giving participants the opportunity to enjoy nature and active recreation.
course_highlights: The competition takes place in Senvagė and Culture and Recreation Park in Panevėžys
A traditional Lithuanian Running Cup stage featuring runners from various cities
Encourages participants to discover the nature and architecture of Lithuania’s regions
additional: Registration is managed by VšĮ Bėgimo taurė. The entry fee is non-refundable unless the event is cancelled. Participants may change their distance or transfer their registration to another person no later than the close of advance registration. If changing from a more expensive to a less expensive distance, the price difference is non-refundable. The participant change fee is 10 euros. The event will take place at Kranto g. 24, Panevėžys, with online registration available.

name: Komian kirkon hölkkä
description: Komian Kirkon Jog is a running event organized by Ylistaron Kilpa-Veljet ry in the Ylistaro area. The event offers a variety of distances, including 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon, on scenic routes with changing landscapes. It is popular with locals and offers a good opportunity to test your fitness in early spring. The event is part of Ylistaron Kilpa-Veljet ry’s active event calendar and orienteering activities.
course_highlights: Varied routes: 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon
Beautiful and diverse terrain in the Ylistaro area
Route maps available for the 5 km and half marathon/10 km routes
additional: Race instructions for runners, spectators, support crew and volunteer helpers are available on the race information page. Results and registered participants can be viewed online. Route maps are available in PDF format for the 5 km and half marathon/10 km routes. The event takes place on 4 April 2027 and includes various race and participation options. Results and more information are available on the event website.

name: Arctic Marathon
description: Arctic Marathon offers a unique running experience amid the magnificent scenery of Finnish Lapland. Choose from a marathon, half marathon or 10 km distance, all taking you through Arctic nature. Participants stay in four-star Finnish cabins with saunas and enjoy full board and a range of activities, including husky safaris, ice swimming and Northern Lights viewing. The event combines sport and adventure in a unique way and is part of the international Wildmarathon series.
course_highlights: 42 km marathon route through the nature of Finnish Lapland
You can also run the 21 km half marathon or 10 km distance
The route passes through an Arctic setting where you may see the Northern Lights
additional: The event includes airport transfers from Rovaniemi to Santa Claus Holiday Village, accommodation in four-star cabins with saunas, all meals, an awards ceremony, a husky safari, ice swimming and the chance to see the Northern Lights. The programme also includes a post-run sauna and cool-down activity, as well as time to relax. The run starts at Santa Claus Holiday Village. The terrain includes snowy roads and forest tracks. Temperatures range from -12°C to -7°C. Recommended gear includes spikes and thermal clothing. Registration includes accommodation, meals, transfers and Arctic experiences.

name: Vårruset Uppsala
location: Studenternas IP, Uppsala, Uppsala Municipality, Sweden
description: Vårruset Uppsala is a recreational race for women, offering distances of 2.5 km and 5 km, with the start and finish at Studenternas IP. The event is all about the joy of movement and camaraderie, and welcomes participants of all fitness backgrounds and ambition levels. You can register individually or as part of a team; registered teams receive a picnic after crossing the finish line. Vårruset has a long tradition dating back to 1989 and offers an inclusive environment where women can feel safe and inspired to take part.
course_highlights: Certified 5 km course
Start and finish at Studenternas IP, Ulleråkersvägen 6
Picnic after the finish for teams of 5
additional: Race bibs can be collected May 3–5 at Intersport Boländerna. Picnics can be collected using the team captain’s race bib. The event area opens at 17:30, with a sponsor village and activities. There is a place to leave warm-up clothes and showers are available at the arena. Water stations and toilets are located at the start and finish. The recommended age is 11 for the 2.5 km distance (from age 7 when accompanied by an adult) and 13 for the 5 km distance (from age 11 when accompanied by an adult). Registration is binding and remains open until race day, up to 1 hour before the start. Optional timing is available, and all individual participants receive a medal, a finish-line bag and a race bib. The event is suitable for recreational runners and teams and is held in an inclusive atmosphere.

name: Östhammars Stadslopp
description: Östhammar City Race is a local city race in Östhammar, organised by Östhammars Friidrott. For 2026, Frösåkersvallen is listed as the start location. Welcome to take part in a race with strong local roots in Östhammar.

name: Östgötatidningen Mjölby Stadslopp
price_range: 325 kronor (ordinarie), 195 kronor (kyrkundan), gratis för barnloppet, tillkommer 50 kronor för efteranmälan
description: Östgötatidningen Mjölby Stadslopp is a popular running event featuring a scenic six-kilometre course through Mjölby, starting and finishing in Stadsparken. The course follows the Svartån and includes both challenging uphill sections and enjoyable downhills, with an almost entirely asphalt surface. In addition to the main race, there is also Kyrkundan, approximately 3 km, and a free children’s race, Bostadsbolaget Lilla Stadsparksloppet. All participants who cross the finish line receive a medal as proof of their effort. The race is organised by Norrköpings Löparklubb in cooperation with IK Akele and Mjölby Cykelklubb.
course_highlights: 6 km course starting and finishing in Stadsparken, Mjölby
Runs along the Svartån for most of the route; 99% asphalt
Includes challenging uphill sections and enjoyable downhills
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Intersport Mjölby on Friday 8 May, 12:00–18:00, with a 25% discount coupon. Fitness4You will lead the warm-up before the start. The children’s race has four starts between 11:00 and 11:45, with age groups up to 12 years. The main race starts at 13:00 and Kyrkundan at 13:10. Late registration is possible until 8 May for an additional fee of SEK 50. Massage is available in the start and finish area. The race takes place in Stadsparken, with the option of a company tent; registration is via the website, race bibs are collected at Intersport Mjölby, and sponsorship is possible.

name: Springtime Mariestads stadslopp

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Gratis deltagande för barn upp till årskurs 6 och personer med funktionsvariation

description: Springtime Mariestads Stadslopp is an annual road race organized by Mariestads AIF and Korpen Mariestad since 1982. The race takes place in Mariestad in early May and offers several distances for all ages and abilities, including 10 km, 5 km, a children’s race and a race for people with disabilities. The event is part of the Västsvenska Löparcupen and welcomes both competitive and recreational runners in various categories. It is a traditional, well-attended running festival with strong involvement from volunteers and participants.
course_highlights: Two main distances: 10 km (2 x 5 km) and 5 km on city streets
Children’s race and race for people with disabilities, with shorter 500 m and 2,000 m routes
Part of the Västsvenska Löparcupen
additional: Start times: Funkisloppet at 10:30, Minimara at 11:15, 10 km and 5 km at 12:00. Participation in the senior and veteran categories requires membership in a club affiliated with the Swedish Athletics Federation. Participants may run with a guide in Funkisloppet. Course maps are available via a link on the website. Multiple race distances, including 5 km, 10 km, and children’s and disability races; registration is required; medals and prizes for participants.

name: Petzl Helsinki Night Trail
description: Petzl Helsinki Night Trail is a springtime night trail running event held on the trails of Helsinki Central Park. The route is approximately 13 kilometres long, and the event starts beneath the canopy of Helsinki Olympic Stadium. Runners are timed electronically, and the maximum time allowed is 2.5 hours. The event also has a category for non-binary runners. A headlamp is mandatory for all participants.
course_highlights: Approximately 13 km route on the trails of Helsinki Central Park
Night trail running on a spring evening
Start and finish area beneath the canopy of Helsinki Olympic Stadium
additional: The race office and bib collection are open on event day from 18:00 to 20:00 at Olympic Stadium. The maximum time allowed is 2.5 hours. There are two cut-off points on the route, which runners must reach by the specified times. A headlamp is mandatory; lamps are not available for rent. The race office does not accept cash, including for on-site registrations. Free gear storage is available next to the race office. The maximum time allowed is 2.5 hours.

name: Startmilen
price_range: 2026 års avgifter: 50–80 kr för KnatteStarten, 100–250 kr för 5 km och 200–300 kr för 10 km
description: Startmilen is a recreational race in Örebro that welcomes runners of all abilities and marks the start of the outdoor running season for many. The event offers a 1 km race for children, 5 km for juniors and veterans, and 10 km for competitive runners and recreational participants. The start and finish are at Tybblelundshallen, near Örebro University, and the course runs along streets in the Almby district. The 10 km race is the district championship for Södra Svealand and is part of the Södra Svealand Running Series. Official timing is provided for all races except the children’s race.
course_highlights: Start and finish outside Tybblelundshallen at Örebro University
The course runs along streets in the Almby district
The 5 km and 10 km courses are certified by a federation course measurer
additional: Race numbers are distributed at Tybblelundshallen from around 10:30 on race day. Timing uses a transponder, which is loaned out when race numbers are distributed and must be returned after finishing. A fee of SEK 800 applies for a lost transponder. All races except KnatteStarten are timed. Prize ceremonies take place at 13:40 for the 5 km and 15:30 for the 10 km. All finishers receive a medal. All finishers receive a medal. Information about distances and fees is from the 2026 edition and may change for 2027.

name: Tjust Trail Run
description: Tjust Trail Run is a trail race organised by Tjust Bike & Running Club in Västervik. The race offers a challenging and sweaty competition on winding trails, over beautiful rocky outcrops and through the scenic nature of Småland. Participants get to experience the Småland forest in a unique way, running across varied terrain. Welcome to a wonderful running experience in a beautiful natural setting.
course_highlights: Winding trails through the Småland forest
Sections over beautiful rocky outcrops
Beautiful and varied terrain
additional: Changes to the race distance are possible by email until 31 March. On the longest distance (The Long Run), runners must complete a lap by 11:45 to be allowed to continue for the second lap. Race bibs must be clearly visible. Trail shoes and a mobile phone are recommended. If withdrawing, participants must notify a race official or call the number provided. Transport can be arranged from aid stations if needed. Trail shoes and a mobile phone are recommended. Distance changes can be made until 31 March.

pipeline_log.evidence_quote: 10 april 2027 kommer Tjust Bike & Running Club anordna den elfte upplagan av TJUST TRAIL RUN.

name: Kurts 300:e maraton - halvmaran
description: Kurt’s 300th Marathon is a special race organized by Hultsfreds Löparklubb to celebrate Kurt Gustavsson’s 300th marathon and his 80th birthday. The race follows a 5-lap course along Lake Hulingen in Hultsfred, combining park paths and asphalt. The half marathon consists of two long laps and one shorter lap. The start and finish are at the entrance to Knektavallen, where changing rooms, showers, and toilets are available. After the race, participants are invited to a get-together with food and good company.
course_highlights: 5-lap course along Lake Hulingen
20% asphalt, the rest park paths
Two water stations offering water, sports drink, cola, and fruit
additional: The start and finish are at the entrance to Knektavallen, facing Lake Hulingen. Changing rooms, showers, and toilets are available at Knektavallen. Bib numbers are distributed from 08:00. Runners expecting to take over 5 hours start at 09:00. After the race, a get-together with food and good company is offered at around 14:30, about 1 km from Knektavallen at the restaurant. The course is officially measured and the race is sanctioned. The start and finish are at Knektavallen; changing rooms, showers, toilets, and water stations are available according to the organizer’s information.

name: 6/12 stundu skrējiens “Pārspēj sevi”
organizer: Šrī Činmoja Maratona komanda; Biedrība “Rīgas Šrī Činmoja centrs”
description: The 6- and 12-hour “Beat Your Own Best” run takes place around Māras Pond in Riga, giving participants the opportunity to push their limits and experience personal growth. The certified course is 1,355 km long, allowing runners to focus on sustained endurance and pace. The event is organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team, which has served the running community for almost 50 years, inspiring athletes to develop physically and spiritually. Registration is by email, and the entry fee depends on the payment date. Race numbers are provided to participants on race day.
course_highlights: A certified 1,355 km course around Māras Pond
An endurance run with 6- and 12-hour events
An event with almost 50 years of tradition and spiritual inspiration
additional: The number of participants is limited, so early registration is recommended. The entry fee depends on the payment date, not the registration date. Race numbers are issued on race day. To register, email the required information. No refunds are given if a participant does not take part.

name: Skrējiens un soļošana pa Preiļu ielām “Cīruļputenis”
organizer: Preiļu novada Bērnu un jauniešu sporta skola
description: The “Cīruļputenis” run and walk through the streets of Preiļi is a traditional spring running and walking event in the city, bringing together athletes and active residents of all ages. Held on the city streets, the event offers a chance to enjoy running and walking in a friendly, sporting atmosphere. The competition is organized by the Preiļi Municipality Children and Youth Sports School, which provides professional support and a safe environment for participants. It is a great opportunity for both beginners and experienced athletes to test their abilities and enjoy an active day with fellow sports enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Running and walking through the streets of Preiļi
A friendly, sporting atmosphere for all age groups
Organized by the Preiļi Municipality Children and Youth Sports School
additional: In previous years, the competition has started outside Preiļi Municipality Council or on Raiņa Boulevard.

name: Skärholmsloppet
description: Skärholmsloppet is a family-friendly fun run in Stockholm, with races for all ages, including a Mini Race for the youngest participants, the Little Skärholms Race for children from preschool class through Year 6, a timed 5 km race for participants aged 13 and over, and a 1.6 km Fun Run for all ages. The event is organised by Löparakademin, a non-profit organisation that supports young people in million-programme suburbs in their personal development through running. There will be music and entertainment, with DJs along the course, and all participants receive a medal at the finish. Skärholmsloppet is an inclusive, encouraging running experience that promotes physical activity and health equity.
course_highlights: Timed 5 km race for participants aged 13 and over
Little Skärholms Race, approximately 1.6 km, for children from preschool class through Year 6
500-metre Mini Race for children aged 0–6, with the option to run together with parents
additional: Start and finish at Puckelbollplanen. Start times: Mini Race 10:30; Little Skärholms Race from 11:30, with different start groups by age; 1.6 km Fun Run 12:25; 5 km race 13:00. Registration is free and available until 17:00 on 14 May. Late registration may be available at bib collection and on race day, subject to availability. Music and DJs along the course provide extra encouragement. The race takes place at Puckelbollplanen in Stockholm, with music and entertainment along the course, and all participants receive a medal at the finish.

name: Siguldas apļi
organizer: Biedrība “Siguldas Maratona klubs & Siguldas Takas” sadarbībā ar Siguldas novada pašvaldību

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: OPEN, SV30 – SV50+ dalības maksa 5.00 eur

description: Sigulda Circuits is a series of running and Nordic walking training races in Sigulda, held in several stages at different locations around the city. The aim of the races is to promote an active lifestyle, encourage meaningful ways to spend free time, and bring together friends and like-minded people. The series offers opportunities for schoolchildren, families, and individual runners, with a range of distances and a friendly atmosphere. The races are organized by the association “Siguldas Maratona klubs & Siguldas Takas” in cooperation with Sigulda Municipality.
course_highlights: Running and Nordic walking routes at various locations around Sigulda
Stages take place at Festivity Square, near the Sigulda bobsleigh track, and in Gutman’s Cave
Nature trails and urban scenery in Sigulda Municipality
additional: Participant timing chips are issued from 17:30. Participants with an S! Card receive a 20% discount on the entry fee. Use of the electronic timing system equipment is free of charge. Participants can look forward to pleasant surprises and prizes at the end of the series.

name: TEC 200 miles
description: TEC (Tyresö Extreme Challenge) is an ultramarathon held at Alby Friluftsgård in Tyresö, Stockholm. The event offers several distances, including the 46 km MiniUltra, Backyard Ultra, 50 miles, 100 miles and 200 miles, on a beautiful and challenging 11.5 km loop course. The start and finish are at the TEC tent beside the outdoor gym, and the event takes place over a weekend in April, with different start times for each distance. It is a tough and fun challenge for ultrarunners, with the option to change distance during the race.
course_highlights: 11.5 km loop course at Alby Friluftsgård
Backyard Ultra course of approximately 6.7 km, with hourly starts
Aid station at the start/finish
additional: Start times: 200 miles starts Friday at 10:00, with a 54-hour time limit; Backyard Ultra starts Friday at 18:00, with hourly starts and a 46-hour time limit; 50 and 100 miles start Saturday at 10:00, with a 30-hour time limit; MiniUltra 46 km starts Sunday at 08:00, with an 8-hour time limit. Bibs can be collected from Friday at 08:00 at the TEC tent. Changing rooms, showers and sauna are currently unavailable due to renovation. Setting up your own tents or aid tables at the start/finish or along the course is not permitted. Runners’ bags are stored in the tent in a designated area. Changing distance during the race is permitted, but a Swedish record can only be set in the distance entered. The finish closes Sunday at 16:00. Previous editions have also included the 50 miles, 100 miles and Backyard Ultra distances.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://new.tec100.se/?p=9313): 2027-04-16 — "16-18 april 2027 i Alby, Tyresö!" (was estimated 2027-04-16)

name: Vantaan Maantiejuoksucup 5/5
description: The Vantaa Road Running Cup is Finland’s largest and fastest winter running series, consisting of five events in Hakunila and Tikkurila, Vantaa. The races offer accessible road-running competitions, with the option to enter using a series pass or by paying for a single race. The route runs around Sotunki Upper Secondary School, which also serves as the event centre. At the final event, the top runners in each category are awarded prizes based on points, and runners are also encouraged with bonuses for course records. The event is open to runners of all levels and also includes a running school with coaching.
course_highlights: The route runs around Sotunki Upper Secondary School in Vantaa
Sotunki Upper Secondary School serves as the event centre, with changing rooms and showers
Sports drinks are available at the finish area, along with a café
additional: A series pass lets you take part in all five events without registering separately. Race numbers are collected from the race office and returned after each race. Prizes are awarded based on points after the final event, and runners must take part in at least two events to qualify for overall prizes. The running school offers coaching and training sessions, and members can participate in the road-running cup for free by claiming a pass in advance. The event is held in Tikkurila, Vantaa, and includes several races, such as the 5K and 10K. These popular local events offer accessible road-running races.

name: Kaarina Rata-Ultra
description: Kaarina Rata Ultra is an annual track-running event featuring six- and 12-hour races, as well as a track marathon and track half marathon. The event offers a challenging and varied running experience at Kaarina Central Sports Field, where the running direction changes halfway through the race. The competition has been awarded IAU Bronze Label status and attracts both elite runners and enthusiastic recreational runners. The event also has a strong community spirit and a long tradition that includes several Finnish records.
course_highlights: The running direction changes after 3 hours
The course consists of 400 m and 430.66 m laps
The competition takes place at Kaarina Central Sports Field
additional: The number of participants is limited to 120. The running direction changes after 3 hours. Elite runners use lanes 1 and 2; other runners use lanes 5 and 6. The race office is open on race day from 08:30 to 09:30 and 11:30 to 12:30. Race numbers must be collected at least 30 minutes before the start of your distance. Late registration is possible up to one hour before the start, but payment is accepted in cash only. Entry fees are non-refundable, but in the event of illness, participation may be transferred to the following year with a medical certificate. There is ample parking, and directions are provided. Payment can also be made with sports and culture vouchers.

name: Rock The Trail

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmälan kan göras via hemsidan fram till tisdagen 13/4 kl 23.59

late_fee.price: Swish betalning på plats, hamburgare kan ta slut

description: Rock The Trail is a trail race on paths across varied terrain in Hågadalen/Nåsten, Uppsala. The race offers four categories, including a children’s race of approximately 1.5 km and longer distances of 8 km, 16 km and 48 km. The start and finish are at OK Linné, and participants are offered hamburgers and drinks after the race. The course features scenic trails and mixed terrain, and the longer distances are registered with ITRA.
course_highlights: Trail running on paths across varied terrain in Hågadalen/Nåsten
The longer-distance course is approximately 16 km, adjusted from the previous 15.8 km
Children’s race of approximately 1.5 km around the start and finish area
additional: Late registration is available on site with payment by Swish, but hamburgers after the race may run out. Umara sports drink is served during the race. Toilets are available at the start/finish. Parking is limited; taking public transport or cycling is recommended. The start location is listed as OK Linné, Tallbacksvägen 68.

name: Varvetmilen Sollentuna
description: Varvetmilen Sollentuna is an annual running race organized by Turebergs Friidrottsklubb at Sollentunavallen in Sollentuna. The race offers runners of all ages a great opportunity to compete on a well-organized course with good training facilities. Turebergs Friidrottsklubb is an experienced organizer that also hosts several other athletics and running events throughout the year. Sollentunavallen is a centrally located, easily accessible venue that contributes to a pleasant race environment.
course_highlights: The race takes place on the running track at Sollentunavallen
Organized by Turebergs Friidrottsklubb, an experienced club
Centrally located venue with good training facilities
additional: Turebergs Friidrottsklubb covers up to 15 race entries per season for its members. Late registration and failure to participate are charged to the participant. Training at Sollentunavallen may be affected by other events and football matches, but the track is generally available for running. Previous editions have offered Minivarvet for children.

name: Kurts Marathon / Kurts 300:e maraton (Hultsfred) — inkl. halvmaraton & Backyard Ultra
description: Kurt 300 Marathon in Hultsfred is a welcoming and inclusive race celebrating Kurt Gustavsson’s 300th marathon and his 80th birthday. The race offers both a marathon and a half marathon on a scenic 5-lap course along Lake Hulingen, combining park paths and asphalt. The course is officially measured and the race is sanctioned, with timing and water stations along the way. After the race, participants are invited to a social gathering with food and good company near the start and finish area.
course_highlights: 5-lap course along Lake Hulingen, with the final lap 3 km shorter
20% of the course is asphalt; the rest is park paths
Two refreshment stations with water, sports drink, cola and energy supplies at the lap point and at 4 km
additional: Start and finish at the entrance to Knektavallen facing Lake Hulingen. Changing rooms, showers and toilets are available at Knektavallen. Bib numbers are distributed from 08:00. Runners expecting to take more than 5 hours should start at 09:00. After the race, a social gathering with food and good company is planned for around 14:30, approximately 1 km from Knektavallen. Start and finish at Knektavallen.

name: BYU Lūša pēdās Jēkabpilī
description: BYU In the Footsteps of the Lynx in Jēkabpils is a unique running event where participants compete by running a set distance every hour until only one finisher remains. The race is physically and mentally challenging, attracting both local and international runners. The event is well organized, with precise timing and a friendly atmosphere that fosters sportsmanship and a sense of community. The participant list reflects a broad range of runners from Latvia and neighboring countries.
course_highlights: Run a set distance every hour until only one finisher remains
The race takes place in Jēkabpils, with precise timing using RFID equipment
The event attracts both local and international participants
additional: Timing with RFID equipment ensures accurate recording of results. The participant list is available online, and registration takes place online. The race is part of a wider range of events organized by RaceTiming.LV.

name: Aizkraukles novada 12. pusmaratons
location: Aizkraukles novada Sporta centrs, Lāčplēša iela 21B, Aizkraukle, Latvia
description: The 12th Aizkraukle Half Marathon is an annual running event held at the Aizkraukle Municipality Sports Centre. It offers a 21.097 km half-marathon and a 5.3 km fun run. The event also includes children’s races over various distances, providing an opportunity for all age groups to take part. The start and finish are at the Aizkraukle Municipality Sports Centre, and the course runs through the city streets and past landmarks such as the Aizkraukle History and Art Museum and the Evangelical Lutheran Church. The event is friendly and prioritizes participants’ safety by closing roads during the races.
course_highlights: The half-marathon course runs through Aizkraukle’s city streets and past notable landmarks
Children’s races over various distances: 300 m, 500 m and 1 km
Start and finish at the Aizkraukle Municipality Sports Centre
additional: Adult registration is from 10:00 to 11:00, and children’s registration is from 10:00 to 10:30. The children’s race starts at 10:45; the half-marathon and fun run start at 12:00. Road sections will be closed from 10:00 to 14:30 to ensure participants’ safety. The half-marathon and fun run are scheduled to start at 12:00, while the children’s races begin at 10:45. The event takes place at the Aizkraukle Municipality Sports Centre, Lāčplēša Street 21B.

name: Rudes Maratons un Kultūras festivāls
location: Rude, Rojas pagasts, Talsi Municipality, Latvia
description: The Rudes Marathon and Culture Festival offers a running route around Rude that is relatively flat and approximately 1.8 km long. This loop follows roads, providing an easy and accessible distance for both beginners and experienced runners. The event combines sporting activities with the atmosphere of a cultural festival, creating a friendly, community-focused environment.
course_highlights: Relatively flat loop
The route follows roads
Approximately 1.8 km long
additional: The route profile and elevation data are available for download. The route is also suitable for hiking and is easy to access using various route-planning and navigation options with plotaroute.com tools.

name: Vårruset (Stockholm)
description: Vårruset in Stockholm is a women’s fun run offering 2.5 km and 5 km distances in Norra Djurgården. The event celebrates the joy of movement and togetherness, and welcomes everyone regardless of fitness background or ambition level. Participants can register individually or as part of a team; registered teams receive a picnic after the finish. The event has a long tradition dating back to 1989 and aims to promote women’s health and create an inclusive environment for all participants.
course_highlights: Certified 5 km course in Norra Djurgården
Start and finish at Frescatiängen, near Stockholm University
The course follows gravel paths and forest trails in a scenic setting
additional: Race bibs are mailed to participants who register before 17 April; otherwise, they must be collected at the event. Teams of five receive a picnic after the finish. Changing rooms and showers are available for a fee. The recommended minimum age is 13 for the 5 km and 11 for the 2.5 km; younger participants may take part when accompanied by an adult. You can opt out of timing when registering. The event area is easiest to reach on foot, by bike or by public transport. Parking is limited and not recommended. The event is part of Sweden’s largest women’s fitness tour and focuses on community and health.

name: KOMIA Trail Cup
description: KOMIA Trail Cup is a trail-running series suitable for anyone interested in trail running, whatever their ability level. The series takes place on marked routes in the nearby forests of Seinäjoki, with distances of approximately 5–7 kilometres. The events are held on weekday evenings, allowing runners to enjoy the tranquillity of nature and varied terrain. Points are awarded at each event, and the best runners are rewarded at the end of the season.
course_highlights: The route follows marked nature trails in the nearby forests of Seinäjoki
Varied trail sections, which may include wet areas after rain
The start and finish are at the Katajalaakso playground, immediately next to the event centre
additional: Registration and race-number collection take place at the event venue from 17:00 to 17:50. The race starts with a mass start, but there is also the option to run without being timed. Race numbers must be kept visible throughout the run. Baggage storage is limited, and there are no toilets at the event venue. Participants are advised to have their own leisure-time insurance. Littering in nature is prohibited. Participants must register separately for each event.

name: Sandbäckens Norrköpingsstafetten
description: Sandbäckens Norrköpingsstafetten is a relay race starting, with exchanges and finish in Folkparken in Norrköping. Teams of four each run a fast-paced four-kilometre leg. The event offers a wonderful team atmosphere, with men’s, women’s and mixed teams, with or without timing. The course stays close to the event centre, with upbeat music along the route and spectators cheering at the exchanges and finish. It’s an evening filled with exercise, community and joy, where children and young people can take part for free thanks to HSB.
course_highlights: Start, exchanges and finish in Folkparken in Norrköping
Each team member runs 4 km on a fast-paced course close to the event centre
Upbeat music along the route and spectators cheering at the exchanges and finish
additional: Leg massages are offered by Helhetshälsan both before the start and after the finish. All participants receive a medal sponsored by Azets. Performance prizes go to the first team in each category, and great prizes are drawn among all participating teams. ICA Smedby provides participants with energy-packed products after the finish. The race takes place in Folkparken, with on-site late registration available; participants can register via the website or on race day. Participants receive energy-packed products after the race.

name: Vårruset
description: Vårruset in Västerås is a women’s fun run offering 2.5 km and 5 km distances through central Västerås, with the start and finish at Lögastrand. The event celebrates the joy of being active and a sense of community, and welcomes everyone regardless of fitness background or ambition. Participants can register individually or as a team; registered teams receive a picnic after finishing. The event has a long tradition dating back to 1989 and aims to promote women’s health and create an inclusive setting for exercise and socialising.
course_highlights: Measured 5 km course through central Västerås
Start and finish at Lögastrand
Picnic after the finish for teams of 5
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Intersport in Livli Shopping Centre Erikslund in the days before the race. The event area has supervised bag drop, a water station and toilets. Picnics can be collected using the team leader’s race bib. Recommended ages are 13 for 5 km and 11 for 2.5 km; younger participants may take part accompanied by an adult. Participants can opt out of timing when registering. Training meetups are organised in several locations ahead of the race. Participants receive a race bib, a finish-line bag and a medal; teams consist of 5 people. The event is open to runners, joggers and walkers. Registration is online. The event is part of the national Vårruset series.

name: Kolmården Vertical

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 100 kr per deltagare fram till den 19 april.

description: Kolmården Vertical is a challenging 5 km trail race with 300 metres of elevation gain in beautiful, technical terrain at Hults Bruk in Kolmården. The course features lovely trails and technical sections where strong legs and quick feet are an advantage. The race starts at the old football field and includes steep hills, singletrack and scenic views over Lake Ågelsjön. Welcome to this somewhat classic race, which offers a serious challenge for trail enthusiasts.
course_highlights: 5 km with 300 metres of elevation gain in challenging terrain
Technical sections with singletrack and steep hills
Beautiful views over Lake Ågelsjön and a passage past the hermit’s Jakobs Cave
additional: The race starts at the old football field at Hults Bruk. Prizes are awarded to the top three in each category, along with raffle prizes. A ball field is located 200 metres from the parking area. Cancellation and accident insurance are available as add-ons. The course’s technical sections include “Koklämman,” with a rope to help runners climb, and the race passes a cosy barbecue area beneath a large rock overhang. Trail running, technical sections, start at Hults Bruk; the course description includes hills and trail sections.

name: ÜLEMISTE Grit 2027
organizer: Eesti Ööjooks - Night Run Estonia ja Liikumisharrastuse kompetentsikeskus

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Virtuaalne osalemine: 24€ (sisaldab medalit, tulemuse haldamise tasu ja saatmiskulu)

description: Ülemiste Grit is an immersive endurance running event held inside Ülemiste Centre in Tallinn. Participants can choose a 1-, 2- or 3-hour challenge, running a 552-metre loop. The event is not a race, but an opportunity to enjoy moving and challenge yourself: you can run, walk or power-walk. There is an aid station on the course offering water, juice and solid food, and a medal and gift bag await at the finish. The event has a limited number of participants and offers a unique indoor running experience.
course_highlights: The course runs on the second floor of Ülemiste Centre; each loop is 552 m long.
The indoor course has tiled floors and extensive glass surfaces, so take care.
The aid station offers water, juice, Coca-Cola and solid food (banana, pickles, bread, meat product, chocolate and orange).
additional: Race pack collection takes place from 19:00 to 21:30 on the third floor of the Ülemiste Centre parking garage. Bag storage at the event centre costs €2. Medals and gift bags are handed out at the event centre after finishing. After finishing, participants are asked to stay in the finish area briefly for a group photo. Participants in the 2-hour distance are asked to enter the start area via the first floor (take the escalator near Rimi). The event is sold out; on-site registration is not available. The virtual run option ends on 22.04.2027. Participants can leave their own drinks bottles along the course, labelled with their names. The event is non-competitive and emphasises cooperation and safety. Participants receive gift bags; the course is designed to be an experience, not for chasing records.

name: Mustavuori Uphill Challenge
organizer: Mustavuori Uphill Challenge / Great Event Oy
description: Mustavuori Uphill Challenge is a unique trail running event in Tampere, where participants challenge themselves by running up the steep slopes of Mustavuori and back down within their chosen time limit (4, 6 or 8 hours). The event offers an encouraging, welcoming atmosphere, energising aid stations and wonderful scenery. The day ends with a chance to relax in a tent sauna and hot tub, providing the perfect recovery moment after the race. Mustavuori Uphill Challenge is suitable both for those aiming for records and for anyone who enjoys a physical challenge.
course_highlights: Run up and down the steep slopes of Mustavuori
Choose a 4-, 6- or 8-hour endurance run
Aid stations offer tasty energy refuelling and fresh drinks
additional: The race office opens at 8.00. Starts begin at 10.00 for the 8-hour event, 11.00 for the 6-hour event and 12.00 for the 4-hour event. The finish closes at 18.00. Participation changes are free up to 14 days before the start; after that, a change fee of €15 applies. Entry can be transferred to the following year once, without giving a reason. There is an aid station in the finish area. Participants are advised to wear trail shoes and weather-appropriate clothing, and to bring their own water bottle or cup. Changing facilities and showers are available at the event site.

name: adidas Premiärhalvan
description: adidas Premiärhalvan is a half marathon that runs through scenic parts of Gärdet and Södra Djurgården in Stockholm. The start and finish are at Sportgärdet on Lindarängsvägen. The race is perfect preparation for adidas Stockholm Marathon, but also suits anyone who wants to welcome spring with a great half marathon in an urban setting. The course has been officially measured and features a varied mix of asphalt, gravel and paving stones, with a total elevation gain of 183 metres.
course_highlights: The course runs through Gärdet and Södra Djurgården, starting and finishing at Sportgärdet on Lindarängsvägen
Surfaces include asphalt, gravel and paving stones
Total elevation gain of 183 metres, with kilometre markers at every kilometre
additional: The race has a time limit of 3 hours. Enervit sports drink will be available during the race. Bib collection takes place at Gärdet sports field on Friday 24 April from 10:00 to 19:00 and Saturday 25 April from 08:00 to 11:00. Participants who collect their bib on Friday receive IcePower Cold Gel and a Scholl foot mask. Registered participants receive 25% off adidas shoes and clothing at the adidas pop-up store at Löplabbet from 20–26 April. Race rules prohibit, among other things, strollers, inline skates, roller skis and competition wheelchairs. Wheelchair participants start in the final starting group, and guides are free of charge. The provisional start time is 11:00 and the time limit is three hours. Minimum age: 17. Race-day registration is available until 09:00, subject to availability.

name: Munkastigen Trailrun
location: Olshammar, Askersund Municipality, Örebro County, Sweden
description: Munkastigen Trailrun is an ultramarathon through the enchanted forests of Tiveden, from Olshammar on the shore of Lake Vättern to Laxå. The race follows a historic trail used by monks in the 15th century and offers challenging, scenic terrain. A new course is planned for 2027, with a longer distance of approximately 53 km for the Swedish Championship categories. The course is well marked, and participants receive a map to minimize the risk of taking a wrong turn.
course_highlights: Historic trail used by monks in the 15th century
Enchanted forest landscape in Tiveden
Well-marked course with two aid stations
additional: Bus transport from Laxå to the start in Olshammar is included in the entry fee for individual starters. For teams, transport is included for the first runner. Timing is recorded using SportIdent every 10 km. Participants receive a plaque and are served a hot meal after finishing. Teams can consist of 2–5 runners, with exchanges permitted anywhere along the course. The regular race can be completed individually or in teams of 2–5 runners. There are two aid stations, and bus transport from Laxå to the start in Olshammar is included in the entry fee. Finishers receive a plaque and a hot meal after finishing. The organizer’s website contains maps, an elevation profile, and a GPX file.

name: Vårmilen (Lidingöloppet Vårmilen)
organizer: Lidingöloppet (IFK Lidingö Friidrott och IFK Lidingö Skid- och Orienteringsklubb)
description: Lidingöloppet Vårmilen is a popular running challenge featuring one of Stockholm’s most beautiful 10 km courses. The race takes place on scenic, hilly trails through forests and meadows and along the archipelago coast, with a soft, gentle surface suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. Participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km. The race qualifies runners for seeding at TCS Lidingöloppet, offering the chance to get a better start group in the classic autumn trail race. Water and sports drinks are available at aid stations, and there is entertainment along the course. After the race, refreshments and light food are available to buy at Lidingövallen.
course_highlights: Winding forest trails and hilly terrain
The course is mostly on soft trails and gravel
Beautiful scenery featuring forests, meadows and the archipelago coast
additional: Start and finish at Lidingövallen. Aid stations with water and sports drinks at 5 km and at the finish. The course is marked with white flagging tape and spray-painted arrows, with course marshals at difficult points. Changing rooms with showers and a sauna are available at Lidingövallen. Free bag storage is available, but not for electronic items. Valuables storage costs 20 kr. Group warm-up before the start. Public transport or cycling is recommended because parking is limited. Category changes and name changes are possible for a fee. A children’s race (Knattarnas Vårmil) takes place before the main races. The 10 km starts at 11:00 and the 5 km at 11:10 on 24 April 2027. The 10 km course has an aid station at 5 km and drinks at the finish. Parking is limited; public transport or cycling is recommended.

description: Pilsēttakas Stirnu buks is part of the popular Stirnu buks trail-running series, held on Latvia’s scenic forest trails. This event offers a range of distances for participants of different ages and fitness levels, encouraging an active lifestyle and enjoyment of nature. The race welcomes both beginners and experienced trail runners, with particular attention given to youth and children’s categories. The event is well organized and offers the option to participate individually or in teams, as well as season passes.
course_highlights: Routes with varied surfaces: asphalt, gravel roads, forest trails, forest firebreaks and off-road terrain
Five different distances are available for various age groups and fitness levels
Late registration and participation in a non-timed walk are available on race day
additional: Late registration is available at the race center on race day, up to 30 minutes before the start of the relevant distance. “ENEFIT Taku gājējs” participants start first; walking participants may set out on the course from 9:00 to 10:30 without timekeeping. Walkers should note that after 12:00 they may encounter fast runners on the courses. Season passes are available at a discount, but an additional fee applies if the “Vilks” distance is selected on 20 June.

name: Suvi-ilta Trail Run
description: Suvi-ilta Trail Run Tammela is a trail running event held at Saari Folk Park in Tammela. The route passes through varied terrain, including lakeshore, ridges, forest and hills. The finish is at the foot of the Kaukola observation tower, which offers a magnificent view over the lake highlands. The event has a warm, welcoming atmosphere and is popular with trail runners.
course_highlights: A route of approximately 8.2 km through varied terrain
The route goes around Lake Suujärvi, through Kaukola village and onto the Kaukola ridge
The finish is at the foot of the Kaukola observation tower; 150 metres of elevation gain
additional: The number of participants is limited to 200 runners. The race office opens at 10:00, and late registration closes at 11:00. Live timing is available online. The race number must be attached to the front of the shirt. Trail running shoes are recommended. Café services are available at the race office. Prizes and raffle prizes will be awarded. Participation is at your own risk, and the organiser has not insured the competitors. The event is held together with the Forssa Suvi-ilta running and cycling event. Café services are available at the race office.

name: Sportland Kõrvemaa Kevadjooks 2027
location: Sportland Kõrvemaa Matka- ja Suusakeskus, Kõrvemaa, Estonia
description: Sportland Kõrvemaa Spring Run is a beautiful spring running event held amid the ancient natural landscapes of the Kõrvemaa Nature Reserve. The event centre is conveniently located near Tallinn at the Sportland Kõrvemaa Hiking and Ski Centre. The varied routes include a 16 km main distance, a 6 km run and a youth run. Free children’s runs, activities for the whole family and childcare are also available. After the run, participants can enjoy hot soup, a sauna and hot tubs, as well as an exciting treasure hunt at Anija Manor.
course_highlights: The entire route runs through a nature reserve
A range of distances: 16 km, 6 km and a youth run
Event centre conveniently located near Tallinn
additional: Free bus transport is provided for participants between Aegviidu railway station and the event centre, in both directions. The event centre has childcare, a bag drop, a Stebby wellbeing area with Fysiotikker, and a Sportland pop-up shop where you can top up on running gear. For children, Aegviidu RMK offers nature-themed activities, a low ropes course, a mini-pancake café, and horse and pony rides (bring cash). A sauna and hot tubs will be open after the run. Participants can enter a draw to win a stylish Trek city bike at the Spring Run awards ceremony at 14:00. Group discounts: 10% off when registering at least 5 participants, and 20% off when registering at least 10 participants. A 50% discount is available for seniors (60+) and young people (up to 17) when registering in advance; the minimum final price is €15. The event takes place on 25 April 2027, offering a choice of distances and the chance to enjoy outdoor exercise and time with family.

name: Bålsta Stadslopp
description: Bålsta Stadslopp is a fast and enjoyable spring race held in central Bålsta, starting and finishing at Gröna Dalens IP. The race has grown steadily since it began in 2019 and is known as a PB course, where many runners beat their previous records. The course is a 5 km loop that can be run once or twice, with 99% asphalt and a finish on an athletics track. The event is marked by speed, joy and community, and welcomes runners of all ages and categories.
course_highlights: 5 km loop in central Bålsta, finishing at Gröna Dalens IP
99% asphalt, with a finish on an athletics track
Fast course with a small incline removed to make even faster times possible
additional: Bib collection starts at 08:00 outside Gröna Dalens IP. Start times are 09:30 for 5 km and 10:45 for 10 km. Runners self-seed at the start to reduce congestion. Late registration is available online until 1 hour before the start, subject to availability. There is a bag drop and limited changing facilities. Take the commuter train to Bålsta station, within walking distance of the start/finish. Several parking areas are nearby. Badhusvägen is closed to traffic on race day. Registration is open. The sports drink served in the cups is Umara U Sport Lemon.

name: Kvantumloppet (Kvantumloppet med Trail 7+17km)
description: Kvantumloppet Trail is organized by Huddinge AIS at Källbrinks IP and offers 7 and 17 km of running in Gömmarskogen. The courses mainly follow narrow forest trails and follow Gömmaren’s yellow trail for 7 km and black-and-white trail for 17 km. Expect some technical terrain with rocks, roots and steep hills, mixed with scenic sections. The race is for anyone looking to challenge themselves on the trails, whether running, jogging or moving at their own pace.
course_highlights: The 7 km course follows Gömmaren’s yellow trail, called Sparven.
The 17 km course follows Gömmaren’s black-and-white trail, called Skatan.
Mostly narrow forest trails with technical sections, rocks, roots and steep hills.
additional: Start and finish at Källbrinks IP. The courses are stated to be approximately 5% longer or shorter than the indicated distance.

name: STHLM Trail Run
description: STHLM Trail Run is a trail race held on Norra Djurgården in Stockholm, with the start and finish at Fisksjöäng. The race offers two distances, 5 km and 10 km, starting at 11:00 and 12:00, respectively. The course offers a wonderful experience in nature, with varied terrain, and is easy to reach by public transport. The event is open to young people aged 11 and over when accompanied by a parent or guardian, and has a friendly, inclusive atmosphere. All participants receive a medal, refreshments along the course and race timing with a bib.
course_highlights: Trail running on Norra Djurgården through varied natural scenery
Start and finish at Fisksjöäng, near Ropsten metro station
Refreshment stations along the course and chip timing
additional: The start and finish are at Fisksjöäng, a 10-minute walk from Ropsten metro station. Bibs can be collected the Friday before the race at the Icebug store in Stockholm or at the venue on race day. The bib is personal and must be worn visibly on the chest, with the chip unfolded. A medal, refreshments along the course, finish-line services and race timing are included. Late registration is possible up to 1 hour before the start. Participants receive a discount on Icebug running shoes. A bib with race timing, refreshments along the course, a medal and finish-line services are included. The price information applies to the price periods listed on the organizer’s website and may refer to an edition other than 2027.

name: Palangos pusės maratono bėgimas „PRALENK ŽIRGĄ“
description: The Palanga Half Marathon “OUTRUN THE HORSE” is a high-quality half-marathon event held in celebration of St. George’s Day. The event aims to establish Palanga as a European City of Sport and encourage physical activity and a healthy lifestyle among residents and visitors. The race takes place in the resorts of Palanga and Šventoji, expanding the range of mass sporting events and encouraging local community participation in sports.
course_highlights: Start in Šventoji and finish in Palanga
The course is marked and adapted for runners
Promotes a healthy lifestyle and popularizes sports
additional: Traffic restrictions and public relations campaigns are planned to ensure the event runs smoothly.

name: Värmlandsstafetten

tiers.description: Ordinarie anmälningsavgift fram till och med 27/4 1 500:-/lag.

description: The Värmland Relay in Karlstad is a relay race where teams of 5–15 participants compete together on a flat circuit around Sundstatjärn, approximately 1,270 metres long. All teams start and finish at the same time and have two hours to carry the relay baton as far as possible, changing runners after each lap. The relay is open to everyone, and teams can be mixed freely, creating a fun, social competition that promotes community and health. There is an awards ceremony after the race, and light refreshments are available on site. First-time participants buy a team baton featuring their team logo, which is used at every competition.
course_highlights: Flat circuit around Sundstatjärn, approximately 1,270 metres per lap
Asphalt surface
Runners change over with the relay baton in the exchange zone by the arena
additional: Each team must buy a baton featuring its team logo in its first year, for 500:-. After the race, results can be engraved on the baton for a fee. Team leaders collect race bibs, chips and the baton at the arena. Paid parking is available at Sundstabadet. Changing rooms and showers are available at Idrottshuset. The card-payment refreshments stand opens at 16:30. Medical services and toilets are available at the arena. Teams may bring their own tents and beach flags to decorate the arena. Teams consist of 5–15 participants. Runners change after each lap, and the same person may not run multiple laps in a row. The baton costs 500 kr in the first year (750 kr for late registration).

name: KAU släppet 2026
description: KAU-släppet is a 5 km race around the Karlstad University campus. It is organised by the university's student support unit together with the Sport and Health Coach programme, and 2026 was its third year. The start is at building 21 and the finish at the square by building 1. You choose whether to run or walk.
course_highlights: 5 km course around Karlstad University
Start at building 21, finish at the square by building 1
Runners and walkers both welcome
additional: Entry is via RaceID. Information from Öyvind Alster at Karlstad University.

name: Porkkala Coast Trail
description: Porkkala Coast Trail kicks off the trail-running season in the stunning surroundings of Porkkalanniemi, Kirkkonummi. The route winds through varied coastal terrain, with twisting trails, old spruce forests, impressive coastal cliffs and beautiful sea views. The race venue is Porkkala Marina, and runners can choose between two distances: 8 km or 14 km. The event offers a well-marked course, water stations, first aid, a race souvenir and raffle prizes.
course_highlights: A varied route across rocky terrain, through spruce forests and along the water’s edge
Twisting trails and old spruce forests
Impressive coastal cliffs and sea views
additional: On race day, a bus departs from Tolsa station at 9:30, with a return transfer at 14:00. The race office opens at 9:30, and race bibs must be collected by 10:30 at the latest. Late registration is available at the race office from 9:30 to 10:30. The entry fee includes timing, results service, water stations, first aid, gear storage and a race souvenir. There is a sales stand at the venue, and the restaurant offers an affordable race-day lunch. Entries can be transferred for a transfer fee. In case of illness, entry can be transferred to the following year with a doctor’s note. The event centre is at Porkkala Marina.

name: Björnlunken 2026
description: Björnlunken is a cross-country race in Kungsör organised by volunteers from Kungsörs Sportklubb. The course follows the pine-covered esker between Alberga and Kungsör on trails and gravel roads, with moderate climbing and a few more technical sections. Runners choose between 18.3 km, 10 km and 5.5 km, and there is also MTB, Björnlunken Jr for children aged 0 to 13 and Dagens Dubbel, combining MTB with a running distance of your choice. All surplus goes to the club's youth activities.
course_highlights: Cross-country along the esker between Alberga and Kungsör
Running 18.3 km, 10 km and 5.5 km plus MTB
Dagens Dubbel combines MTB and a running distance
additional: The race venue is Lockmora in Kungsör. Late entrants collect their bib at the finish in Lockmora before the bus leaves. Contact: info@kungsorssk.se.

name: WINTER BAY Backyard Ultra 2026
description: Winter Bay Backyard Ultra in Trosa is a unique ultrarunning event where participants run laps on a 6.7 km course in central Trosa, mostly along the Trosa River. Each lap must be completed within one hour to continue, and the race goes on until only one runner remains. The course is easy and flat, making it suitable for both experienced ultrarunners and enthusiasts. Sports drinks, fruit, sandwiches and food are available during the race. There is also a team competition and a children’s race, Mini-TUB. The race is celebrating its 10th anniversary with especially fine medals and prizes for the top three in the men’s and women’s categories.
course_highlights: 6.7 km course in central Trosa, mostly along the Trosa River
Easy, flat course suited to ultrarunning
Mini-TUB children’s race with its own course and medals
additional: Each participant in the main race receives a free silicone cup from Umara at bib collection. Umara sports drinks, fruit from ICA Kvantum Trossen, and food from Trosa Stadshotell are served during the race. Sandwiches and sweets are offered at every lap. There is a team competition where the three best results from each club count, with prize money for the winning team. Mini-TUB for children starts at 14:15 and is open to children born in 2017 or later. Tents may be set up outside the start area in consultation with the race officials. The race is fully booked. There is also a team competition and Mini-TUB for children born in 2017 or later. Tent spaces are arranged in consultation with the race officials; a small number of motorhome spaces are available, but they do not have electricity.
