name: Sevede Trail Run
location: Mariannelund, Eksjö Municipality, Jönköping County, Sweden
description: Sevede Trail Run is organized by Hässleby Ski and Orienteering Club in Mariannelund and offers a challenging, scenic trail run. The race attracts runners of all ages and levels and takes place in beautiful woodland with varied terrain. It is a much-loved tradition that brings together participants and spectators for a wonderful day outdoors.
course_highlights: Trail running in woodland
Varied terrain with trails and forest roads
Scenic views around Mariannelund

name: Trosa Ultra Backyard 2026
description: Trosa Ultra Backyard is a unique ultramarathon held in central Trosa on an easy, flat 6.7 km course, mostly along the Trosaån river. The goal is to complete as many laps as possible, with one hour per lap. Participants who complete a lap can start again at the beginning of the next hour. It is a festive, social competition with prize money, a team competition and prize draws during the race. Children can take part in Mini-TUB, with its own course and lovely medals. Sports drink, fruit, sandwiches and food from local sponsors are served during the race.
course_highlights: A 6.7 km course in central Trosa, mostly along the Trosaån river
An easy, flat course suited to completing many laps
A 700 m Mini-TUB children’s course that follows the main course
additional: Start time: 10:00 on 1 May 2027. Mini-TUB for children starts at 14:15 the same day. Umara sports drink and fruit from ICA Kvantum Trossen are served during the race. Participants receive a free silicone cup from Umara when collecting their race numbers. Food from Trosa Stadshotell, as well as sandwiches and sweets, is served at every lap turnaround. The team competition counts the three best results from each club. Tents may be set up outside the start area in consultation with race officials. No plastic cups are used, for environmental reasons. The 2027 race starts on 1 May at 10:00 and is fully booked. The team competition counts the three best results per club. Mini-TUB for children born in 2017 or later starts at 14:15.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.trosaultrabackyard.se/): 2027-05-01 — "1 maj, kl. 10.00 2027 – Loppet är fullt!" (was estimated 2027-05-01)

name: Ropažu novada RETRO skriešanas svētki
location: Vecā Kangaru stacija, Ropaži Municipality, Latvia
description: The Ropaži Municipality Retro Running Festival is an annual sporting event held on 1 May near Kangari Station. The festival invites everyone to take part and spend the holiday actively, enjoying running and a sense of community. The event is suitable for participants of different ages and fitness levels, promoting a healthy lifestyle and a sporting atmosphere in the municipality.
course_highlights: Start and finish near the Old Kangari Station
Various distance options for all age groups
A friendly, festive atmosphere with a retro theme
additional: The event runs from 9:00 to 14:30, offering a range of activities and opportunities for all participants. No registration fees or direct registration links are listed. The organizers encourage people to follow updates on the municipality’s website.

name: Skrējiensoļojums Rīga-Valmiera
description: The Rīga–Valmiera ultramarathon is an epic 107 km charity trail-running race held every year in early May. The race starts in Rīga and follows a route to Valmiera, offering participants a challenge and an opportunity to push their limits. The race has become a tradition, bringing together professional trail runners and enthusiasts, and is closely connected to Latvia’s national history and sporting community. The event also provides significant support to the Latvian trail-running team and serves as a platform for charitable initiatives.
course_highlights: A 107 km trail from Rīga to Valmiera
A route known for record-setting and challenges for trail runners
Starts on Latvia’s Proclamation Day, with a precise course record time
additional: The race starts on Latvia’s Proclamation Day, and the precise course record time is 7:30:49. The race is charitable in nature and supports the Latvian trail-running team. Participant numbers are record-breaking, and the route is known for its challenges and record-setting.

name: Klaipėdos EKOMaratonas
description: Klaipėda EKOMarathon is a traditional running event held on the forest trails of Giruliai in Klaipėda. Both amateur and professional runners can take part, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity. Distances range from 2 km for schoolchildren to 42.2 km for Ekomarathon participants, who run 10 laps of 4.2 km each. The event is organized by the Klaipėda city running club “Maratonas” and supported by Klaipėda City Municipality.
course_highlights: Ekomarathon course: 10 laps of 4.2 km on the forest trails of Giruliai
Schoolchildren’s course: 2 km (1 km out, 1 km back)
Start in Giruliai Forest, at the beginning of the bike path beyond the Summer Stage
additional: On race day, the timing system operates until 15:00. The entry fee is paid on site when collecting the race number. The first 300 participants receive commemorative medals; all participants receive certificates. Participants must bring an identity document to collect their race number. Participants agree that event organizers may use photographs and video footage taken during the event for marketing purposes. 4.2 km and 42.2 km distances, 2 km schoolchildren’s race, start in Giruliai Forest, online registration until April 30.

name: Nupen halvmaraton
description: Nupen Half Marathon in Harstad is a long-standing race that marks the start of the season for the local running community. The race takes runners through the scenic surroundings of Kasfjord and offers a great half-marathon experience for both local and visiting runners. The event brings together runners of all ages and abilities for a social and sporting day in early May.
course_highlights: A half marathon through the scenic surroundings of Kasfjord
The start of the season for Harstad’s running community
The race covers varied terrain with great views
additional: Kasfjord is approximately 12 km from Harstad.

name: Ulfstindmila
description: Ulfstindmila is an annual cross-country race held on May 1, starting at Tønsvik Bridge and finishing at Skittenelv School in Vågnes. Known as the “world’s shortest 10K,” it covers 8.7 km and has a long history dating back to 1972. There are two categories: a non-timed recreational class and a competitive class. Mini-Ulfstindmila and Mini-mini Ulfstindmila are also held for children, with shorter distances suited to the youngest participants.
course_highlights: Cross-country race in the beautiful Tønsvik Valley
Starts at Tønsvik Bridge and finishes at Skittenelv School
The race is 8.7 km long, known as the world’s shortest 10K
additional: Mini-Ulfstindmila (approx. 2.5 km) and Mini-mini Ulfstindmila are held for the youngest children. The race has been held annually since 1972, with a few exceptions. Previous editions have offered changing facilities, parking, a café and an awards ceremony at Skittenelv School. The organizer has also offered to transport bags from the start to the finish. Practical information and prices listed for 2025 may change for 2027.

name: Myllymäki Trail Run
description: Myllymäki Trail Run is an annual trail-running event held at the Myllymäki ski centre in Joutseno, offering a varied and scenic route. The race features aid stations along the course, timing and a recovery drink at the finish. Participants also receive soup as part of the entry fee. The event is suitable for both competitive athletes and recreational runners and takes place in early May.
course_highlights: Trail-running route through the terrain of the Myllymäki ski centre
Aid stations along the course
Scenic views and varied terrain
additional: Race administration opens at 10:00 on race day. Late registration is available at the race office on race day, at least one hour before the event, but there is no card terminal at the race office. Payments can be made by bank transfer, Epassi or MobilePay. The entry fee includes soup, timing, aid along the course and a recovery drink at the finish. Previous entry fees have included soup, timing, aid along the course and a recovery drink.

name: Kanallöpet
location: Bergvallen, Borensberg, Motala Municipality, Östergötland County, Sweden
organizer: Borensbergs IF, OK Skogsströvarna och Vreta SoMK
description: Kanallöpet is a popular running event that welcomes competitive runners, recreational runners and families to run through beautiful Swedish countryside along the Göta Canal between Ljungsbro and Borensberg. The event offers several distances, including a half marathon, a 10 km race and a 5 km recreational race. It is marked by a strong sense of community and scenic views along the canal. Kanallöpet is organised by Borensbergs IF, Vreta SoMK and OK Skogsströvarna, and is a tradition that returns every spring.
course_highlights: Run along the Göta Canal between Ljungsbro and Borensberg
Half marathon, 10 km and 5 km recreational races
Beautiful Swedish countryside and scenic views
additional: The event has competitive and recreational categories, as well as family-friendly distances. The organising clubs are Borensbergs IF, Vreta SoMK and OK Skogsströvarna. Participants receive medals, although medal deliveries may sometimes be delayed. For the 2025 race, buses are reported to be arranged from Borensberg to the starting locations. Competitive categories require membership in a club affiliated with the Swedish Athletics Federation.

name: SäterMaran (inkl. DM i halvmaraton)
description: SäterMaran is a running event organized by Säters IF FIK, offering half-marathon and 10 km distances. A full marathon was previously held, but is currently closed to late entries due to low participation. The event is a welcome opportunity for runners of different levels to challenge themselves in a beautiful setting in Säter. Säters IF FIK is an active athletics club with dedicated coaches and a strong sense of community.
course_highlights: Half-marathon and 10 km distances are offered
The event takes place in Säter amid scenic surroundings
Organized by Säters IF FIK, a club with a long tradition in athletics
additional: Registration for the half-marathon and 10 km is open as usual. The organizer publishes the invitation, course route, race information, schedule, start list, and results on the club’s website.

name: Ritma skrējiens Liepājā
description: “Ritma skrējiens” in Liepāja invites everyone to run at their own pace—fast or slow, with a smile or in a competitive spirit. The event brings together runners of different ages and fitness levels, offering several distances, including children’s races. The race starts at Daugava Stadium, and the atmosphere is complemented by music, positive energy, and the joy of being together.
course_highlights: The start is at Daugava Stadium in Liepāja.
The course passes through Liepāja’s cityscapes and surrounding area.
Previous event descriptions mention distances ranging from children’s races to 21 km.
additional: The event’s motto invites runners to go fast or slow—the main thing is to run at your own rhythm.

name: Apkārt Cēsīm
location: Cēsu Pils parka estrāde, Cēsis, Latvia
organizer: Cēsu novada pašvaldība sadarbībā ar sporta klubu „Ašais”
description: The “Around Cēsis” run is a traditional spring running event held on the streets and in the park of Cēsis, attracting both local and international runners. The competition offers several distances—a children’s run, 5 km and 10 km—with the fastest runners recognized in different age groups and in the team classification. The courses are marked, and the 10 km course is certified, ensuring a professional standard of competition. The event aims to promote running and a healthy lifestyle, as well as raise the profile of Cēsis Municipality as a centre for active living. Participants are provided with electronic timing, commemorative medals and safety along the course.
course_highlights: The 10 km course is certified and marked
A short children’s run takes place in the city park
The competition takes place on the streets of Cēsis and in the city park
additional: Race starts: children’s run at 11:00, 5 km at 11:30, 10 km at 12:15. Race numbers must be attached to the front of the sports shirt with four safety pins. Time limits: 5 km — 40 minutes; 10 km — 1 hour 30 minutes. After the run, physiotherapist massages and consultations are available in a designated tent. In the 10 km team classification, each team consists of 2 men and 1 woman. Team entries must be submitted separately. The event centre is located at the Cēsis Castle Park open-air stage. The 10 km course is certified, and finishers receive a commemorative medal.

name: Latvijas čempionāts jūdzes 1609m skrējienā
description: The Latvian 1609 m Mile Running Championship is a prestigious running event that brings together Latvia’s best runners. The competition takes place in Līvāni and offers the chance to compete over a short, intense distance that demands speed and endurance. The event is part of Latvia’s sporting calendar and promotes the development of the country’s running tradition.
course_highlights: The distance is exactly 1609 metres, or one mile
The competition takes place within the city of Līvāni
A fast, intense race offering a chance to test your speed

name: Jūrmalas skriešanas svētki
description: Jūrmala Running Festival is a running and Nordic walking event held on the beach at Majori, on the coast of Jūrmala, with sandy courses. The event offers distances for all ages and abilities, from a children’s race to a 21 km Nordic walking race in the sports class. Participants in the 10 km and 5 km races start alongside musician Ozols, creating a special atmosphere. The event welcomes both beginners and experienced athletes, with medals and a refreshment point at the finish.
course_highlights: Sandy courses on Majori Beach
Distances for children, beginners, and experienced athletes
10 km and 5 km races alongside musician Ozols
additional: Registration and race bib collection begin at 9:00 on race day. Bibs can be collected in advance at T/c “Riga Plaza” on 2 and 3 May from 10:00 to 19:00. The entry fee includes a race bib with a timing chip, a refreshment point at the finish, and a medal for finishers within the time limit. System service fee: EUR 1.21.

name: Vårruset Uppsala
description: Vårruset Uppsala is a wonderful fitness event for women, held at Studenternas IP in Uppsala. Participants can choose to run or walk 2.5 km or 5 km on a course measured for accuracy. The event is all about the joy of movement and togetherness, with a fantastic atmosphere and entertainment along the course and in the event area. After finishing, teams that have registered five people are treated to a picnic, making it a sociable and enjoyable spring evening together.
course_highlights: Accurately measured 5 km course
Start and finish at Studenternas IP
Entertainment and encouragement along the course and in the event area
additional: Race bibs can be collected May 3–5 at Intersport Boländerna. The event area opens at 17:30, with a sponsor village and activities. Participants are advised to arrive changed; changing facilities and showers are available. A water station and toilets are available at the start and finish. Parking is available south of the arena, but environmentally friendly travel is encouraged. According to the local race information, registration can be completed online up to race day, no later than one hour before the first start. Timing for the 5 km can be opted out of. Teams of five participants are treated to a picnic after finishing.

name: Run for Change
description: Run for Change is an initiative that combines the joy of running with the fight against poverty, with a particular focus on Kenya. Participants are encouraged to run, walk, cycle or move in any way they choose, contributing to a shared virtual running journey that raises awareness of how women, with support from Hand in Hand, are lifting themselves out of poverty through entrepreneurship. The event is open to everyone and aims to engage more people in the fight against poverty through physical activity. Run for Change has become a well-established initiative and also includes an iconic tattoo worn by both recreational and elite runners.
course_highlights: A virtual running journey where every kilometre counts
Focus on entrepreneurship and fighting poverty in Kenya
Open to all kinds of physical activity — run, walk, cycle or crawl
additional: Participation is flexible and can take place whenever and wherever you like. You can join a Strava club where every kilometre is logged and contributes to a shared distance. Run for Change also includes a temporary tattoo as a symbol of commitment, worn by both recreational and elite runners, including Swedish Championship gold medallist Carolina Wikström. Participation is flexible: you can run, walk or cycle and log kilometres in a shared Strava club.

name: Bankvarvet
price_range: 125 kr för vuxna; gratis för barn och ungdomar upp till 16 år

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmälningsavgift: 125 kr/vuxen Barn och ungdom upp till 16 år deltar gratis

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Barn och ungdom upp till 16 år deltar gratis

description: Bankvarvet is a popular fun run in Kullaparken, Kisa, focused on the joy of being active rather than on achieving a personal best or running the fastest lap. The race offers several distances, including 5 km, 10 km and a 900-metre Minivarv for children born in 2016 or later. The event is a community celebration with entertainment, activities and food, perfect for families, groups of friends and companies looking to strengthen team spirit. Bankvarvet attracts many participants and is known for its warm and welcoming atmosphere.
course_highlights: The race takes place in Kullaparken in Kisa
A 900-metre Minivarv for children
5 km and 10 km routes for adults and young people
additional: Kullaparken opens at 16:00, with activities such as basketball, football, table tennis and boules, as well as food and drinks. Bankvarvet is a popular company activity for strengthening team spirit. The event runs from 16:00 to 20:00, with the 5 km and 10 km races starting at 18:30.

name: Valio Helsinki City Run
description: Valio Helsinki City Run is Finland’s largest running event, bringing more than 24,000 runners from over 110 countries to Helsinki Olympic Stadium and the city streets. The event offers six different running distances, including a marathon, half marathon, marathon relay, 5 km run and walk, and the children’s Minimarathon. The routes are scenic and coastal, and the finish is at Olympic Stadium. The event also offers a wide range of services, such as world-class timekeeping, refreshment stations, and free entry to the Swimming Stadium after the run.
course_highlights: Scenic coastal routes in Helsinki
Finish and event centre at Olympic Stadium
Officially measured, AIMS-certified routes
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Olympic Stadium before the race. Payment with sports benefits is available (ePassi, Edenred, Zevoy Benefits). Group registration requires at least 5 runners. Groups of at least 10 people receive free event shirts. Free entry to the Swimming Stadium after the run. Refreshment stations and gels along the route. Cancellation insurance is available for purchase. Free group training sessions and training plans. World-class timekeeping (excluding the walk). The event includes several distances, such as the marathon, half marathon, 5 km run, and walking events. Participants can follow live results and get their certificates as soon as they finish. The event takes place at Olympic Stadium and also includes an event week with activities and sponsorship opportunities.

name: Bodom Team
description: Bodom Trail is a spring trail-running event in the Pirttimäki outdoor recreation area in Espoo, offering a variety of distances for individuals and teams. The event includes a 10 km team race and individual trail runs of 6 km, 12 km and 21 km (half marathon). The routes cross varied terrain, with both easy-to-run outdoor paths and technical trail sections. The event is known for its great atmosphere, careful organisation and the opportunity to explore the route on group runs before race day.
course_highlights: Varied trail sections along pond shores and over rocky, pine-covered terrain
Approximately 230 metres of elevation gain on the 10 km route and 500 metres on the 21 km route
The 21 km route consists of two laps, the second of which is more technically challenging and more remote
additional: The Bodom Team 10 km starts on Friday at 14:00, with teams starting one minute apart. A race bus transports participants from various parts of the Helsinki metropolitan area. The entry fee includes timing, results services, water stations, first aid, a race video and race photos. Young people may take part in different distances, subject to age limits. Late registration is available at the race venue at the highest price tier.

name: RAHOLAN KYMPPI (TAMPERE)
location: Tampereen Tesoman jäähallin parkkipaikka, Tampere, Pirkanmaa, Finland
description: Raholan Kymppi is an annual 10-kilometre running event starting from the parking lot of Tesoma Ice Hall in Tampere. It gives runners the chance to enjoy a course that is traditional and popular with locals. The event is part of the running calendar organised by Team Rahola and attracts a diverse range of participants. It is a good opportunity to test your fitness in spring and experience the sense of community at a running event.
course_highlights: A 10-kilometre course
Start and finish at the parking lot of Tesoma Ice Hall in Tampere
A traditional local running event popular with the community
additional: Team Rahola's Monday group runs from Tesoma Ice Hall at 18:00 offer an opportunity to train. No specific start times or prices are listed for the running event. Team Rahola also offers other running events and training sessions, such as the Cooper test and weekly events. The event takes place at the parking lot of Tesoma Ice Hall in Tampere, and participants can run or walk. The event offers a chance to enjoy exercise in surroundings that combine nature and the city.

name: Bodom Trail
description: Bodom Trail is a spring trail-running event set amid the beautiful forest scenery of Pirttimäki, Espoo. It offers races over several distances: a 6 km race for children and young people, a 12 km race, a 21 km half marathon, and a 10 km team race. The routes traverse varied terrain, with both easy trails and technical sections, and the event is known for its great atmosphere and careful organization. The race is part of the Trail Tour Finland series and attracts trail-running enthusiasts and professionals every year. Participants have access to aid stations, first-aid services, and prizes in the different categories.
course_highlights: Varied trail sections along pond shores and over pine-covered rocky outcrops
The 21 km route consists of two laps, with around 500 m of total elevation gain
Technical, wilderness-like sections where your shoes may get wet
additional: The start takes place in waves of around 30 runners, one minute apart. A race bus transports participants from various parts of the Helsinki metropolitan area to the venue. The entry fee includes timing, results services, a race video and race photos, aid stations, and first aid. Late registration is available at the venue. Minimum age requirements apply to young participants in the different distances. The race centre has washing facilities and a café, as well as the restaurant and saunas at Backby Manor. The race venue is in Pirttimäki, Espoo.

name: 45. Tartu Maastikumaraton
description: The 45th Tartu Forest Marathon is a traditional event held at the Tartumaa Sports Centre, offering participants the chance to enjoy trail running in beautiful natural surroundings. The event is part of Estonia’s programme to promote recreational physical activity and is suitable for runners of different abilities who want to improve their fitness and mental well-being. The marathon highlights the importance of physical activity for maintaining health and well-being and invites everyone who leads an active lifestyle to take part. It is organised by the Centre of Excellence for Physical Activity, which supports the development of a healthier and more active society in Estonia.
course_highlights: Trail running through the beautiful forest landscapes of the Tartumaa Sports Centre
A varied and changing course suitable for runners of different abilities
An opportunity to enjoy nature and improve mental and physical health
additional: The event takes place at the Tartumaa Sports Centre. Participants can register and collect their race numbers at Turu 10 in Tartu and in the car park at Aura Centre.

name: Kungsholmen Runt
description: COOP Kungsholmen Runt takes place on Saturday 8 May 2027 with start and finish in Rålambshovsparken on Kungsholmen in Stockholm. The race started in 1981 and has been organised by FK Studenterna since 2001. You choose between 10 km and a half marathon, and children up to 13 can run kids' races of 600 m, 1.1 km and 1.6 km. The course is fast with long flat straights in the first half and a twistier finish, and both the 10 km and the half marathon are officially measured.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Rålambshovsparken on Kungsholmen
The half marathon runs two laps around Kungsholmen plus a loop around Rålis
World Athletics approved, with pacers and live results with splits
additional: The 10 km starts at 11:00 and the half marathon at 12:05. Entry is SEK 299 to 399 for 10 km and SEK 399 to 499 for the half marathon depending on COOP membership, and SEK 149 for the kids' races. The half marathon time limit is three hours. Bibs are collected at Runners' Store, Regeringsgatan 26, 5 to 7 May from 10:00 to 19:00. SEK 20 per 10 km or half marathon entry goes to Doctors Without Borders' work in Ukraine.

name: Åstöloppet Trail
description: Åstöloppet Trail is a unique trail race offering a fantastic running experience in the beautiful and dramatic natural surroundings of Åstön Nature Reserve. The race offers four distances—1 km, 4 km, 8 km and 14 km—with a mix of wide forest trails, technical sections and off-trail terrain. The start and finish are at Skeppshamn, where participants are welcomed by a wonderful atmosphere and a scenic finish by the sea. Whether you are a beginner or an experienced trail runner, this race is a great challenge by the sea.
course_highlights: Run through the beautiful and dramatic natural surroundings of Åstön Nature Reserve
A mix of wide forest trails, technical sections and off-trail terrain
Start and finish at Skeppshamn, with a scenic finish by the sea
additional: Four distances are offered: 1 km, 4 km, 8 km and 14 km. The race is suitable for both beginners and experienced trail runners. The race director can be contacted at race.tyndero@gmail.com. Previous editions have featured distances ranging from a children’s race to 14 km.

name: Kolmårdstrailen
description: Kolmårdstrailen is one of Sweden’s finest trail races, offering challenging, hilly courses in the scenic Kolmården terrain. Runners can choose between distances of 21 km, 11 km and 6 km, as well as a 500-metre children’s course for the youngest participants. The courses run through forests, over rocky outcrops and along hiking trails, with beautiful views and sections of technical terrain. The focus is on the experience, with a course that combines the beauty of nature with a physical challenge.
course_highlights: Hilly terrain with rocky-outcrop running and forest trails
Passage through Rödgölen Nature Reserve, with soft singletrack
Views from Kolmården’s highest peak, 171 metres above sea level
additional: Race bib collection and late registration take place on race day between 9.00 and 11.00. Payment is by cash or Swish. All courses pass the race centre approximately 1 km before the finish, where the final kilometre is tough and partly off-trail through the forest. There are water stations along the course, including one at 7.5 km by the Scout Hut at Gransjön. Volunteers are needed for race bib collection, serving and water stations.

name: Strandmilen
description: Strandmilen is a recurring running race organised by Hultsfreds Löparklubb. The race offers an enjoyable running experience in Hultsfred, with a course that passes close to the shoreline. It is a welcoming event for runners who want to challenge themselves in a scenic setting. Results from previous years are available to track progress and performance.
course_highlights: Running close to the shoreline
Scenic course in Hultsfred
Recurring annual race
additional: The start location is listed as Folkparksvägen 3 in Hultsfred. The event is scheduled for 10:00–13:00.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://visithultsfred.se/evenemang/strandmilen/): 2027-05-08 — "Strandmilen — 8 maj, 2027 kl.10:00 - 13:00" (was estimated 2027-04-08)

name: Östgötatidningen Mjölby Stadslopp
organizer: Norrköpings Löparklubb i samarbete med IK Akele och Mjölby Cykelklubb
description: Östgötatidningen Mjölby Stadslopp is a popular running event featuring six enjoyable kilometres through Mjölby, starting and finishing in Stadsparken. The course follows the Svartån and includes both challenging climbs and pleasant downhill stretches, with an almost entirely asphalt surface. In addition to the main race, there is also the approximately 3 km Kyrkundan and a children’s race, which is completely free thanks to Bostadsbolaget. All participants receive a medal after finishing. The race is organised by Norrköpings Löparklubb in collaboration with IK Akele and Mjölby Cykelklubb.
course_highlights: 6 km course starting and finishing in Mjölby Stadspark
Course follows the Svartån and has a 99% asphalt surface
Challenging climbs and pleasant downhill stretches
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Intersport Mjölby on Friday 8 May from 12:00 to 18:00, with a 25% discount coupon, or on race day from 09:00 in Stadsparken. Fitness4You will lead a warm-up before the start. The children’s race has four starts, with timing in eight categories for children up to 12 years old. Companies can book a tent in Stadsparken for their team and promotional exposure.

name: Östhammars Stadslopp
description: Östhammar City Race is an annual running event that starts at Frösåkersvallen in Östhammar. The race brings together runners of different ages and abilities and is a popular local celebration. The event has a friendly atmosphere and offers the chance to run in beautiful surroundings near Östhammar. It welcomes both competitive runners and recreational runners.

name: SHE Silverlöpet
organizer: IFK Sala i samarbete med Sala-Heby Energi
description: SHE Silverlöpet is a revived running tradition in Sala, organized together with IFK Sala. The race offers a beautiful, officially measured 10 km course through central Sala, starting and finishing in Stadsparken. There are three categories: the children’s race, 5 km and 10 km. The event is a celebration for everyone, whether you run, walk or compete. All participants receive a medal, and prizes are awarded to the top three women and men in the 10 km race, with prize draws for the 5 km race.
course_highlights: Officially measured and sanctioned 10 km course through central Sala
Start and finish in Stadsparken
Running through Sala’s beautiful surroundings
additional: Nordic Wellness leads a warm-up for all participants before each start. Start times are 9:30 for the children’s race, 10:00 for 5 km and 10:20 for 10 km. SHE customers get a 50 kr discount on the entry fee via the “Mitt SHE” mobile app or customer service. All participants receive a medal, and it’s a celebration for everyone, including those with a stroller or who prefer to walk. Categories are available for children, 5 km and 10 km. Prizes are awarded to the top three women and men in the 10 km race; prizes are drawn for the 5 km race.

name: Spångaloppet
description: Spångaloppet is a local running race being held for the third year in a row and welcomes all participants. The race offers several distances: 10 km, 5 km, 2 km for younger runners, and a 400-metre children’s race. The routes pass through beautiful natural areas and Spånga Centrum, with the start and finish at Spånga IP. The goal for 2027 is to have more than 600 participants take part in this popular event.
course_highlights: The route passes through beautiful natural areas and Spånga Centrum
Several distances: 10 km, 5 km, 2 km for younger runners, and a 400 m children’s race
Start and finish at Spånga IP
additional: There are distances for both adults and younger participants.

name: Åre Halvmarathon
description: Åre Half Marathon is a road race over the half-marathon distance, held in Duved, Jämtland. The race offers a lovely spring atmosphere and marks the start of the running season in the Åre Valley. The entire course is on asphalt, and runners avoid running on the E14, making for a safe and enjoyable running experience. All proceeds from the race support Duveds IF’s children’s and youth activities. The race director is Hector Haines, and the event will be held for the fourth time in 2027.
course_highlights: Entire course on asphalt, without running on the E14
Elevation profile between 375 m and 415 m
Start and finish at Duvedshallen in Duved
additional: All profits from the race go towards developing Duveds IF’s children’s and youth activities. The race is organised by Duveds IF Teamet. The course has an elevation gain of approximately 40 metres. The start and event venue is at Duvedshallen.

name: Sommarro Snabbare
description: Sommarro Snabbare is a unique running race held in the beautiful Sommarro cultural reserve in Örebro. The race involves running several laps of a 2.6 km course in a woodland park setting, with each lap to be run faster than the one before. It’s a challenge for everyone, focused on running farther and faster, with a clear time limit for each lap. Lilla Sommarro Snabbare also offers a child-friendly version where the youngest participants can run one untimed lap and feel like winners.
course_highlights: A 2.6 km course through hilly woodland park terrain, with gravel paths, fitness trails and a little off-road running
Start and finish on the lawn by Sommarro Värdshus
A timed challenge with progressively faster laps, focused on endurance and speed
additional: Lilla Sommarro Snabbare is for children born in 2014 or later. The children run one untimed lap and receive a medal at the finish.

name: Backyard Race
description: Backyard Race is an obstacle course race in Ozolnieki, offering a short course with world-class obstacles. The race is suitable for both experienced athletes and those who want to try OCR (Obstacle Course Racing) in a short format. It is a dynamic and challenging event that brings together active participants and spectators.
course_highlights: A short course with world-class obstacles
The race takes place in Ozolnieki
Short-distance OCR race
additional: This short-distance OCR race takes place in Ozolnieki and offers world-class obstacles over a few kilometers.

name: Wings for Life World Run (Valmiera)
organizer: Wings for Life World Run Valmierā organizatori
description: Wings for Life World Run is a unique global race in which all participants start at the same time around the world. There is no traditional finish line—participants run as far as they can until they are caught by a special “Catcher Car.” The event is open to runners, wheelchair users, and beginners, and 100% of entry fees are donated to spinal cord research. The race in Valmiera will take place at J. Daliņš Stadium and is part of this global event, bringing people together around the world to support those who cannot run themselves.
course_highlights: Starts simultaneously around the world
There is no traditional finish line—the finish is when the Catcher Car catches you
Participants can run, roll, or walk, and everyone competes together
additional: The start is not only in Valmiera but takes place simultaneously around the world. The Catcher Car begins pursuing participants 30 minutes after the start and continues catching up with them until everyone has been caught. The event is inclusive of everyone—beginners, athletes, and wheelchair users. The official Wings for Life World Run app is required to participate.

name: Pärnävaaran polkujuoksu
description: Pärnävaara Trail Run is a trail-running event held in May at Pärnävaara in Liperi, offering a suitable option both for those seeking a challenge and for first-timers. The routes run along pine-needle trails, over rocky terrain and up steep hills, providing a varied and demanding running experience. The event was first held in 2026 and is traditionally run on Ascension Day.
course_highlights: Pine-needle trails and rocky terrain
Plenty of hills
Good facilities for spectators at Pärnävaara

name: NUBU10
description: NUBU10 is a relaxed and unique running event in Nuuksio National Park, where participants run 6.7 km loops under backyard ultra rules, with a one-hour time limit for each loop. The event ends after 10 loops, giving participants the chance to test their limits and learn about the sport. A shorter NUBU mini run on a 4.5 km route is also held on the same day, suitable for younger and less experienced runners. Polku Hotel provides the event centre, accommodation and meals, and the entry fee includes food, refreshments, a sauna, and electronic timing and tracking.
course_highlights: 6.7 km route in Nuuksio National Park
Backyard ultra rules, with a one-hour time limit for each loop
The chance to run up to 10 loops, for a total of up to 67 km
additional: The entry fee includes a hot meal served during the day, energy products and refreshments, and a sauna after the run. The event has electronic timing, and 30 runners will receive a GPS tracking device; others can follow the event on their own phones. Children receive a medal as a keepsake. Polku Hotel offers accommodation at a 15% discount for registered participants with the code NUBU15.

name: OTTARSLOPPET
distance_verbose: 69 km, 46 km, 23 km, 15 km, 5 km, 2 km, 1500 meter
description: Ottarsloppet is a running race on natural trails and forest roads in the Vendelåsen terrain, with start and finish at Ottarsborg sports ground about 30 km north of Uppsala, on road 709 between Läby and Örbyhus. It is organised by IK Rex and was held for the 56th time in 2026. Classes range from kids' races and 1.5, 2 and 5 km to 15 and 23 km, and Ottarsloppet Ultra is run as 2 or 3 laps of 23 km. The event also has mountain bike classes.
course_highlights: Natural trails and forest roads in the Vendelåsen terrain
Ultra of 46 or 69 km in 23 km laps
Drinks three times on the 15 km and four times on the 23 km
additional: Bibs can be collected from about 08:00 on race day, from 06:00 for the Ultra. Late entry costs an extra 50 percent of the normal fee, plus SEK 50 for late entry on site. A kiosk and grill are open at the sports ground, and ultra runners get pasta salad after the finish.

name: Medåkersloppet
location: Parkuddens IP, Medåker, Arboga Municipality, Sweden
description: Medåkersloppet is a classic trail race held annually since 1979 in the beautiful forests around Parkuddens IP in Medåker. The event offers several distances, including a new 14 km race, as well as a children’s race and a mini race for the youngest participants. It is a festival welcoming both runners and walkers, with refreshments and activities in the start and finish area. The mini race and children’s race are untimed and open to all children; participants in the mini race receive a medal.
course_highlights: A trail race through forest terrain, with both wide and narrow paths
The route runs along gravel roads and through the forest
The children’s race follows the exercise trail and is suitable for strollers
additional: The mini race is untimed and requires no registration. The children’s race is also untimed. Refreshments are available in the start and finish area.

name: Šventinis bėgimas „Kuršėnams 463“
location: Kuršėnų pėsčiųjų tiltas, Kuršėnai, Šiaulių rajonas, Lithuania
price_range: nemokamai, 3-5 Eur, registracijos mokestis iki 2026-05-13 d. 23:59, vėliau 10 Eur

description: The festive “Kuršėnams 463” run is a traditional running event held in Kuršėnai, Šiauliai District. The event aims to promote running and encourage a healthy lifestyle, inviting runners of all ages to take part. The races take place by the Kuršėnai pedestrian bridge, with three distances on offer: approximately 463 m, 2.5 km, and 10 km. Participants can enjoy a symbolic route and a friendly atmosphere, and the event concludes with awards and a joint finish at around 21:30.
course_highlights: A symbolic route of approximately 463 m by the Kuršėnai pedestrian bridge
A 2.5 km loop that 10 km runners complete four times
The races take place in an urban setting, with a convenient start and finish
additional: Race schedule: 19:30 — 463 m start; 19:40 — 2.5 km start; 20:00 — 10 km start. Awards take place after the last participant finishes, at around 21:30. Participants must be healthy or have a doctor’s clearance to exercise. The health and conduct of underage participants are supervised by accompanying adults. The race takes place by the Kuršėnai pedestrian bridge; registration and race-number pickup are by the bridge; participant age groups; COVID-19 safety requirements.

name: Kokkola Ultra Run
description: Kokkola Ultra Run is Finland’s fastest ultrarunning event, held in the centre of Kokkola. The event features 6-, 12- and 24-hour races, a 100 km race, and a new 42.272 km distance, Finland’s shortest ultramarathon. The event centre is Kokkola Areena, and the course is flat, with sections of asphalt and gravel, offering a varied running experience. The event also includes the Finnish Championships in the 24-hour and 100 km races, with prizes awarded to the top finishers in each distance.
course_highlights: Officially measured 862.7-metre course
Flat course, with about one metre of elevation gain per lap
The course is half asphalt and half gravel; runners can also use the grass alongside the asphalt section
additional: Registration takes place at Kokkola Sports Hall, Vapaudentie 1, on Friday 21.5. from 18:00 to 19:00 and Saturday 22.5. from 9:00 to 11:00. The race briefing is on Saturday at 11:30 at the same location. Runners must wear a top, and changing rooms, toilets and portable toilets are available at the course. Distance is measured using chip timing. Participants are not insured by the organisers, and participation is at their own risk. The venue is Kokkola Sports Hall, Vapaudentie 1.

name: Brannin Trail
description: Brannin Trail Run is a trail-running event that takes runners through the historic Strömfors ironworks and its stunning natural surroundings. The routes wind across wooded rocky terrain, lakes and spring meadows, offering varied terrain and challenges for both beginners and experienced runners. Runners have been returning to the event since 2015, which offers a welcoming, supportive atmosphere and aid stations along the route. Refreshments and light snacks await at the finish to help runners recover. Brannin Trail Run is an unforgettable experience for nature and exercise enthusiasts.
course_highlights: The route passes through the grounds of the historic Strömfors ironworks, one of the best-preserved in Finland.
Varied terrain includes wooded rocky areas, lakeshores and an old narrow-gauge railway bed.
Aid stations at approximately 6 km and 14 km, as well as at the finish, provide drinks and light snacks.
additional: Late registration is possible at the event centre on race day. Sports benefits such as ePassi, Smartum and Edenred are accepted as payment. The route is clearly marked with trail markers, direction arrows and signs, so there is no risk of getting lost. Refreshments and light snacks are available at the finish. Starts take place in mass starts or between them during the 11.00–11.30 time window.

name: Lamminrahka Trail Run
description: Lamminrahka Trail Run is a trail running event in Kangasala that combines the running community’s passion for flowing trails with the lively entertainment, local food and family-friendly programme of Lamminrahka Katufiest. The event offers three different route options, suitable for both first-timers and experienced trail runners. After the run, participants can enjoy the community atmosphere and entertainment in the heart of Kangasala. This event is for the whole running community, with time to stay, relax and share the best trail stories after crossing the finish line.
course_highlights: The 7 km route features fast-flowing trails, gentle climbs and short sections of boardwalk, making it especially suitable for first-timers.
The 13 km route follows narrow forest trails, rocky sections and technical stretches of stones and roots, offering a varied trail running experience.
The 23 km route is a challenging and rewarding trail running experience, with long forest sections, rocky terrain and several aid stations.
additional: Parking is available at Lemmetyn kenttä and in the Riesonpolku area; both are about a 1–1.5 km walk from the start. Bus 29 runs from Tampere. The Katufiest area opens at 10:00 and closes at 15:00. The race bib entitles runners to a discount on food in the Katufiest area. The prize-giving takes place at approximately 12:30. The event recommends carpooling, cycling or using public transport. The event centre is located around Lamminrahka School. The race bib entitles runners to a discount on food at Katufiest.

name: Kulhan polkujuoksu
description: Kulha Trail Run is a trail running event held at Pirttipuro Mill in Saarijärvi. The event offers three distances: 7 km, 10 km and 21 km, which run through the beautiful and varied terrain of the Kulha Nature Reserve. There is also a 5 km hiking category without timing. The event is suitable for both competitive runners and hikers, offering a nature-focused running experience.
course_highlights: Trails in the Kulha Nature Reserve
Varied terrain and scenic landscapes
Choose from 7 km, 10 km or 21 km
additional: The event takes place at Pirttipuro Mill on Konttimäentie. The untimed 5 km hiking category offers an alternative for those interested in running events who want to enjoy nature at a more leisurely pace. The address of the previous event venue is Konttimäentie 980, Saarijärvi; Pirttipuro Mill has served as the start and event centre.

name: Muuramen Yrityksen polkujuoksu
description: Muuramen Yrityksen Trail Run takes runners through the Muuratharju terrain in Muurame. In previous years, the event has offered 10 km and 20 km distances as well as children’s races. Welcome to enjoy trail running amid ridge scenery!
course_highlights: The route runs through the Muuratharju terrain.
In previous years, 10 km and 20 km distances have been offered.
Children’s races have also been held at the event.

name: LHV Maijooks - 7 km
description: LHV Maijooks is Estonia’s and the Baltic States’ largest women’s movement and sports event, taking place for the 40th time. Dedicated exclusively to women, it offers the opportunity to run, walk or Nordic walk along a beautiful 7 km route through Tallinn’s natural surroundings and the iconic Tallinn Song Festival Grounds. The event is for the whole family, with a children’s run and entertainment in addition to the women’s run. Participants receive an exclusive medal, a gift bag and a spring concert, creating a unique atmosphere.
course_highlights: A 7 km route through Tallinn’s natural surroundings
Start and finish at the Tallinn Song Festival Grounds
Suitable for running, walking and Nordic walking
additional: A 20% discount on the 7 km distance applies to seniors (60+) and young people (under 20). A 10% group discount applies to teams of at least 10 people. Participants receive an exclusive medal, a gift bag, partner discount codes, a spring concert and a health fair at the Tallinn Song Festival Grounds. Both timed and untimed participation options are available. A 20% discount applies to people aged 60 and over and those under 20; groups of at least 10 people receive a 10% discount.

name: Skärholmsloppet
price_range: Gratis enligt information om tidigare upplagor

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmälan på hemsidan stänger torsdag den 14 maj kl 17

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmälan på hemsidan stänger torsdag den 14 maj kl 17

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmälan på hemsidan stänger torsdag den 14 maj kl 17

description: Skärholmsloppet is a family-friendly running festival in Skärholmen, offering races for all ages, from a Mini Race for the youngest participants to a timed 5 km race for participants aged 13 and over. The race is organised by Löparakademin, a non-profit organisation that works with young people in Sweden’s Million Programme suburbs. There is music and entertainment along the course, and all participants receive a specially designed medal at the finish. Skärholmsloppet is an inclusive and encouraging community event that promotes exercise and togetherness.
course_highlights: Timed 5 km race for ages 13 and over
Lilla Skärholmsloppet, approximately 1.6 km, for children from preschool class to year 6
Mini Skärholmsloppet, 500 metres, for children aged 0–6
additional: Start and finish at Puckelbollplanen. Music and DJs along the course. A medal for everyone who completes the race. Race bib, medal, fruit and a drink are included in the registration. Lilla Skärholmsloppet has start times split by school year, with colour-coded starting groups. The Mini Race is 500 metres and can be run together with a parent. Late registration is possible at bib collection on 15 May and on race day, subject to availability. The race centre at SKHLM offers bib collection and bag storage; late registration may be available subject to availability. The recommended route is metro red line 13 to Skärholmen.

name: Borgarloppet Trail Race
location: NIK Arena (Näsvikens skidstadion), Näsviken, Hudiksvall Municipality, Sweden
description: Borgarloppet is a scenic trail race along Borgarleden between the Dellen lakes, finishing at NIK Arena in Näsviken. The course offers varied terrain, with a long climb at the start followed by downhill running, an easier middle section and a demanding finish on technical trails and steep hills. Participants in the 13 km class are bussed to the start, and there are several water stations along the course. After the race, kolbulle and a well-stocked coffee table are offered to everyone except the children’s class, which receives juice, a bun, a banana and a medal at the finish.
course_highlights: The course follows Borgarleden, with beautiful views over southern Dellen Lake
The terrain includes a long climb, downhill running and technical trails with steep hills
Water stations are located at 6.2 km, 9.9 km, 13.8 km and 18.7 km
additional: Start and finish at NIK Arena (Näsviken ski stadium). The 13 km start is at Simabobacken; participants are bussed there from the ski stadium. Online registration closes on Thursday evening before race day; after that, on-site registration is available until one hour before the start, with Swish as the only payment method. Race numbers are collected on site. Honorary prizes go to the top three in the women’s and men’s classes; everyone in the children’s class receives a prize. The cutoff is at Borgarberget (19 km) after 3:30 hours. The 13 km classes are bussed to the start at Simabobacken. In 2026, kolbulle and a coffee table at the finish were included in the entry fee, except for the children’s class.

name: Kilsbergen Ut & Tillbaka
description: Kilsbergen Out and Back is a unique, friendly trail run in Ånnaboda, near Örebro, where participants choose their own distance by running one, two or all three out-and-back sections. The race offers hilly trail running through forests and mountains, with technical sections and beautiful trails. Everyone starts at the same time from the same place, creating a sociable, relaxed atmosphere throughout the day. After finishing, participants are served a simple hot meal, with a vegetarian option.
course_highlights: Three out-and-back sections, with distances of 10 km, 26 km and 54 km
Hilly trail running through forests and mountains, with technical sections
The Bergslagsleden Trail, with the turnaround point at the Rusakulan viewpoint
additional: The maximum number of participants is 100. Race bibs can be collected from 08:00 at the event centre. The start, finish and event centre are at the warming hut by the artificial snow trail in Ånnaboda. Toilets are available in the area; changing facilities and showers are at the SM hut by the lower car park. Trail shoes with good grip are recommended. Runners must carry all their own equipment and energy; no support is available along the course. The refreshment table at the event centre offers water, sports drink, bananas, sweets, crisps, buns and more. Runners may leave their own drop bags there. Parking is recommended at the lower car park, with signs directing you to the event centre. The organiser’s information lists the start time as 09:00, the maximum number of participants as 100, and the final registration date as 15 May. Runners are responsible for their own equipment and energy; support is permitted only at the event centre.

name: Anger TT run
description: Anger TT Run is a race in Hedemora, Dalarna, on Saturday 15 May 2027, where skiers and runners meet. The main race is 7.3 km, one lap around Stadsberget. There is also a 3 x 3 km relay through central Hedemora and Anger Jr Run, a 600 m kids' race for children born 2017 or later. The day ends with prize giving, an after-run and an evening party.
course_highlights: The 7.3 km main race is one lap around Stadsberget
Sports profiles and amateur runners on the same course
After-run with food, live music and prize giving
additional: The kids' race starts at 12:00, the relay at 13:00 and Anger TT Run at 14:30. Entry to the main race is SEK 350 until 31 December, then SEK 450 until 14 May and SEK 600 for late entry. Total prize money is SEK 36,000 across the women's and men's classes. The event is run together with Hedemora Sportklubb and IFK Hedemora Skidor.

name: Hälleforsterrängen
description: Hälleforsterrängen is a running race organized by Hällefors Running Club and held in Hällefors. The race is part of the club’s annual competition program and welcomes runners of different age groups and ability levels. The club provides financial support to members taking part in running races and encourages carpooling and wearing club clothing. Hälleforsterrängen offers a great opportunity to run in scenic surroundings and take part in a well-organized local running event.
additional: The club reimburses entry fees and mileage expenses for children, young people and juniors at running races, as well as 50% of the entry fee for seniors and veterans in races in Närkes Långloppscup. Wearing club clothing is required to receive reimbursement. Carpooling is recommended. The club also reimburses the entry fee, accommodation, mileage expenses and food for participation in Vasastafetten. Previous editions have included 5 km, 10 km and children’s races. This information applies to 2026 and does not confirm the format for 2027.

name: Rimi Rīgas maratons
description: Rimi Riga Marathon is an annual running festival held in Riga, offering a range of distances, including the marathon, half marathon, 10 km and 6 km races, as well as relay races. The event takes place on 15 and 16 May, bringing together runners from around the world. It is part of the prestigious SuperHalfs European half marathon series and offers new, scenic and fast courses. Participants can also take part in relay races, making the longer distances more accessible to a wider audience.
course_highlights: New, scenic and fast courses in the city of Riga
Marathon relay with four legs: 10.5 km, 6.5 km, 12.5 km and 12.7 km
Half marathon relay with two legs: 10.2 km and 10.9 km
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Rimi Olympic Centre. The 6 km start is split into two start times, which are shown on the race bib. Relay teams can have 2 to 4 runners, and one runner may complete multiple legs. Registration details can be changed free of charge until 30 April 2027, including year of birth, email address, phone number, team name, nationality and country of residence.

name: Festivalio „Sportas visiems“ bėgimo varžybos
location: Vytauto and S. Dariaus ir S. Girėno streets intersection near Restaurant Gabija, Palanga, Lithuania
organizer: Lietuvos bėgimo mėgėjų asociacija ir Lietuvos asociacija „Sportas visiems“
description: The “Sport for All” Festival is a traditional running event held in Palanga, at the intersection of Vytauto and S. Dariaus ir S. Girėno streets, near the Gabija restaurant. The event is open to anyone willing to participate voluntarily and accept the associated risks. The races include 1 km, 5 km, and 10 km distances, each with a time limit. Participants receive medals and commemorative souvenirs, while the clubs with the highest participation receive trophies.
course_highlights: Race routes through the streets of Palanga
Start and finish at the intersection of Vytauto and S. Dariaus ir S. Girėno streets
Three race distances: 1 km, 5 km, and 10 km
additional: Registration is available online and on race day at the start location from 11:00 to 12:20. Participants must wear their race number on the front of their shirt. The use of vehicles during the race is strictly prohibited; violators will be disqualified. Time limits: 1 km — 20 min; 5 km and 10 km — 80 min. Advance online registration and registration at the start location on event day are available. The time limit for the 1 km distance is 20 min; for 5 km and 10 km, it is 80 min.

name: Vårslippløpet
description: Vårslippløpet is an annual town-centre race in Tanabru that brings together runners and recreational joggers of all ages. The race takes place on marked, permanent routes in Tanabru town centre, with the start and finish outside Tanabru kindergarten. There are three distances: 1,500 metres, 5 kilometres and 10 kilometres, with the 10 km run over two laps. After the race, food is served and participants can chat about the start of the season at Cafè Kievra. This is included in the entry fee.
course_highlights: Marked, permanent routes in Tanabru town centre
Start and finish outside Tanabru kindergarten
Three distances: 1,500 m, 5 km and 10 km (two laps)
additional: Changing rooms are open at Tana multipurpose hall. The address for collecting race numbers and timing chips is Ringveien 55, 9845 Tana. Results are published at www.sirbma.no and can be followed live on EQtiming. Changing rooms are available at Tana multipurpose hall.

name: Kajenloppet
organizer: Nacka Hockey Friidrott i samarbete med Kajen i Nacka Strand
description: Kajenloppet is a running experience along the waterfront in Nacka Strand, suitable for the whole family. The race is organised by Nacka Hockey Friidrott in collaboration with Kajen in Nacka Strand, with a focus on the joy of movement, community and local engagement. The course offers beautiful views of the inlet and takes runners past Svindersvik and around Kvarnholmen before the finish at Kajen. There are distances for everyone, from children’s races to longer routes, and the event is a lively celebration full of energy and spectators.
course_highlights: Run along the waterfront with views of the inlet
The course passes Svindersvik and loops around Kvarnholmen
Start and finish at Kajen in Nacka Strand
additional: The 400 m children’s race starts at 10:30, and the 1,200 m children’s race starts at 11:30. Kajenloppet is a lively celebration full of energy, spectators and community. Kajen also offers activities such as mini golf and pétanque near the event area. Previous editions have included 6 km and 10 km races as well as children’s races; distances and arrangements may vary from year to year.

name: Adelsö ultra
description: A new ultratrail race on Adelsö on 16 May 2027. Adelsö is one of the Mälaren islands on the outskirts of Stockholm. We have worked hard on the course and are proud to present a scenic marathon-distance XL that combines coastline and technical forest trails with 600 metres of climbing. Beyond the natural experience, the race offers a journey through historically significant landscapes, which we have made an effort to highlight along the route. One of the most exciting ultraraces in Stockholm in spring 2027 for those who love trail running.

Två löpare med en Adelsö Ultra-banner på en vagn i bakgrunden.

name: Vårruset Stockholm
location: Stora Skuggan, Norra Djurgården, Stockholm, Sweden
description: Vårruset Stockholm is a popular spring running event held on Norra Djurgården, with distances of 2.5 and 5 km. The event offers a lovely spring evening with timing, a medal, a finish-line goodie bag, and a music quiz with prizes. The start and finish are at Stora Skuggan/Universitetet, and the event has a friendly atmosphere, with teams able to enjoy a picnic after finishing. This recreational race welcomes both individual runners and teams, with a focus on fun and community.
course_highlights: Course on Norra Djurgården, starting on Fiskartorpsvägen
Distance options of 2.5 km and 5 km; the 5 km course is officially measured
Start and finish on the grass area at Stora Skuggan/Universitetet
additional: Race bibs are mailed to participants who register early; otherwise, they must be collected on site. Teams consist of 5 people and receive a picnic after finishing. Changing rooms and showers are available for a fee at Frescati Sports Center. The event area is easily accessible by public transport and bicycle. Parking is limited and subject to a fee.

name: Namdalskarusellen 2027 løp 4 - 3000m

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Pris: 80 ,- (+ lisens) for enkeltløp i karusellen.

description: The Namdalskarusellen is a race series organized by Namdal Running Club in Trøndelag, focused on the joy of running and giving your best. Race 4 in 2027 is a 3000-metre road race at Svenningmoen Stadium in Overhalla, where participants run 7.5 laps around the athletics track. The series offers a participation prize to those who complete at least four of the eight races, and has age-group categories to ensure fair competition.
course_highlights: 7.5 laps around the athletics track at Svenningmoen Stadium
Road race in Overhalla, Trøndelag
Participation prize: porcelain mug for taking part in 4 of 8 races
additional: Age-group categories: 12–14, 15–17, 18–22, 23–34, 35–39, 40–44, 45–49, 50–54, 55–59, 60–64, 65–69, 70–74, 75+. A porcelain mug participation prize is awarded to those who take part in at least 4 of the 8 races in the Namdalskarusellen.

name: Sandbäckens Norrköpingsstafetten
description: Sandbäckens Norrköpingsstafetten takes place in Folkparken in Norrköping. Four people form a team and take turns walking, jogging or running an exciting 4 km leg each. There are timed and untimed categories, and the race is promoted as an accessible and festive relay for recreational runners and teams. Thanks to HSB, children and young people can participate completely free of charge, and there is specific information for schools.

name: Vårruset (Falun)
description: Vårruset is Sweden’s largest fitness tour for women—a cheerful and accessible spring evening where participants can run, jog, or walk 2.5 or 5 km. The event tours 19 cities during the period, and Falun is one of the locations. All participants receive, among other things, a medal and a race bib, and teams of five are rewarded with a picnic after the finish. The race has been held since 1989 and welcomes recreational runners of different ages, in accordance with the recommendations for each distance.

name: Västerviksfemman 2026
description: Västerviksfemman is a 5 km running race starting and finishing in Stadsparken in central Västervik. The race offers a pleasant setting and a great atmosphere along the entire course, making it a popular running event. Participants can run individually or in teams of at least five people, with the team result based on the five fastest runners. The 2.5 km lap is run twice, with the start, lap point and finish in Stadsparken. Race bibs are distributed well before the start, with the option to collect them the day before or on race day.
course_highlights: 5 km course in central Västervik, starting and finishing in Stadsparken
The 2.5 km lap is run twice
Pleasant setting and a great atmosphere along the entire course
additional: Race bibs are distributed before 17:30 on race day. Teams receive their race bibs together in one envelope. Race bibs can be collected on Tuesday 18 May at Intersport from 11:00 to 14:00, or on Wednesday 19 May at the stage in Stadsparken from 12:00. You can participate individually or in a team of at least five people; the five fastest times are added together.

name: Blodomloppet Linköping
organizer: IK Akele och Blodtappen i Östergötland

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Ungdomslag (alla fem lagmedlemmar födda 2009 eller senare) deltar för halva startavgiften tack vare samarbete med Lejonfastigheter och Maxi ICA Linköping. Gäller endast till och med 30 april.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Sista dag för laganmälan är 14 maj, därefter är det individuell anmälan som gäller.

description: Blodomloppet in Linköping is a recreational race that raises awareness of the vital importance of blood donation and welcomes everyone to walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km. The race is open to both individual participants and teams. Teams can consist of 3–5 people, and participants can choose different distances within the same team. Blodomloppet is a social, health-promoting activity that ends with a large picnic and has a strong focus on attracting new blood donors. Youth teams receive a discount, and blood donors are offered a special discount on the entry fee. Participants also have the opportunity to travel free of charge on public transport in Östergötland on race day.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km distances for women and men
The race takes place in Linköping, with the start and finish in central areas
Water stations are available along the course
additional: All participants who register by 14 May and provide a mobile phone number will receive a ticket link by text message for six hours of free public transport in Östergötland on 21 May. Team registration is for 3–5 people, and you always pay for 5, even if the team has fewer members. Race bib collection and late registration are available at several locations in the days before the race. Blood donors receive a discount of SEK 40 per person, both for individual entries and team entries. Registration for 2027 opens in a few weeks, according to the organiser’s website.

name: Vårruset (Västerås)
description: Vårruset in Västerås is part of Sweden’s largest recreational running tour for women and starts at 19:00 at Lögastrand. The race offers distances of 2.5 km and 5 km (the 5 km course is officially measured) and is suitable both for experienced runners and for those who want to jog or walk. Everyone who registers individually receives a medal, a finish-line bag and a race number; teams of five are treated to a picnic after finishing. Timing is available for the 5 km, but can be opted out of during registration if you do not want your result published.

name: Stigtomtaloppet 2026
location: Stigtomta, Nyköping Municipality, Södermanland County, Sweden
description: Stigtomtaloppet is a scenic running festival in Stigtomta, welcoming all age groups and runners, from children to adults, including a new dog category. The race offers distances of 3.8 km and 7.6 km on a mix of paved roads, forest trails and residential streets. It is a popular recreational race that also features team competitions with a picnic after the race, bringing participants together. Since starting in 2012, the race has grown to become the largest in the Nyköping region and is known for its friendly, inclusive atmosphere.
course_highlights: Course on paved roads, forest trails and residential streets
Timed hill sprint on the steepest hill
Prizes along the course that participants can take with them to the finish
additional: Start and finish at ICA Nära in Stigtomta. Participant bags with race bibs and timing chips must be collected no later than 30 minutes before the start. Team competitions have a mass start and include a picnic basket (no special diets). The dog category has its own start time and prize table. A refreshment tent serving fika and accepting card payments is available. Parking with guidance and bicycle parking are available. Timed hill sprint on the steepest hill. Prizes along the course that participants can take with them to the finish.

name: NUTS Karhunkierros
organizer: Northern Ultra Trail Service - NUTS oy
description: NUTS Karhunkierros is Finland’s greatest trail-running event, following the legendary Karhunkierros hiking trail in Kuusamo. The event centre is in Ruka’s pedestrian village, where all distances also start and finish. There are five different trail-running distances, from 13 km up to the 166 km ultra, challenging runners across varied terrain and in changeable weather. The routes pass through the stunning scenery of Oulanka National Park, and the event provides aid stations, timing and a range of services for participants.
course_highlights: Varied trail scenery in Oulanka National Park
Overnight running on the longest, 166 km distance
Ruka’s fell scenery on the shorter distances
additional: The entry fee includes a race bib, timing, a marked course, drinks and energy supplies at aid stations, transport to the finish for participants who withdraw at aid stations, finish-line food, washing facilities for day visitors and a medal. Portable toilets are available at the start areas, but the 34, 55 and 83 km start areas do not have a separate water point. GPS tracking is a rental service, and booking opens approximately 2–3 weeks before the event. A start bus can be purchased for the 34, 55 and 83 km distances, but no start bus is needed for the 166 km distance. Participants choose a start window during which they set off, and timing begins when the runner starts the course. The distances are 13 km, 34 km, 55 km, 83 km and 166 km. Participants in the 13 km distance must be at least 12 years old during the event year.

name: Sidsjö Trail
organizer: Sidsjö Böle IF P-14 tillsammans med morron
description: Sidsjö Trail is a challenging and fun trail race set in the scenic surroundings of Sidsjön and Södra Berget in Sundsvall. The race offers several distances, from a 1 km children’s race to 12 km, and is suitable for both seasoned trail runners and beginners looking to test their limits. The courses feature varied terrain, beautiful views, forests and lakes, with nature at the heart of the experience. The event is documented with photos and video, and children receive a Kexchoklad wafer bar at the finish. Sidsjö Trail is organized by the local football team Sidsjö Böle IF P-14 together with morron, helping support the team’s activities and community involvement.
course_highlights: A trail race through varied natural surroundings around Sidsjön and Södra Berget
Beautiful views, forests and lakes along the course
Distances include a 1 km children’s race, 3 km, 6 km and 12 km

name: Tolvanloppet 12km
description: Tolvanloppet is a city race with a friendly, charming atmosphere and events for all ages (in 2026, participants ranged from 2 to 98 years old). Adults can choose between two distances, the main event being 12 km (the shorter distance is 6 km). The course winds through the old residential neighborhoods of Bromma and is described as beautiful but challenging, with quite a few hills. Along the route, expect plenty of support from residents, including their own water stations (in addition to the course’s four official ones) and refreshing sprinklers. All this makes the race Stockholm’s most charming street race.

name: Ludvika stadslopp
description: Ludvika City Race is an annual running celebration that brings together elite runners and recreational runners in Ludvika. The start and finish are at Charlie Normans Square, centrally located between the railway station and the marina. The event is marked by large crowds, many participants, and a wide range of activities for all ages. Together with partners and volunteers, it creates a wonderful atmosphere of wellbeing, exercise, and community.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Charlie Normans Square in Ludvika
Race through the central parts of the city, near the railway station and marina
A large number of participants and crowd support create a festive atmosphere
additional: The event has over 1,100 registered participants and offers activities for both young and old. Thanks go to the participants, spectators, volunteers, and partners who make this well-organised and popular running celebration possible.

name: Luleå Stadsmara
description: Luleå Stadsmara is a classic recreational race held at the university campus in Porsön, Luleå. The race is aimed particularly at upper secondary school students and offers a spectator-friendly 10 km course that passes through Mjölkudden, the city centre, Lulsundet and Björkskatan before returning to the university. After finishing, participants receive fruit and drinks and have the chance to win great raffle prizes. Timing is done with a chip, and results are reported live online.
course_highlights: Start at the university campus in Porsön
The course passes through Mjölkudden, the city centre, Lulsundet and Björkskatan
A spectator-friendly course, with fruit and drinks after the finish
additional: Race bibs are collected inside Stil Sportcenter, Universitetsvägen 11C, 977 54 Luleå. Registration is through PE teachers. Chip timing and net time. Live results online. Race bibs are collected at the reception of StiL Sportcenter, and timing is done with a chip. Late registration is stated to cost an extra 50 kr.

name: Uka Pain
description: Uka Pain is a series of challenging trail races in Älvdalen, offering distances from 12 km up to 100 miles. The races feature spectacular scenery, high mountain peaks and technical trails, making them one of Sweden’s major autumn running experiences. The start and finish are at Hotell Älvdalen, which also serves as the hub for the race and support. The longest distance, 100 miles, features a unique course consisting of three laps of the 50 km course, with spectacular views from several mountain peaks.
course_highlights: The course passes three of Älvdalen’s highest peaks: Hykjeberg, Skärklitt and Väsaberget
Technical trails and varied terrain, with approximately 1,500 metres of elevation gain on the 52 km course
Start and finish at Hotell Älvdalen, with spa and sauna access available to 100-mile participants
additional: Start and finish at Hotell Älvdalen. Bib pickup at The Running Company near Hotell Älvdalen. Drop bags are permitted for the 50 km, 100 km and 100-mile races, with a maximum size of 60x40x40 cm. Mandatory equipment requirements apply to the 50 km, 100 km and 100-mile races. A bus is provided for 100-mile participants from Hotell Älvdalen to the start at Boggberget. Maximum time limits: 28 km – 10 hours, 50 km – 12 hours, 100 km – 22 hours, 100 miles – 34 hours. A T-shirt is included for registrations made by 30 April. A finisher’s medal is exclusive to the 100-mile race. Spa and sauna access for 100-mile participants. The race takes place on 28–29 May 2027. Bibs can be collected at The Running Company, Dalgatan 81F. Bring your own cup for the aid stations; a participant T-shirt is included for those who register by 30 April 2027.

name: VirsboRUN
description: VirsboRUN is a trail race offering a varied and exciting course in an untouched nature reserve, partly in Hälleskogsbrännan, which burned in 2014. The race offers several distances, from 5.3 km up to a challenging half marathon of 21.2 km, with 101 metres of elevation gain per lap. There is also a children’s race of approximately 800 metres, which is free and suitable for the whole family. The start and finish are at Skräddartorpet, where participants can enjoy medals, freshly grilled hamburgers and a great atmosphere. Everyone is welcome to take part, regardless of age or experience, and experience the beautiful, challenging terrain.
course_highlights: Trail race in an untouched nature reserve, partly in Hälleskogsbrännan, which burned in 2014
5.3 km lap course with 101 metres of elevation gain per lap
Children’s race of approximately 800 metres, starting and finishing at Skräddartorpet
additional: Warm-up with music and course presentation before the start. Maximum of four laps (21.2 km), with a time limit of 3 hours. An additional water station is located approximately halfway around the course. A relay option is available for families with children. Race numbers are handed out at the start. The children’s race is not officially timed, and all participants receive a medal and a goody bag. Freshly grilled hamburgers are available in the finish area after the race. A free children’s race of approximately 800 metres is offered.

name: Å-Varvet
description: Å-Varvet is a classic running race in Eskilstuna, offering a scenic and varied course along the water and through the city’s parks. The race is popular with both elite runners and recreational runners, with a great atmosphere and crowd support along the entire route. It’s a perfect event for anyone looking to challenge themselves in beautiful surroundings while enjoying Eskilstuna’s charm.
course_highlights: The course runs along Eskilstuna’s waterways and through its parks
Varied terrain with both asphalt and gravel
Crowd support along the entire course
additional: The distance is 10,549 metres.

name: Vikingbackyard
description: Vikingbackyard is a backyard ultra on the technical ski slope (teknikbacken) in Upplands Väsby, organised by Väsby SK. Each backyard is 14 laps of the slope, equal to 6.7 km, and must be completed within an hour. The runner who completes the most consecutive backyards wins the main race. The 2026 edition was the second and also included a sprint contest and a hill prize.
course_highlights: Each backyard is 14 laps of the slope, 6.7 km in total
Viking Sprint: fastest time on the first backyard
Viking Hill: fastest up the hill on the first lap
additional: Väsby SK runs open hill training on the slope on Saturdays at 10:00, and everyone is welcome to walk, jog or run.
