description: The Wild Vidzeme Stirnu buks is part of the popular Stirnu buks trail-running series, which offers various distances for participants of different ages and fitness levels. The event takes place on scenic forest trails in Latvia, where participants can enjoy a variety of surfaces, including asphalt, gravel roads, forest trails and off-road terrain. This race takes place in the vicinity of Augstroze and is suitable for both beginners and experienced trail runners. Stirnu buks is a traditional, friendly event that promotes an active lifestyle and enjoyment of nature.
course_highlights: Trails with varied surfaces: asphalt, gravel roads, forest trails and off-road terrain
Scenic forest trails in Latvia’s Vidzeme region
Distances suitable for different age groups and fitness levels
additional: Last-minute registration is available at the event centre on race day, no later than 30 minutes before the start of the relevant distance. “ENEFIT Taku gājējs” participants start first. Hike participants may set off on any distance between 9:00 and 10:30, with no timing. After 12:00, fast runners may be encountered on the courses. Discounts are available for juniors, seniors and special groups.

name: Skrējiens Apkārt Bušenieku ezeram
description: The Run Around Lake Bušenieki is a traditional running event in Ventspils, offering participants the opportunity to enjoy a beautiful, scenic route around Lake Bušenieki. The race is suitable for runners of all levels and promotes an active lifestyle. The event is organized with the support of the Latvian Athletics Association, ensuring professional organization and a safe environment for all participants.
course_highlights: A route around Lake Bušenieki with scenic natural landscapes
The race takes place in the city of Ventspils on a well-prepared course
Suitable for runners of all levels and fans of active recreation

name: Bėgimo varžybos Pavelo Fedorenkos ir Kupiškio r. Kūno kultūros ir sporto centro prizams laimėti
organizer: Kupiškio r. kūno kultūros ir sporto centras
description: The running competition for the prizes of Pavel Fedorenka and the Kupiškis District Physical Education and Sports Centre invites participants to register and compete. The event is held in Kupiškis to promote sporting activity and community spirit. It is a great opportunity to test your abilities and enjoy running in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: The event is open to all age groups
Compete for prizes from Pavel Fedorenka and the Kupiškis District Physical Education and Sports Centre
Location: Kupiškis, Lithuania
additional: The event will take place on May 29, 2027. Registration is available online and via social media.

name: Stadionloppet
description: Stadionloppet is a family-friendly running event held at Stockholm Olympic Stadium. The main race is 5 km long and takes place on a scenic two-lap course created by Kalle Berglund. The event is marked by a wonderful sense of community, where children, young people and adults can all take part and cheer one another on. The start, lap point and finish are at the beautiful stadium, offering a unique running experience in a setting where the buzz of the city meets greenery and birdsong.
course_highlights: 5 km two-lap course around Stockholm Olympic Stadium
Course created by Kalle Berglund, a former world-class runner
Start, lap point and finish at Stockholm Olympic Stadium
additional: All members of Djurgården Friidrott run for free and receive a registration code when they join. Several shorter distances are available for children and young people. Members can also take part as volunteers and be part of the event. Start times and categories are preliminary and may change. Stadiongirot, a cycling race held in collaboration with Djurgården Cykel, also takes place on the same day. Members of Djurgården Friidrott can run for free with a registration code. Distance and category details for 2027 are preliminary and may change. Free trial training on the course is held ahead of the race.

name: “Mizojam, ka prieks”
location: Zeltiņu pļavas, Zeltiņi, Alūksne Municipality, Latvia
description: We run for joy is an open cross-country running series in Zeltiņi Parish, organised by Sports Club Zeltiņi since 2013. The races take place in four rounds in the meadows of Zeltiņi and are open to different age groups and fitness levels, with distances ranging from 300 metres for children to walking distances for the 60+ age group. The event welcomes both recreational runners and experienced athletes, and is characterised by variety, accessibility and a sense of togetherness. Traditionally, warm-ups are led by Latvian Olympians and athletes, creating a special atmosphere for all participants.
course_highlights: Cross-country running on trails through the meadows of Zeltiņi
Distances ranging from 300 metres for children to walking distances for the 60+ age group
Warm-ups led by Latvian Olympians and athletes
additional: The competition is a four-round series open to children and adults, as well as walkers in the 60+ age group. Local businesses and the community support the event, promoting an active and sporty lifestyle. The series consists of four rounds, with events held at different locations in Zeltiņi Parish. The season opening includes a group warm-up run and soup by the campfire.

name: KOMIA Trail Cup
description: KOMIA Trail Cup is a trail-running series in the nearby forests of Seinäjoki, offering marked routes over distances of 5–7 kilometres. The series is suitable for runners of all levels who want to enjoy trail running, either competitively or at a relaxed pace in nature. The events are held on weekday evenings, and participants earn points throughout the series, with prizes for the top runners. The series also offers children a free, shorter 2 km distance. The running events are relaxed but suitably challenging, and are ideal for getting fit or for an evening run.
course_highlights: The route follows marked nature trails in the nearby forests of Seinäjoki
The main route is about 7 km; the children's route is about 2–3 km
There may be wet sections on the route after rain
additional: Registration and bib collection take place at the event venue from 17:00 to 17:50. The run starts with a mass start, but participants can also run without a time. The bib must be visible throughout the run. Gear storage is limited, and there are no toilets at the event venue. Participants are encouraged to arrange their own leisure-time insurance. Littering in nature is prohibited. Registration is required separately for each event.

name: Blodomloppet (Umeå)

price_tiers.distance: Promenad 5 km, löpning 5 km och 10 km

description: Blodomloppet in Umeå is a recreational event that raises awareness of the vital importance of blood donation and welcomes everyone to walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km. The event is open to participants of all ages and abilities, including children and teams, and ends with a shared picnic. It is a social and healthy activity that promotes community and wellbeing while supporting a good cause. Blodomloppet is part of Sweden’s largest recreational running event, with a strong focus on blood donation and health.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km courses in Umeå
The children’s race, Lilla Blodomloppet
Shared picnic after the race
additional: Race bibs and T-shirts can be collected at IFK Umeå’s club premises on 21–22 May and 24 May, and at Väven on 25 May. Teams of at least 5 people receive a picnic bag. Blood donors receive a discount of SEK 40 per person. Registration changes are free of charge until 21 May; after that, changes require an in-person visit and cost SEK 50. An order ID is required to collect race bibs. Blood donors receive a discount of SEK 40 per person. The last day to register a team and receive the picnic bag offer is 18 May. Individual registration is stated to be available until 25 May.

description: Blodomloppet in Hudiksvall is a fun run that raises awareness of the vital importance of blood donation. You can walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km, either on your own or together with colleagues and friends. The event is part of Sweden’s largest fun run series, with a strong focus on health and social connection, and traditionally ends with a large picnic. Blodomloppet is open to everyone and promotes a healthy lifestyle while supporting youth activities in the organizing clubs.
course_highlights: Timed 5 km and 10 km courses
Lilla Blodomloppet for children
Water stations along the course
additional: The event offers discounted team registration and an Excel template for large groups. Changing facilities, toilets, storage, water stations and medical assistance are available on site. After the event, participants can enjoy a large picnic. The main races start at 18:30. The event is organized by Strands IF Friidrott together with GeBlod Gävleborg. Timed 5 km and 10 km races are available. Lilla Blodomloppet is available for children.

name: Vårruset Karlstad
organizer: Vårruset i samarbete med IF Göta Karlstad
description: Vårruset in Karlstad is a popular spring running event offering a lovely, friendly running experience for women of all ages. The race follows a 5 km course, with both timed and untimed participation options. After the finish, teams of five are treated to a picnic, creating a pleasant opportunity to socialize. The event area is located between Sundstagymnasiet and Sundstabadet, and the organizer encourages participants to travel to the start in an environmentally friendly way.
course_highlights: 5 km course, timed or untimed
Start and finish in the area between Sundstagymnasiet and Sundstabadet
Picnic after the finish for teams of 5
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Intersport Bergvik in the days before the event and at the venue from 15:00 on race day. Race information is sent out about one week before the event. There is a supervised area where participants can leave their warm-up clothes before the start. The organizer recommends cycling or taking public transport to the event area. City buses are free upon presentation of a race bib or race information. Teams consist of 5 people and must be complete no later than one month before the event to receive picnic vouchers. Changing rooms are available at Sundsta Sports Hall. Teams registered with five people receive a picnic after the finish. Individual participants receive a medal, a finish-line bag, and a race bib.

name: Gladsheim Finspångs Stadslopp
description: Gladsheim Finspång City Race is an annual fun run through beautiful Finspång, starting and finishing in Bruksparken. The race offers a 7-kilometre course with smooth, even surfaces, ideal for both runners and recreational participants. For a shorter challenge, there is AktivRundan, approximately 3.8 kilometres with no timing, and children can take part in XL Bygg Lilla Slottsrundan, a 1.7-kilometre route through an easy-to-run park setting. All participants receive a medal and energy products, and there are great prizes to be won. The race is open to everyone, whether they walk, jog or run.
course_highlights: 7 km course with smooth, even surfaces through central Finspång
AktivRundan: 3.8 km without timing for walkers and joggers
XL Bygg Lilla Slottsrundan: 1.7 km for children through an easy-to-run park setting
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Stora Coop Finspång/Viberga on Tuesday, 26 May, between 15:00 and 19:00. Late registration is available at the bib collection point and at the start and finish area from 15:00 on race day. Timing uses a chip on the race bib tab; without it, no time will be recorded. The children’s race has four start times between 17:00 and 18:00, depending on age group. All participants receive a medal, energy products and a water bottle sponsored by local businesses. The children’s race prize-giving takes place on the stage in Bruksparken at 18:15. The race’s official website currently provides information about the 2026 edition; prices and practical details for 2027 have not been specified.

description: Blodomloppet in Uppsala is a recreational race that highlights the life-saving importance of blood donation and welcomes participants to walk, jog or run the 5 km and 10 km distances. The race is open to everyone, whether taking part alone or with colleagues and friends. There are also special races, including Lilla Blodomloppet and Specialomloppet, for different ages and abilities. Blodomloppet is a social and healthy activity that ends with a shared picnic and helps promote blood donation and youth sports in the region.
course_highlights: The 10 km course is officially measured and runs through Uppsala
The 5 km and 2.5 km courses are popular but not officially measured
Option to participate as a team of 5
additional: Team registration for 5 people is available. An Excel template for large registrations can be downloaded. The 10 km course is officially measured, while the 5 km and 2.5 km distances are approximate. Dogs are welcome to participate. A shared picnic is offered after the race. Water stations are located along the course. Changing facilities and toilets are available. Medical services are on site. Race bibs are distributed before the start. The race highlights the importance of blood donation.

name: Bėgimas „Kutaliai – Kaltinėnai“
location: Kutaliai, Kaltinėnai eldership, Šilalė District Municipality, Lithuania
description: The “Kutaliai–Kaltinėnai” Run is a traditional cross-country race held to mark the 141st anniversary of the birth of Aleksandras Stulginskis, President of the Republic of Lithuania, and the Day of the Constituent Seimas. The race takes place over hilly terrain, promoting physical activity and respect for sport. The start is in the village of Kutaliai, and the finish is at the stadium of Aleksandras Stulginskis Gymnasium in Kaltinėnai, Šilalė District. Athletes from city and district schools, as well as anyone else wishing to participate, may take part provided they have a doctor’s permission. The event is organized by Aleksandras Stulginskis Gymnasium in Šilalė District.
course_highlights: Cross-country race over hilly terrain
Start in the village of Kutaliai; finish at the Kaltinėnai gymnasium stadium
Held to mark the anniversary of Aleksandras Stulginskis, President of the Republic of Lithuania, and the Day of the Constituent Seimas
additional: Registration is open until 9:30 a.m. on race day at Aleksandras Stulginskis Gymnasium in Kaltinėnai. Participants must have a doctor’s permission or an entry form endorsed by a doctor. All participants receive commemorative medals, and the first-, second-, and third-place finishers in each group receive medals. Participants at the previous event were presented with commemorative medals.

name: Blodomloppet Örebro

description: Blodomloppet in Örebro is a recreational race that highlights the vital importance of blood donation and welcomes everyone to walk, jog or run with friends, family or colleagues. The event offers several distances, including 5 km, 10 km, the Special Race and Little Blodomloppet for children. It is a social, healthy activity that also promotes team spirit and wellness, with the option to participate in teams of five. After the race, participants often gather for a shared picnic, and the event area is well equipped for an enjoyable day for the whole family.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km courses for women and men
Special Race: approximately 2.1 km
Little Blodomloppet: approximately 750 m or 2.1 km for children aged 1–12
additional: You can register individually or in a team of five, with the option to fill vacant places later. Discounts are available for blood donors and ICA Stammis members (SEK 40), but not during late registration. There is no age limit for the 5 km and 10 km distances, but participants should be able to complete the course on their own or with an accompanying adult. Little Blodomloppet is for children aged 1–12, and adults may accompany them as long as they do not interfere with others. A large picnic is offered to participants after the race. Wellness allowances can be used when registering. The event takes place at Trängens IP. Participants receive, among other things, a T-shirt, race bib and medal; prices vary depending on the distance and registration date.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://blodomloppet.se/vara-lopp/orebro/): 2027-05-27 — "27 maj 2027" (was estimated 2027-06-01)

name: Vårruset
organizer: Marathongruppen, tillsammans med Hässelby SK, Spårvägens FK och lokal arrangör KFUM Örebro Friidrott
description: Vårruset in Örebro is a popular spring running event offering 2.5 km and 5 km distances on a measured course. The event is open to all ages. The recommended minimum age is 7 when accompanied by an adult for the shorter distance and 11 for the longer distance. Participants receive a medal, a finish-line bag and a race bib, and can opt for timing on the 5 km course. Teams that register are invited to a group picnic after finishing, making for a lovely social spring evening at Gustavsviksbadet. The event is all about community and fun, with activities and a music quiz for participants.
course_highlights: Measured 5 km course
Start and finish at Gustavsviksbadet
Water station and toilets in the event area
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Intersport Marieberg in the days before the event. Teams of 5 can enjoy a picnic after finishing. The event area is at Gustavsvik Camping, where parking is limited; participants are encouraged to travel in an environmentally friendly way. Participants are advised to change at home. A water station and toilets are available on site. There is an option to leave a bag of warm-up clothes labelled with your name and race number. Race information will be emailed approximately two weeks before the event. Timing is available as an optional extra for the 5 km. The recommended minimum age for the 2.5 km is 11, or 7 when accompanied by an adult; for the 5 km, it is 13, or 11 when accompanied by an adult.

name: 3. Benno Viirandi nimeline rahvajooks
description: The 3rd Benno Viirand Memorial Fun Run is a family-oriented running and Nordic walking event held in Mustla. The race follows a 5 km course, starting near the Vambola bus stop in Soe village and finishing at the Tarvastu Gymnasium stadium. The event aims to honour the memory of the legendary runner Benno Viirand and promote running as a healthy way to spend time. In addition to the main race, free children’s races are held at the stadium. Participants are provided with race numbers and can register in advance or in person on race day.

name: adidas Shake Out Run
description: The adidas Shake Out Run is a 5 km race starting and finishing at Stockholm Olympic Stadium. It’s a perfect warm-up for participants running the Stockholm Marathon the following day, as well as an opportunity for other runners to experience the unique marathon atmosphere during the event weekend. The first 1,000 people to register will receive an adidas T-shirt in their chosen size to run in, distributed at the event. After the race, people who register later can also collect T-shirts in the remaining sizes.
course_highlights: 5 km distance, starting and finishing at Stockholm Olympic Stadium
The race serves as a warm-up for the Stockholm Marathon
A unique marathon atmosphere during the event weekend
additional: Age limit: 13 years (11 years when accompanied by a parent or guardian). Late registration is available online until 1 hour before the first start. Payment options include online banking, Visa, MasterCard, Swish, and invoice via Klarna. The event is organised by the athletics clubs Hässelby SK and Spårvägens FK. The age limit is 13 years, or 11 years when accompanied by a parent or guardian. Late registration can be completed online until one hour before the first start.

name: Rojas 24h, 12h, 6h un maratona skrējieni
description: Roja Marathon Festival offers a variety of distances, including 24-hour, 12-hour and 6-hour ultramarathons, as well as a half marathon and shorter races. The event takes place at Roja Stadium on a certified asphalt course suitable for timed races. It welcomes both professional runners and amateurs, with a range of races and Nordic walking. The festival also includes children’s races and is a great opportunity to enjoy an active day and the spirit of competition by the sea.
course_highlights: Course lap length: 1,234.7 m
Course surface: stadium and asphalt
The course meets the requirements for timed races and has World Athletics certification
additional: The 24-hour ultramarathon starts at 15:00, the 12-hour race at 20:00, the 6-hour race at 09:00, and the 42 km race at 10:00. The course is a 1,234.7 m loop with stadium and asphalt surfaces. Registration and bib collection take place on race day from 12:00 to 14:00. The awards ceremony is at 17:00.

name: Seiklus x Tartu
description: Seiklus x Tartu is the fifth stage of the adventure racing series and takes place in the city of Tartu. This one-day adventure race has teams of three navigating the terrain on foot, by canoe and by bike. It is suitable both as a serious competition and as an active way to spend time with friends in Estonia’s beautiful nature. The course offers distances of varying difficulty, including an accessible short course for everyone.
course_highlights: The course is completed on foot, by canoe and by bike
The short course is technically easy and accessible to everyone
There are several refreshment stations along the course with snacks and drinks
additional: The race centre opens at 9:00, with registration and distribution of race materials. There are snack and drink stations on the course, and hot food and tea are served at the finish. No organised transport or official accommodation is provided; participants are advised to use their own transport and arrange accommodation themselves. The course is a loop, with the start and finish at the same location. Participants can compete in three-person men’s, women’s and mixed teams, and individual participation is also possible. The short course is technically easy. The race centre opens at 9:00 and the start is at 10:00; hot food and tea are served at the finish.

name: Arco Vara 55. jooks ümber Harku järve
description: The 55th Arco Vara run around Lake Harku is a traditional 6.5 km running race held on the shore of Lake Harku. The race is part of the 2026 Maru Lake Runs series and is its second event. There are water stations along the course, which is marked and secured by course marshals. Nordic walkers and walkers are also welcome and start in the final group. The event centre is at the start/finish area, where race numbers are also distributed and the awards ceremony takes place.

name: Koeru kergejõustikuvõistlused
description: Koeru Athletics Competition is a traditional track and field event held at the Koeru Secondary School stadium. Men and women compete in two age groups and take part in several events, including the 100 m run, long jump, shot put, discus throw, javelin throw, and 1000 m run. The winner is determined by adding the points from their three best events. The competition is open to everyone, and participants may enter all events. Young athletes use throwing implements appropriate for their age group.

name: Maardu kevadjooks
description: Maardu Spring Run and Health Walk is a traditional sports day held in Maardu, bringing together people of all ages who enjoy being active. The event features several runs and health walks for different age groups and abilities, including children’s runs, a youth run, a walk for people with special needs, and 3 km and 5 km runs. Participation is free, and every finisher receives a medal. The event aims to offer the joy of movement, a sense of well-being, and an active day outdoors, while highlighting time spent together with family and friends.

name: adidas Stockholm Marathon
description: The adidas Stockholm Marathon is a classic marathon that takes place this year and attracts both elite and recreational runners. The race is 42,195 metres long, officially measured in accordance with current rules, and follows a new route through central Stockholm. The event is organised by the athletics clubs Hässelby SK and Spårvägens FK, and the organisers highlight extensive runner services along the course. The race starts at Stockholm Olympic Stadium and offers seeding opportunities through events including adidas Premiärmilen and adidas Premiärhalvan.
course_highlights: 42,195 metres, officially measured according to the Swedish Athletics Association and the IAAF
A new route through central Stockholm (including Sveavägen and Kungsgatan), with a passage through the city
World-class runner services along the entire course
additional: Start and finish area: Lidingövägen outside the clock tower at Stockholm Olympic Stadium. The race starts in two waves, at 12:00 and 12:10. The marathon time limit is 6.5 hours, and there are four checkpoints with cut-off times along the course. adidas Premiärmilen and adidas Premiärhalvan count towards seeding. adidas Premiärmilen (10 km) takes place in Norra Djurgården, has a total elevation gain of 117 m, features mixed surfaces and has a provisional start time of 11:00; the time limit is 2 hours, and the contact email for Premiärmilen is info@premiarmilen.se. The event is organised by Hässelby SK and Spårvägens FK, and the website is provided by Marathongruppen i Stockholm AB. The course passes through central Stockholm and finishes at Stockholm Olympic Stadium; runners can also take part in related adidas events such as Premiärmilen, Premiärhalvan and Shake Out Run.

name: Backyard Ultra Vänge
description: The loop is a real gem, if we may say so ourselves—a slice of Uppland at its best. The race hub is High Chaparral Park, with its large green spaces: a natural race base in the heart of the community of Vänge. Backyard Ultra Vänge will draw spectators along the course, which awaits you dressed in lovely spring attire. We have taken care to create a varied and somewhat challenging course. The result is an experience where something is always happening and the running never gets monotonous. Large parts of the race take place on the slightly bumpy trail on the outskirts of the community. You’ll feel as if you’re flying over soft ground beneath big trees and past colossal rocks. Several national-team runners began their running careers here, and many prominent floorball players have sweated through hard training sessions. An oasis in the forest—with a glimpse of Highway 72. A road tunnel takes you beneath the highway and into the unique Uppland rowing village of Vänge-Ekeby. The village, which has been a listed building since 1998, has medieval origins and a preserved village layout. Vänge Hembygdsförening has given the village an active cultural life and attracted many visitors. The course winds through this fantastic setting. Take the opportunity to enjoy the atmosphere and a glimpse of society as it once was. Then it’s back beneath the highway and into the forest on small trails. Before you know it, you’re back in the community and looping around High Chaparral. Take a short rest and perhaps enjoy some of the energizing snacks on offer. Then you’re off again. Wonderful!
