name: Seskarö Trailrun 2026
location: Seskarö Havsbad & Camping, Seskarö, Haparanda Municipality, Sweden
distance_verbose: 12 km, 7 km, 3000 meter, 2 km, 1 km, 0.5 km
description: Seskarö Trailrun 2026 is northern Sweden’s most fun race, offering courses for everyone, regardless of experience or age. It’s a competition and an experience for the whole family, with a focus on the joy of running. The courses wind through Seskarö’s fantastic trails and the beautiful natural surroundings of the Haparanda Archipelago, across varied terrain including forest, gravel, cobblestones and sand. There are several distances, from 500 metres for the youngest participants to 12 km for those looking for a bigger challenge on technical terrain.
course_highlights: The course follows existing trails and combinations of trails, with varied surfaces including forest, gravel, cobblestones and sand
Technically challenging sections include jumping over logs and rocks, as well as sandy and cobblestone sections
Detailed course maps for 12 km (clockwise), 7 km (clockwise) and 3 km (counterclockwise) are available on site
additional: Race bibs can be collected on Friday 29/5 from 17:00 to 20:00 and Saturday 30/5 from 08:00 at Seskarö Havsbad & Camping. Bibs must be collected at least 30 minutes before the start. All participants receive a Seskarö Trailrun finisher’s medal. Showers and toilets are available. Proceeds from the entry fee go towards maintaining and developing the Seskarö Trails recreation area. The race takes place at Seskarö Havsbad & Camping.

name: Blue Mountain Trail Run
price_range: 150-450 kr beroende på distans och anmälningstid

price_tiers.distance: 15 km - Alvars stig by Nordväggen AB
6 km - Östra Ånnabodasjön by ICA Glansen

description:
Blue Mountain TrailRun is a trail race in Kilsbergen, 20 kilometres west of Örebro. There are four courses of 6, 10, 15 and 21 km, all starting and finishing at First Camp Ånnaboda.

The courses follow Bergslagsleden and the MTB trails around Ånnaboda: narrow trails, roots and rocks, boardwalks over streams, moss-covered spruce forest and views of forest lakes. The 21 km Blankhult course has 527 metres of elevation gain and is the race’s long loop for those looking for technical trails and hills. The 15 km Alvars stig is the middle-distance course, with trails all the way. The 10 km Trolldalsvägen is the classic 10-kilometre course. The 6 km Östra Ånnabodasjön course goes around the lake on mostly easy-running trails and is suitable as a first trail race.

Men’s and women’s categories on all courses, no time limit, electronic timing and a medal for everyone who finishes. The runner who breaks the course record on the 21 km course receives SEK 5,000. The fifth edition takes place in 2027. The race has been organised by Garphyttans IF Orientering since 2023.
course_highlights: Technical trails and hilly terrain along stage 9 of Bergslagsleden
Passes several forest lakes, including Norra Ånnabodasjön and Stora Dammsjön
Climb to Sånnabodahöjden, with sweeping views over Närkeslätten
additional: Race bibs can be collected at the race office from 09.00. Registration opens on 1 December 2026. The registration deadline is 22 May 2027. Late registration is available on race day from 09.00 to 09.15, subject to availability. Start times: 6 km at 09.43, 21 km at 10.00, 15 km at 10.35 and 10 km at 11.00. Aid stations with water, sports drink and snacks are located approximately every five kilometres. Trail shoes are recommended. Burgers, coffee and refreshments are available in the finish area. Swim in Södra Ånnabodasjön after the race. 21 km course records: 1:16:41 (men) and 1:29:16 (women).

name: Öland Lighthouse Challenge
location: Långe Erik Lighthouse, Byxelkrok, Öland, Sweden
description: Öland Lighthouse Challenge is an ultramarathon that starts at Långe Erik Lighthouse on Öland and offers three distances: 100 miles, 50 miles and 50 km. The race offers a fantastic running experience along the coast of the Kalmar Sound, through meadows and forests, and across the unique limestone pavement with views of the Baltic Sea. The finish location depends on the distance: 50 km in Djupvik, 50 miles in Lindby and 100 miles at Långe Jan Lighthouse. Everyone who completes the race receives a medal and a T-shirt as a keepsake.
course_highlights: Start at Långe Erik Lighthouse and finish at Långe Jan for the 100-mile distance
Run along the coast of the Kalmar Sound and through meadows and forests
Views of the Baltic Sea and Öland’s unique limestone pavement
additional: All distances start together on Friday afternoon at 15:00 at Långe Erik Lighthouse. Aid stations or energy stations are located approximately every 20 km along the course. Get 15% off accommodation at Böda Sand during the weekend when booking with the code Lighthouse Challenge. Energy and hydration stations are located along the course; the official race website states that they are approximately 20 km apart. Published prices apply to 2026 and may change before 2027.

name: „Vilties bėgimas“
distance_verbose: Maratonas, Pusmaratonas, 10 km, 5.3 km, 5 km, 3000 metrai, 1.35 km, 0.2 km
organizer: Mažesniųjų Brolių Ordino Lietuvos Šv. Kazimiero Provincijos Klaipėdos Šv. Pranciškaus Asyžiečio Vienuolynas, VšĮ „Šv. Pranciškaus vilties miestas“, Klaipėdos miesto savivaldybės administracija ir VšĮ Klaipėdos lengvosios atletikos akademija
description: The Run for Hope is a traditional fundraising and solidarity run in Klaipėda, held to support people with cancer and their loved ones. The event offers a range of distances, from children’s races to a marathon on a loop course in the city centre. It promotes a healthy, active lifestyle and brings the community together in solidarity and hope. Participants can choose an individual distance or a team relay. The event takes place in late May, with start times from morning until afternoon.
course_highlights: Loop course in Klaipėda city centre
Marathon: 8 laps; half marathon: 4 laps
Distances ranging from 0.2 km for children to the 42.195 km marathon
additional: Online registration is open until May 29 at 21:00. In-person registration and race pack collection are also available in Klaipėda from May 28–30. Team relay participants register separately by email. Starts are scheduled at different times by distance, from 9:00 to 14:00. Special courses are available for children, seniors and people with disabilities. Participants are invited to show solidarity and support people with cancer and their loved ones. The event also welcomes people with disabilities. In 2026, the start and finish for most distances were at Tiltų St. 26, while the 0.2 km race took place at the amphitheatre square near Jono Kalnelis.

name: Tromsøstafetten 2027
description: Tromsøstafetten is a new celebration of community in central Tromsø, focused on togetherness, atmosphere and enjoyment. The race consists of eight exciting and challenging legs with varying surfaces, distances and elevation. There is room for everyone, whatever your pace, and you are encouraged to take part with family, friends, a sports club or colleagues and experience the relay spirit together. The start and finish will be near central Tromsø, and the race offers a unique opportunity to run in beautiful surroundings with a great atmosphere along the course.
course_highlights: Eight varied legs with different surfaces, distances and elevation
Start and finish near central Tromsø
Several different categories to suit all levels and paces
additional: The minimum age is 13 (born in 2014). Medals will be awarded to the three best teams in each category, and prizes will also be drawn among all participating teams. Results will be published during and after the event. The course and start/finish location will be announced in early 2027. The minimum age is 13. The course and exact start and finish locations will be announced in early 2027. Medals will be awarded to the three best teams in each category, and prizes will be drawn among participating teams.

name: Läänemaa sörgib ühissörk
description: Läänemaa Jog Together is a fun, relaxed family event taking place on 31 May at Haapsalu Railway Station. The group jog is about 3+ kilometres at an easy pace (~7:30 min/km), welcoming everyone in Läänemaa who enjoys being active. The event is the campaign’s grand finale, bringing together the various jogs held across the county during May. Both previous participants and newcomers are welcome to enjoy being active together and strengthen the sense of community.

name: Meie oma maijooks 2026
description: The event offers various distances and age groups suitable for runners, Nordic walkers, and recreational athletes of all ages. Its aim is to promote a healthy lifestyle, provide an opportunity to compete, and celebrate family-oriented activities in the Kolga-Jaani area. Participants can enjoy a pleasant evening run on the shared-use path and at the stadium, with recognition for the top runners and representatives of the area.

name: Virtuaaljooks suvi 2026
description: Virtual Run Summer 2026 is a flexible, remote running event that allows participants to complete their chosen distance in their local area at a time that suits them. The event offers several distance options, including 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon (21 km), as well as the option to take part in a children’s race. Participants can record and upload their results to the GoAndRun.eu portal, ensuring that results are reliable and can be compared with those of other participants around the world. The virtual run offers a convenient, environmentally friendly way to take part in sport without having to travel to an event venue.

name: Vårruset Sundsvall
description: Vårruset Sundsvall is a popular spring fun run held at Hamnträdgården, with the start and finish in central Sundsvall. The event offers two distances, 2.5 km and 5 km, with the course passing through the city centre and along Selångersån. It is a fun run with timing on the 5 km distance and a great sense of community. Teams can take part, and participants are treated to a picnic after finishing. The event is open to all ages, with a recommended minimum age of 7 when accompanied by an adult, and is a perfect spring activity for both recreational and competitive runners.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Hamnträdgården in Sundsvall
The course passes through the city centre and along Selångersån
Two distances: 2.5 km and 5 km, with a certified 5 km course
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Intersport in Birsta City in the days before the event. Teams of 5 people are treated to a picnic after finishing. You can opt out of timing when registering. There are no changing facilities at the venue, but there is a supervised area where you can leave warm-up clothes. Water stations and toilets are available at the event area. The recommended minimum age is 13 for the 5 km (11 when accompanied by an adult) and 11 for the 2.5 km (7 when accompanied by an adult). Participants receive a medal, a finish-line bag and a race bib. Teams consist of five people and receive a picnic after finishing.

name: Blodomloppet
organizer: Stora Tuna OK och Kvarnsvedens GOIF Friidrott

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: ANMÄLNINGSAVGIFT 1750kr Lag (3-5 deltagare, picknickkasse ingår) fr.o.m. 8 maj

description: Blodomloppet in Borlänge is a recreational event that raises awareness of the vital importance of blood donation and welcomes everyone to walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km. The event is open to both individual participants and teams, with teams consisting of 3–5 people who can take part in different distances. The event ends with a shared picnic and offers an inclusive, social atmosphere for participants of all ages and abilities. Lilla Blodomloppet is a shorter race of approximately 800 metres for children, held in the area around the event grounds. Blodomloppet is part of Sweden’s largest recreational running series, with a focus on health and blood donation.
course_highlights: The 5 km and 10 km running routes head north across Sportfältet and split at Storsvängen
The walking route has no finish arch and ends at the fruit and medal tables
Lilla Blodomloppet is approximately 800 metres long and takes place in the area around the event grounds
additional: You can register individually or as a team (3–5 participants). Team members can take part in different distances. Team participants receive a picnic bag. Late registration for teams is not possible after 21 May, but individuals can register late until 28 May at 12:00. Late registration on race day is available between 15:45 and 17:45, with payment via Swish. Name, category or distance changes can be made by 21 May at the latest by email or at bib collection on 26 May from 16:30 to 18:30. A simple kiosk offering Swish payments only is available at the event grounds. Water stations are located along the course. Teams consist of 3–5 participants and can choose different distances or categories. A picnic bag is included with team registration. Blood donors receive a SEK 40 discount per person. Entry prices and information for 2027 may be updated.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://blodomloppet.se/vara-lopp/borlange/): 2027-05-31 — "31 maj 2027" (was estimated 2027-05-27)

name: Kambja Tervisejooksud
description: Kambja Health Runs is a traditional running series event that began in 2016 and will take place in three stages in 2026. The runs are held on the Kambja health trails, giving participants the opportunity to enjoy forest paths and some asphalt sections. The series aims to promote healthy lifestyles and motivate people to take up recreational running. Each stage features a 10 km race, as well as a health run and a power run, which uses body weight and elevation gain in its calculations. Runners who participate in all three stages will receive a series T-shirt, and the grand prize winners will receive a Merida Big Nine 20 bicycle.

name: Vårruset Östersund
location: Storsjön, north of Badhusparken, Östersund, Sweden
organizer: Marathongruppen i samarbete med lokala idrottsklubbar, däribland Trångsvikens IF
description: Vårruset in Östersund is a spring fun run offering distances of 2.5 km and 5 km along the shore of Lake Storsjön, north of Badhusparken. The event is family-friendly, with a recommended minimum age of 7 when accompanied by an adult, and offers a lovely spring evening with a post-finish picnic for teams. The start and finish are by Lake Storsjön, and the course is officially measured for 5 km. Participants receive a medal and a finish bag, and can enjoy a music quiz and prizes. They can also choose whether or not to have their time recorded.
course_highlights: The course follows the shore of Lake Storsjön, with the start and finish by the lake
The event area is north of Badhusparken, near Jamtli
The officially measured 5 km course also offers a 2.5 km distance
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Intersport Östersund on 23 and 30 May, 11:00–17:00. Teams consist of 5 people, and team members must register individually. Teams receive a picnic after the finish, which can be collected by presenting the picnic voucher on the team leader's race bib. The event area is easy to reach on foot, by bicycle, or by train to Västra station. There is a water station, portable toilets, and a facility at the information desk for checking in outerwear and valuables. The 5 km course is officially measured. Teams of five receive a picnic after the finish.

name: 5. ETAPP - Merimets
description: Stage 5 – Merimetsa is part of the 24th Tervisejooks ja -kõnd series, which takes place in the car parks at Pelguranna and Stroomi Beach. This 3.6 km stage gives participants the chance to enjoy beautiful nature and fitness trails in a coastal area. The event is suitable for both runners and walkers who want to spend time actively and improve their health. The series stages take place in different parts of Tallinn, offering varied landscapes and views.

name: Blodomloppet Stockholm
organizer: IFK Lidingö Friidrott och IFK Lidingö SOK
description: Blodomloppet in Stockholm is a recreational race that raises awareness of the vital importance of blood donation and promotes a healthy lifestyle. Participants can walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km, either individually or in a team with colleagues and friends. The race is a popular workplace wellness activity and ends with a large picnic, offering a social and meaningful experience for all ages and levels. There is also Lilla Blodomloppet for children, Specialomloppet, and the option to participate remotely.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km distances in central Stockholm
Walking category where dogs are allowed
Lilla Blodomloppet for children aged 1–12
additional: Dogs are allowed in the 5 km walking category. Wheelchairs and walking poles are permitted only in the walking categories. Strollers are not allowed during the race, but are allowed in the event area. Team registration (at least 5 people) includes a picnic bag, with extra bags available to purchase. Tents can be rented for teams or companies in the event area. Start times are divided into several groups for the 5 km and 10 km, including walking and competitive categories, with prizes for the top 3 runners. Teams must register with five people. The walking categories are not timed; blood donors receive a discount. Information about the course route and start times for 2027 will be announced later.

name: Tornimäki VERTTITONNI
description: Tornimäki VERTTITONNI is a vertical kilometre race organized by Haukivuoren Kisailijat ry and held at Tornimäki in Mikkeli. The race offers a challenging, fast-paced running experience on Tornimäki’s slopes. Participants gather for the race in the afternoon, and the event is intended for anyone interested in running. The event centre is located near the slopes, and the event is a traditional part of the local running calendar.
course_highlights: Run on Tornimäki’s slopes
Challenging slope terrain
Up Tornimäki’s lift line and down the banana slope
additional: Registration closes no later than the day before the race. The car park at Tornimäki’s slopes is not available, so cars must be left in the car park before the slope area. The use of poles is prohibited. Participants are responsible for their own support and insurance. Parking is outside the slope area.

name: Valgamaa lahtised MV
description: The Valgamaa Open Championships in Orienteering Sprint is an orienteering competition held in the Valga area. The competition is part of the RMK Eestimaa Orienteerumispäevakud, family events with no age restrictions. The courses are designed for participants of different skill levels, and competitors can choose a pace that suits them. Timing is used at the competition, and an SI card can be rented if needed to help with orienteering. The event is for everyone who wants to enjoy outdoor activity and orienteering in good company.

name: Vårruset 2025 — Luleå
location: Luleå University of Technology, Porsön, Luleå, Sweden
description: Vårruset in Luleå is part of Sweden’s largest fitness tour for women and offers a welcoming and inclusive running experience. The race is organised by Marathongruppen and takes place at scenic Porsön, by Luleå University of Technology. Participants can choose between the 2.5 km and 5 km distances on a measured course. The event includes a medal, a finish-line goodie bag, a music quiz with prizes, and timing for the 5 km race. It concludes with a picnic for team participants.
course_highlights: Measured 5 km course
Start and finish at Porsön, Luleå University of Technology
Water station and sponsor village at the event area
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Intersport Luleå in the days before the race, as well as at the event area on race day. Teams that register receive a picnic after the finish; it can be collected with the picnic voucher on the team leader’s race bib. Changing facilities are not available, but participants can leave their warm-up clothes in a bag marked with their name and race number. Toilets and water are available on site. The event area opens at 16:00, with a sponsor village and activities. Information about distances and the event format comes from Vårruset’s official website.

name: Izskrien Rīgu 1. posms – Uzvaras parks
description: Izskrien Rīgu is a running series in Riga for the whole family, held at five unique locations around the city, including Victory Park. The series aims to promote a healthy lifestyle and encourage Riga residents to be physically active. The races are suitable for participants of different ages and fitness levels, with distances ranging from children’s races to 10 km. The atmosphere is friendly and sporty, and participants can take part individually or in family teams.
course_highlights: The race takes place in Victory Park on a 1.52 km loop
The 5 km distance consists of three loops along the park paths
The relatively flat terrain is suitable for runners of different levels
additional: Bib collection starts at 18:00. There are two entrances to the start area, and participants are asked to assess their pace honestly when choosing a place in the start corral. A dedicated bag storage facility is available; participants receive a tag that must be kept for the entire season, and replacing it costs 2 EUR. It is recommended to arrive at least 30–45 minutes before the start. Public transport is the recommended way to get there, as parking in the area is limited. The series includes five events per season; participants who start in at least four events receive a commemorative season prize.

name: Cursores Backyard Ultra Aland Islands
description: Cursores Backyard Ultra is the fourth Backyard Ultra to be held on the Åland Islands. Runners repeatedly complete a 6,706-metre (4.167-mile) loop made up of gravel, asphalt and forest roads. Part of the course runs along the sea in eastern Mariehamn. The race starts at 18:00 local time and offers 100 places for runners.
course_highlights: The loop is made up of gravel, asphalt and forest roads
Part of the course runs along the sea in eastern Mariehamn
The same loop is run throughout the race
additional: Runners repeatedly complete the 6,706-metre loop in under an hour, using the remaining time to recover before the next lap. The race has 100 places for runners. The race has 100 participant places.

name: Lammasmäe Eesti Ööjooks - Rakvere 2026
description: This is a popular sporting event that brings running enthusiasts together and offers an exciting, atmospheric night-running experience. The race takes place in the beautiful surroundings of Rakvere, giving participants a unique opportunity to enjoy sport and the urban landscape at night.
course_highlights: Night run in the city of Rakvere and its surroundings
Beautiful and varied scenery
Atmospheric and energetic race environment
additional: The event includes various distance options and promotes healthy lifestyles and community support.

name: NATTMILEN 2026 - Sundsvall
description: Nattmilen is a popular night race in Sundsvall, celebrating its fifth anniversary in 2027. The race offers timed 5 km and 10 km distances with a mass start, as well as an optional untimed distance. The race starts at 22:00 from Stora torget and has a festival atmosphere with music, energy and an after-run at Bloco restaurant. Nattmilen is an event for everyone, from beginners to experienced runners, and has become one of Sundsvall’s most eagerly awaited summer running evenings.
course_highlights: Run through Sundsvall’s beautiful stone city centre
Mass start and timing for the 5 km and 10 km distances
Sweden’s only finish area with a bar, since 2023
additional: Late registration is available online until 30 minutes before the start on race day, while places remain. Race bibs can be collected at Stadium City Sundsvall during race week or at the start area from 19:00 to 21:30 on race day. A water station along the course offers water and sports drink. After the race, participants are invited to an after-run at Bloco restaurant, with mingling and a party. Participants can choose to run an untimed distance of either 5 km or 10 km. Participants under 18 must be accompanied by an adult, or be at least 14 years old to run on their own. The organiser documents the event with photos and video that may be published; participants can opt out of appearing by contacting event@morron.se. The event is documented in photos and video. The stated race date is 4 June 2027.

name: Jaama Run
description: Jaama Run is a trail-running event held on the Kontionpolut trail network in Kontiolahti, North Karelia. The event features a 1 km Mini-Jaama category for children, as well as 5 km, 12 km and 24 km races for different age groups. The routes are technically suitable for first-timers too and follow trails maintained by the municipality, with natural obstacles such as rocks, roots and mud. Prizes are awarded to the three fastest finishers in each category, and everyone who finishes Mini-Jaama receives a prize.
course_highlights: The routes follow the Kontionpolut trails maintained by the municipality of Kontiolahti
The 12 km and 24 km routes use the same course; the 24 km race is run over two laps
The trails may include rocks, roots, mud, puddles and slippery sections
additional: Registration for the Mini-Jaama 1 km category takes place on site and is free of charge. Participants receive a race bib and an ankle-mounted transponder for timing. The event has organizer's liability insurance, but participants take part at their own risk and are responsible for their own insurance coverage. Carrying a mobile phone with the emergency number 050-5633480 saved is recommended. Results are published on Kontiolahden Urheilijat’s channels.

name: Toivakkahölkkä
description: Toivakkahölkkä is a popular free running event that kicks off summer in Toivakka. Held at the Paikkalanvuori sports field, the event offers an approximately 10-kilometre trail and cross-country race in four categories: men’s and women’s open categories, and girls’ and boys’ categories for under-18s. Children’s races are also free, with shorter routes and no timing. The three fastest runners in each category receive Lumonite headlamps. The marked route runs through the Paikkalanvuori terrain, using the ski-track and trail network.
course_highlights: Approximately 10-kilometre trail and cross-country race through the Paikkalanvuori terrain
The marked route uses the ski-track and trail network
Children’s races on flat terrain, without timing
additional: The event is free, and participation is limited to the first 150 people to register in advance. A transponder for timing is attached to each race number. On-site registration is possible until 10:00, and places made available by cancellations can be claimed between 09:00 and 10:00. Advance registration is not required for the children’s races, and every child receives a small prize and encouragement. The children’s races start at 10:00 and 10:15. Results are available at https://esahoo.fi/toivakkaholkka26.htm. The start and finish are at the Paikkalanvuori sports field.

name: Peura Trail
distance_verbose: 102 km, 51 km, 37 km, 23 km, 13 km, 6 km

name: Jaanikese jooksukross
description: The Jaanikese running cross-country race is the second event in the series and takes place at the Jaanikese Motor and Leisure Centre. The course features varied terrain suitable for both recreational and experienced runners. The event offers the chance to enjoy a sporting competition in beautiful natural surroundings and is part of the centre’s active running and cycling trail.

name: Narva Linna Jooks - 5 km ja 21,1 km
description: The Narva City Run is the largest mass-participation sports event in Ida-Viru County, taking place on June 5 and 6 at Joaorg in Narva. The two-day event features a mile run around Town Hall Square on Friday, followed by the main races on Saturday, including the 5 km and 21.1 km distances. This year’s course is flatter, allowing runners to achieve better times, and the event also hosts the Estonian Road Mile Championships. The Narva City Run brings thousands of recreational runners and elite athletes to the course, offering a great mass-participation sports experience.

name: Luhamaa piirijooks
description: Luhamaa Border Run is part of the Võrumaa running and walking series, offering a variety of distances for both runners and walkers. The main distance follows paved roads around the Luhamaa village hall and is approximately 5.9 km long. There are also shorter mini-distances and races for toddlers, suitable for participants of all ages. The series aims to provide a sporting and friendly race experience amid Võrumaa’s beautiful natural surroundings.

name: Padise liigub
description: Padise liigub is part of the Lääne-Harju movement series and takes place at the Padise community centre of the Lääne-Harju Cultural Centre. The route passes through Padise’s beautiful landscape, offering excitement and scenic views for runners, walkers and Nordic walkers. The event is suitable for the whole family, with children’s races in addition to the main 5 km distance. It is a wonderful opportunity to enjoy being active in a historic and naturally beautiful setting.

name: Jaanikese jooksukross
description: The 2nd Jaanikese Cross-Country Run takes place at the Jaanikese Moto and Leisure Centre and is part of the Rein Leppik Valgamaa Running and Walking Series. The event offers several distances, including children’s races, a 2.7 km run and walk, and the main 5.4 km run. The courses follow the cross-country track, giving participants the chance to enjoy a sporting competition across different age groups. The event is organised by the Valgamaa Sports Association, which welcomes everyone interested in running to take part and enjoy an active day.

name: SunRun
description: SunRun Saaremaa 2026 is a team running experience held amid Saaremaa’s beautiful natural scenery. The run starts at sunrise in Kuressaare and finishes at sunset at Illiku laid in Orissaare, covering a total of 180 km. Any group, circle of friends, or sports club can take part by forming a team and dividing the distance among its members. The aim is not to win, but to run together with friends at a comfortable pace and enjoy the experience. Each participant receives a GPS wristband that serves as a baton, and there are refreshment and food stations along the course.

name: Björnfrossa Ultramarathon
location: Kungsbergets skidanläggning, Sandviken Municipality, Gävleborg County, Sweden
description: Björnfrossa Ultramarathon is a 65 km trail race through the scenic bear country of Gästrikland, starting and finishing at Kungsberget Ski Resort. The course mainly follows the Gästrikeleden Trail and offers fine, occasionally technical trail running, as well as some gravel roads. The race is organized by Björnfrossa Arrangörsförening and offers a challenging experience with approximately 1,200 metres of elevation gain and four aid stations along the way. For safety and communication, participants are advised to carry mandatory equipment such as a headlamp and mobile phone.
course_highlights: 65 km of trail running along the Gästrikeleden Trail
Occasionally technical trails and some gravel roads
Just over 1,200 metres of elevation gain and four staffed aid stations
additional: Race bibs are handed out in the start area and must be worn visibly throughout the race. Mandatory equipment includes a headlamp and a mobile phone with the race management’s number saved. There is no drop-bag service; participants carry all their equipment from the start. Medical staff are available at the start/finish, but participants are responsible for themselves out on the course. The maximum time limit is 12 hours. Earlier race information also states that there are four staffed aid stations, the time limit is 12 hours, and a headlamp and mobile phone are mandatory; the race is not a sanctioned competition.

name: Söder Runt
description: Söder Runt is a popular 10 km race around Södermalm in Stockholm, known for its beautiful, fast course along the water with no uphill sections. The race attracts many runners looking to set a personal best and offers a flat, easy-to-run course on asphalt and gravel. After the finish, runners can enjoy a popular After Run party with music, mingling, food and drinks. The start and finish are at Tantolunden and Hornstulls strand, respectively, and the race is sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association.
course_highlights: 10 km around Södermalm along the water
Flat, easy-to-run course on asphalt and gravel
No uphill sections; many runners set personal bests
additional: Water stations are available after 4 km and at the finish. Strollers and dogs are not allowed. All participants receive a medal and products at the finish. The minimum age is 14 for the race and 18 for the After Run. Payment is made via the website by card, Swish, invoice or bank giro/postgiro for larger groups. The start is provisionally scheduled for 19:45. The course is officially measured and the race is sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association. Minimum age: 14; strollers and dogs are not allowed.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.soderrunt.se/): 2027-06-05 — "Jubileumsupplagan äger rum lördagen den 5 juni 2027 kl. 19:45." (was estimated 2027-06-05)
pipeline_log.evidence_quote: Jubileumsupplagan äger rum lördagen den 5 juni 2027 kl. 19:45.

name: Vilkaču maratons
description: Vilkaču Marathon is a challenging 42-kilometer marathon along forest trails in Tukums Municipality, considered one of the toughest marathons. The course includes more than 2,000 meters of elevation gain on steep and very steep climbs, and participants must complete thirteen laps, passing the race center several times. During the race, a hydration and food station is available in the start/finish area, and the winner receives 25% of all participants’ entry fees. This marathon offers seven hours of racing in a forest, among hills and in a place steeped in legends, where participants compete against themselves and the clock.
course_highlights: 42 km along forest trails with more than 2,000 meters of elevation gain
Thirteen laps, passing the race center several times
Steep and very steep climbs on the slopes of Āžu Hill
additional: A hydration and food station, staffed by the marathon chef, is available in the start/finish area.

name: Samogitia Ultra 2027 - Where Dreams Go to Die
description: Samogitia Ultra is a unique endurance race held in the Germanto Landscape Reserve near Telšiai, Lithuania. Participants run a 6.7 km forest trail loop every hour on the hour, continuing until only one runner remains, known as the Last Man Standing. The race challenges runners' endurance, strategy, and grit, with a minimum of 7 loops required to earn a medal. The course features about 70 meters of elevation gain per loop and is set in a beautiful natural reserve.
course_highlights: 6.7 km forest trail loop with about 70 meters of elevation gain
Course runs through the Germanto Landscape Reserve near Telšiai
100% forest single- and double-track trails and gravel; the same loop is run day and night
additional: Runners must complete each 6.7 km loop within one hour or be eliminated. A minimum of 7 loops (46.9 km) is required to earn a medal. Runners receive warnings 3, 2, and 1 minute before each loop. Personal tents can be set up from 6 PM the day before the race near the start gate. Toilets are available about 50 meters from base camp. Water and hot water are available at base camp. There are no showers, but a clean lake is nearby. Walking during the race is allowed and recommended. Personal items can be left in tents, but are not the organizer's responsibility. The event has a tent base and aid stations, but there are restrictions on support along the course.

name: The Arctic Run
description: The Arctic Run is an island race on Hadseløya in Vesterålen, Northern Norway. The course is varied, with up to 300 meters of elevation gain, and is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. Choose from a marathon, a half marathon with views of the sea and mountains, or a 10 km course that runs through both the town center and nature. The race takes place in a landscape with views of Langøya, the Lofoten Wall, and the mountains of Bø.
course_highlights: Marathon around Hadseløya, with up to 300 meters of elevation gain
Half marathon with views of the sea, Langøya, and the Lofoten Wall
10 km through the town center, residential areas, and nature, with 79 meters of elevation gain
additional: The event includes a free 600-meter TAR Family Run at 10:00 AM on race day, with no timekeeping. Bib pick-up is available from 08:00 to 09:45 AM at Hurtigrutemuseet. Food and drink stations are located at multiple kilometers and offer energy drinks, juice, water, bananas, nuts, chocolate, cookies, and dried fruit. Toilets are available at the start, finish, and along the course. Camp TAR offers drop-in showers, with passes available for purchase. Photographers will capture moments from the race, with photos available for purchase after the event. Shuttle buses operate from several hotels to the race. The information page mentions food and drink stations, toilets, baggage storage, and pacers. A free 600-meter family run is also held.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 24. Laekvere – Simuna jooks
description: The third stage of the 2026 Lääne-Virumaa running and walking series is the traditional Simuna–Laekvere Run, which has earned a firm place in runners’ calendars and hearts. The run is distinctive because its direction changes every year. The event takes place at Simuna School and welcomes all running enthusiasts.

name: E-Lux Peetri Jooks
description: E-LUX Peetri Run is one of Estonia’s liveliest mass-participation sporting events, bringing together running enthusiasts of different ages and abilities. The main distance is 10 km, which is timed, with prizes awarded to the top finishers. There is also a charity run, a youth run and children’s races. The event takes place in Peetri and, alongside the running, features a large expo and market area with a variety of vendors and entertainment. The charity run supports the Children’s Foundation of Tartu University Hospital and, through it, children with mobility impairments. All finishers receive a cool summer medal.

name: Simuna-Laekvere rahvajooks
description: The Simuna-Laekvere People’s Run is a traditional recreational running event held every other year, alternating between Simuna and Laekvere. The course follows paved roads, with rolling sections and a few climbs, offering participants a varied running experience. The event is friendly and well organized, suitable for both experienced runners and recreational participants, and also offers a sauna and hot soup after the run. The number of participants is usually around 100, creating a pleasant, relaxed atmosphere. Age-group prizes are awarded, and the first ten finishers receive a running shirt.

name: Västerås Stadslopp
price_range: 2026: 120–400 kr beroende på lopp och anmälningstid
description: Västerås Stadslopp is a community festival in Vasaparken, inviting runners of all ages to take part in different races, including children’s races and team races. The event is organised by Västerås Friidrottsklubb and offers a great atmosphere, activities for children, mascots, and opportunities to participate regardless of disability. Race bibs are collected at the venue, and services include bag drop and water stations. Teams that register receive a food hamper after crossing the finish line, making it a fun and sociable running experience.
course_highlights: Children’s races with three different distances to choose from
Children’s activity area with an obstacle course, high jump and shot put
Start and finish in Vasaparken, with toilets and water refill points
additional: Race bibs are collected at Vasaparken on 7 June from 09:00, with a separate collection time for the 2.5 km race and longer distances after 11:00. Teams of four receive a food hamper after crossing the finish line. Toilets and water refill points are available at Rådhuset near the start. Bag drop is available, but there is no cover. The children’s races are limited to 400 participants and are fully booked for 2026. Mascots and a children’s activity area will be on site. The date for 2027 will be announced later. Teams of four can receive a food hamper/picnic after the race.

name: Tjejjoggen Sjulsmark
description: Tjejjoggen is a fun run for women and girls of all ages in Sjulsmark. The course is about 5.8 km and you can walk, jog or run. The 2026 edition was held on Sunday 7 June with the start at 13:00. Everyone registered gets a goodie bag and every registered team gets a coffee basket.
course_highlights: About 5.8 km in Sjulsmark
For women and girls of all ages, walk, jog or run
Prize draw on bib numbers at 14:30
additional: Before the 2026 race there were joint warm-up sessions with Åse Borgeryd on Wednesdays in May at Folkets Hus in Sjulsmark for everyone registered. The last registration day in 2026 was 25 May.

name: Ventspils pusmaratons
description: Ventspils Half Marathon 2027 is an annual running event taking place on June 6 in Ventspils. The race offers various distances, including a half marathon (21.0975 km), 10 km, 5 km, and a children’s run, welcoming participants of different ages. The event is organized by the Maratona Klubs Association in cooperation with the Ventspils City Council, providing professional organization and a friendly atmosphere. The course passes through some of Ventspils’ most beautiful spots, offering both city scenery and seaside views.
course_highlights: Half-marathon distance: 21.0975 km
Distances suited to different age groups, including a children’s run
The course passes through Ventspils city and seaside scenery
additional: Participants may transfer from a longer distance to a shorter one free of charge until 01.06.2027. During race week, changing distances costs 10 EUR. Young people born in 2008 or later receive a 50% discount on the 10 km and 5 km distances until 03.06.2027. Registration on race day is available, but full services may not be provided. Runners from Russia and Belarus are not permitted to participate.

name: Eidemila 2027
location: Kvaløy kirke, Eidkjosen, Kvaløya, Tromsø, Norway
description: Eidemila is an annual 10 km race that has been held since 2008, starting at Eidkjosen and finishing at Kvaløysletta. The race is organized by Tromsø Running Club and attracts runners who want to track their progress and compete for fast times. It is a popular event in the region with a rich history and results available to participants. The race has a tradition of bringing experienced and new runners together in a great running atmosphere.
course_highlights: 10 km course from Eidkjosen to Kvaløysletta
Held annually since 2008
Fast course with good opportunities for personal bests
additional: Results and statistics from previous years are available to participants, including winning times, age groups and team competitions. In 2026, bib collection was outdoors at Eide Handel. There were no changing facilities, and parking was available at Eide Handel.

name: Võru kergejõustikuõhtu
description: The Võru Athletics Evenings series is a traditional series of athletics events combining track races, throwing events and jumps. Each evening features one throwing event, one jumping event and running distances, offering a varied athletics experience. Competitions take place at Võru Stadium, and the IAAF scoring tables are used to determine the rankings. The series has five stages, one of which is the Võru County Championships. Participants must register separately for each stage, and their race bib is valid for the entire season.

name: Pärnu Aasta jooksud 4 etapp
description: Pärnu Aasta jooksud Stage 4 is part of the Pärnumaa public sports series, inviting all running enthusiasts to take part in varied running competitions. The event takes place at Pärnu Beach, offering participants a pleasant and sporty setting. Organized by the county sports association, it is a great opportunity for both recreational and experienced runners to enjoy exercise and the thrill of competition.
course_highlights: The runs take place at Pärnu Beach
The public sports series brings together various sporting events in Pärnumaa
Suitable for both recreational and experienced runners

name: Lääne-Virumaa noorte MV
description: The Lääne-Virumaa Youth Championships is an athletics competition for young people and adults, held in Rakvere. The events include several athletics disciplines, such as running, jumping and throwing, and are intended for different age groups from U-14 through to adults. The competition aims to honor the memory of Eerik Konist and promote athletics among young people. All age groups receive medals, and the top performers receive special prizes. The competition takes place at the stadium and starts at 11:00; registration opens at 10:00.

name: 6. ETAPP - Nõmme terviserada
description: The Nõmme health trail is part of the Tradehouse health running and walking series organized by Stamina Sports Club, which encourages people to stay active by collecting health kilometres. This stage offers a chance to enjoy the Nõmme area health trail, which is suitable for both runners and walkers. As part of the series, participants can collect health kilometres at both in-person and remote stages, as well as through personal training. The event is open to everyone interested in physical activity who wants to improve their health and spend time actively.

name: Gallaberget Trailrun
description: Gallaberget Trailrun is a trail race organized by Vretstorps IF Löpning. The race features a more challenging course with plenty of trails and forest terrain, offering a demanding and scenic running experience. After the race, participants can enjoy some social time with hot dogs in buns and a swim in the evening sunshine. The event attracts runners of different ages and abilities and is appreciated for its great atmosphere and well-organized arrangements.
course_highlights: A more challenging course with plenty of trails
Forest terrain and scenic surroundings
Hot dogs in buns and a swim in the evening sunshine after the race
additional: After the race, hot dogs in buns are served, and participants can swim in the evening sunshine. Previous races have had around 65 registered runners and included great prizes from sponsors such as Vitamin Well and Nocco. The 2026 edition had a 10 km race category. After the race, hot dogs in buns were served, and participants could go for a swim.

name: Avesta Night Sky Run Knattelopp
description: Avesta Night Sky Run is an evening trail race held at Dalahästens ski centre in Avesta. The race offers two distances, 3.33 km and 10 km, which mostly follow the trails on the esker around the ski slope. It is an enjoyable and challenging off-road course suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. The event is part of Dalaportens OL’s competition programme and offers a unique running experience in the evening.
course_highlights: Trail race over 3.33 km or 10 km
The course mostly follows trails on the esker
Runs around the ski slope at Dalahästens ski centre
additional: Participants receive a medal and Festis.

name: Liikumissari" 8.Järvamaa järvede jooksud" V etapp Paide tehisjärve jooks
location: Paide tehisjärv, Paide, Järva County, Estonia
description: The Paide artificial lake run is the fifth stage of the “8. Järvamaa Lake Runs” series. The run takes place by Paide artificial lake and invites participants to explore the surroundings of Järvamaa’s lakes while staying active.
course_highlights: The start and running venue are by Paide artificial lake.
The stage is part of the Järvamaa Lake Runs series.

name: Vertikālais kilometrs (VK) Siguldā
description: The Vertical Kilometer in Sigulda is a challenging mountain run that offers a chance to test your strength and endurance on the trails of Sigulda’s hills. The race is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners looking to climb 1,000 meters in elevation. The event is part of the Sigulda Running Series, which brings together athletes and active people from all over Latvia. The run takes place in beautiful natural surroundings, with breathtaking views and challenging terrain.
course_highlights: A challenging climb with 1,000 meters of elevation gain
Run along the mountain trails in Sigulda and the surrounding area
Breathtaking views and natural scenery
additional: Race bibs and timing chips will be issued at the start venue.

name: Vanglateenistuse jooks
description: The Prison Service Run is part of the Ida-Viru Running Series and takes place at the Jõhvi music square. This athletics event gives participants the opportunity to enjoy a run in the beautiful surroundings of Ida-Viru County. The series includes several stages in different locations, offering a varied running experience. The event is open to all running enthusiasts and is traditionally well organized and friendly.

name: ELVA SÜDAÖÖJOOKS 2026 TARTUMAA LIIGUB ETAPP
description: Elva Midnight Run 2026 is a nighttime running and walking event held near the Elva Cultural Centre. The races start in the evening and offer several distance options, including a 10 km run and walk, as well as children’s races. The event is part of Tartu County’s exercise events and is suitable for both active runners and families. The organizers welcome everyone to take part and enjoy a sporty evening in Elva’s beautiful natural surroundings.

name: Eesti noorte KV
description: The Estonian Youth Archery Cup takes place in Pärnu, giving young athletes the opportunity to compete and develop their skills. Several archery clubs from across Estonia take part, making it an important event on the calendar for young archers. The competition is held at Tammiste Stadium, where athletes can demonstrate their accuracy and skill. The event is a tradition and supports the development of young people in archery.

name: Öland Ultra Trail
description: Öland Ultra Trail is a fantastic trail adventure through the beautiful natural surroundings of northern Öland. The race offers two distances, 50 km and 25 km, starting from Böda Sand and Byxelkrok respectively, with both distances finishing at Böda Sand. The course offers scenic views and passes places such as Skäftekärr, Byrums raukar, Neptuni åkrar and Trollskogen. Everyone who completes the race receives a medal, and pre-registered participants receive a T-shirt included in the entry fee.
course_highlights: Passes Skäftekärr, Byrums raukar, Neptuni åkrar and Trollskogen
50 km starts at Böda Sand; 25 km starts at Byxelkrok
Both distances finish at Böda Sand
additional: Late registration is available until 11 June, as well as during bib collection on Friday 12 June from 19:00 to 20:00 and on race day, 13 June, from 07:30 to 09:00. Payment can be made in cash, by card or via Swish. Aid stations are located along the course. A T-shirt is included in the entry fee for participants who register by 6 June and specify their shirt size. Everyone who completes the race receives a medal. Pre-registered participants receive a T-shirt if they register by 6 June. The 50 km race starts at 09:00 and the 25 km race at 10:00.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://olandrunning.se/lopp/oland-ultra/): 2027-06-12 — "Tid & datum 12 juni 2027 50 km kl. 09:00" (was estimated 2027-06-12)

name: Urskogsloppet

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmälningsavgiften är 200 kr och anmälan stänger den 10/6.

description: Urskogsloppet is a recreational race on simple trails through a magnificent old-growth forest in Örnsköldsvik Municipality. There are two distances: the original long race of 19.7 kilometres, starting in Backe/Berg and finishing at Bigvallen in Björna, and a shorter 6.6-kilometre race that starts and finishes at Bigvallen. The race is always held on the Saturday before Midsummer weekend and partly follows the Urskogsleden hiking trail. Björnadagen, with activities and an awards ceremony, takes place alongside the race. The terrain is uneven in places, with logs, rocks and wet sections, providing a unique running experience close to nature.
course_highlights: Run on simple trails through old-growth forest
Partly follows the Urskogsleden hiking trail
Uneven terrain with logs, rocks and wet sections
additional: The race starts in Backe/Berg, with bus transport from Björna. Depending on the number of participants, there are two start groups, starting at 11:00 and 11:30. Timing is by wrist chip, with a split time at 11.5 km. At the finish, there are changing rooms and showers, as well as the option to buy food for those who pre-ordered. Shoes with spikes are not allowed in the changing facilities. Parking is available at Björna School, and carpooling is recommended. The race has four checkpoints with drinks and light refreshments. The terrain is wet and uneven in places, so runners should be prepared. The 19.7 km course has four checkpoints. Registration, parking and changing facilities are at the school in Björna, and bus transport to the start in Berg is included for registered participants.

name: Nalta Backyard Ultra
description: Nalta Backyard Ultra is a unique ultramarathon where endurance matters, not speed. The challenge is to run one lap of an approximately 6.7-kilometre course every hour on the hour, for as long as you can. The start and finish are at Ursberget ski lodge in Piteå, and the race continues until only one runner can complete another lap. It is a test of both physical and mental strength on a technically demanding forest course.
course_highlights: 6.7-kilometre loop with approximately 65 metres of elevation gain
The course includes forest trails, running tracks, gravel road and approximately 500 metres of asphalt
Technically demanding sections, clearly marked with signs and course tape
additional: Registration takes place from 07:30 to 08:30, with the race briefing at 08:30. The start and finish are at Ursberget ski lodge, with a grassy area for participants’ equipment. There are two small changing rooms, one shower and two toilets at the event area. The site map shows the start area, lap checkpoint, finish, race management, refreshment area, participant area and recommended parking. The race starts at 09:00 and continues every hour on the hour. Registration is listed as 07:30 to 08:30, and the race briefing at 08:30. Participation is at your own risk.

name: Flosjön-Edstjärn
location: Flosjön–Edstjärn, Gagnef Municipality, Dalarna County, Sweden
description: Flosjön-Edstjärn is a half marathon organized annually by Edstjärns Idrottsklubb in Gagnef. The race is open to everyone and runs through scenic areas around Flosjön and Edstjärn. It is a well-established event that promotes sport and community, especially among young people. The club encourages participation in various sports and offers a great opportunity to experience beautiful scenery while running.
course_highlights: Half marathon around Flosjön and Edstjärn
Scenic views and varied terrain
Organized by the volunteer-run Edstjärns IK, with a focus on youth sports
additional: All registrations are binding, and participation is at your own risk. Personal data is handled by Edstjärns IK and Mitt Lopp. Names and results are published at www.eik.one. The organizer may stop the race if necessary to protect participants’ health and safety.

name: Ezerkauliņi Salaspils pilsētas pusmaratons
description: The “Ezerkauliņi” Salaspils City Half Marathon brings together running enthusiasts, Salaspils residents and visitors for a sporting celebration in Salaspils. Participants can choose the half marathon, a 10.55 km run or Nordic walking, a 5.27 km fun run, or a 0.75 km children’s run. The course runs along Salaspils streets, and the event invites everyone to enjoy moving together and the city’s atmosphere.
course_highlights: The city course runs along the streets of Salaspils.
A 21.097 km half-marathon distance is available.
Participants can also take part in the 10.55 km distance by Nordic walking.
additional: A 0.75 km children’s run is also available.

name: EKVA lahtised kergej. võistl.
description: The EKVA Open Athletics Competitions take place in Kohila and offer veterans and recreational athletes the opportunity to compete in a variety of track and field events. The competitions are intended for active athletes of all ages who want to test themselves and enjoy the thrill of athletics. EKVA regularly organizes various championships and series that promote running and athletics in Estonia. The competitions are open to both recreational athletes and veterans, with age-group events available.

name: Viimsi maraton
description: Viimsi Marathon 2026 takes place on the Viimsi Peninsula and offers participants a course consisting of one large loop. The start and finish are in the parking lot of Randvere School. The varied terrain includes both paved roads and forest trails, with climbs and descents throughout the distance. It is a great opportunity to enjoy a summer run with a positive community.

name: Dadathlon Run and Festival (Stockholm, Hagaparken)
description: DaddyHood Dadathlon is a sporting event for dads and children that aims to inspire movement and quality time together. The event takes place both live in Hagaparken, Stockholm, and virtually for participants who cannot attend in person. It is a family-friendly activity that promotes healthy habits and a sense of community among active dads and their children.
course_highlights: Family-friendly run in Hagaparken, Stockholm
The event offers both live and virtual participation
Strollers are welcome during the run
additional: The event is part of a global virtual sports challenge featuring three sports over three months: running in May, cycling in June, and hiking. Strollers are welcome during the run. Virtual participation is free, and the event aims to create unforgettable memories and build healthy habits together with the children. Dadathlon consists of three events held at different times throughout the year. Activity can be recorded using an app or sports watch.

name: Rapla Selveri suurjooks, virtuaaljooks
description: Rapla Selveri Suurjooks is a traditional running race held in Rapla, offering several distance options from children’s races to a half marathon. The race centre is located in the Rapla Selver car park, and the routes run along the town’s streets and highways. They are clearly marked and measured. Participants’ safety is ensured, and the event is organised by Kehakultuur OÜ in cooperation with Jooksja magazine. Pre-registration closes on 20 May, and start groups are formed according to expected finish times to ensure a smooth and safe race day.

name: Blodomloppet (Visby)
organizer: VIF Gute Friidrott och Blodcentralen i Visby
description: Blodomloppet in Visby is a fun run organised to raise awareness of the vital importance of blood donation and promote a healthy lifestyle. Participants can choose to walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km on scenic routes that include Visby’s city wall, old town, promenade, Almedalen and harbour. There is also Lilla Blodomloppet for children, with shorter distances. The event is open to individuals and teams, and ends with a group picnic for participants.
course_highlights: The 5 km route follows Visby’s city wall and passes through the historic old town
The 10 km route includes the city wall, promenade, Almedalen and Visby harbour
Lilla Blodomloppet takes place in an urban setting and starts behind the main stage
additional: Late registration is available on site from 16:00 on 16 June at the Information Tent. Participants receive a T-shirt, race bib, medal and gift for blood donors. Team members can collect a picnic bag after finishing or use a picnic card (valid only for Blodomloppet at a distance). The scenic routes pass through historic and central parts of Visby. Water stations and medical assistance are available. Changing facilities and toilets are provided. Parking information and directions are available on the website. Participants can register individually or in teams of up to five. Participants receive a T-shirt, race bib and medal; team members can collect a picnic bag after finishing. Lilla Blodomloppet has distances of 300 m and 1.6 km.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://blodomloppet.se/vara-lopp/visby/): 2027-06-15 — "Välkommen till Blodomloppet 2027! ... 15 juni 2027" (was estimated 2027-06-15)

name: Filter Temposari (3. etapp)
description: Filter Temposari is Estonia’s oldest and most prestigious time trial series, offering the chance to test yourself in cycling, running or inline skating. The events take place at various locations in Tallinn and the surrounding area, featuring speed races with individual starts. The Tallinn event is held at Vabaduse väljak, on a short, technical course well suited to sprint enthusiasts. Series finishers are eligible for the Kullapada awards programme, which rewards consistent participation in every event.

name: Kohila pikamaajooksude sari 2026 IV etapp 400m
description: The Kohila Long-Distance Running Series 2026, Stage IV (400 m), takes place at the Kohila Sports Centre stadium and is intended for all running enthusiasts. The series features various distances and age groups, with participants earning points according to their placing in each race. The entry fee is €8, or €5 for young people and pensioners; payment is in cash at the venue. Pre-registration is recommended and closes at 16:30 on race day. Those who register later will be placed in the later races. Series winners are determined by age group, and the awards ceremony takes place at the end of the series.

name: Kohila Pikamaajooksusari
description: The Kohila Distance Running Series is a sports series in Kohila Municipality consisting of several stages and aimed at sports enthusiasts in the region. The series aims to promote sports and physical activity and give participants the opportunity to compete over various distances. Participants at each stage receive a commemorative medal, and points are tallied across the series in the competition classes. The series is organized by Kohila Sports Centre, which supports a healthy lifestyle and active movement.

name: KEVEK ja Tartu Kalev staadionijooksu sari
description: The KEVEK and Tartu Kalev Stadium Running Series is an athletics track-running series organized by Tartu Spordiselts Kalev, offering the opportunity to take part in multiple meets at stadiums in Tartu and Ülenurme. The series aims to provide competition opportunities for children and young people and promote participation in athletics in the city and county of Tartu. Competitions take place during the summer months and are open to various age groups. Registration closes at 12:00 on the day of the competition, allowing for flexible participation.

name: Midsommarjoggen 2026
description: Midsommarjoggen is a running festival in Rynningeviken Nature Reserve in Örebro, inviting runners, families and colleagues to kick off Midsummer week together. The race is 7.2 km long and follows easy-to-run gravel paths with beautiful views and two wooden bridges over Lillån. For the youngest runners, there is an action-packed 600-metre Kidsrun without timing. After the finish, the evening continues with a pleasant after-run gathering with food, drinks and good company at Stora Hjortstorps Gård.
course_highlights: 7.2 km through Rynningeviken Nature Reserve on easy-to-run gravel paths
Two wooden bridges over Lillån
Two longer hills by Venastugan
additional: The Kidsrun starts at 17:45, with runners gathering at 17:40. Race numbers can be collected from 16:00 to 18:00 on race day. Timing uses a transponder lent out when race numbers are collected; it must be returned after the race. Water and sports drinks are available at 3 and 5 km. Toilets are available near the race area and at the aid stations. No changing facilities or showers are available on site. An after-run gathering with food and drinks is offered after the race (not included in the entry fee). Young people born in 2008 or later receive a 50% discount on the entry fee. Members of certain running clubs may receive a discount through the member pages. Group registration is available by contacting info@epictrail.se.

name: Rakvere lahtised MV
description: The Rakvere Open Championships are athletics championships held at Rakvere Stadium. The competition brings together the local sporting community and offers an opportunity to watch a variety of track and field events. The event is open to everyone interested and creates a sporty, supportive atmosphere.

name: Tallinna noorte MV
description: The Tallinn Youth Championships is an individual athletics competition for young people and adults, held in Tallinn. The competition includes several age groups, from U-14 to adults, and a range of athletics events, including running, jumping, putting, and throwing. Its aim is to honour the memory of Eerik Konist and promote athletics among young people. Medals are awarded in all age groups, and the top performers receive special prizes. The competition takes place at a stadium and starts at 11:00 in the morning; registration opens at 10:00.

name: Tänndalen 100 miles
location: Ski Lodge Tänndalen, Tänndalen, Härjedalen Municipality, Jämtland County, Sweden
description: Tänndalen 100 Miles is a spectacular 161-kilometre ultrarace on easy-running asphalt through the mountain landscapes of Sweden and Norway. The race starts at Ski Lodge in Tänndalen and takes you across vast mountain expanses, alongside sparkling waters and all the way to the World Heritage city of Røros, before returning to the finish at Ski Lodge. The race offers magical midsummer light and a unique mountain experience for ultrarunners.
course_highlights: 161 km of easy-running roads through the mountain landscapes of Sweden and Norway
The route includes a loop to Funäsdalen and the World Heritage city of Røros
Start and finish at Ski Lodge in Tänndalen
additional: The race starts at 19:00. The organiser’s information says sunset is around 23:00 and describes the race as one of the few 100-mile races where a headlamp is not needed. Prize money is offered to the top three finishers in both the women’s and men’s categories.

name: Borejoggen
price_range: 300–350 kr för Borejoggen och Lagjoggen enligt 2026 års prisuppgifter; Minijoggen 150 kr
description: Borejoggen is a long-established running race held in Torsby every Midsummer’s Eve, with a 42-year history. The race follows an 8.5-kilometre asphalt course through central Torsby and welcomes runners of all levels, from elite athletes to recreational runners. Children and young people can take part in the 1.5-kilometre Minijoggen. There is also a popular team race, Lagjoggen, where three participants compete together and the team’s combined time is counted.
course_highlights: 8.5 km asphalt course through central Torsby
Minijoggen for children and young people, 1.5 km
Water stations at 2 km, 4 km, 5.8 km and the finish
additional: Mass start for Minijoggen at 9:30 on Östmarksvägen. Mass start for Borejoggen and Lagjoggen at 11:00 on Östmarksvägen. Changing facilities and showers are available at Torsby Ski Tunnel and Valbergsstugan. Prizes are awarded for the sprint prize at 2 km, the hill prize at Kollsberg after 5 km, and the top three finishers in the women’s and men’s classes and the team class. Traffic marshals and course guides are stationed at road crossings with traffic. Medical assistance is available at the finish and ready to respond on the course. Previous editions have started and finished at Herrgårdsparken. Borejoggen and Lagjoggen have started at 11:00 and Minijoggen at 9:30.

name: Orsakajtn
description: Orsakajt'n and Orsabajk'n are MTB and running races held every Midsummer’s Eve in Orsa. The course follows the Ore River valley, with forest trails, gravel roads and a little asphalt, and gently to moderately rolling terrain over sand ridges. Race numbers are sent digitally the day before and can be picked up at the venue or at Karl Hedin in Orsa. The MTB race requires a licence and membership in a club affiliated with the Swedish Cycling Federation.
course_highlights: The course follows the Ore River valley on forest trails, gravel roads and asphalt
Gently to moderately rolling terrain over beautiful sand ridges
The course is marked with orange enduro arrows and kilometre signs
additional: Race numbers are sent digitally to your mobile phone the day before the race. Bibs can be collected at Karl Hedin in Orsa on Thursday from 16:00 to 20:00 or at the start location on race day. No on-site entries; registration closes one hour before the start. No refunds in case of injury or illness. Parking is available at Lillåvallen. Registration is online and closes one hour before the start; on-site registration is not available. Bibs can be collected at Karl Hedin in Orsa or at the respective start location on race day.

name: Kuusalu valla kergej. MV
description: The Kuusalu Parish Athletics Championships is a traditional athletics competition held in Kuusalu. The event features various age groups and distances, offering opportunities for both recreational and advanced athletes. It is dedicated to the memory of Margus Keerma and is organized by the Treeningpartner sports club. The competition is a great opportunity to showcase your skills and enjoy the sporting atmosphere in Kuusalu Parish.

name: Ümber Saadjärve jooks
description: The 38th Around Saadjärv Run takes place in Kukulinna, offering participants a 17 km run and a fitness walk around Lake Saadjärv. The course follows paved roads and has three refreshment stations to keep runners well supplied. In addition to the main race, children’s races are held in different age groups, along with a fitness walk suitable for everyone who enjoys being active. Every finisher receives a commemorative medal, and the best participants are awarded prizes by age group. The event is a long-standing tradition and is well organised, offering an enjoyable sporting experience for the whole family.

name: EcoTrail Stockholm
description: EcoTrail Stockholm is a nature-focused running event offering several distances for all ages and levels, from children’s races to ultradistances. The races follow beautiful trails through forests, the archipelago, countryside and urban environments, with a high proportion of nature experiences. The event is marked by a strong environmental ethos and sense of community, where runners can challenge themselves in an inspiring, well-organized setting. The finish is at Stora Skuggans Amphitheatre on Norra Djurgården, with beautiful medals and an after-party for participants.
course_highlights: A high proportion of nature, with forest trails, archipelago and countryside
Viewpoints and sights along the course
Start and finish at Stora Skuggans Amphitheatre on Norra Djurgården
additional: Mandatory equipment for 58 km includes a water container holding at least one liter, a cup or mug for drinks at aid stations, and a mobile phone with a fully charged battery and the race organizers’ phone number. Aid stations do not provide cups; participants must fill their own cup, mug or bottle. The time limit for 58 km is 11 hours. For 21 km, a cup, mug or bottle for drinks is required. There are also children’s races and virtual races at various distances. Wooden medals with a unique theme are awarded to everyone who finishes. Start and finish at Stora Skuggans Amphitheatre. All finishers receive a wooden medal.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://stockholm.ecotrail.com/): 2027-06-19 — "19 juni 2027 EcoTrail Stockholm" (was estimated 2027-06-12)

name: 46. skrējiens "Apkārt Vaidavas ezeram"
description: The “Around Lake Vaidava” race is a traditional running event held in the Vaidava area. Participants can take part in the 11.7 km race or the walk, enjoying beautiful scenery and a well-prepared course. The event is popular and attracts many participants, offering timing and service points. Commemorative medals are provided, but their number is limited and they are allocated in order of registration. The race is suitable for both athletes and people who enjoy active recreation.
course_highlights: 11.7 km running distance around Lake Vaidava
A walk along a scenic, well-prepared course
Service points and timing chips for race participants
additional: The number of commemorative medals is limited, and they are provided to participants in order of registration: medals go to 11.7 km race participants with registration numbers up to 340 and walk participants with numbers up to 100. Participants who register after the limit has been reached will receive a full participation package without a medal.

name: Pasvalio maratonas
location: Pasvalio kultūros ir poilsio parko stadionas, Pasvalys, Pasvalio rajonas, Lietuva
organizer: Bėgimo mėgėjų ir sveikos gyvensenos klubas „Vėtra“, Lietuvos bėgimo mėgėjų asociacija, Pasvalio sporto mokykla
description: The Pasvalys Marathon is a traditional running event held in the city of Pasvalys. It aims to promote running among young people and adults and encourage a healthy lifestyle. The event takes place at the stadium in Pasvalys Culture and Recreation Park, where participants compete in the marathon, half-marathon, and children’s race. The course length and number of laps are adjusted for the different distances, with water and refreshment stations every 5 km. Participants receive prizes and commemorative medals, and the event is part of the Pasvalys City Festival “Vys par to ãlo” programme.
course_highlights: 10 km course; 4 laps for the marathon and 2 laps for the half-marathon
Water and refreshment stations every 5 km
Start and finish at the stadium in Pasvalys Culture and Recreation Park
additional: Race numbers are distributed from 8:00 at Pasvalys Stadium. The children’s 400 m race starts at 11:00. Participants must have a doctor’s permission or an application bearing a doctor’s approval; otherwise, they are responsible for their own health during the competition. Participants who finish within the time limit receive commemorative medals. Various distances are offered, and participants can look forward to medals, certificates, prizes, and refreshments.

name: Midnight Sun Marathon
description: The Midnight Sun Marathon in Tromsø is an Arctic running adventure beneath the midnight sun, with five distances offering a unique experience in the light of the sun that never sets. The race brings together thousands of participants from around the world and creates a festival atmosphere, with the whole city cheering on the runners. With spectacular mountain and fjord scenery, and an intimate atmosphere that only Tromsø can offer, this is one of the world’s northernmost marathons and a highlight of the racing calendar.
course_highlights: Run beneath the midnight sun, with daylight all night
Spectacular mountain and fjord scenery
A festival atmosphere, with cheers from across the city
additional: Bib distribution and the MSM Expo take place before the race. Bag storage is available at Kulturhuset and Havneterminalen. Changing facilities and showers are available at Gyllenborghallen. Refreshment stations are located approximately every 5 km and offer water, sports drinks and bananas. The Tromsø Red Cross Search and Rescue Corps has a medical station every 5 km and provides assistance and transport when needed. Warm-ups take place 15 minutes before the start of all distances. Bibs can be transferred in the event of illness or injury with a doctor’s certificate and an administration fee. The event offers five distances. The courses are officially measured and certified, and the Midnight Sun Marathon is a member of AIMS.

name: Trysil-løpet
description: Trysil-løpet is an inclusive race in central Trysil, with fast, flat courses suitable for all ages. Distances are 10 km, 5 km, 2 km, 600 m and 300 m; the shortest races are untimed. The start and finish are at the north end of Trysilsenteret, and the courses are officially measured and designed to be fast, with little elevation gain. Places are limited for the 5 km and 10 km. All finishers receive a medal, with prizes for the top finishers in the longer distances.
course_highlights: Fast, flat course with little elevation gain
Start and finish at the north end of Trysilsenteret in central Trysil
Officially measured courses with few turns and good opportunities for fast times
additional: Race numbers can be collected from the event office in the foyer of Trysil cinema. There is a total limit of 400 places for the 5 km and 10 km. All finishers receive medals. Prizes go to the first three women and men in the 5 km and 10 km. A one-time licence is required for participants aged 13 and over who do not have an annual licence. Kondis members receive a discount of 40 kr. Timing and registration are handled by EQ Timing.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 4. Pariisi Maastikujooks
description: The Lääne-Virumaa Running Series 2026 brings together fitness enthusiasts and recreational runners from spring to autumn, offering a variety of running and walking opportunities. The series aims to promote healthy lifestyles and encourage local people to take part in sporting events. The 4th Pariisi Cross-Country Run takes place on 21 June at Pariisi Holiday Village and is part of a long-running series featuring different age groups and distance options. Timing is chip-based, and race numbers must be attached to the stomach or chest, reflecting the organisers’ care for participants’ comfort and safety.

name: Mapri Ehitus x Vägilase jooks Rummu
description: Mapri Ehitus x Vägilase jooks Rummu is a varied obstacle race held at the Rummu quarry. On the course, participants climb, crawl, lift and drag their way through mud, water, sand and hills, making it a challenge for everyone. The race is part of the Vägilase jooks series, known as Estonia’s best OCR event. The course is more substantial and offers exciting obstacles and experiences in nature.

name: Kõrgessaare jaanijooks
organizer: Kõrgessaare Vaba Aja Keskus TERKA ja Hiiumaa Spordiliit
description: Kõrgessaare Midsummer Run is a Midsummer running race held in Kõrgessaare, Hiiumaa. The race offers an opportunity to celebrate the start of summer in an active way and take part in a local community sporting event.
additional: The race has been part of the Hiiumaa Liigub series.

name: Maraton igas linnas Keila
description: Marathon in Every City Keila is a unique running event that gives participants the opportunity to run a marathon distance in different cities. There are refreshment stations every 400 metres along the course, as well as toilets, making the run more comfortable and supporting athletes’ well-being. The event is suitable both for experienced marathon runners and for those who want to test their endurance. It is well organised and offers an enjoyable experience for all participants.
