description: Saulgriežu nakts Stirnu buks is part of the popular Stirnu buks trail-running series, which takes place on Latvia’s most beautiful forest trails. This leg offers a unique night trail-running experience in Liepāja, where participants can enjoy roads and trails with a variety of surfaces that wind through natural landscapes. The races are suitable for participants of different ages and fitness levels, with several distances, including options for children and young people. The event is friendly and inspiring, fostering a sporting spirit and a love of nature.
course_highlights: Roads and trails with a variety of surfaces — asphalt, gravel roads, forest trails and off-road terrain
A night trail run with a special atmosphere and challenges
Distances suitable for different age groups and fitness levels
additional: Registration closes at 12:00 on the Thursday before race week. Late registration is available at the event centre on race day until 30 minutes before the start. Participants are awarded in different age groups and in the overall standings. The series also includes the Latvian Youth Trail Running Championships.

name: Pärnumaa Võidupüha maraton
description: The Pärnumaa Victory Day Marathon takes place in Tori Parish, with the race headquarters located next to the historic Tori Estonian Soldiers’ Memorial Church. The marathon brings several new features and is organized in cooperation with the Pärnumaa Sports Association and its supporters. This traditional and legendary race offers athletes a varied and memorable experience.

name: Night Trail Run  Sommar 2025
description: Night Trail Run Sommar 2027 is a personal and unique trail race held on the longest day of the year in Sollentuna, Stockholm. The race starts early in the morning at 02:00 and offers 30 kilometres of wonderful trail running at dawn, as participants meet the light along the way. With a maximum of 100 participants, the race focuses on the experience and the chance to enjoy nature as it awakens. Navigation is by GPS route and map, and a generous breakfast is served after the finish so participants can share the experience with other runners.
course_highlights: 30 km of trail running at dawn, welcoming the summer light
Two aid stations along the course
Navigation by GPS route and map
additional: Maximum 100 participants for a personal experience. Start and finish at Attunda Orienteering Club’s clubhouse, Ytterbyvägen 22 in Sollentuna. Take the commuter train to Rotebro station and walk 1.5 km to the start/finish. Parking at Sollentuna Golf Club, followed by a 500 m walk. Registration is open until one hour before the start. Minimum age: 18. Breakfast is served after the race. Participant numbers are limited. A generous breakfast is served after the finish.
