name: Modine Söderköpings Stadslopp

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Ordinarie anmälan stänger söndag 13 juni kl 23.59. Ordinarie avgift: 325 kronor.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Från 14 juni tillkommer 50 kronor extra (totalt 375 kr). Efteranmälan via hemsidan till söndag 20 juni kl 16.00.

description: Modine Söderköping City Race is a festive fun run taking place on 22 June 2027, with the start and finish in Brunnsparken in Söderköping. Participants can walk, jog or run 5 kilometres through the city’s beautiful surroundings along the Storån and Göta Canal. The race features music, performances and plenty of encouragement along the course, creating a wonderful atmosphere for both runners and spectators. After crossing the finish line, all participants are treated to a hearty summer plate from ICA Supermarket. This annual running festival is organised by Norrköpings Löparklubb and attracts many participants and spectators.
course_highlights: 5 kilometres through Söderköping, starting and finishing in Brunnsparken
The course is run in three laps: the first along the Storån and Göta Canal, the second through central Söderköping, and the third around Brunnsparken and the residential neighbourhoods
Music and performances along the entire course create a festive atmosphere
additional: Race bibs can be collected at ICA Supermarket Söderköping on Monday 21 June from 12:00 to 18:00, or on race day in Brunnsparken from 15:00 to 18:30. The top tear-off strip on the race bib is the timing chip. Late registration in person is available at ICA Supermarket on 21 June from 12:00 to 18:00 and on race day from 15:00 to 18:30. Swish is the only accepted payment method for late registration in person. The 2027 race takes place on Tuesday 22 June, with the start at 19:00. All participants receive a medal. Late registration costs an extra 50 kronor.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://soderkopingsstadslopp.se/): 2027-06-22 — "Tisdagen 22 juni 2027 är det dags för Modine Söderköpings Stadslopp!" (was estimated 2027-06-15)
pipeline_log.evidence_quote: Tisdagen 22 juni 2027 är det dags för Modine Söderköpings Stadslopp!

name: Häädemeeste Võidupüha jooks
description: The Häädemeeste Victory Day Run is a traditional running event held near the Häädemeeste bus station. The event invites everyone who enjoys being active to celebrate Victory Day in a sporting and community-minded spirit. In addition to the main race, a children’s run for the youngest members of the family will be held for the first time. After the run, participants can enjoy the Midsummer celebration at Häädemeeste Summer Garden. Participation is free, and registration takes place on site.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Häädemeeste bus station
Children’s run before the main race
Midsummer celebration at Häädemeeste Summer Garden after the run
additional: Registration and gathering take place on site at the Häädemeeste bus station from 16:00 to 17:30. Participation is free.

name: 49. Jaanijooks ümber Karksi-Nuia paisjärve
description: The 49th Jaanijooks around the Karksi-Nuia Reservoir is a traditional running race held near the ruins of Karksi Order Castle. The race route circles the scenic Karksi-Nuia Reservoir, offering participants beautiful views and an enjoyable running experience. The event is intended for both recreational and experienced runners and offers a chance to enjoy an active day with the community.

name: Jooks suvesse
description: The Solstice Runs are an annual series of races consisting of several stages, where participants can earn points and compete in age groups. Jooks suvesse is one of the stages in the series and takes place in the Loode oak forest in Kuressaare. The course has varied terrain, including a cycle and pedestrian path and forest trails, which may be muddy depending on the weather. Participants are provided with electronic timing, reusable race bibs and drinking cups, and a sweet snack and drink at the finish.

name: Karlstad Stadslopp
description: Karlstad Stadslopp is a community celebration and recreational race featuring a fast, scenic 10 km course through the most central parts of Karlstad. The race is marked by a sense of community and the joy of running, with many spectator spots along the course. In addition to the main race, there is also the Minilopp for children aged 7–12 and the Miniminilopp for the youngest children. Karlstad Stadslopp is a traditional summer event that brings together over 3,000 runners and is part of SM-veckan.
course_highlights: Certified 10 km course through central Karlstad
Start on Tingvallabron at 18:35
Many spectator spots where runners pass several times
additional: Seeding for start corrals is based on the estimated running time provided at registration. Team competition for the 10 km, with 5–6 people per team; the five fastest times count. Bib pickup and late registration take place in Museiparken on race day. Concert with Dotter at Sandgrund after the finish. Gift cards are available to purchase as gifts. There is also the Karlstad Minilopp for children aged 7–12 and the Miniminilopp for children aged 0–6.

name: Skrējiens “Jānis un Jānītis”
organizer: Noskrien Cēsis un Cēsu novada pašvaldība
description: The “Jānis and Jānītis” run is a traditional Cēsis race with a history dating back to 1989, inviting young and old alike to take part in a festive sporting atmosphere. The event aims to promote a healthy lifestyle, inspire new achievements, and promote Cēsis as a city for active recreation. A range of distances is offered, from a 600-metre children’s run through the city to a 13 km course on asphalt, gravel, and forest roads. Registration is open until 17 June, and places are limited.
course_highlights: Distances range from a 600 m children’s run to a 13 km course
The course includes asphalt, gravel, and forest roads
The race takes place in Cēsis and its surrounding area
additional: Registration must be completed by 17 June. The distances are suitable for different age groups and fitness levels.

name: Līgo skrējiens Ozolos, Liezēres pag.
description: The Līgo Run in Ozoli is an annual running event held in Liezēre Parish, Madona Municipality. The aim of the race is to promote running and Nordic walking as a healthy, active lifestyle, and to foster togetherness and a sporting atmosphere on Līgo Day. The course is a marked loop, offering different distances for children and adults, including a popular run and a Nordic walking distance. The event is suitable for participants of different ages and fitness levels, and is organized in cooperation with the Liezēre Parish Administration.
course_highlights: Loop course with a 3 km lap and a 500 m children’s lap
Various distances for children and adults, including 3 km, 6 km, and 9 km options
Course marked along its entire length
additional: The race takes place in Ozoli, Liezēre Parish, Madona Municipality, in the parking lot opposite the shop. The event runs from 11:00 to 16:00. Participants are divided into age groups and gender categories. The organizer is the association “Madonas rings,” in cooperation with the Liezēre Parish Administration.

name: 12. Rõuge maastikujooks-kõnd
description: The 12th Rõuge Trail Run and Walk is a trail running and Nordic walking event held in Rõuge Nightingale Valley, Võru County, offering participants the chance to enjoy nature and exercise. The event is suitable for runners, Nordic walkers and walkers who want to spend their time actively. The Centre of Excellence for Physical Activity organises the event to promote physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. Participants can experience beautiful scenery and the joy of exercise while enhancing their well-being.

name: St Olavsloppet
organizer: St Olavsgruppens Ideella förening i Sverige och St Olavsloppet A/S i Norge
description: St Olavsloppet is a unique three-day relay race stretching from Trondheim in Norway to Östersund in Sweden. The race offers two main distance options, StOlav 340 and StOlav 210, with teams running timed daily stages and using GPS tracking. It is a social and challenging competition for teams in various categories, including open teams, corporate teams and club teams. There are drink stations and timed changeovers along the route, and the event is characterised by a great atmosphere and teamwork among participants.
course_highlights: Three-day relay from Trondheim to Östersund
Drink stations approximately every four kilometres and at changeovers
GPS tracking with a relay baton for each team
additional: Start groups are based on the team’s running speed, with seeding by the race management. Race bibs must be worn clearly visible on the chest and back, without being folded; otherwise, a time penalty will be added. Changeovers are permitted only at regular and extra changeover points, with timing at regular changeover points. GPS transmitters are attached to the relay baton, which is handed over at changeovers. Teams may hand out their own drinks, but not from moving vehicles. Discounts are available when multiple teams from the same association or company register. Teams can take part in one, two or three daily stages. Categories include, among others, open class, corporate teams, women’s teams and club teams.

name: Izskrien Rīgu 2. posms – Mežaparks
description: Izskrien Rīgu Stage 2 is part of the popular Riga running series, offering running fun for the whole family in the beautiful Mežaparks area. This stage is one of five unique runs held in different locations around Riga, featuring flat and scenic courses. The event brings together professional runners and amateurs alike, creating a friendly and sporting atmosphere. Traditionally, the race takes place in the evening, allowing participants to enjoy running in a city park.
course_highlights: A run through Mežaparks on flat and scenic trails
The course goes around a pond and through Māras Garden
Running in Riga’s most beautiful park areas
additional: The race traditionally starts at 18:30. The event is part of a five-stage series held in different parks and areas around Riga. Participants can take part individually or with their families. The event usually concludes with an awards ceremony and various activities.

name: Trosa Stadslopp
description: Trosa Stadslopp is a traditional community celebration and running race held every year on the Friday after Midsummer in the beautiful summer town of Trosa. The race offers categories for all ages and ability levels, from young children to elite runners, on a varied course through the town centre and close to the water. Chip timing and several start groups create a welcoming, race-friendly atmosphere for both recreational and competitive runners. Trosa Stadslopp is known for its positive atmosphere, enthusiastic spectators and compact course, creating a unique running experience.
course_highlights: The course runs through summery Trosa, close to the water
Chip timing with two intermediate timing points in the 8.9 km race
Competitive and recreational categories for all ages and ability levels
additional: Race bibs with disposable chips are handed out from 10:00 on race day at Team Sportia Trosa. The cutoff time to reach the lap point in the 8.9 km race is 40 minutes. Start groups are available for elite runners, and runners in categories 1 and 2 can choose their start group. The jogging and Nordic walking events start shortly before the competitive categories. Parking is available, with a voluntary fee supporting youth activities. All runners receive 50 cl of Vitamin Well at the finish of the 8.9 km and 4 km races. Registration is available via the race’s registration portal; late and on-site registration have specific dates and fees.

name: Sillamäe promenaadijooks
description: Sillamäe Promenade Run is a well-known city race held near the Sillamäe Cultural Centre. The race began as a stair run and has been called the Promenade Run since 2021. The event offers various distances, from short races for little ones to the adults’ 7 km main distance, which also challenges trained athletes. It is a community-oriented and engaging event, with several activities in addition to running, and important contributions from supporters and volunteers.

name: EUTR - Estonia Ultra-Trail Race
description: The 9th edition of the Estonia Ultra-Trail Race (EUTR) will be held in Narva, Ida-Virumaa County, Estonia. The race starts and finishes at the Äkkeküla sports complex (Nut Hill). Organized by the nonprofit sports club SK ETR, the event features trails certified by the International Trail Running Association (ITRA), with ITRA points awarded to finishers. The race offers several distances for trail runners of different levels, including an ultra-trail and shorter trail options.

name: Fjällmaraton Gastronomi
location: Ottsjö and Trillevallen, Åre Municipality, Jämtland County, Sweden
description: Fjällmaraton Gastronomi is a relaxed mountain marathon offering an experience-filled day in the Åre Mountains, with good food and drink served along the classic mountain marathon trails. Participants can choose between two distances, 22 km and 43 km, both following well-marked trails, with starts in Ottsjö and Trillevallen respectively and the finish in Ottsjö. With an open start time, runners and walkers can complete the course without time pressure, making the race an enjoyable experience in a mountain setting. Accommodation near the start and finish is recommended for the best transfer options.
course_highlights: Local food served at aid stations along the course
Well-marked mountain trails with scenic views
Two distances: 22 km and 43 km, starting in Ottsjö and Trillevallen respectively, and finishing in Ottsjö
additional: Entries can be transferred for a fee of 250 kr. Food and drink stations serve local food, and a kåsa (drinking cup) is provided for use at cup-free stations. Bus transfers to the start are available from Ottsjö, Trillevallen and Undersåker, with return transfers after the finish. Electronic chip timing. A safety team is in place to respond quickly to accidents. The number of start places is limited (400 participants). The open start time allows participants to complete the course without time pressure. Those who want to take it easy are advised to start early. The entry fee includes, among other things, food and drink stations and bus transfers.

name: Jordgubbslunken
description: Jordgubbslunken is a popular fun run held every year on the first Saturday after Midsummer in Rudskoga. Participants can choose between 6 km and 10 km on winding village roads through a beautiful historic countryside, with gravel and grass surfaces. Children can take part in the 500-metre Minilunken. The race welcomes everyone from competitive recreational runners to families looking for a lovely walk. All participants receive a litre of strawberries at the finish and have a chance to win great prizes.
course_highlights: 6 km route on gravel roads
10 km route on gravel roads and well-mown grass
Beautiful winding village roads through the historic countryside
additional: Start and finish at Grunnebacka School. Categories for men, women and children. A generous prize table, with a major prize drawn using participants’ race numbers. All finishers receive strawberries and a medal; the major prize is drawn using participants’ race numbers. Listed prices are from previous races and may change for 2027.

name: Silverleden Ultra 100 Miles
location: Silvergruvan, Hällefors Municipality, Örebro County, Sweden
description: Silverleden Ultra is a challenging ultramarathon in Bergslagen, with several distances ranging from 9 km to 100 miles. The races follow the well-marked Silverleden, a hiking trail with hilly terrain and beautiful views. Silverleden Ultra 100M is known as one of Sweden’s toughest 100-mile races, with a high DNF rate, while the shorter distances offer tough but accessible challenges for different runners. The event includes transport to the start for some distances and nearby accommodation options. The race is marked by a love of running and a strong sense of community in a scenic setting.
course_highlights: Hilly, trail-filled terrain with steep climbs
Fantastic views from the hilltops along the trail
Well-marked hiking trail with bridges over marshes and waterways
additional: Bus transport is included in the entry fee for the 33 km and 100-mile races, departing at 13:00 on Friday for 100M and 11:30 on Saturday for 33K. Children and young people can take part in the 9 km race for free when accompanied by a registered adult. A limited number of caravan and motorhome pitches are available at the start and finish; book by email. To have a name and club/town printed on the race bib, register by 31 May. Silverleden Ultra’s program includes distances of 9 km, 33 km, 64 km and 100 miles. The official website lists the race weekend as 2–3 July 2027, which does not match the stated date of 26 June.

name: Midnattsoltrappa Opp
description: Midnattsoltrappa Opp is a unique uphill race organized by Lavangen Idrettsforening, challenging participants to climb 2,117 steps with an elevation gain of approximately 380 meters. The race starts at the foot of Midnattsoltrappa and finishes at the viewing platform at the top. It is open to children, young people, and adults, with options to race against the clock or take part without timekeeping. The competitive class starts in intervals, while the recreational class has a flexible start time. The event offers a spectacular experience of nature in Spansdalen, Lavangen, and is suitable for both recreational runners and competitive racers.
course_highlights: 2,117 steps up Midnattsoltrappa
Approximately 380 meters of elevation gain
A viewing platform at the top with a great view
additional: The recreational class has a flexible start time between 11:00 and 13:30, with self-registration via QR code. The competitive class starts in intervals from 14:00, with official timing via EQ Timing. Parking is available at Spansdalen community center, approximately 580 meters from the start of the staircase. Prizes are awarded to the fastest women, men, and youth classes, and class winners get their names on a step. A simple kiosk and café are available. Recommended equipment includes good shoes, weather-appropriate clothing, your own drinks, and gloves with a good grip. The staircase is steep, with a handrail and opportunities to take breaks. First-aid equipment and communications equipment are available during the event.

name: KFC Südasuve Challenge - Pirita 2027
description: KFC Midsummer Challenge - Pirita 2027 is a versatile running race held amid Pirita’s beautiful natural surroundings. The race offers a range of distances, suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. The routes wind through the scenic Pirita area, giving participants an enjoyable running experience and a summer sporting challenge. The event is open to everyone and offers a great opportunity to enjoy active leisure time with family and friends.
course_highlights: Scenic Pirita area
A range of distances for runners of different abilities
Pleasant summer running environment
additional: The list of registered participants is updated once an hour. The event includes children’s and family runs, as well as various distances up to 10 km. The event is organized by MTÜ Rakvere Maraton.

name: Muraste jooks
description: Muraste Run is part of the Harku municipality running series and takes place at Muraste School stadium. The course follows Muraste’s streets and shared-use paths on marked, open roads. A range of distances is available for both children and adults, as well as a family race. The top finishers in each age group receive awards, and those who complete the series receive a season medal. The event is organised by MTÜ TreeningPluss, which promotes the joy of movement and active lifestyles.

name: Märgatud laps jooksmas
description: The charity running series “Märgatud Laps jooksmas” takes place at the Kose song festival grounds and offers participants the chance to enjoy a sporting experience while supporting a good cause. The series aims to bring the community together and make the joy of exercise accessible to all age groups. The event is open to everyone interested in running and creates a friendly, supportive atmosphere.

name: TrailÖvik
location: Själevad, Örnsköldsvik Municipality, Västernorrland County, Sweden
description: TrailÖvik is a trail race in Själevad with four different courses to suit all levels. Participants can enjoy a challenging running experience in magnificent natural surroundings, with fantastic trails and fairytale views of the World Heritage Site of the High Coast. The course has been praised by both recreational and elite runners for its fun trails, challenging climbs and beautiful views, with no gravel roads or asphalt. The event has a welcoming, family atmosphere while still being professional, and is well worth travelling to experience.
course_highlights: Fantastic trails in magnificent natural surroundings
Fairytale views of the World Heritage Site of the High Coast
Challenging climbs and no asphalt sections
additional: Race bibs must be collected at the arena no later than 30 minutes before the start. On-site registration opens at the arena and closes 30 minutes before each start. The courses are marked with signs and tape, but runners are encouraged to study the map carefully before starting. Printed maps are available at the beginning of Älgstråket, and digital maps can be downloaded to the Avenza Maps app. Spiked shoes are recommended in wet weather due to slippery rock slabs. Safety staff are available at checkpoints and the finish to help with minor injuries and discomfort. Results are posted immediately after finishing at the arena and on the website. It is possible to test-run the courses.

name: Böda Beach Run
location: Böda Sand Beach Resort, Löttorp, Öland, Sweden
description: Böda Beach Run is a challenging and fun race for the whole family, with distances from 500 meters to 10 kilometers. The race takes place on the beautiful, long sandy beach at Böda Sand Beach Resort on Öland, offering a unique and scenic running experience. Everyone who finishes the race receives a medal as a keepsake. The event is held annually and is part of Böda Sand’s wide range of summer activities and events.
course_highlights: Run on one of Öland’s most beautiful beaches, with almost two miles of white sand
Courses from 500 meters up to 10 kilometers
Family-friendly race with a medal for everyone who finishes
additional: The race is part of Böda Sand’s summer program, with activities for the whole family. There are several distances to choose from, making it accessible to both children and adults. Böda Sand also offers many other sports and leisure activities alongside the event. A lodging offer at Böda Sand has previously been mentioned in race information.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.bodasand.se/evenemang/): 2027-06-30 — "Böda Beach Run — 30 juni 2027" (was estimated 2027-06-23)

name: Millionfiskløpet 27
description: Millionfiskløpet is a 4.2-kilometer race in Sjøvegan in Troms. The race has been held in early July, with start lists and results for participants. Take part in a short, straightforward running challenge in Sjøvegan.
course_highlights: 4.2 km course
Held in Sjøvegan in Troms
The race has been held in early July

name: Byrundan
location: Unos park, Gamleby, Västervik Municipality, Sweden
description: Byrundan is a running race held in Gamleby, starting and finishing in Unos Park. The race offers distances for all ages, from children to adults, on a beautiful summer course through Gamleby. There are several categories and distances, including children’s and youth races, as well as a joint start for the 4 km and 8 km races. All participants receive a medal after finishing, and prizes are awarded to the top finishers in each category, along with sprint prizes in the 4 km and 8 km races. Byrundan is part of TOUR DE RUN and is organised by Gamleby OK.
course_highlights: The course runs through beautiful summer scenery in Gamleby
Start and finish in Unos Park
Water stations at the start/finish and at 4 km
additional: Race numbers can be collected in Unos Park from 15:00 until one hour before the start. Children are offered hamburgers/sausages after the race, sponsored by ICA Supermarket. Medals are sponsored by Metallfabriken Norden AB. Professional timing by Racetimer. The prize ceremony takes place at approximately 19:25 for children and 20:45 for everyone else. A sprint prize at 450 m for the 4 km and 8 km races is a gift card worth 3000 kr. The 8 km course record comes with a 1000 kr prize.

name: Lofoten Skyrace
description: HOKA Lofoten Skyrace is a spectacular trail race held in Svolvær, with three distances: 15 km, 32 km and 42 km. The courses offer varied and technical terrain, panoramic views, challenging ridges and memorable experiences in nature whatever the weather. The race takes place over two days, with the marathon distance on 2 July and the shorter distances on 3 July 2027. A dedicated SkyCrew helps ensure a great and safe race experience. Participants must be self-sufficient with drinks and nutrition, and must carry the mandatory equipment.
course_highlights: 42 km with approximately 2,000 metres of elevation gain over Matmora, Isvatnryggen and Tjeldbergtinden
Technical, varied terrain with panoramic views and challenging ridges
Natural and staffed drink stations along the way on all distances
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Sport1 in Svolvær in the days before the race. A HOKA shake-out run and a Kids race are also held beforehand. A bus to the start is available for the marathon. Runners must bring a fully charged mobile phone, drinks and nutrition; mandatory equipment may be checked before the start. Participants in the 42 km race must be at least 18 years old and provide their own drinks and nutrition. A bus to the start can be selected when registering, and the courses may be changed at short notice due to weather or other unforeseen circumstances.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 22. Emumäe jooks
description: The Lääne-Virumaa Running Series 2026 brings together recreational athletes and active people from spring to autumn, offering a chance to test their abilities in different age groups and distances. The 22nd Emumäe Run is the series’ fifth stage and takes place on 4 July at Emumäe. The series aims to popularise running and fitness walking and support local recreational athletes. Races are held over several distances, from short children’s races to main races of up to 10 km. Timing is chip-based, and race numbers must be attached to the stomach or chest.

name: Võhma terviseraja maraton
description: The Võhma health trail marathon is a trail marathon held on the Võhma town health trail. The course is a 620-metre loop that must be completed 68 times, for a total of 42.2 km. The race starts at 9:00 and offers participants a medal, timing, course support, refreshments at the finish and washing facilities. In addition to the marathon, participants can also run a shorter distance free of charge and without official timing, making it suitable for anyone who enjoys being active.

name: J. Lossmanni mälestusjooks
description: The Jüri Lossmann Memorial Run is a traditional running race held in Viljandi. The race starts at 19:00. The run is dedicated to Jüri Lossmann and offers participants the chance to enjoy a pleasant summer evening and a sporting challenge.

name: Kolmårdsrundan / Kolmården Ultra Trail
description: Kolmården Ultra Trail is a challenging and scenic running experience in the deep forests of Kolmården, with distances of 45 km and 60 km. The course offers varied terrain, with forest trails, mountain ridges featuring spectacular views, sections along the shores of Bråviken, and technical running in nature reserves. The race is suitable for both elite runners and recreational runners seeking a memorable trail experience. At the finish, participants receive a medal and a light meal, included in the entry fee.
course_highlights: Start in Kolmården Forest, with trails through varied terrain
Views from the mountain ridge at Kvarseboklint and running along the shores of Bråviken
Technical and challenging running through Bråviksbranten Nature Reserve
additional: Mandatory equipment: mobile phone, running vest/backpack/belt with at least 0.5 L of fluids, a pressure bandage/blood stopper, and a map with the emergency number (provided at bib collection). Aid stations: the 45K has 4 stations, and the 60K has 5 stations offering sports drink, energy products, and water. The cutoff time for the 45K is 13:30 at 44 km (pace 9:00 min/km). Participants are served a light meal at the finish. Start and finish at Klintvallen in Kvarsebo. Medical services are available on site. After finishing, participants receive a medal and are offered hot vegetarian soup. Mandatory equipment rules apply; aid stations are located along the course.

name: Mörksuggejakten TrailRun

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startavgift före 1/7 Barn och ungdom upp till 16 år 150 kr

description: Mörksuggejakten is one of Sweden’s most popular events in the long-distance race cup, offering a top-class competition since 1997. The cycling race in Rättvik features a beautiful and varied course covering 74 km, with a shorter 46 km option. The route passes through Rättvik, climbs to heights with breathtaking views over Lake Siljan, follows gravel roads and trails, and passes distinctive locations such as Dalhalla and Springkällan. Younger participants can take part in Lilla Mörksuggejakten, with several spectator-friendly courses in the Jarl area. Mörksuggejakten TrailRun also offers 10 km and 20.8 km runs starting from IK Jarl Rättvik.
course_highlights: The course offers beautiful views over Lake Siljan from the heights around Vidablick and the Hedsåsen summer pastures
The route follows gravel roads and trails, and crosses narrow suspension bridges over the Enån valley
Passes distinctive locations such as Dalhalla, Springkällan and Kungshol
additional: Mass start for all classes at 09:30. Maximum time: 5 hours. Race bibs can be collected on race day from 08:00 at IK Jarl. The courses are marked with red-and-white tape and signs. The course is 95% trail and 5% gravel road. It is permitted to switch to a shorter distance during the race. Parking is available at Rättvik Arena; camping in the parking area is prohibited.

name: Ritma skrējiens
description: Ritma Run is a running event in Liepāja where everyone is welcome to take part at their own pace—fast or slow, with a smile or a competitive spirit. It’s a chance to get moving, feel the energy of running, and be part of a community of runners.

name: 6. Navi jooksu-kõnnitiir
description: The Võrumaa Running and Walking Series is a multi-stage series of running and walking events offering a range of distances for both adults and children. The main distances vary from approximately 5 to 8 kilometres, and the course runs mainly on asphalt and gravel roads, with a small section on soft terrain. The series also includes mini distances and runs for young children, suitable for all age groups. The events take place in various locations across Võrumaa, giving participants the opportunity to enjoy the region’s beautiful nature and sporting community.

name: Navi jooksutiir
description: Navi Run is a running, Nordic walking and walking event held in Võru County and organized by Navi Village Association. The event offers an opportunity to enjoy exercise and a healthy lifestyle in beautiful surroundings, and is suitable for participants of different abilities. Navi Run is part of a broader initiative to promote physical activity, with the aim of supporting an active and healthy lifestyle. Everyone who enjoys being active is invited to enjoy a sporty day and the joy of movement.

name: Riddarsprånget
description: Riddarsprånget is the Hova Knight Week's own street race, held on the Monday of the festival week from 18:00. There are 29 classes for ages 2 to 80+, and the race draws 300 to 400 runners every year. The longest distance is 10 km, two laps of a 5 km loop almost entirely on the streets of Hova. Everyone who finishes gets a knight's medal, and all children and youths up to 16 get a T-shirt.
course_highlights: Street race through Hova during the Knight Week
10 km, two laps of a 5 km loop
Knight's medal for every finisher
additional: Register via the Hova IF website or on site in Riddarparken from 16:00 to 17:30 on race day. The prize ceremony is held in Riddarparken.

name: Kambja Tervisejooksud
description: Kambja Health Runs is a three-stage running series inviting both recreational and experienced runners to enjoy an active time outdoors. At each stage, participants can choose between a lap of the approximately 5 km health trail and a 10 km race. There is also an exciting power run to find the best ratio of strength to speed. Series finishers are eligible for prizes and prize draws, including a bicycle as the grand prize. Participation is free, and registration is available online and on-site.

name: 7. ETAPP
description: Käime Koos is a recreational sports series by the Estonian Sports Association Kalev, inviting participants to take part in various hiking and walking stages across Estonia. The 7th stage takes place on Kesselaid, offering participants the chance to enjoy the beautiful natural scenery of the Muhu escarpment. The series aims to promote physical activity and a healthy lifestyle through hiking and walking together. Participants can experience varied terrain and combine exercise with good company.
course_highlights: Beautiful natural scenery of the Muhu escarpment
Varied terrain suitable for walking and hiking
The series takes place in different parts of Estonia, showcasing local natural beauty
additional: Käime Koos stages take place in different locations across Estonia, where participants can enjoy nature and physical activity. The series is organised by the Estonian Sports Association Kalev. More information and contact: Sirje Soovik +372 506 2250.

name: Vooremäe tipujooks
description: Vooremäe Tipujooks is a running competition organized by the Tartumaa Sports Association and held at Vooremäe. It is a traditional summer sporting event that invites running enthusiasts to take part and offers the chance to enjoy beautiful scenery and competitive sport. The competition is part of the Tartumaa sports calendar and is suitable for runners of different ability levels.

name: 45. jooks ümber Pühajärve
location: Pühajärve Spa & Holiday Resort, Otepää, Valga County, Estonia
description: The 45th Run Around Lake Pühajärv is a traditional running race held around Pühajärv Spa & Holiday Resort. The distance is 10.7 km, and the course is well marked and secured, offering participants beautiful views of the lake. The race is part of the 2026 Maru Lake Runs series and is its third event. The start is at 12:00 on Saturday, July 11. Participants are provided with timing, refreshment stations and an awards ceremony.
course_highlights: A 10.7 km course around Lake Pühajärv
Refreshment stations at 4.4 km and 7.7 km
The course is marked and secured by course marshals
additional: Start groups are formed based on previous results; elite runners may start in the first group. Timing is chip-based, with the chip attached to the back of the race bib. Participants receive a medal, sports drink and water on the course and at the finish, as well as medical assistance along the entire course. The awards ceremony is scheduled for approximately 13:30, with awards for the top six. Participants can register on site, and discounts are available. The course runs around Lake Pühajärv and is suitable for both recreational and experienced runners.

name: Sportland Kõrvemaa Triatlon 2026
location: Kõrvemaa Matka- ja Suusakeskus, Kõrvemaa, Estonia
description: Sportland Kõrvemaa Triathlon takes place at Kõrvemaa Hiking and Ski Centre and offers an exciting grassroots triathlon experience. The main distance comprises a 250 m swim, a 20 km mountain bike ride and a 4 km run, much of which follows the ski trails and forest roads of the Põhja-Kõrvemaa Landscape Reserve. In addition to the main event, participants can take part in the Stebby duathlon and youth duathlon, which are intended for different age groups. The event is well organised, with chip timing, medical support and water stations. After the race, participants receive a medal and can enjoy hot soup, a sauna and bike-washing facilities.
course_highlights: The swim takes place in the pond at Kõrvemaa Hiking and Ski Centre, over one lap, with a maximum depth of 2.5 m
The 20 km bike course follows the ski trails and forest roads of the Põhja-Kõrvemaa Landscape Reserve
The 4 km trail run is marked and secured
additional: Starts are in waves of five, with a 10-second interval between each wave. Competitors must wear a helmet while cycling and a timing chip around their ankle. The entry fee includes medical first aid, water-station service, a medal, hot soup, a smoothie, use of the sauna and hot tub, and bike washing. There is a bag drop at the event centre, and changing facilities are available in the sauna anteroom. The swim start number must be written on the cheek or shoulder with a waterproof marker. Drafting is permitted during the bike leg. Trail course, family events, free soup and sauna, registration information, entry fees vary, limited number of places

name: Mõisa jooks
organizer: SK Team Kehtna ja Alutaguse vallavalitsus
description: Kehtna Manor Run is a friendly, community-focused running event held in the grounds of Kehtna Manor. It offers three distances: a 5 km main race, a 2.5 km youth race, and a 500 m children’s race, welcoming participants of different ages. Alongside the races, the event features Children’s Day activities, pony rides, and trampolines, creating a pleasant family-day atmosphere. It is organized by SK Team Kehtna, which is dedicated to promoting sport and physical activity in the community.

name: 5. Pühajärve pargimiil
description: The 5th Pühajärve Park Mile is a 1.6 km running race held in the park of Pühajärve Holiday Centre. The start and finish are at the same location, and the race begins at 12:10. The race is open to all running enthusiasts and offers a pleasant opportunity to enjoy a run in beautiful park surroundings. Participants receive a medal and bib number, chip timing, sports drink and water at the finish, and medical assistance along the entire course.

name: Pajusi Mudajooks
organizer: MTÜ Sporty ja MTÜ Pajusi Küla Selts
description: Pajusi Mudajooks is a popular mass-participation sporting event in Central Estonia, offering participants an exciting and adventurous obstacle course of up to 10 km. The event takes place in Pajusi village and is suitable for both individual runners and teams. The course features natural and man-made obstacles that challenge participants’ physical and mental endurance. Separate courses are available for children, and all finishers receive a commemorative medal. Free parking and hot soup after the race are provided for participants.

name: Böda Sandsloppet
location: Böda Sand SportCamp, Böda, Öland, Sweden
description: Böda Sandsloppet is a family-friendly running race held at Böda Sand SportCamp on Öland. The race offers several distances for both children and adults, with routes through lovely forest terrain. Adults can choose between 6.5 km and 4 km, while shorter distances are available for children and young people. All participants who finish the race receive a medal as a keepsake. The event has a welcoming atmosphere and is open to runners of all ages and abilities.
course_highlights: Route through lovely forest terrain
Start and finish at Böda Sand SportCamp
Distances available for both children and adults
additional: Late registration is available through 8 July, followed by race-number collection on race day from 15:00. Payment can be made in cash, by card or via Swish. Children and young people under 11 are not timed and there is no prize ceremony for them. Start and finish at Böda Sand SportCamp. Register by 3 July 2027; late registration is available for a higher fee. Children aged 11 and under are not timed and there is no prize ceremony.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://olandrunning.se/lopp/bodasandsloppet/): 2027-07-10 — "Tid & datum 10 juli 2027" (was estimated 2027-07-02)

name: Musköloppet
description: Musköloppet is a popular running race held in the spectacular archipelago setting of Muskö. The race has a long tradition and celebrated its 30th anniversary in 2022, after being paused during the pandemic. There are several different courses and categories, including children’s races, and the event offers a wonderful nature experience, with the start and finish at Muskö Hembygdsgård. Late registration is available on site up to one hour before the start.
course_highlights: The race takes place in the beautiful archipelago setting of Muskö
Start and finish at Muskö Hembygdsgård
Children’s races over 1.5 km and 2.5 km for different age groups
additional: Late registration is available on site at the start and finish area up to one hour before the race begins. There are water stations along the course, and runners may arrange their own drinks. Race management may decide to restart the race if needed. Pacing assistance from non-competitors is not permitted. The children’s races start at 10:00 for 1.5 km (ages 7–10) and at 10:30 for 2.5 km (ages 11–14). The countdown on the official website indicates 10 July 2027. However, the published times and distances on the website are for 2026. The relay costs 150 kr per team, and the children’s race for ages 4–6 is free, according to the published information.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.muskoloppet.se/): 2027-07-10 — "Nedräkning till Musköloppet 10 juli 2027" (was estimated 2027-07-10)

name: Gotland Run 511k (2026)
description: Gotland Run 511k is a unique running adventure and a journey to explore your inner landscape. It is not a traditional race, but a self-supported run around the beautiful island of Gotland, including a loop around Fårö, starting and finishing in Visby. Participants have 10 days to complete the approximately 511 km course, with support from four Angel Stations along the way. The organizer provides basic support, while runners are responsible for their own food and accommodation.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Visby, Gotland’s medieval capital
Clockwise loop around the island, including Fårö
Mixed terrain with asphalt, gravel roads, and shorter trails
additional: Participants must check in twice daily using an online tool. Accommodation on the first night is at Visby Fängelse Hostel in shared rooms. A pre-race dinner and briefing are held the evening before the start. Angel Stations offer support, water, rest, and sometimes shower facilities. The ferry to Fårö runs every 30 minutes, but requires a call between 22:00 and 05:30. The run must be completed on foot within 10 days, averaging approximately 51 km per day. Luggage storage is available at the hostel. Parking is available near the ferry terminal, with cheaper options at Visby Airport. This is a self-supported event: participants are responsible for most of their food and logistics. The entire distance must be completed on foot within ten days, with regular position reports.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://runtrip.se/race-memo-2027/): 2027-07-10 — "SATURDAY, JULY 10 — The race starts at 10:00 am outside the main entrance of Visby Fängelse" (was estimated 2027-07-03)
pipeline_log.evidence_quote: SATURDAY, JULY 10 — The race starts at 10:00 am outside the main entrance of Visby Fängelse

name: Branäsutmaningen
description: Branäsutmaningen is a summer adventure in Branäs featuring a challenging 6-kilometre course. Branäs is known for its beautiful natural surroundings and family-friendly outdoor activities all year round. In summer, activities include mountain biking, padel and water activities by the Klarälven River. Branäs is investing in family-friendly cycling trails and scenic hiking trails, making it a perfect place for an active and fun summer experience.
course_highlights: A challenging 6-kilometre course
Family-friendly downhill trails and wide cross-country trails
A scenic location by the Klarälven River, with hiking trails and fishing
additional: Branäs offers family-friendly lift-accessed cycling, with the six-seat express lift Sjöexpressen at the heart of its cycling programme. There are barbecue and rest areas with views, miles of gravel and paved roads for training, and cycling tracks for children at Soltorget. Food and drinks are available at Ladan restaurant in the centre. The summer map includes a pump track, zipline, trampoline with a big airbag, and trails in Logläntan. Start at 14:00 at Soltorget. Family Day also includes Björnbuseloppet for children, an after-run and an evening of live music. The first prize in the race is a family ski holiday.

name: Rojas pusmaratona festivāls
description: The Roja Half Marathon Festival is an annual running event held in Roja, offering a range of distances, including a 21.1 km half marathon, 12.3 km, 3 km, and children’s races. The competition takes place on a stadium track and a certified asphalt course suitable for timed races. The festival welcomes both professional and amateur runners and also features a 24-hour ultramarathon and other running options. It is a great opportunity to enjoy a sporting atmosphere and the Zvejnieksvētki morning activities in Roja.
course_highlights: Course lap length: 1234.7 m
Course surface: stadium track and asphalt
The course meets the requirements for timed races and has a World Athletics certificate
additional: Registration and bib collection take place from 7:00 to 8:45 (3 km) and until 9:15 (21.1 km, 12.3 km, and 400 m children’s races). The 3 km race starts at 9:00, the 12.3 km race and Nordic walking at 9:30, the half marathon at 9:30, and the children’s races at 9:45. The festival also includes 24-hour, 12-hour, and 6-hour races with separate start times. The awards ceremony takes place at around 12:00–13:00. Individual support points for the ultramarathon are available along the course.

name: Rástegáisái
description: Rástegáisái 2027 is a traditional uphill race and hiking event in Tana, Finnmark, organized by Sirbmá-Sirbma IL. The recreational hike starts between 08:00 and 12:30, and the uphill race has a mass start at 13:00 for all categories. Participants must bring a backpack with full-coverage outerwear for the descent. A hydration belt is recommended, as there is only one water station along the route. All participants receive a finisher’s prize, and prizes are awarded to the top three in every category. The event offers a challenging mountain route through beautiful scenery, with the opportunity to earn fitness points and visit a Perletur checkpoint along the way.
course_highlights: Uphill race with a challenging climb
Only one water station along the route, at the camp below the mountain
Opportunity to earn fitness points and visit a Perletur checkpoint along the way
additional: All uphill-race participants must bring a backpack with full-coverage outerwear for the descent. Runners without a backpack that meets the requirements will receive a 15-minute time penalty. Runners and hikers who have not reached the summit by 16:00 will be turned back by marshals. Hikers taking the shortest route (4 km) may start as late as 15:55.

name: Melbuløpet
location: Melbu torg, Melbu, Hadsel, Nordland, Norway
description: Melbuløpet takes place at Melbu Square and offers three officially measured distances: 2.5 km, 5 km and 10 km on a very flat, fast course, offering good opportunities to achieve fast times. A children’s race of approximately 600 metres is also held for the youngest participants. The race is part of Sommer-Melbu, a long-running summer festival held since 1986 and characterised by broad local involvement and a strong volunteer spirit.
course_highlights: Very flat and fast course
Three officially measured distances: 2.5 km, 5 km and 10 km
Children’s race of approximately 600 metres
additional: The children’s race starts at 15:30 and the competitive race categories start at 16:00. Children’s race participants register on site. The race is held as part of the Sommer-Melbu festival, which lasts ten days and is run by volunteers. The listed start location is Melbu Square. Registration for the competitive race categories is via EQ Timing, while children’s race participants register on site.

name: PALMS Südasuve Challenge - Võsu 2026
location: Võsu, Lääne-Nigula vald, Lääne County, Estonia
description: PALMS Midsummer Challenge - Võsu 2026 is a sporting summer event held in the town of Võsu. It is an enjoyable and active challenge for running enthusiasts, offering the chance to enjoy summer nature and community support. The event is part of the Estonian Night Run series and brings together runners from different regions. Võsu’s beautiful coastal scenery provides excellent conditions for a sporting experience.
course_highlights: Coastal scenery in the town of Võsu
A pleasant, active summer running environment
Part of the Estonian Night Run series
additional: The event includes a range of swimming distances and is open to both local and virtual participants, offering summer sea air and sport in a friendly atmosphere.

name: Vimka tõusu maraton
description: Vimka Tõusu Marathon is a summer marathon on the Viimsi Peninsula, offering participants one large loop. The start and finish are in the parking lot of Randvere School. The varied course includes both paved roads and forest trails, with several climbs and descents that make the run exciting and varied.

name: Semesterhalvmaran
location: Torps herrgård, Kumla Municipality, Örebro County, Sweden
description: Semesterhalvmaran is a recurring running event organized by the running club LK Gränslöst, inviting runners to experience the beautiful open landscapes of the Närke Plain. The race starts and finishes at Torps herrgård outside Kumla and offers a lovely running experience on gravel roads among rolling grain fields. After a two-year break, the race returns on July 11, 2027, welcoming runners of all levels to take part in a community filled with the joy of running. LK Gränslöst is an inclusive club that aims to bring runners from across the country together and build a strong community around running.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Torps herrgård outside Kumla
Run on gravel roads among rolling grain fields on the Närke Plain
Beautiful, nature-rich surroundings on the Närke Plain
additional: Registration is planned to open in January. The race is organized by the running club LK Gränslöst, which also organizes other races and group training every Wednesday at 18:00 in Örebro. The club focuses on community and the joy of running for all levels.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.lkgranslost.se/semesterhalvmaran-finish/): 2027-07-11 — "Söndagen den 11 juli 2027 är det åter dags för löpning på Närkeslätten när den är som bäst!" (was estimated 2027-07-03)
pipeline_log.evidence_quote: Söndagen den 11 juli 2027 är det åter dags för löpning på Närkeslätten när den är som bäst!

name: Liepājas pusmaratons (Jūras svētki)
location: Lielais Dzintars Concert Hall, Liepāja, Latvia
description: The Liepāja Half Marathon is an annual running event held in Liepāja, bringing together local and international runners. The race offers an opportunity to enjoy the city’s most beautiful spots and its proximity to the sea while completing the half-marathon distance. The event is part of Sea Festival celebrations, creating a special festive atmosphere for participants and spectators. It is a great way to combine sport with cultural activities and relaxation in Liepāja.
course_highlights: The route runs through the central streets of Liepāja
Views of the sea and the seaside promenade
Part of the Sea Festival celebrations, with a special atmosphere
additional: Finishers receive a Sea Festival commemorative medal, and participant registration includes BTA accident insurance.

name: Võru kergejõustikuõhtu
description: The Võru Athletics Evenings series is a traditional series of track and field events combining throwing, jumping, and running disciplines. The series consists of several stages, where participants can compete in different distances and events, with the IAAF scoring tables used to determine the rankings. The competitions take place at Võru Stadium and are open to athletes of varying abilities. The series offers a varied track and field experience for both recreational and advanced athletes.

name: Västervik City Run
description: Västervik City Run is a city race of approximately 6.3 km that takes place in and around central Västervik, starting and finishing at Grönsaks- och Fiskartorget. The race offers a scenic course along the cycle path beside Gamlebyviken, passing landmarks including the Stegeholm Castle ruins and Myntbryggan. After finishing, participants receive a medal as proof of their participation. The race is a popular summer tradition that welcomes runners of all ages.
course_highlights: A city race of approximately 6.3 km in central Västervik
The course follows the cycle path beside Gamlebyviken and passes the Stegeholm Castle ruins
Start and finish at Grönsaks- och Fiskartorget
additional: A children’s race (Sparbanksloppet) of 800 m for children up to 10 years old, with a group start from Fiskaretorget at 18:30. Participants receive medals after finishing. A separate Sparbanksloppet of approximately 700 metres is offered for children up to 10 years old. Registration for the 2027 race opens on 1 May.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.vikhockey.se/boka-bord-2/city-run/): 2027-07-12 — "Måndag den 12 juli är det dags för 2027 års löpartävling i Västerviks centrum!" (was estimated 2027-07-05)
pipeline_log.evidence_quote: Måndag den 12 juli är det dags för 2027 års löpartävling i Västerviks centrum!

name: Izskrien Rīgu 3.posms Biķernieku trase
location: Biķernieku trase, Sergeja Eizenšteina iela, Riga, Latvia
organizer: Biedrība “Piedzīvojumu sacensību apvienība” sadarbībā ar Rīgas valstspilsētas pašvaldību
description: Izskrien Rīgu is a running series in Riga for the whole family, held at five unique locations around the city, including Biķernieku Track. The series offers a range of distances suitable for active runners, beginners, and children. Its aim is to promote a healthy lifestyle and encourage Riga residents to be physically active. Each event is specially organised with a friendly atmosphere and the opportunity to compete in family and sports-team categories.
course_highlights: Biķernieku Track, with 6 laps in the 10 km distance
The races take place in Riga’s parks and neighbourhoods on flat terrain
Distances are suitable for different age groups and fitness levels
additional: Participants may take part with strollers, but dogs are not allowed. A single registration gives participants a number that is valid for all events. Participants who take part in at least 4 of the 5 events receive a season commemorative prize. It is recommended to arrive 30–45 minutes before the start to collect your race number and warm up. The event centre is at Biķernieku Track by the stadium, on S. Eizenšteina Street. The course is marked. The venue is accessible by public transport, but parking is paid.

name: Lüllemäe mägedejooks
description: Lüllemäe Mountain Run is the third event in the Valgamaa running series and takes place on the Lüllemäe health trails. The main race distance is 4.5 km, and children’s toddler and mini runs are also held at the Lüllemäe Basic School stadium. The event is suitable for runners of different ages and offers a chance to enjoy beautiful nature and a sporting competitive atmosphere. Children’s runs are free, and the main race entry fees are reasonable, encouraging broad participation.

name: Ozolkalna VK
additional: The participation fee must be paid by bank card or bank transfer. If paying by bank transfer, registration details must be sent to latloppet@gmail.com.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 9. Rakvere valla Suvejooks
description: Lääne-Virumaa Running Series 2026 is a multi-stage running and walking series featuring various races in the Lääne-Virumaa region. Stage 9, Rakvere Parish Summer Run, takes place at Kooli 4 in Rakvere. The series aims to offer a sporting challenge and enjoyment to running enthusiasts and promote an active lifestyle throughout the region.

name: Väinjärve jooks , 8. Järvamaa Järvede jooksud VI etapp
description: The Järvamaa Lake Runs is a traditional running series consisting of several stages by different lakes in Järvamaa. The Väinjärve Run is the sixth stage of the series. The race gives participants the opportunity to enjoy the beautiful natural surroundings and varied terrain around the lake. The series offers different distances and is suitable for both recreational and experienced runners.

name: Lidingöloppet Funäsfjällen
description: Lidingöloppet Funäsfjällen is a challenging trail race in a mountain setting, with steep climbs, sloping trails and flat meadows offering fantastic views of the mountains. The race combines adrenaline-filled running with scenic experiences and is held at Bruksvallarna ski stadium in Bruksvallarna. This is the fourth edition of the race, welcoming runners to a unique and beautiful challenge in the Swedish mountains.
course_highlights: Steep climbs and sloping trails
Flat meadows with incredible mountain views
A downhill stretch towards Bruksvallarna village after a tough climb
additional: Bib pick-up takes place at the venue in Bruksvallarna. A late-entry fee of SEK 100 applies to registrations on race day. During the week before the race, running clinics, shoe testing, try-out mountain running sessions and other activities are held in Bruksvallarna. Water stations and food and drink stations are available along the course.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.lidingoloppet.se/lidingoloppet-funasfjallen): 2027-07-17 — "Date 17 juli" (was estimated 2027-07-10)

name: Åsele Trailrun
description: Åsele Trail Run is organised by Åsele Idrottsklubb on the third Saturday of July, with the race centre, start and finish at Åslia just outside Åsele. The course follows trails, snowmobile tracks, some unmarked ground and a stretch of gravel road. The 2026 edition was the second, held on 18 July on a new course with a joint start for all classes at 11:00. The top three in each class get prizes from the sponsors.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Åslia outside Åsele
Trails, snowmobile tracks and gravel road
Water and sports drink at two points on the course
additional: Showers and changing rooms are at the Åsele ice rink, about 4 km away. Late entry, if places remain, is at the race centre for an extra fee of 100 SEK.

name: 12. skrējiens Piltene
description: Skrējiens Piltene is an annual running event in Piltene that brings together participants of different ages and fitness levels. Previous editions have included 10 km and 5 km races, as well as shorter events and Nordic walking starts. The event aims to promote an active, healthy lifestyle and popularize running.
course_highlights: The event’s main race is a 10 km road run.
Previous editions have also included a 5 km race.
Participants have also been offered a mile race and a 5 km Nordic walking start.

name: Yttersia Skyrace Senja
description: Yttersia Skyrace Senja is a rugged and accessible skyrace held on Senja’s spectacular outer coast, starting and finishing at Yttersia Base in Skaland. The course takes participants through dramatic coastal mountain terrain with long ridges, sheer slopes and fantastic views of the Berg Islands, Steinfjorden and Okshornan. The race features a continuous, runnable climb to Husfjellet, followed by narrow, exposed ridges and challenging technical terrain. It finishes with a sociable atmosphere, music and an after-run gathering at the finish area. This race is for anyone looking to experience authentic Senja terrain and a day filled with community and good vibes.
course_highlights: Dramatic coastal mountain terrain with long ridges and sheer slopes
A continuous, runnable climb to Husfjellet (632 m above sea level) with spectacular views
Technical, untouched terrain at Nonshaugen, near a historic graphite mine
additional: The race starts with a short stretch on a gravel road before continuing onto trails and uphill. There is one refreshment station at Litjebrusen. The finish area at Yttersia Base offers music, an announcer, awards, food, drinks and an after-run gathering with a sociable atmosphere lasting into the afternoon and evening. For 2026, the course is listed as running on gravel roads, trails and technical mountain terrain, with one refreshment station.

name: 31. Jooks-kõnd ümber Uhtjärve
description: The 31st Run-Walk Around Lake Uhtjärv is a traditional running and walking series in the Võru region, offering a range of distances for every participant. The event takes place in the beautiful natural surroundings of Lake Uhtjärv, providing a sporting challenge for both runners and walkers. The series includes various distances and mini-distances suitable for beginners and experienced athletes alike. The event is part of the Võru County running and walking series, known for its friendly atmosphere and good organization.

name: Sõõrikujooks
description: The Sõõrikujooks is a running event held by Õismäe Pond in Tallinn, organized by Marathon100. Running enthusiasts are welcome to enjoy a pleasant run and a day together.
course_highlights: The start and event venue are by Õismäe Pond.

name: Jooks ümber Uhtjärve
description: The Võrumaa Running and Walking Series is a multi-stage series of running and walking events, offering a range of distances for both adults and children. The main distances range from approximately 5 to 8 kilometres, and the course runs mainly on asphalt and gravel roads, with some off-road sections. The series also includes mini-distances and runs for toddlers, suitable for all age groups. The event is open to everyone interested in sport and promotes healthy lifestyles and community involvement.

name: Aastajooks
organizer: Spordiklubi Pärnu Kahe Silla Klubi MTÜ
description: The Pärnu Annual Runs are a traditional running series that began in 1985 and are inspired by the Eastern calendar, dedicating each year to its corresponding symbolic animal. The 2026 series is themed around the Year of the Fire Horse and consists of nine stages held in three different areas of Pärnu: Vallikäär, Pärnu Beach, and the Reiu-Raeküla health trail. Three stages take place at each location, offering participants a varied and enjoyable running experience. The series aims to provide a sporting challenge and enjoyment for both recreational and experienced runners.

name: Kohila Pikamaajooksusari
description: The Kohila Long-Distance Running Series is a competition for sports enthusiasts in Kohila Parish, offering a variety of running opportunities for different age and ability groups. The series aims to promote recreational exercise and provide participants with an enjoyable sporting experience. Participants receive a beautiful commemorative medal at each stage, and the series standings are based on points. The series is organized by Kohila Sports Centre, which provides modern facilities and a strong sporting environment.

name: KEVEK ja Tartu Kalev staadionijooksu sari
description: The KEVEK and Tartu Kalev Stadium Running Series is a running series competition organised by Tartu Spordiselts Kalev and held in the city of Tartu. The series has several stages, offering opportunities to take part in track races across different age groups. Competitions are held mainly at Tamme and Ülenurme Stadiums and are aimed at both young people and adults, providing a sporty and friendly competition environment. Registration closes at 12:00 on race day, offering flexibility for participants.

name: Kaldoaivi Ultra Trail
description: Kaldoaivi Ultra Trail is the world’s northernmost ultra-running event, held in Utsjoki, in the Lapland wilderness. The route climbs to the summits of Kaldoaivi’s highest fells and offers spectacular, challenging scenery. The race tests runners’ endurance and skills in demanding natural terrain, but rewards them with an experience that brings many back year after year. The event also includes mountain bike races and offers a range of options for participants of different levels.
course_highlights: The route climbs to the summits of Kaldoaivi’s highest fells
Spectacular, rugged Lapland wilderness scenery
A demanding and instructive trail route
additional: Registering for two days gives a 30% discount on the price of the lower-priced category. The entry fee includes drinks and energy supplies at aid stations, washing facilities, transport of a gear bag to the finish, a race number, timing, a Kaldoaivi Ultra Trail lightweight backpack, a KUT product and a Finisher pendant. Category changes and transfers are free of charge until 7.7.2027. The event centres and start locations are in Nuorgam and Utsjoki. The race schedule includes several start times for different distances on 23.7. and 24.7.2027. Participant limits vary by distance; for example, MTB & E-MTB 57 km: 100 participants, Trailrun 168 km: 100 participants. The event offers several distances, including trail running, mountain biking and road cycling, with no amenities along the route. Participation includes a race number, timing chip, lightweight backpack and Finisher pendant. The event takes place in July 2027; detailed schedules and registration information are available on the website.

name: Mispo maastikumaraton
description: Mispo Trail Marathon is a trail race held in the Kurgja area of North Pärnumaa. The race distances are 42.195 km (marathon), 21.097 km (half marathon), 14 km and 7 km. The start is at the C. R. Jakobson Farm Museum at 11:00, and the race office opens at 9:00. All finishers receive a drink, food, access to the sauna, a diploma and a medal at the finish. The traditional event is organised by Terviseklubi Mispo, an active sports club since 1989.

name: Sakala metsajooks
description: The Sakala Forest Run is a trail race held in the Metsarada area in Kurgja municipality. The event offers several distances, including a marathon, half marathon, and shorter 7 km and 14 km runs. The race starts at 11:00 from the C. R. Jakobson Farm Museum, and participants are provided with a drink, food, sauna, certificate, and medal at the finish. The traditional event is organised by the Mispo Health Club and offers a sporty, friendly atmosphere.

name: Helags Fjällmara
description: Helags Fjällmara is a classic mountain marathon that has been held in the Ljungdalsfjällen since 1985. The event offers several distances for all levels, from the challenging full marathon of 42 km to the 800-metre children’s race. It provides a unique mountain experience amid beautiful scenery and varied terrain, and is family-friendly, with races for both adults and children. The start and finish are on the meadow in the centre of Ljungdalen, and the event includes energy and hydration stations, a personal cup, a medal for everyone who finishes, and showers and a sauna after the race.
course_highlights: Trail race amid the beautiful mountain scenery of the Ljungdalsfjällen
Distances from an 800 m children’s race to the 42 km full marathon
Start and finish on the meadow in the centre of Ljungdalen
additional: Mass start for all distances. Bib pickup is in the gymnasium at the event site; bibs include a chip for electronic timing. Energy and hydration stations are located along the course and after the finish. Showers and a sauna are available after the race. Participant limits apply to each distance, e.g. 100 participants for the 42 km race. Children below a certain age must run with an adult.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://helagsfjallmara.se/): 2027-07-24 — "24 Juli 2027" (was estimated 2027-07-17)

name: Hornsjön Runt
description: Hornsjön Runt is a traditional running race around Öland’s only inland lake, through beautiful and varied Öland nature. The race offers several distances for both young people and adults, including a walking category. Along the course, participants pass gravel roads with limestone surfaces, grass, cow pastures, deciduous and coniferous forest, and sand dunes. Everyone who finishes receives a medal, and prizes are awarded to the top three in each category.
course_highlights: The course goes around Öland’s only inland lake
Varied terrain including gravel roads, grass, cow pastures, deciduous and coniferous forest, and sand dunes
Three water stations along the course, as well as at the start/finish
additional: A walking category is available for 5.5 km and 11 km, with start times between 13:00 and 16:00 and no timing. Shower and changing facilities are available at Högby Idrottsplats. Prizes are awarded to the top three in all categories. The start and finish are at Pensionat Hornsjön. Youth categories have different start times from 15:30 to 16:00, depending on age and distance. There are distances for children and young people, as well as a walking category without timing.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://olandrunning.se/lopp/hornsjon-runt/): 2027-07-24 — "Tid & datum 24 juli 2027" (was estimated 2027-07-17)

name: Hamra Trail Run 2026
description: Hamra Trail Run is a friendly, exclusive trail running event held in spectacular mountain surroundings at Pensionat Strandgården in Fjällnäs. The event offers three distances—Sprint 12 km, Distance 24 km and Ultra 48 km—with varying elevation gain and aid stations along the course. Runners are expected to be self-sufficient and follow the clearly marked orange flags along the route. The event is limited to a maximum of 150 participants and is known for its community spirit and scenic experience.
course_highlights: Sprint 12 km with approximately 300 m of elevation gain and 1 aid station at 4 km
Distance 24 km with approximately 630 m of elevation gain and 2 aid stations at 4 km and 20 km
Ultra 48 km with approximately 1,300 m of elevation gain and 4 aid stations, including at the start/finish
additional: Race bibs are collected at the race office on race day, with different collection times depending on the distance. A mandatory pre-race briefing is held before the start. Runners must bring their own cup/mug/bottle, as disposable cups are not used at the aid stations. Mandatory equipment includes an extra layer, a wind jacket/wind pants depending on the weather, a first-aid kit including an elastic bandage, and a fully charged mobile phone with the safety number saved. Parts of the courses are muddy and unmarked, particularly across Skenörsfjället, where the terrain is dense and rugged. The cut-off time for the 24 km is 3.5 hours, with a maximum time of 8 hours. Runners are encouraged to stop and help others if needed and to follow the flags carefully. GPX files for all distances are available. According to the available race information, the number of entries is limited to 150. A runners’ dinner is held after the finish.

name: Ulvöruset 2026
description: Ulvöruset is a race on the island of Ulvön in the High Coast archipelago, with the start and race office at the harbour by Ulvö Hotell. The longest distance is the 22 km Extrem across the whole island, with technical trails, coastal stretches and 512 m of total climbing. There is also a 10 km on varied and technical ground and a 5 km Motion along the shoreline on a wide forest path. The 2027 edition is on Saturday 24 July.
course_highlights: 22 km Extrem across all of Ulvön
10 km and 5 km with sea views
Lilla Ulvöruset 1.5 km and Ulvöspringet for children
additional: You reach Ulvön on the M/F Ulvön or M/F Minerva ferries from Köpmanholmen, or in summer on the Högakustenbåtarna boats from Ullånger, Docksta and Mjällomslandet. Lilla Ulvöruset is for children up to 12.

name: Engelbrektsloppet Trail
description: Engelbrektsloppet Trail is a trail race in Norberg organised by Föreningen Engelbrektsloppet. The course runs on paths through the forests around Karlberg and around Ötjärn, finishing on the main square (Torget) in Norberg. Shortly after the start the race passes Nya Lapphyttan, Europe's oldest known blast furnace from the 12th century, and parts of the old Engelbrektsloppet ski route. The 2026 edition was the second and drew 815 registered runners over distances from 500 m to 22 km.
course_highlights: Passes Nya Lapphyttan, Europe's oldest known blast furnace
Parts of the old Engelbrektsloppet ski route
Finish on the square in Norberg
additional: The 2026 distances were a 500 m kids' race, Lilla Trailen 1.8 km, 5 km, 12 km and 22 km. The organiser has said the race will return next summer.

name: Kil till Skutberget
description: Kil to Skutberget follows the hiking trail between Kil and Skutberget in Karlstad, a distance of approximately 22 kilometres. The trail passes through varied Värmland countryside and goes by Sörmon, Högemon and the Kilsravinerna ravines. A nature-focused race that takes participants from Kil towards the shores of Lake Vänern at Skutberget.
course_highlights: Approximately 22 kilometres between Kil and Skutberget in Karlstad.
The trail passes the natural areas of Sörmon and Högemon.
The route goes through the Kilsravinerna ravines and finishes near Lake Vänern.

name: Jelgavas nakts pusmaratons

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Pusmaratona stafete sastāv no 2 dalībniekiem. Cena ir 20x2 = 40 euro €17,50 - +

description: BTA Jelgava Night Half Marathon is a night half marathon organized by the Baltic Events Association in Jelgava. Participants can compete individually in the half marathon or as a two-person relay team. The event is a popular sporting occasion that brings together runners who want to test their abilities at night in an urban setting.

name: KFC Südasuve Challenge - Pirita 2026
description: KFC Midsummer Challenge is a midsummer sports celebration taking place in Pirita for the third time. This community run offers beautiful views of the sea and the Old Town, with three distances to choose from. Participants can run, walk, or cover the distance with a stroller or walking poles. The start and finish are conveniently located in the same place on the beachfront, and the route follows a seaside pedestrian and cycling path without closing roads to traffic. All finishers will receive KFC gifts, and an event host and mascot will keep the spirits high.

name: Leigo Trail
description: Leigo Trail is a varied trail run in Southern Estonia, held around the Leigo Lakes. The race centre is at Leigo Tourism Farm, and the event offers a choice of distances and difficulty levels, making it suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. The routes follow forest trails, clay and gravel roads, and natural paths along the lakeshore, with technical climbs and descents and beautiful views. The event brings together nature, exercise, and community, offering an enjoyable experience for the whole family.

name: Iigaste metsajooks
description: The Iigaste Forest Run is part of the Rein Leppik Valgamaa running and Nordic walking series, held every summer. This forest run gives participants the chance to enjoy beautiful nature and a sporting challenge on the 7.4 km main course, as well as shorter running and Nordic walking distances. The event takes place in Iigaste village and is suitable for different age groups, with medals and diplomas awarded to the top finishers. Entry is affordable, and registration is conveniently available online.

name: Runmaröloppen 2026

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Mini-Lunken 1.5km 60kr inkl nummerlapp, medalj och en kula glass.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Lunken 5.7km: från 150kr inkl nummerlapp, medalj och finisherdryck.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Halvmarathon 21km: från 350kr inkl nummerlapp, medalj och finisherdryck.

description: Runmaröloppen is a unique running event in the heart of the Stockholm archipelago, on the island of Runmarö. The races offer a friendly, welcoming atmosphere and scenic courses suited to children, seniors and experienced runners alike. The start and finish are at Svängens Krog, and the day includes running, food, ice cream, swimming and a great atmosphere. The half marathon course is approximately 21 km long and is considered one of Sweden’s most beautiful, while Lunken, at 5.7 km, passes through lush sheep pastures and archipelago villages. Mini-Lunken and Antikrundan are shorter races for children and seniors, and there is also a dog category where the dog receives an edible medal.
course_highlights: Half marathon: 21 km around the whole of Runmarö, with historic and scenic views
Lunken: 5.7 km through lush sheep pastures and authentic archipelago villages
Mini-Lunken and Antikrundan: 1.5 km for children and seniors
additional: Mini-Lunken starts at 11:00, and Lunken and the half marathon start at 13:00. There are refreshment stations and encouragement all around the island. After finishing, everyone receives a medal and a finisher drink; Mini and Senior Lunkare are treated to ice cream. There are a maximum of 200 places for the half marathon and 120 for Lunken in the first release, with a further 30 places released later. There is a dedicated taxi boat between Stavsnäs Vinterhamn and Styrsvik, as well as Vaxholm boat line #23. Race bibs can be collected at Svängen and Låttas Bageri. An evening dinner and party will be held at Svängen after the race. 20% of the surplus is donated to Skärgårdsstiftelsen. The event offers children’s races, a 5.7 km race and a 21 km half marathon. Participant numbers are limited. According to the existing event information, 20 percent of the surplus goes to Skärgårdsstiftelsen.
