name: Salomon 27K
location: Ottsjö, Åre Municipality, Jämtland County, Sweden
description: Salomon 27K is a mountain-running event covering 27 kilometres and crossing three mountains, with a beautiful finish in Ottsjö. Many consider it one of Sweden’s most beautiful races, offering a unique mountain experience and pure poetry in nature. Food and drink stations serving locally crafted food are available along the course, and a safety team can provide rapid assistance if needed. Participants can also take a bus transfer to the start and back after the finish.
course_highlights: 27 kilometres of mountain running across three mountains
Beautiful finish in Ottsjö
Food and drink stations serving locally crafted food
additional: Bus transfers to the start are available from Ottsjö, Trillevallen and Undersåker, as well as a return transfer after the finish. Electronic chip timing. A kåsa drinking cup is used at cup-free drink stations. A safety team is on hand to respond quickly to accidents. Entries can be transferred for a fee of 250 SEK. A large portion of the entry fee goes towards upgrading the Fjällmaraton trails for sustainable development. The race is part of Fjällmaratonveckan.

name: Pajūrio basatlonas
description: Pajūrio Basatlonas is a unique barefoot run on the seaside sand, held in Smiltynė, Klaipėda. The event takes place during the Sea Festival and gives participants an unforgettable experience of running between the sea and the dunes. The race promotes running culture in Lithuania and encourages a healthy lifestyle. Participants can choose from several distances and enjoy the beautiful coastal scenery and gentle breeze.
course_highlights: Barefoot running on seaside sand
Start on the beach by the southern pier, Kopgalis, Smiltynė
Distances of 500 m, 2.5 km, 5 km and 10 km, with a 2-hour time limit
additional: A 2-hour time limit applies to all distances. Participants must have an identity document, a race number attached, and an electronic timing chip attached to their shirt. Participants run voluntarily and assume all risks associated with taking part. Barefoot running on seaside sand, various distances (500 m, 2.5 km, 5 km, 10 km), online registration, regulations and rules, awards and commemorative medals.

name: Peak Performance Vertical K
description: Åre Vertical K is a prestigious vertical race held annually on Tuesday evening as part of Kia Fjällmaraton Årefjällen. The race starts with a mass start at Åre Torg and finishes at the summit of Åreskutan, gaining exactly 1,000 vertical metres. It is a demanding race, and participants can expect to give their all from start to finish. The course records to beat are 46:24 for women and 39:13 for men. Prize money is awarded to the top three finishers in both the women’s and men’s categories.
course_highlights: Mass start at Åre Torg
Finish at the summit of Åreskutan
Exactly 1,000 vertical metres
additional: Food and drink stations along the course featuring local food products. A kåsa is used for serving drinks at cup-free hydration stations. Bus transfers to the start from Ottsjö, Trillevallen and Undersåker, and bus transfers back after the finish. Electronic chip timing. Safety team for rapid response in the event of accidents. Entry can be transferred for a fee of SEK 250. Insurance is recommended to cover refunds in the event of illness or injury. Prizes are awarded to the top three women and men. The course records are held by Emmie Collinge in 46:24 and Kilian Jornet in 39:13.

name: 10. ETAPP
description: TV 10 Olympic Start is a competition series organized by the Estonian Athletics Association for schoolchildren and young athletes. Competitions take place in different age groups and cover a range of athletics events. The 10th stage will be held at Tamme Stadium in Tartu, giving young athletes the opportunity to test their skills and gain experience. The series aims to support young people’s athletic development and provide a fun and motivating competitive environment.

name: Fjällmaraton 100k
location: Fångåmon, Åre Municipality, Jämtland County, Sweden
description: Fjällmaraton 100K is a classic mountain marathon that starts at dawn in Fångåmon and follows a beautiful, winding, easy-to-run trail to Vålådalen via Nulltjärn. The race then joins the classic Fjällmaraton course over Ottfjället, before continuing over Hållfjället, Grofjället and Välliste on the way back to Ottsjö. The race offers a unique atmosphere, with a recovery zone in the finish area where participants can relax in the sauna and recover with non-alcoholic beer. All participants must be self-sufficient during the race, with opportunities to refill water at official aid stations along the course.
course_highlights: Dawn start in Fångåmon
Beautiful, easy-to-run trail via Nulltjärn and Vålådalen
Crossing Ottfjället, Hållfjället, Grofjället and Välliste
additional: Food and drink stations along the course serve locally made food. The official drink is U Sport by Umara (lemon). Participants receive a Fold-a-Cup to use at the drink stations. Bus transfers to the start are available from Ottsjö, Trillevallen and Undersåker, with return transfers after the finish. Entries can be transferred for a fee of 250 SEK. A safety team is on hand to provide quick assistance in the event of serious injuries. Participants are responsible for their own hydration and energy between the official drink stations.

name: Ottsjö 8k
description: Ottsjö 8K is a shorter mountain race during the Fjällmaraton week, starting and finishing at the Kia Fjällmaraton centre in Ottsjö. The course follows a not too technical path and trail of just over 7 km with about 150 m of total climb, and in 2026 the race was run as Vivobarefoot 7K. It takes place on the Thursday evening, the same day as Fjällmaraton 100K, with a festival atmosphere in the finish area. All prizes are drawn among the runners who finish.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Kia Fjällmaraton centre in Ottsjö
Just over 7 km of path and trail with about 150 m of climb
Prizes worth over SEK 100,000 drawn among finishers
additional: In 2026 the start was in two groups, at 18:00 and 18:10. Sauna, cold bath and food were available in the finish area during the day.

name: Izskrien Rīgu 4. posms – Lucavsala
description: Izskrien Rīgu Stage 4 is part of a popular running series held in Riga’s parks and neighborhoods, designed for the whole family. This stage will take place on Lucavsala, giving participants the chance to enjoy running in a beautiful, green urban setting. The series is known for its friendly atmosphere and for welcoming both professional and amateur runners. At the end of the event, the fastest runners and the season’s overall leaders are traditionally honored.
course_highlights: Run through Lucavsala Park and the surrounding area
Green, flat terrain suitable for runners of all levels
Friendly atmosphere and the chance for the whole family to compete
additional: A concert and party are traditionally held at the end of the event, adding to the sporting experience. Participants can check in until noon on race day. The series brings together around two thousand participants at each stage.

name: Vormsi maraton
description: Vormsi Marathons VIII is a two-day running event on Vormsi Island, taking place on July 31 and August 1 near Sviby Harbour. Participants can choose the marathon or half-marathon distance on both days, with the courses running mainly on paved roads on Vormsi Island. The courses are marked, and timing is provided using electronic SI sticks. After the run, participants can join a social gathering and enjoy a sauna and hot soup at the finish. The event is small and friendly, suitable for both experienced runners and recreational runners.

name: 28. Holstre-Paistu maanteejooks Hanno Priksi mälestuseks
description: Holstre-Paistu Road Race is the fourth stage of Viljandi Municipality’s running series and takes place in Paistu. The race is intended for runners of all abilities and offers young people and adults alike the opportunity to take part. Participation in the series motivates runners to complete all four stages, and active participants are rewarded. The course runs through the scenic Viljandi County, offering an enjoyable running experience.
course_highlights: Road race in the Paistu area
Participation opportunities in different age groups
Participants are motivated by awards in the running series

name: Mapri Ehitus x Öövägilane
description: Mapri Ehitus x Öövägilane is an obstacle course race held on the Lähte health trails. It is a varied and challenging run where participants climb, crawl, lift and are dragged through mud, water, sand and over hills. The event is suitable for both beginners and experienced obstacle racers, offering an exciting and fun experience. The series aims to offer a multi-day competition where each stage has its own character, with an emphasis on both fun and physical challenge.

name: Mapri Ehitus x Vägilase jooks Lähte
description: Mapri Ehitus x Vägilase jooks Lähte is an obstacle race held on the Lähte health trails and at the outdoor gym. The courses are 4 km and 8 km long and offer participants a serious challenge, with a variety of obstacles testing both strength and agility. Vägilase jooks is Estonia’s most versatile obstacle race series event, suitable for both beginners and experienced obstacle racers. The event is part of a series focused on terrain, obstacles and an adventurous experience.

name: Ottsjö 12k
location: Ottsjö, Åre Municipality, Jämtland County, Sweden

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Barn i åldern 10 -13 får springa tillsammans med förälder eller annan vuxen och endast betalar 200kr

description: Ottsjö 12K is a 12-kilometer mountain trail race with 300 meters of elevation gain. It offers a beautiful and memorable course without being as demanding as the longer distances during Fjällmaraton Week. The race is a perfect first step for runners who want to challenge themselves in a mountain setting and perhaps later try Salomon 27K or Kia Fjällmaraton. Children aged 10 to 13 can run with an adult at a reduced price, and youths aged 14 to 18 receive half off the entry fee. The race is organized with a focus on sustainability and safety, with food and drink stations along the course and bus transfers to the start and back from the finish.
course_highlights: 12 km of mountain trail with 300 meters of elevation gain
Beautiful and memorable course in a mountain setting
Food and drink stations featuring locally made food along the course
additional: Bus transfers to the start from Ottsjö, Trillevallen and Undersåker, and return bus transfers after finishing. Electronic chip timing. Safety organization for a rapid response in case of accidents. A kåsa (traditional drinking cup) is used at cup-free drink stations. Children aged 10–13 can run with an adult. Half price for youths aged 14–18. The standard minimum age is 14. Children aged 10–13 can participate with an adult for 200 kr, and participants aged 14–18 pay half the entry fee. The adult must stay in contact with the accompanying child throughout the race.

name: Bruksleden Terrängmaraton

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Sista dag för ordinarie anmälan är fredagen den 17 juli.

description: Bruksleden Trail Marathon is a trail race organised by Fagersta OK, offering two distances: 42 km (Helan) and 21 km (Halvan). The race follows the beautiful Bruksleden Trail through forests, winding paths and past lakes, across varied and technically demanding terrain. With a limited number of 200 places, the event has a friendly, welcoming atmosphere. Along the course, staffed checkpoints offer refreshments, and after the finish there are showers and a light meal. This is a perfect race for experienced trail runners and curious recreational runners alike who want to enjoy nature and a challenge.
course_highlights: Run through beautiful forests and along winding forest trails
Pass sparkling lakes
Varied and technically demanding terrain with steep climbs and descents
additional: Places are limited to 200 to preserve a friendly atmosphere. Previous editions have started and finished in the area around Fageråsen/Fagersta.

name: Blidöloppen 2026
description: Blidöloppet is a fun run for children and adults that Blidö IF has organised since 1999. The races run over varied terrain around Blidö IP, Björkudden, Granö, Söderäng, Fällgate and Bromskärsvägen, starting and finishing at Blidö IP. Adults choose between 5 and 9 km cross-country in women's and men's classes, and there is also a 2.5 km race and an 800 m children's race. The clubhouse café is open during the day.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Blidö IP
Varied terrain around Björkudden, Granö and Söderäng
800 m race for the youngest children
additional: Registration and payment are made through Raceid.com and there is no late registration on site. In 2026 runners gathered at 10:30 and the first start was at 11:00. Those who just want some exercise can walk one of two walking loops from the clubhouse.

name: „Biržų kilometrų“ bėgimas
description: The “Biržų kilometrai” run is a traditional event held during the Biržai City Festival. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively, meet like-minded people, and enjoy running in the beautiful surroundings of the city. The event welcomes participants of all ages and promotes a healthy lifestyle and community spirit.
course_highlights: The run takes place in Biržai.
The event is held during the city festival.
The run is included in the Lithuanian Running Cup series.

name: Bodøryggen 2027
description: Bodøryggen is a spectacular mountain race in a national park, with two distances offering runners a unique experience and views of the Lofoten Wall, Landegode, Børvasstindan and Bodø city. The race is limited to 400 participants to preserve the quality of the experience. The start and finish are at The Wood Hotel on Rønvikfjellet, and the course crosses varied terrain from mountain to mountain. Participants receive a medal, food at the finish, spa access and transport to the start for half-marathon runners. This race is part of Bodø Run Festival, organised by Arctic Sport with a focus on authentic Arctic experiences and inclusive running events.
course_highlights: The 49 km ultradistance starts and finishes at The Wood Hotel and passes via Keiservarden, Junkerfjellet and several other mountain peaks
The 22 km half-marathon starts at Heia and finishes at The Wood Hotel, sharing part of the ultra course
Views of the Lofoten Wall, Landegode, Børvasstindan and Bodø city during the race
additional: Race bib collection is at Sport 1 Stormyra on Friday 30 July from 16:00 to 18:00 and at the start on race day. The spa on the 8th floor of Wood Hotel is open to participants after they finish. A long-sleeved wind jacket is mandatory. Transport to the start for the 22 km distance is available from Wood Hotel at 09:30, with limited places. There are water stations only on the 49 km distance; 22 km runners must bring their own drinks. Small snack stations with jellymen and fruit chews are available on both distances.

name: Altamila (NNM 10km gateløp)
description: Altamila is an annual running event held in Alta in early August. The event offers three main distances: a 5 km recreational jog without timing, the 10 km Advanti Altamila, and the Sport 1 Alta Half Marathon. The courses are known as some of the easiest and fastest in Norway, offering good opportunities for personal records. The start and finish are at the athletics track in Alta Idrettspark, and the event also includes a children’s race.
course_highlights: The Advanti Altamila 10 km is a very flat and fast course, officially measured by the Norwegian Athletics Association.
The Sport1 Alta Half Marathon consists of two laps of the Altamila course, plus an extra lap around the athletics track.
The 5 km recreational jog follows the same course, with a turnaround after 2.5 km.
additional: Race numbers can be collected on Friday between 12 and 19, or on race day from 12 to 16. There is a water station approximately 2.5 km from the start, and several in the finish area. All finishers receive a medal and have the chance to win draw prizes. The awards ceremony includes trophies for class winners and cash prizes for the fastest times and course records. Changing rooms and showers are available at Finnmarkshallen. Parking is available near the start area.

name: Vääna-Jõesuu jooks
description: The Vääna-Jõesuu Run is part of the Harku Municipality Running Series and takes place at the Vääna-Jõesuu School stadium. The event offers several distances, from children’s races to the 5 km main race, which runs counterclockwise along the streets of Vääna-Jõesuu and a forest trail. The series aims to motivate people to take part in sports and to promote the enjoyment of exercise and an active lifestyle. The event is organized by local running and triathlon clubs in cooperation with the municipality and village associations.

name: Skärgårdsloppet
description: Skärgårdsloppet in Holmsund is a pleasant 7.4 km fun run through a beautiful archipelago setting. It is a Fun Run, meaning it is a recreational race with no official results list, except for the five fastest men and women. The start and finish are at Bräntebacken, and the course goes one lap around Lövöudden. All participants receive a medal, and the fastest man and woman receive a winner’s trophy.
course_highlights: 7.4 km course in an archipelago setting
Start and finish at Bräntebacken
One lap around Lövöudden
additional: The race is a Fun Run with no official timing for most participants, but times are recorded for the five fastest men and women. No times are recorded in the children’s race, and everyone is a winner. All participants receive the Skärgårdsloppet medal. The main race is a Fun Run, with most participants keeping their own time. The children’s race is untimed.

name: Sörörundan
description: Sörörundan is an annual summer event in Gullspång, organized by Gullspångs IF. Choose to run 5, 10 or 15 kilometers, or walk together with friends. You are warmly welcome to a relaxed activity for different levels.
course_highlights: Three distances: 5, 10 and 15 km
Walking is also an option
Start at Gullmovallen
additional: According to local reports, the race has been held on the first Wednesday in August. The 2027 date is Wednesday, August 4.

name: ÜLEMISTE Ööjooks - Tallinn 2026
description: ÜLEMISTE Night Run - Tallinn 2026 is a running and walking event taking place in the Ülemiste district of Tallinn. The event offers an opportunity to get active and support well-being and health. It is part of a wider initiative to promote recreational physical activity in Estonia, organised by the Centre of Competence for Recreational Physical Activity. Participants can enjoy being active in an urban environment and support their mental and physical health.
course_highlights: Running and walking in the Ülemiste district of Tallinn
A great opportunity to get active and support your health
Organised by the Centre of Competence for Recreational Physical Activity
additional: Participation involves running and walking; registration is open

name: Gauja Trail by UTMB
distance_verbose: 91 km, 53 km, Pusmaratons, 13.5 km, 13 km, 12 km, 6 km, 1.6 km
description: Gauja Trail by UTMB offers a beautiful trail run through the Gauja Valley, combining forest trails, hills, and scenic riverbanks. The 100 km course starts at Sigulda New Castle and passes through Līgatne and Cēsis, offering a unique opportunity to enjoy the nature and scenery of Gauja National Park. Runners should take note of the mandatory equipment required to ensure safety in varying weather conditions. The event takes place in August 2027 and is part of the UTMB World Series.
course_highlights: Beautiful forest trails and hilly terrain in the Gauja Valley
The course includes the Sigulda bobsleigh track and the sandstone cliffs of Līgatne
Finish at Rožu Square in Cēsis
additional: Participants must bring the mandatory equipment required to ensure safety in varying weather conditions, including the possibility of spending the night outdoors on the course. In hot weather, organizers may require additional fluids, a hat, and sunglasses. Registration is personal and cannot be transferred to another person or to the following year. After finishing the 100 K and 50 K distances, participants are provided with a meal and baggage transport.

name: Meråker Mountain Challenge
distance_verbose: 100 miles, 100 km, 70 km, 50 km, 20 km, 8 km, 2 km
description: Meråker Mountain Challenge is a demanding ultramarathon offering distances from 2 km to 161 km, including a spectacular 100-mile loop around Meråker Municipality. The courses feature varied terrain with mountains, forests, marshland and several peaks over 1,000 metres, and are suitable for both experienced ultrarunners and recreational runners. The event has a long tradition and also includes the Norwegian Championships in trail ultrarunning. The start and finish are at Teveltunet, and the race places a strong emphasis on safety, good logistics and runner support along the way.
course_highlights: The course crosses varied terrain with mountains, forests and marshland
The 70 km distance passes nine peaks over 1,000 metres in Meråker Municipality
The 100-mile loop goes around the entire municipality and features spectacular mountain sections
additional: All races start on Saturday, 1 August, except the 100 km and 100-mile races, which start on Friday evening. Race bibs are collected primarily at Teveltunet, and transport to and from the start is available by free bus with advance registration. Personal support is permitted on the 100K and 100M distances. Drinking water sources are not publicly monitored, and using a water filter is recommended. The event has offered several distances, including 8 km, 20 km, 50 km, 70 km, 100 km and 100 miles. On the 100-mile course, one drop bag may be handed in before the start and collected at Nøstmo after approximately 93 km.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 20. Tapa linnajooks
description: Lääne-Virumaa Running Series is a traditional running and walking series offering a variety of events for different age groups and ability levels. The stages take place in different locations across Lääne-Virumaa, giving runners the chance to enjoy both city and trail running. The 20th Tapa City Run takes place near Tapa Gymnasium and is part of the series’ long-standing tradition of bringing together recreational athletes and running enthusiasts. The series aims to motivate people to stay active and provide enjoyable running experiences.

name: Paldiski liigub
description: Paldiski Moves is the third stage of the West-Harju Movement Series, held at Paldiski Sports Centre. The course passes Paldiski’s main attractions, streets and shared-use paths, offering participants beautiful natural views and a historic atmosphere. Free children’s races are organised for the younger members of the family, with an emphasis on the joy of movement and lifelong physical activity. The event takes place as part of Paldiski City Day, when the series’ top performers are awarded, and the evening ends with a concert.

name: Kia Fjällmaraton 45 km
description: Kia Fjällmaraton 45K is a demanding mountain marathon across classic mountain terrain, held during Fjällmaraton Week in the Åre area. The race dates back to 2005, and for 2026 the course is planned to cross Ottfjället along the event’s signature trail. The race welcomes both experienced mountain runners and curious beginners looking for an unusual and scenic challenge. To earn the well-known wooden medal, you must finish within the “medal time” (the winner’s time + 30%); all participants must be self-sufficient on the course.
course_highlights: The course crosses Ottfjället over classic mountain terrain
Food and hydration stations at Edsåsdalen (12 km, 25 km), Tobaksdalen (35.5 km), and Hållvallen (40 km)
Finish in Ottsjö, with a shared post-race lunch for all finishers
additional: Participants must be self-sufficient on the course; the official hydration product at the stations is Umara (2:1 lemon, 120 g/l). Water and toilets are available at the start in Trillevallen. Support along the course is not permitted except at the official stations. In addition to drinks, the stations offer bars, bananas, buns, and, at later stations, hot dogs, coffee, and broth. The race is approximately 45 km long with around 1,200 metres of elevation gain (according to a race report). Participants are self-sufficient between aid stations; official food and hydration are available at Edsåsdalen, Tobaksdalen, and Hållvallen. Kia offers Fjälltransfer, with free transfers between the finish and the parking area, as well as a bus between the finish and Undersåker/Åre. Accommodation in Åre near Kia Fjällmaraton includes, among other options, Hotel Åre Fjällsätra.

name: Stora Stöten Run
description: Stora Stöten Run is a trail race in the heart of the Falun Mine World Heritage Site, offering a historic and varied running experience. The course passes medieval smelting sites, mining farmsteads, dams and dam houses, following old routes known as Vattnets Väg till Gruvan (The Water’s Way to the Mine). The race has three distances (21.6 km, 13.6 km and 5.6 km) and welcomes both competitive runners and recreational participants, with the option to run timed or untimed. The event is organised by the orienteering club OK Kåre, which welcomes participants to the start and finish at Falun Mine.
course_highlights: Three courses: 21.6 km, 13.6 km and 5.6 km, starting and finishing at Falun Mine
The course passes medieval smelting sites, mining farmsteads, dams and dam houses along Vattnets Väg
Varied terrain: gravel, grass, trail tracks, nature paths and short paved sections; an initial climb and clearly marked downhill sections
additional: Start and finish at Falun Mine; warm-up begins at 12:10 on Falu Rödfärg’s paved area (approximately 7 minutes), led by Friskis & Svettis; all courses start at the same time, and runners are divided into two optional groups based on target pace (group 1: women ≤6 min/km, men ≤5 min/km). Runners can choose to run with or without timing; prizes go to the first three finishers on each course, with raffle prizes for other participants; teams can be registered (teams of 3), and registrations can be transferred free of charge through the registration system. The race information mentions aid stations/water stops, parking, race office, showers/changing facilities and course markings. All three courses start and finish at Falun Mine; results from previous years are available.

name: Ölands Marathon
description: Öland Marathon is a flat, easy-to-run marathon starting and finishing in the square in Löttorp. The course consists of a 2.1 km loop in Löttorp, followed by an 11.2 km loop run three times, for a total distance of 42,195 metres, entirely on asphalt. During the race, runners have views of Blå Jungfrun and pass three aid stations per lap offering sports drink, cola and water. All finishers receive a unique medal made of Öland limestone, and the women’s and men’s winners each win dinner for two at Kalk in Löttorp.
course_highlights: Flat, easy-to-run course
100% asphalt
Three aid stations per lap offering sports drink, cola and water
additional: Bib numbers can be collected from 12:00 on race day. Personal energy supplies must be handed in at least one hour before the start. Accommodation is available in four-bed cabins at Högby IP. Prizes are awarded to all age-group winners and the top overall finishers.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://olandrunning.se/lopp/olands-marathon/): 2027-08-07 — "Tid & datum 07 augusti 2027 Start kl 14:00" (was estimated 2027-08-07)

name: Svartåloppet
location: Svartå Folkets hus, Svartå, Degerfors Municipality, Örebro County, Sweden
description: Svartåloppet is a recreational race held on the second Saturday in August, starting and finishing at Svartå Folkets hus. The race offers three distances: 2.5 km on flat roads, and 5.5 km and 14 km on hilly forest roads and trails. Timing is handled by Racetimer, providing a modern and reliable system. The race is open to all ages and has a long tradition in Svartå dating back to the 20th century.
course_highlights: The 5.5 km and 14 km courses are hilly forest routes on forest roads and trails
The 2.5 km course is a flatter route on roads
Start and finish at Svartå Folkets hus
additional: Timing is handled by Racetimer, providing a modern and reliable timing system. Svartå IF is the organizer and has its own facilities, including floodlit trails and a clubhouse at Hyttvallen. Results from several past years are available via Racetimer. Timing is handled by Racetimer.

name: Nätra Fjällskogslopp
location: Hinnsjöstugan, Nätra fjällskog, Örnsköldsvik Municipality, Sweden
description: Nätra Fjällskogslopp is a trail race organised by Nätra GIF youth since 2021. It has quickly become popular and sold out. The race offers four distances: 22 km, 15 km, 9 km and a 2 km children’s race, all through the beautiful and challenging terrain of Nätra Fjällskog. The courses follow trails and forest roads, cross bogs on boardwalks, and offer wonderful nature experiences with views of Hinnsjön and the coastal landscape. The start and finish are at Hinnsjöstugan, and the organisers ask participants to respect the nature reserves along the course.
course_highlights: Beautiful terrain with trails, forest roads and boardwalks across bogs
Climbs up Selshöjden and Västanåhöjden, with views of the coast and Ulvön
A downhill stretch with enchanting views over Hinnsjön
additional: Start times: 22 km at 9:30, 15 km at 9:45, 9 km at 10:00 and 2 km at 10:10. Bibs must be collected by 9:00. A clothes drop-off is available at Hinnsjöstugan. Recommended equipment includes a mobile phone, water/energy supplies and a map of the course. Parking is along the road past Hinnsjöstugan, a short walk from the start. Participants are asked to choose their starting position according to their ability, with those aiming to race at the front. The courses are marked with ribbons in different colours for each distance. Clear course markings and participant support.

name: Häv och Gräv Vikbovändan 2026
location: Vikbolandet, Norrköping Municipality, Östergötland County, Sweden

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: vuxen 490 kr (fram till den 30/6, sedan kostar loppet 540 kr)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: vuxen 490 kr (fram till den 30/6, sedan kostar loppet 540 kr)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: duoklass: 980 kr per par (fram till den 30/6, sedan kostar duolopp 1080 kr)

description: Häv & Gräv Vikbovändan is a recreational race held on Vikbolandet in Östergötland during the summer. The main event is approximately 45 km long and features a scenic route with both gravel and asphalt sections. Along the way, participants can enjoy local delicacies at several aid stations. The event offers running, cycling and duo categories, as well as a children's race in the forest on illuminated trails. It is a welcoming, nature-oriented experience focused on community and local flavours.
course_highlights: Approximately 45 km, with a 50/50 mix of gravel and asphalt
Aid stations with locally produced delicacies and the opportunity to visit production facilities and a shop
Children's race in the forest on illuminated trails, with a medal and ice cream afterwards
additional: Start times: Children's race 10:30, Running + duo 11:30, Cycling 12:30. The children's race is free and does not require advance registration. Helmets are mandatory for cycling. All participants who register in advance receive a collapsible cup to use at the aid stations to avoid disposable cups. On-site registration may be available if places remain, up until 30 minutes before the start. Participants who register in advance receive a collapsible cup, which they should bring along during the race to reduce the use of disposable cups.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://vikbovandan.se/): 2027-08-07 — "7 augusti 2027" (was estimated 2027-08-07)

name: Kivijärviloppet
location: Kivijärvi, Övertorneå Municipality, Norrbotten County, Sweden
description: Kivijärviloppet is a traditional cross-country race organized by Kivijärvi IF since 1970. The race is held in the village of Kivijärvi in Tornedalen and offers several distances, with a 12 km main event open to both women and men, with no age categories. The race is known for its long history, beautiful courses and generous prize table, thanks to its sponsors. Many well-known athletes have taken part over the years, giving the race strong local and national standing.
course_highlights: Cross-country race with several distances: 0.5 km, 1.5 km, 5 km, 7.5 km and 12 km
Course markers in different colors for each distance: yellow, white, blue and red
The race has used the same courses since it began in 1970, except during Covid
additional: Courses are marked with colors for different distances: 0.5 km and 1.5 km (yellow), 5 km (white), 7.5 km (blue), 12 km (red). The race offers a generous prize table for children, adults and recreational runners, thanks to generous sponsors. Kivijärvi is about 15 kilometers south of Korpilombolo along the Övertorneå road. Information on the official website applies to 2026 and does not confirm the date of August 7, 2027.

name: Augustiloppet
description: Augustiloppet is part of Augustifesten in Smedjebacken, a week filled with fun and exciting activities for the whole family. The race is held in conjunction with the festival and offers an enjoyable running experience in a welcoming atmosphere. It is a traditional summer event that brings together both recreational and competitive runners. The event welcomes all ages and levels.
course_highlights: Children’s race of approximately 700 metres
5 km recreational class
10 km competitive class
additional: Previous editions have started and finished in the square in Smedjebacken. In a previous edition, the children’s race was free.

name: Storå 6 timmars och 3 timmars
description: Storå 6-hour is a challenging ultra race organised by Storådalens SK at Hagabacken School in Guldsmedshyttan. The race offers two distances, 6 hours and 3 hours, with participants running on a 2,130-metre course with approximately 50 metres of elevation gain per lap. Sports drink and energy products are served at the lap point, and hot dogs in buns are available halfway through. All participants receive a T-shirt after finishing, and prizes are awarded to the top three in each category. Results are published live on race day at hug-timing.se.
course_highlights: Laps of 2,130 metres with approximately 50 metres of elevation gain
After 20 laps, runners pass the marathon distance with a total of 1,000 metres of elevation gain
During the final 30 minutes, runners complete a shorter lap
additional: The start, lap point and race centre are at Hagabacken School, which has showers, toilets, services and medical care. Parking for the 6-hour race is on the gravel football pitch behind the school. For the 3-hour race, parking is available at Guldsmedshyttebruk, 500 metres away, or at the start. Timing is done with an ankle chip, which must be returned after the race. Umara sports drink and other products are served at the lap point. All runners receive a T-shirt after completing the race. Prizes are awarded to the top three in each category. The race has been cancelled due to too few participants. The planned start times were 11:00 for the 6-hour race and 14:00 for the 3-hour race. Timing was to be done with a chip.

name: Fjällmaraton Sälen by EQPE
description:
Fjällmaraton Sälen by EQPE is the trail-running adventure for anyone looking to combine the joy of running, a challenge and spectacular scenery. Choose between 42 km, 21 km or 10 km—and bring the whole family! Children up to 12 years old can run for free in Barnens Fjällmaraton.
The course takes you over rugged mountain trails, boardwalks and winding paths all the way to the finish and the lively After Run party at Experiumtorget in Lindvallen. Fjällmaraton Sälen is a deluxe running experience. Secure your place and experience the mountains with us!

images.alt_text: Två löpare springer på fjällstig i höstlandskap under Fjällmaraton Sälen by EQPE.
Löpare på fjällstig med vidsträckt utsikt över berg och himmel
Löpare på träspång i fjällandskap under Fjällmaraton Sälen tävling
Löpare i fjällterräng under en terränglöpning med färgglada markeringar och skyltar.

name: VI Ilgų nuotolių bėgiko Piotro Silkino jubiliejinis 85-mečio bėgimas
location: Kretingos Vasaros estrada, Maironio g. 15, Kretinga, Lithuania
description: The 85th-birthday run of long-distance runner Piotr Silkin is a traditional race held at Kretinga Summer Amphitheatre. The competition follows a lap format, with marathon participants completing one 2.2 km lap and twelve 3.3 km laps. The event celebrates longtime runner Piotr Silkin and attracts running enthusiasts from various places. Participants can enjoy both athletic competition and a welcoming community atmosphere.
course_highlights: The marathon course consists of 1 lap of 2.2 km and 12 laps of 3.3 km each
The competition takes place at Kretinga Summer Amphitheatre
The lap format lets spectators follow the race and support the participants
additional: Various distances and age groups will be offered at the event; results will be published, and registration is online.

name: Kohila pikamaajooksude sari 2026 VI etapp 1000m
description: The Kohila Long-Distance Running Series 2026, Stage VI (1000 m), takes place at the Kohila Sports Centre stadium and is open to everyone interested in running. The series includes different distances and age groups, with participants earning points and winners determined by age group. The entry fee is €8, or €5 for young people and pensioners. Registration is primarily available in advance, and on-site registration is possible until 18:30. The series winners will be awarded after the final race. To place among the prize winners, participants must take part in at least four stages.

name: Filter Temposari (5. etapp)
description: Filter Temposari is Estonia’s oldest and most prestigious time-trial series, offering the chance to test yourself in cycling, running or roller skating. The stages take place at various locations in Tallinn and the surrounding area, featuring individual-start speed races. The races are short and intense, suitable for both recreational and advanced participants. The series also includes the Kullapada prize programme, which rewards consistent participation in every stage over the same distance.

name: 14. ETAPP / Järve terviserada
description: 14th STAGE / The Järve health trail is a 10-stage relay race around Lake Viljandi, held on varied terrain and a health trail with different surface types. Teams consist of 10 members, with an equal number of women and men, who take turns running the different stages. The start and finish are at Viljandi City Stadium, and runners are taken to the stages on buses provided by the organizers. The race is part of the tradition of the Suurjooks ümber Viljandi järve and offers a sporting experience for schools, companies, and sports clubs.

name: BAMM
description: BAMM supported by OMM is a two-day ultramarathon in an Arctic mountain environment, where participants compete in pairs using mountain navigation across vast areas of unmarked terrain. The event offers several classes with different levels of difficulty and distances, making it accessible to both beginners and experienced adventurers. During the competition, participants experience spectacular mountain scenery and challenging navigation, with an overnight stay in the mountains. BAMM is a unique opportunity to combine physical challenge with a nature experience in one of Sweden’s most scenic environments.
course_highlights: Mountain navigation across unmarked terrain
Two-day competition with an overnight stay in the mountains
Arctic mountain environment with vast areas to navigate
additional: Participants compete in pairs (men’s, women’s or mixed teams). Transfers are available from Kiruna Airport to Hotell Riksgränsen and back, with times adapted to flight departures. Riksgränsen railway station is close to the hotel. Accommodation, equipment rental, food and practical information are available via the organiser’s website. The competition is held in teams of two. Mandatory equipment is part of the preparations; for BAMM 30, tents and sleeping bags are transported to the shared overnight camp. OMM is the main sponsor.

name: Park Till Park Loppet 2026
description: Park till Park-loppet is a city race in Nyköping starting and finishing at Nicolaiskolan. The course follows the Nyköping river and finishes with a run from the town hall down Storgatan. A children's race goes first, followed by a 5 km race, and runners, joggers, walkers and wheelers are all welcome. Participants in costume can compete for a best costume prize, and everyone gets a medal.
course_highlights: The course follows the Nyköping river
Final stretch from the town hall down Storgatan
Best costume prize for children and adults
additional: In 2026 the children's race started at 16:30 and the 5 km at 17:30. If places remain, late entry is possible on site or online until 16:00 on race day. Prizes go to the top three in the 5 km, and a bike is drawn among the children's race participants.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 27. Viru-Nigula Rahvajooks
description: The Lääne-Virumaa Running Series 2026 offers a varied series of running and walking events, bringing together fitness enthusiasts and recreational athletes from spring to autumn. The 27th Viru-Nigula People’s Run takes place on the Viru-Nigula running track and in the long-jump pit. It is part of a long-running series that encourages participation across different age groups and distances. The series aims to promote healthy lifestyles and offer participants the chance to test their abilities. The events are well organized, with chip timing, ensuring participants an enjoyable and motivating running experience.

name: Tavelsjö Halvmarathon
location: Tavelsjö Church, Tavelsjö, Umeå Municipality, Sweden
description: Tavelsjö Half Marathon is a family-friendly running event offering races for both adults and children. The half marathon starts and finishes at Tavelsjö Church and is a popular summer training goal. For children, there is a Mini race and a timed youth race, making the event a celebration for the whole family. All participants receive a medal and a treat after crossing the finish line, and there are also prize draws.
course_highlights: Half marathon starting and finishing at Tavelsjö Church
Timed 2.2 km youth race
Children’s Mini race, popular with the whole family
additional: The youth race starts at 10:00 and is open to young people aged 8–17. Parents are welcome to help children who need support during the youth race. Gift certificates are available to buy as gifts and are delivered within one week of ordering.

name: Midnattsloppet Stockholm
description: Midnattsloppet Stockholm is a classic night race held on 14 August 2027, with an evening start. The race offers 10 km and 5 km distances, taking participants through the lively streets of Södermalm in a festive atmosphere filled with music, cheers and camaraderie. In addition to the main races, there is also a costume category and children’s races, making the event a festival for all ages. Midnattsloppet is known for its uniquely late start time and the special atmosphere created among runners, spectators and race staff.
course_highlights: The original course around Södermalm in Stockholm
An evening start with a unique night-race atmosphere
A festive atmosphere with music and cheers from spectators along the course
additional: Start times vary by race: the Mini Race (300 m) starts between 11:45 and 15:30, the 2 km children’s races start at 18:30 and 18:50, the 10 km starts at 21:10, the 5 km starts at 21:40, and the costume category starts at 22:00. Corporate races and team competitions are offered to strengthen camaraderie and workplace health. Midnattsloppet is organised by Midnattsloppet Nordic AB, a wholly owned company of Hammarby IF Friidrott, and the surplus goes back to the sports clubs.

name: 6 sjöar
description: 6 Lakes is a race through the beautiful forests just outside Uppsala. You’ll run mainly on small forest roads, with shorter sections of trail. All distances loop around at least one lake, while the full marathon takes you around 6 lakes. With the environment in mind, we provide free bus transport for runners from Uppsala Central Station to the start in Fjällnora, and back after the race. The race is also free of disposable cups; instead, every runner receives a reusable cup.

name: ÅRC x Copperhill loop!
description:
Welcome to our exciting Åre Run Club x Copperhill loop!

On August 14, runners of all levels will gather to conquer the Copperhill hill. You can choose your own distance—5, 10, 15 or 20 km—and decide for yourself how many laps you want to do before crossing the finish line! We believe everyone should be able to take part and enjoy this amazing experience together. Join us for an unforgettable running celebration, whether you’re a beginner or an experienced runner. Let’s create magical running memories together!

images.alt_text: Löpare i regn under Åre Run Club x Copperhill loop-loppet vid startlinjen

name: Kuldīgas 22. pusmaratons
description: The Kuldīga Half Marathon is a traditional running event in Kuldīga Municipality, bringing together local and visiting runners. The race takes place amid the scenic surroundings of the town and its nearby area, offering a chance to enjoy both a sporting challenge and beautiful natural views. The event is organized by Kuldīga Municipality Sports School, ensuring professional race management and a friendly atmosphere for all participants.

name: Kazdangas pils maratons
description: The Kazdanga Trail Marathon is an annual trail running and Nordic walking event held at the Dzirnezers recreation area in Kazdanga. The event offers marathon and half-marathon distances for both runners and Nordic walkers, giving participants the chance to experience a scenic and challenging trail route. Starts are in the morning, allowing participants to enjoy the natural scenery and sporting atmosphere of South Kurzeme Municipality. The event is suitable for athletes of various levels and fans of active recreation.
course_highlights: 42.195 km marathon and 21.097 km half-marathon distances
The recreation area by Dzirnezers serves as the start and finish venue
A trail route around Kazdanga amid natural scenery
additional: The marathon starts at 08:00 for Nordic walkers and 09:00 for runners. The half-marathon starts at 10:00 for Nordic walkers and 11:00 for runners. Each distance has separate starts for runners and Nordic walkers.

name: Trysilmila
description: Trysilmila is a trail race held in Østby in Trysil, suitable for both children and adults. The race offers varied terrain and beautiful scenery, and largely follows the Trysil Skimaraton course. It is a social and inclusive race day focused on the joy of running and a great atmosphere, with separate children’s races over suitable distances. All participants receive a finisher’s medal, and prizes are awarded in both the children’s race and the main races.
course_highlights: Varied surfaces, including gravel (approx. 3.5 km), trail and forest road (approx. 6.5 km), and some asphalt (approx. 200 m) on the 10 km course
Water stations at 3.8 and 7 km on the long course (10 km), and at 3.5 km on the short course (6.5 km)
The course largely follows the Trysil Skimaraton course near Østby
additional: Children’s race start times: 12:00 (ages 0–6, 500 m), 12:05 (ages 7–10, 800 m), 12:10 (ages 11–15, 1.8 km). The short 6.5 km course starts at 12:45 with timing; the long 10 km course starts at 13:00 with timing. The race office, parking and changing rooms are at Østby Samfunnshus near the stadium area. Bib collection and prize-giving take place at the race office on race day. Trysilmila is part of Trysildobbelen together with Trysil Skimaraton, with prizes for combined results.

name: Nordkjosmila 2027
description: Nordkjosmila is a race in Nordkjosbotn, Balsfjord. In 2026, it featured a children’s race and races over 3.33 km and 10 km; the 10 km course was officially measured and approved, with individual timing. The race aims to become one of the region’s best road races.
course_highlights: The 10 km course was officially measured and approved in 2026
A 3.33 km race and a children’s race were offered in 2026
Held in Nordkjosbotn, Balsfjord

name: 15. ETAPP / Vabaõhumuuseum
description: The Health Run and Walk is a multi-stage running and walking event held in various parts of Tallinn, including the Estonian Open Air Museum. Each stage offers a chance to enjoy beautiful nature trails and the benefits of recreational sport. The Estonian Open Air Museum stage is 4.2 km long and is well suited to both runners and walkers who want to spend active time outdoors. The event is a tradition and is open to everyone interested in recreational sport.

name: Convinistafetten
location: Stora Skuggan, Norra Djurgården, Stockholm, Sweden
description: Convinistafetten is Sweden’s largest relay race, held annually in Stora Skuggan, Norra Djurgården, Stockholm. Each team consists of five participants, each running 5 kilometres, and there is also a walking category where the team walks together. The event is a fun, energetic evening that promotes team building and company camaraderie. After the race, all teams are treated to a picnic with food, drinks, fruit and coffee on the grass. Convinistafetten has a long tradition dating back to 1986 and attracts over 3,000 teams every year.
course_highlights: Each team runs five legs of 5 km each
Start and finish by the transition zone in Stora Skuggan
A picnic with food and drinks is included after the race
additional: Relay teams start in three different waves, with the first start at approximately 17:30. The walking category starts at approximately 17:40. The team captain receives all the race bibs by mail. The final runner collects the picnic box from the picnic tent. It is possible to book extra picnic boxes and private tent packages to enhance the experience. Title sponsor Convini treats teams to a picnic after they finish.

name: Izskrien Rīgu 5. posms – Māras dīķis
description: Izskrien Rīgu is a running series for the whole family, held at five unique locations in Riga and offering unforgettable runs. The 5th stage will take place by Māras Pond, where participants will run on a scenic, flat course around the pond and through Māras Garden. The event is suitable for both active runners and beginners, offering various distances and the option to take part in a health run. At the end, the fastest runners and overall season winners are traditionally celebrated, followed by a concert and party.
course_highlights: Course around Māras Pond and through Māras Garden
Flat terrain, suitable for speed and enjoyment
The run takes place in a Riga park with beautiful natural scenery
additional: Bib collection starts at 18:00. Staggered starts for the children's distances take place at 18:30. Only bags with a special tag, provided at registration together with the race bib, may be left at the bag drop. Public transport is the recommended way to get there, as parking in the area is limited. The 5 km distance consists of 3 laps of a 1.52 km course.

name: 10. Üts Ummamuudu liina üüjuusk-kõnd
description: The 10th Üts Ummamuudu City Night Run-Walk is a physical activity event in Võru, featuring running, Nordic walking, and walking. The event is part of the activities of the Physical Activity Competence Centre, which aims to promote an active lifestyle and health. Everyone is welcome to take part, improve their wellbeing, and enjoy being active at every stage of life. The beautiful nature of Võru County provides a pleasant setting for physical activity.

name: Liikumissari 8.Järvamaa Järvede jooksud VII etapp /Käru järve jooks
description: The 8th Liikumissari Järvamaa Lakes Runs, Stage VII, or the Käru Lake Run, is part of the Järvamaa running series, which brings together running enthusiasts who value healthy lifestyles. The race takes place by Käru Lake and is an individual stage of the series, with different age groups taken into account. The series aims to encourage recreational exercise and offer the opportunity to take part in several races across Järvamaa. Prizes are awarded to the top runners at each stage, and at the end of the season the top three in each age group and the most active families are recognized.
course_highlights: The race takes place around Käru Lake
The series has different age groups, from young children to older participants
Results are published on the Järvamaa Sports Association website
additional: Points are awarded according to a points table, with rankings determined by points. The best 9 race scores count toward the series results. At the end of the season, prizes are drawn among everyone who took part in all the races.

name: Askes Fjällmaraton
location: Torget, Idre Fjäll, Idre, Älvdalen Municipality, Dalarna County, Sweden

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 50 kr som oavkortat går till Viggo Foundation

description: Askes Fjällmaraton is a child-friendly 1 km mountain marathon held on Friday evening at Idre Fjäll. The course is well marked and suitable for all children born in 2015 or later. There is no timing, but all participants receive a medal and a treat at the finish. You can register easily online or on site using Swish, and the entire entry fee goes directly to the Viggo Foundation, which supports neuro-adapted sports for children and young people.
course_highlights: 1 km course with clear markings
Start and finish at Torget, Idre Fjäll
Child-friendly race with no timing
additional: Registration is open online until 15 minutes before the start, or on site at bib collection using Swish. All proceeds go to the Viggo Foundation. After the race, every child receives a medal and a treat. There is also Fjällmaratonklubben for children aged 4–12, with fun activities on Saturday. All proceeds go directly to the Viggo Foundation.

name: Trailvasan
description: Trailvasan 10 is a 10 km evening race starting and finishing at the Vasaloppet finish line in central Mora. The course follows park roads along the Vasaloppet track towards Mora ski stadium and continues on paths and forest roads through deciduous woods along the Österdalälven river before returning through central Mora. The surface is 8 km of forest road and path and 2 km of asphalt. Runners finish under the historic portal reading I fäders spår för framtids segrar.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Vasaloppet finish line in Mora
Paths and forest roads along the Österdalälven river
Drink stations after 5.5 km and 8.3 km
additional: Mass start at 18:00, followed by open start until 18:15. The race is open from age 11 and has room for 1,000 participants. Bibs are collected in Mora on race day.

name: Lüganuse rahvajooks
description: Lüganuse Public Run is part of the Ida-Viru Running Series and takes place in Kiviõli Central Square. The event offers several distances, from a children’s race to a 9 km run, suitable for different age groups and skill levels. Participants can enjoy a friendly, community-focused atmosphere and compete in the team category. Registration is easy and the entry fee is affordable, making this a great event for both recreational and experienced runners.

name: Ultravasan
description: Ultravasan 90 is a trail race starting in Berga by, Sälen, offering runners the classic Vasaloppet route through scenic summer landscapes. The race starts at dawn at 05:00 and follows the historic checkpoints to the finish in Mora, with views of pine forests, waterways, trails and traditional mountain farm settings. The race is 92 km long, has Swedish Championship status in 2026 and is part of Vasaloppstrippeln; the maximum number of participants is 2,500, and the minimum age is 17.
course_highlights: Dawn start at 05:00 in Berga by—watch the sun rise over the marshes around Smågan
Seven Vasaloppet checkpoints along the course, with drinks, energy, toilets and medical care
Scenic stretches through open pine forests, winding waterways, well-trodden trails and picturesque traditional mountain farm settings
additional: Race bibs and chips can be collected in Mora or Sälen in the days before the race, or at the start venue. Start pens open at 04:30, and your time starts when you cross the start line. Baggage transport to Mora is available, and you can send a change-of-clothes bag to Evertsberg. There are refreshment stations approximately every five kilometres, as well as toilets and medical care at all checkpoints. Maximum 2,500 participants; training grants of SEK 60,000 are awarded to the winner in each of the women’s and men’s categories. Ultravasan consists of two longer ultramarathon distances: Ultravasan 90 (Sälen–Mora, approximately 92 km) and Ultravasan 45 (Oxberg–Mora, approximately 45 km). Both finish in Mora and are part of Vasaloppet’s Summer Week.

name: Vasastafetten
description: Vasastafetten is a cross-country relay race held as a festival, where hundreds of teams made up of clubs, companies, families and groups of friends share the classic route from Sälen to Mora. It is the oldest event of the summer and offers a challenging course covering a total of 92 kilometres, divided into ten legs ranging from 4.5 to 15 kilometres. The race starts in Berga by in Sälen and welcomes both elite runners and recreational runners aged 8 and over. The entry fee includes bus transport for participants on the first two legs, and the organiser sends the team captain the race pack with bib numbers and information well in advance of the race.
course_highlights: Cross-country race between Sälen and Mora
Ten legs ranging from 4.5 to 15 km
Start in Berga by, Sälen, and finish in Mora
additional: The race pack with bib numbers and an information letter is sent to the team captain approximately two weeks before the race. The timing chip must be collected on race day at the Vasaloppet start in Sälen between 06:30 and 08:00. A bus ticket to the start for leg 1 must be booked, and runners on leg 2 must take the organiser's bus to Smågan. For legs 2 to 10, teams are responsible for their own transport to and from the changeover points.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://vasaloppet.se/lopning/vasastafetten-lopning/): 2027-08-21 — "Vasastafetten 2027 Datum 21 augusti" (was estimated 2027-08-14)

name: Hjorthagen Ultra Trail 100
description: Hjorthagen Ultra Trail 100 is an ultrarunning event in the scenic surroundings of Lill-Jansskogen in Stockholm, offering distances of 30, 50 and 100 miles. The race combines physical endurance with a sense of community in an intimate setting with a maximum of 100 participants. The course is an 11.8-kilometre loop with aid stations serving food and drinks at set times. Finishers cross the line both day and night, with generous time limits for each distance. The start and finish are at Stora Skuggans väg 22, with good transport links and nearby facilities.
course_highlights: 11.8-kilometre loop in Lill-Jansskogen
Scenic surroundings with magical forest sections
Aid station serving food and drinks from Umara at set times
additional: Time limits are 32 hours for 100 miles, 16 hours for 50 miles and 9 hours for 30 miles. The 30-mile finish cutoff is 23:00 on Saturday, the 50-mile cutoff is 06:00, and the 100-mile cutoff is 17:00 on Sunday. The start and finish area has parking, toilets, tents, a restaurant, a 4-H farm and a café. Drinks are provided by Umara. Volunteer opportunities are available. The information states that the venue has parking and is close to the metro and buses.

name: Fjällvindenterrängen
description: Fjällvindenterrängen is a classic 10-kilometre mountain trail race from Laisaliden to Hemavan. The race takes you through beautiful mountain terrain along Drottningleden and finishes with a run through the ski area, crossing the finish line at the base station of Centrumliften. The race starts at 12:30 with a group warm-up and is limited to 200 participants to ensure a good experience. After the finish, energy, drinks and fruit are provided, and food and fika can be purchased at Anders Bistro. A family evening to get ready for the race is held the night before at Arena Hemavan.
course_highlights: 10 km of mountain terrain along Drottningleden
Crossing Mortsbäcken, followed by a steep, technical downhill section
The final stretch runs through the ski area, descending to the finish
additional: A bus to the start is included, departing at 11:30 from the Centrumhuset car park in Hemavan. There is a water station after approximately 5–6 km. Timing chips are handed out at the start and must be returned after the finish. The prize ceremony takes place at approximately 13:30 in the finish area. Warm-up clothes can be left at the start to be transported to the finish. Toilets are available in Centrumhuset, but there are no showers. There is an outdoor toilet at the start. Start at 12:30 with a group warm-up. Limited to 200 participants; the entry fee includes bus transport to the start and energy at the finish.

name: Adolfsberg Frontyard
description: Adolfsberg Frontyard is a frontyard race in Adolfsberg, Örebro, listed in the Korskyrkan Örebro calendar. Runners complete 3 km laps, with 30 minutes for the first lap, 29 minutes for the second and so on. You run as many laps as you can manage in time. Past editions have had an open café where spectators can have coffee and cheer on the runners.
course_highlights: 3 km laps with one minute less for each lap
Run as many laps as you can manage
Café for spectators
additional: Past editions had the first start at 10:00, the second at 10:30 and the third at 10:59. More information is available from the organiser and on jogg.se.

name: Västerlösa Five Point Challenge
description: Västerlösa Five Point Challenge is a race in Västerlösa organised by Västerlösa Running Beer Club. Instead of running laps, participants run to five different checkpoints and collect a wristband at each, and the first to hang all five wristbands on their hook at HQ wins. Each runner chooses the order in which to collect the wristbands, but may only carry one wristband at a time. The full distance covers all checkpoints, about 10 km, and the half distance three checkpoints, about 4.5 km.
course_highlights: Five checkpoints, each with a wristband to collect
Choose your own order of checkpoints
Start and finish at HQ, the centre of the race
additional: The entry fee is SEK 200 for either distance. In 2026 HQ opened at 12:00 and the race briefing was at 13:45. The organisers hope to hold a new edition in late summer 2027.

name: Tough Viking
description: Tough Viking Kungl. Djurgården is a spectacular obstacle course race that takes you through Stockholm’s beautiful and historic surroundings. The course offers a varied mix of fast running sections, technical obstacles, strength challenges, and water elements. The race is spectator-friendly and suits both beginners and experienced OCR runners looking to combine speed, nature, and an authentic race atmosphere. The start and finish are located on Djurgårdsbrunnsvägen near the Maritime Museum, with a well-organized event area and services.
course_highlights: The course winds through the lush parks and historic landmarks of Royal Djurgården
Varied terrain with fast running sections and technical obstacles
Includes strength challenges and water elements
additional: Start times are selected during registration and sent by SMS before race day. Race bibs and timing chips are collected at the black Tough Viking tents by the Maritime Museum. The chip must be worn around the right ankle. A group warm-up is held 10 minutes before each start. Shoes with metal spikes are prohibited and will result in disqualification. Participants can compete individually or in teams (at least four people per team). Bag storage is available on site. The Open class has a minimum age of 12; participants under 18 need a guardian’s signature. There are four hydration stations along the course. Missing obstacles results in five penalty laps. Parking is limited, and public transport is recommended; changing tents are available, but there are no showers.

name: Rinkebyloppet 2026
location: Ursvikssidan av gångbron, Rinkeby, Stockholm, Sweden
description: Rinkebyloppet is an annual running race that starts on the Ursvik side of the pedestrian bridge in Rinkeby, crosses the bridge and follows Rinkeby Allé to the finish at Rinkeby Square. The race is a welcome tradition that also marks the start of the popular Rinkeby Festival. This year, there is also a class for participants with disabilities who use wheelchairs, following the same course and reaching the same finish as the other runners. Rinkebyloppet welcomes all runners and is part of the active and inclusive Rinkeby Run collaboration.
course_highlights: Start on the Ursvik side of the pedestrian bridge
Run across the bridge and along Rinkeby Allé
Finish at Rinkeby Square, marking the start of the Rinkeby Festival
additional: A new wheelchair class for participants with disabilities follows the same course and has the same finish as the runners. A wheelchair class is offered on the same course, with the same finish as the runners.

name: Stockholm Halvmarathon
description: Stockholm Half Marathon is a popular 21,098-metre half marathon that runs through central Stockholm. The start and finish are located at Strömbron and Norrbron, in the heart of the city’s historic centre near the Royal Palace, the Parliament House and the Opera House. The course is easy to run and inspiring, taking runners past several of the city’s best-known buildings and neighbourhoods, including Norrmalm, Vasastan, Kungsholmen, Gamla Stan and Södermalm. The first start is provisionally scheduled for 15:30. After finishing, runners can enjoy an after-run event in Kungsträdgården.
course_highlights: An easy-to-run course through Norrmalm, Vasastan, Kungsholmen, Gamla Stan and Södermalm
Start and finish by the Royal Palace, the Parliament House and the Opera House
Passes several of Stockholm’s best-known buildings and historic sites
additional: Registration is binding and personal. Participants must be at least 17 years old (born in 2010 or earlier). Payment can be made via online banking, Visa, MasterCard, Swish or invoice through Klarna. An after-run event is offered in Kungsträdgården after the race. After finishing, runners can enjoy an after-run event in Kungsträdgården. The official app offers live tracking, real-time results, maps and event information.

name: TMC (Tromsø Mountain Challenge) HalvUltra 25km
description: Tromsø Mountain Challenge is a weekend featuring four trail races in Tromsø’s unique mountain landscape, spread over two days. The HalvUltra 25 km starts at TUIL Arena and follows a demanding course through Tromsdalen, up Djupdalen to Bønntøva (760 m above sea level), and down Fjøyfjellet to Fjellstua before finishing at TUIL Arena. The race combines spectacular scenery with challenging terrain and attracts both new and experienced runners seeking a true Arctic running challenge.
course_highlights: Start at TUIL Arena and run through Tromsdalen
Climb to Bønntøva at 760 m above sea level, the race’s highest point
Spectacular descent via Fjøyfjellet and finish at TUIL Arena
additional: Bib pickup takes place at TUIL Arena in Tromsdalen. The HalvUltra 25 km has a time limit of 6 hours. Transport to the Ultra 50 km start is available by bus from TUIL Arena at 07:45. Bag storage is available at TUIL Arena. A self-declaration form must be completed before the start for the Ultra and HalvUltra. The time limit is 6 hours. Bib pickup takes place at TUIL Arena, and HalvUltra participants must complete a self-declaration form before the start. Places are limited.

name: Tromsø Mountain Ultra 50km
description: Tromsø Mountain Challenge is a weekend featuring four trail races in Tromsø’s unique mountain landscape, including the 50 km La Sportiva Ultra, which starts from Snarbyeidet. The races offer challenging trails, spectacular mountain and plateau views, and finish with a wonderful descent through Tromsdalen to the finish at TUIL Arena. The event attracts runners from all over the world and offers a true Arctic running experience in the fresh autumn air and beautiful fall colors. This is a race for both new and experienced trail runners looking for a challenging and scenic experience.
course_highlights: Start from Snarbyeidet on runnable mountain terrain, climbing to approximately 760 m above sea level
Pass nine checkpoints along the way during the ultra race
Spectacular descent through Tromsdalen to the finish at TUIL Arena
additional: Bib pickup takes place at TUIL Arena in Tromsdalen. The cutoff time for the 50 km ultra is 9 hours, with a checkpoint at Tromsdalselva (32 km) where the cutoff is 5.5 hours. Transport to the start from TUIL Arena is by bus at 07:45. Bags can be stored at TUIL Arena and transported by bus to the finish area. A self-declaration form must be completed before the start for the Ultra and HalvUltra. The maximum time is 9 hours. The cutoff at the Tromsdalselva checkpoint, after 32 km, is 5.5 hours. The organizer provides a bus from TUIL Arena to the start at 07:45, and Ultra runners must complete a self-declaration form. The number of start places is limited.

name: Dalheim Rundt
description: Dalheim Rundt is a family-friendly trail race that starts and finishes at TUIL Arena in Tromsø. The course follows the network of trails and the floodlit ski trail through beautiful Tromsdalen, with a water station at Dalheim. This race is part of Tromsø Mountain Challenge, which offers spectacular nature experiences in rugged Northern Norwegian terrain, with challenging trails and great views. The event takes place in late August, when Northern Norway displays its finest autumn colours.
course_highlights: Start and finish at TUIL Arena in Tromsdalen
The course follows the network of trails and the floodlit ski trail through Tromsdalen to Dalheim
Water station at Dalheim amid scenic surroundings
additional: Race bibs are distributed at TUIL Arena in Tromsdalen. The number of starting places is limited, and registration is open while race bibs are available. The race is part of a weekend featuring several trail races in Tromsø, and several of the races finish with a spectacular descent through Tromsdalen to the finish at TUIL Arena. The race is part of Tromsø Mountain Challenge and the TMC Triple. The start time is listed as 12:00 on Saturday, 21 August 2027.

name: Sami Maraton

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Pris: kr 100,- Deltakere 7-13 år får kr 50,- i rabatt.

description: Sámi Marathon is mainland Norway’s northernmost marathon and is held in the centre of Tanabru in Deatnu-Tana. The race offers compact, socially oriented courses with several passages past the stadium, creating a great atmosphere and bringing runners close to the spectators. Distances include the marathon, half marathon, 10 km, Run4Fun and MiniMarathon, with separate categories for para athletes and children. All participants receive a medal at the finish, and prizes are awarded in several categories, with additional prizes for the fastest times at each distance. The race places a strong emphasis on community and the joy of running in the centre of Tana.
course_highlights: The marathon consists of 4 laps, and the half marathon 2 laps, on officially measured courses
The courses are compact and close to the town centre, with several passages past the stadium
Suitable for all ages, with separate courses for children and para athletes
additional: Race bibs and Emit timing chips can be collected at the stadium the day before the race between 18:00 and 19:30, or from 08:30 on race day. Arrive at least 30 minutes before the start, or 1 hour beforehand if you have not collected your race bib and timing chip. Medals for all participants. Family discount with a maximum combined entry fee of 1500 kr per family. Additional prizes for the three fastest times in the 10 km, half marathon and marathon. An earlier marathon start is available for participants expecting a finishing time of over 5 hours. The information page states that all participants receive a medal and that changing rooms are available at Tana multi-purpose hall. The distance and price information applies to the published 2027 registration.

name: Kveøy halvmaraton 2027
description: Kveøy Half Marathon is held in scenic surroundings on Kveøya, with the start at Kveøy. The event offers distances including a half marathon, 10 km and a children’s race, and is suitable for both experienced runners and families. The event has a tradition of bringing together local running enthusiasts and offers a wonderful opportunity to experience the island’s beautiful nature while running.
course_highlights: Start at Kveøy in scenic surroundings
Half marathon and 10 km distances available
Children’s race for the youngest participants
additional: A children’s race and 10 km distance are offered in addition to the half marathon. The event has previously started at Kveøy and includes registration options via the website. Contact person: Line Hunstad. In 2026, there was a café at Kveøy Grendehus.

name: Piirin kymppi, Piirin puolikas ja 55. Seinämaraton
Jūrmalas krāsu skrējiens
organizer: UAB GEE TEAM sadarbībā ar Baltijasmaratoni.lv
description: The Jūrmala Color Run is a joyful and positive 5 km run held in Kauguri Park in Jūrmala. The event aims to promote a healthy and active lifestyle by inspiring participants to take part in sports activities. The run is suitable for all fitness levels and ages, and is part of the global The Color Run™ movement, which creates happiness through sport. Both adults and children take part, and it is known as one of the happiest 5 km runs in the world.
course_highlights: 5 km distance in Kauguri Park with color challenges
Suitable for all fitness levels and ages
Part of the global The Color Run™ movement
additional: Race bibs can be collected at the event venue from 10:30 until 30 minutes before the start of each distance. A limited number of THE COLOR RUN™ souvenir shirts and extra color packets are available at the event. The children's distance is approximately 500 meters. There is no timekeeping; participants can complete the distance at their own pace.

name: Blodomloppet
organizer: Östersunds SK och Blodcentralerna i Jämtland/Härjedalen

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmälningsavgift Blodomloppet 5 eller 10 km: 350 kr (t.o.m 3 augusti).

tiers.label: tier_2

description: Blodomloppet in Östersund is a fun run that raises awareness of the vital importance of blood donation. You can walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km, either on your own or with colleagues and friends. The races start and finish in Badhusparken and offer a well-organised, inclusive atmosphere for all participants. After the race, participants often get together for a shared picnic, strengthening the sense of community. Blodomloppet is a recreational activity with an important purpose and a long tradition in Sweden.
course_highlights: The 5 km and 10 km courses are marked with red ribbons and signs
A lead cyclist shows the way, and course marshals are stationed along the route
Start and finish in Badhusparken
additional: Late registration is possible on race day via the website or in person at the information tent, with payment by Swish. The courses have been officially measured and approved by certified course measurers. The start and finish are in Badhusparken. Marshals and traffic guards are stationed along the course, and a lead cyclist shows the way. Participation is at your own risk, as no accident insurance is provided. By participating, you consent to the publication of photos from the event. The final date for team registration is 20 August; after that, picnic bags are available while supplies last. The start and finish for all races are in Badhusparken. The courses are marked and staffed by marshals and traffic guards. Registration information and fees for 2027 may be updated.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://blodomloppet.se/vara-lopp/ostersund/): 2027-08-23 — "23 augusti 2027" (was estimated 2027-08-23)

name: Blodomloppet (Sundsvall)
organizer: Sundsvalls Orienteringsklubb och Blodcentralerna i Västernorrland
description: Blodomloppet in Sundsvall is a recreational race that highlights the life-saving importance of blood donation and welcomes participants to walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km. The event takes place at Ungdomsfältet in Södra hamnen, near the marina, and offers both individual and team starts. The courses are certified by the Swedish Athletics Federation and run counterclockwise along Selångersån, with scenic bridge crossings. Blodomloppet is a social, healthy activity that concludes with a group picnic for team participants.
course_highlights: Two certified adult courses: 5 km and 10 km
The courses run counterclockwise along Selångersån, crossing Sporthallsbron (5 km) and Montörsvägsbro (10 km)
Start and finish at Ungdomsfältet in Södra hamnen, near the marina
additional: Teams consist of 3–5 participants, with the option to add team members up to and including 18 August. A picnic bag for 5 people is included with team registration. Participants in the walking category may use poles or a stroller and bring a well-behaved dog on a short leash. Late registration for individual participants is available on race day from 15:30, at an increased fee, with payment by Swish. The courses are officially measured and certified by the Swedish Athletics Federation. Registration for 2027 has not yet opened. The race highlights blood donation and promotes a healthy lifestyle.

name: Blodomloppet Västerås
price_range: 350–450 kr för 5 eller 10 km; 100–150 kr för Lilla Blodomloppet
