description: Blodomloppet in Västerås is a recreational race that highlights the vital importance of blood donation and welcomes everyone to walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km. The race is open to both individual participants and teams. Teams can consist of 3–5 people, who can take part in different distances. There is also Lilla Blodomloppet for children aged 1–12, with two shorter distances. The start and finish are at the Rocklunda area, with clearly marked courses and several marshals along the way. After the race, all participants receive a medal and a finish-line goody bag, and team participants are invited to a group picnic.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Rocklunda area, on the football pitches north of the riding arena
The courses are marked with Blodomloppet course tape, with flag marshals at strategic locations
Lilla Blodomloppet for children features two distances of approximately 1,400 m and 500 m around Rocklunda IP
additional: The race offers a warm-up in front of the stage at approximately 17:00. Lilla Blodomloppet has two start times: approximately 17:15 for 1,400 m and approximately 17:25 for 500 m. Teams can consist of 3–5 participants and include a picnic for 5 people. Race bibs and T-shirts are handed out, and there are water stations along the course. Registration is binding and cancellations are not accepted. Teams consist of 3–5 participants. The team fee covers five people and includes a picnic.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://blodomloppet.se/vara-lopp/vasteras/): 2027-08-25 — "Välkommen till Blodomloppet 2027! ... 25 augusti 2027" (was estimated 2027-08-25)

name: Norrköpings Stadslopp (Nkpg City)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Gratis anmälan för alla barn och ungdomar.

description: NKPG City Norrköping City Race is a fast-paced and popular running race held in central Norrköping, starting and finishing on Olai Kyrkogata. Participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km. The course passes through classic surroundings, with packed spectator areas and more than ten music stations creating a fantastic atmosphere. The race welcomes both elite runners and recreational runners in a festive atmosphere, with great prizes and a large crowd. There is also a free 1 km children’s race, Lilla Lundbergsloppet, with a medal and goodie bag for every participant.
course_highlights: Start and finish on Olai Kyrkogata in central Norrköping
The course passes through classic Norrköping surroundings, with packed spectator areas
More than ten music stations along the course to keep runners motivated
additional: Lilla Lundbergsloppet starts at 17:00 with four starts and is free for children. The children’s warm-up, led by Friskis & Svettis, begins at 16:40. The 10 km race starts at 18:30 and the 5 km race at 19:30, with a warm-up 15 minutes before each start. Race bibs can be collected at XXL Ingelsta on Wednesday 26 August from 11:00 to 18:00, or on race day from 15:00 at the start and finish area. There are veteran, junior and youth categories, as well as team competitions for women, men and mixed teams. Water stations are located at 2 km and 7 km (Nodra), and at 3.5 km and 8.5 km (ICA Strömmen). After finishing, participants are offered freshly drilled water from Finspångs Brunnsborrning. Timing is chip-based, and results are published immediately after the finish. The ARQLY Sprint is a race within the race over the final 85 metres, with sprint prizes. 5 km and 10 km.

name: Telliskivi 5000
organizer: Buns Run Club ja Telliskivi Loomelinnak
description: Telliskivi 5000 is a 5-kilometre run held in Tallinn’s Telliskivi Creative City and its surroundings. The course is flat and fast, passing through different areas of North Tallinn and offering runners both an athletic challenge and entertainment along the route. The event brings sport and culture together, with a varied programme before and after the run, and ends with a fun finish-line party. All finishers receive a specially designed medal inspired by the identity of Telliskivi 5000.
course_highlights: A flat and fast 5 km course through areas of North Tallinn
The route passes through the Krulli Quarter, Telliskivi Creative City and smaller streets
A varied selection of entertainment along the route, from DJs to musicians and choirs
additional: All participants receive a specially designed medal at the finish. There are several cheering points along the route in collaboration with Red Bull, Bolt and Nike. After the run, enjoy a cold drink at the finish and a lively programme in the Creative City and at several local bars. You can also take part in DIY activities, such as making jewellery or printing a race T-shirt. A photo booth captures runners’ reactions. Participation is for ages 18 and over. Runners have up to 60 minutes to complete the distance, and walking is allowed. There are no water stations or toilets on the route; these are available in the finish area. Bag storage is in the premises of Von Krahl Theatre and is unattended.

name: Höga Kusten Trail
description: Höga Kusten Trail is one of Sweden’s most popular adventure races, offering a weekend filled with spectacular nature, community and celebration in the High Coast World Heritage Site. The event features five unique distances over two days, with each course taking you across some of the High Coast’s most iconic and dramatic peaks. Combining running, jogging and fast hiking, the event is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. Alongside the races, there are cosy pre-event evenings, after-trail parties and a mini expo featuring equipment from leading outdoor brands. Höga Kusten Trail is more than just a race—it’s a complete experience in one of Sweden’s most beautiful settings.
course_highlights: Five unique distances over two days, ranging from 14 km to 60 km
Courses pass through the High Coast World Heritage Site and offer spectacular views and nature experiences
Aid stations and course marshals along the route, plus race briefings and an equipment expo before the races
additional: The races take place over two days, with five distances. On Friday, Three Peaks 18k and Coast to Summits 28k start; on Saturday, Twin Peaks 14k, The Original 45k and The Ultimate 60k start. There is a race briefing before each distance and after-trail parties in the evenings. Buses run from FriluftsByn to the start locations. There is also a mini expo featuring equipment from Icebug and Haglöfs. You can sell your entry through the participant group on Facebook, and optional insurance can be purchased through Startklar. Registration for 2027 opens Friday, 5 March at 15:00. Distance and programme details for 2027 may change; published prices apply to 2026.

name: Arctic Alta Ultra 2027
description: Arctic Alta Ultra is a demanding ultramarathon held in Tverrelvdalen, starting and finishing at Ungdomshuset. The race offers several distances from 6 km to 100 miles, with well-marked courses and aid stations along the way. Participants can use bag-drop points on the longer distances, and facilities at the finish area include a café, changing rooms and showers. The event combines nature experiences with challenging terrain in the beautiful surroundings of Alta.
course_highlights: Aid stations on all distances, with several unmanned stations on the 50 km, 100 km and 100-mile distances
Bag-drop points for the 50 km, 100 km and 100-mile distances
Start and finish at Ungdomshuset in Tverrelvdalen, with facilities including a café and showers
additional: Participants in the 50 km, 100 km and 100-mile races must sign a runner declaration before the start. Race guides for the 16 km, 29 km, 50 km, 100 km and 100-mile distances are available. The start and finish address is Sønvismoen 44, 9537 Tverrelvdalen. For the 2026 edition, a café, changing rooms with showers, and the prize ceremony are listed at Ungdomshuset in Tverrelvdalen.

name: Himos Trail
distance_verbose: 52 km, 36 km, 26 km, 18 km, 11 km, 7 km, 1 km

name: 22. Ülemiste metsajooks
description: The 22nd Ülemiste Forest Run is an environmentally friendly 3 km trail run held around the Tallinn Water Treatment Plant. The event centre, start and finish are at Järvevana tee 3. The run starts at 11:50. Participants are provided with a marked course, sports drink and water at the finish, and medical assistance along the entire route. The event is open to all running enthusiasts and offers an enjoyable sporting experience.

name: Sillamäe ultra 2026: Eesti meistrivõistlused 100 km jooksus
description: This is a traditional ultramarathon where participants run a road race distance, competing for the Estonian championship title. The race challenges both local and international ultrarunners, who appreciate the course’s variety and the event’s organization. Sillamäe Ultra is known for its organization and strong participant community.

name: Tallinna Vee 54. jooks ümber Ülemiste järve
description: The 54th Tallinna Vesi Run Around Lake Ülemiste is a traditional running race. The Run Around Lake Ülemiste is part of the Maru Lake Runs series, and this year’s race is the series’ final, fourth event. The marked course is 13.7 km long and starts and finishes at the Tallinn Water Treatment Plant at Järvevana tee 3. The race centre opens early in the morning, and race materials can be collected on site. Participants are provided with chip timing; the chip is attached to the back of the race number.

name: Stockholm Trail
description: Stockholm Trail is a trail race organised by OK Södertörn, offering a unique running experience in the beautiful Nackareservatet, just outside Stockholm City. The races follow winding forest trails and cross sunlit rock slabs, with courses suited to both beginners and experienced runners. The start and finish are at Hammarbyhöjdens IP, and the event has a welcoming atmosphere, with encouraging marshals and personal service. All proceeds from the race go directly to OK Södertörn’s activities.
course_highlights: The course runs entirely through nature, along technical forest trails and over beautiful rock slabs
Fantastic views and unique natural areas in Nackareservatet
Clearly marked courses with encouraging marshals along the way
additional: There are six different courses: 21K, 10K, 5K, 5K fun run (untimed), 2.5K kids, and Mini Trail for the very youngest participants. All participants receive a race bib with their name and a unique medal after completing the race. Showers and changing facilities are available at the venue. The course requires shoes with good grip and careful attention to roots and rocks. The 21K has a generous time limit to suit all runners.

name: Rynningeviken Längre 2026

tiers.label: tier_2

description: Rynningeviken Längre is a running race in Örebro that challenges participants to run as far as they can in three or six hours in the scenic Rynningeviken Nature Reserve. The course is a beautiful loop of approximately 2.4 km, mostly on gravel paths with a few bridges, close to the city centre. The event is a celebration of running, focusing on endurance and community, where participants can take on a unique challenge and aim for personal distance records. There is also a KidsRun for the youngest runners. The event is open to all ages and offers a wonderful day filled with the joy of running.
course_highlights: A 2,412.5-metre loop, mostly on gravel paths
Two bridges, with little elevation gain
Start/finish on cobblestones, with a shorter loop for the final 15–30 minutes
additional: Start times: 6-hour race starts at 11:00, 3-hour race starts at 14:00, KidsRun starts at 11:30. A mandatory race briefing takes place before each start. Timing is recorded using a transponder, which is loaned to participants and must be returned after the race. There is no timing for the KidsRun. At the finish, the distance is measured precisely using a measuring wheel. Water and energy supplies are available along the course, including sports drink, bars, fruit, coffee and more. Changing facilities and showers are not provided, but swimming is possible in the Svartån River. Toilets are available near the start area and after approximately 1 km on the loop. Participation is at your own risk. Group registration and discounts for young people and members of certain running clubs are available. The timed races are 3 and 6 hours long. The KidsRun is for children born in 2015 or later and covers either one full lap or a shorter 700-metre distance.

name: Kraftloppet Skellefteå Löpning 2026
description: Kraftloppet in Skellefteå is a celebration for both competitive recreational athletes and casual runners who want to challenge themselves in three different events: skiing, cycling and running. The running event offers distances of 21 km and 12 km, as well as children’s races of 2.7 km and 500 m. Kraftloppet focuses on health and community, and offers the opportunity to complete a Kraftklassiker by taking part in all three events in the same calendar year.
course_highlights: Running distances of 21 km and 12 km, plus children’s races of 2.7 km and 500 m
A recreational event with shorter and longer distances for different ages and abilities
Part of the Kraftklassiker, which includes skiing, cycling and running in the same year
additional: The Kraftklassiker rewards participants who complete Kraftloppet skiing, Kraftloppet cycling and Kraftloppet running in the same calendar year. Registration is available via links on the registration page. Contact Bergsbyns SK by phone at +46 (0)910-861 61 or by email at info@kraftloppet.com. It does not confirm the date of 28 August 2027.

name: Dundret Extreme Running
description: Dundret Extreme Running is a trail race held in Gällivare, starting and finishing at Hellnerstadion. The race offers three distances: 22 km, 10 km and 2 km, all featuring varied terrain and elevation changes that challenge runners of different levels. K22 is a demanding test with 800 metres of elevation gain and beautiful views towards Sarek and Kebnekaise, while K10 and K2 offer shorter but still challenging courses. The event is well organised, with safety measures, water stations, prizes for the fastest runners and raffle prizes for all participants.
course_highlights: K22: 22 km with 800 metres of elevation gain, a mix of trail and asphalt, highest point 823 metres above sea level
K10: 9.6 km with 240 metres of elevation gain, a mix of gravel and trail, turnaround point at Femmanvägen
K2: 2.1 km trail loop around Hellnerstadion with 60 metres of elevation gain, a fast and convenient distance
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Hellnerstadion from 08:00 to 09:30. All participants must cross the finish line or inform an official if they withdraw. Water stations along K22 and K10 provide water and Umara sports drink. Changing rooms and showers are available at Hellnerstadion. The prize ceremony takes place at 13:00 for K10 and K22, with a mountain prize for K22. All participants who finish K2 receive a medal. Live results and split times will be published via a link on race day. The registration page states that registration is through MittLopp.se and that race-day registration is not possible.

name: Godisjoggen 2026
description: Godisjoggen is a children's race in Bålsta that Bålsta IK has organised since 1995. Children aged 0 to 11 run a marked course from Gröna Dalens IP towards Bålsta centre and back, and in 2026 the course went through Bålsta centre, making it about 1.2 km long. At the finish the children get a diploma or medal, fruit, ice cream and a bag of sweets, and once everyone has finished the race ends with a shower of sweets. The race now opens the Håbo festival day and is capped at 1,500 participants.
course_highlights: Shower of sweets once all children have finished
The course runs through Bålsta centre
Prize draw on all bib numbers
additional: Family members are welcome to run with their child. Registration is via godisjoggen.se, and late entry at Gröna Dalens IP is possible if places remain. Registration for the next edition opens during 2027.

name: Taurlandia Taurkalnē

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Dalības maksa 15 EUR. Pieteikšanās no 17.08.2027, kad noslēgusies 50K pieteikšanās

description: Taurlandia is an ultrarun in the Taurkalne area, offering a scenic 50 km distance along a trail steeped in legend. The race is part of the events organized by SK Mitauer, which promotes running and an active lifestyle in Latvia. Participants receive a healthy meal after the finish, aid stations along the course, and commemorative medals. The course is registered with the ITRA system, providing points and a ranking for finishers. Spectators can support runners at designated checkpoints, in accordance with the race rules.
course_highlights: A 50 km ultradistance through the beautiful natural surroundings of Taurkalne
Course registered with the ITRA system, with points and a ranking
Aid stations and four checkpoints where runners can receive support
additional: Participants receive a sweatband, a healthy post-finish meal (soup and cake), and aid stations along the sections between all four checkpoints. Spectators can support runners at checkpoints KP1, KP2, and KP4 with sports nutrition and encouragement, while equipment changes are allowed only at KP3. The course is partly accessible by car, and spectators have designated support rights along the course.

name: Šiaurės Lietuvos pusės maratono bėgimas – 2026
location: Pakruojo miesto parkas, Pakruojo rajonas, Lietuva
price_range: 0, nemokama; 2,5 km – 3-6 EUR; 5 km – 5-10 EUR; pusės maratono – 10-20 EUR
description: The Northern Lithuania Half Marathon 2026 will take place in Pakruojis District, in the northern part of Lithuania. The event aims to promote running culture and encourage residents to be active, offering scenic routes in popular tourist areas. The race will start and finish in Pakruojis City Park, where participants can enjoy not only the sport but also discover the nature and culture of northern Lithuania. The event brings together people of different ages and social groups to spend time actively and healthily.
course_highlights: Scenic routes in popular tourist areas
Start and finish in Pakruojis City Park
Discover northern Lithuania while running
additional: Bib collection is open from 8:00 to 10:00. The half marathon starts at 11:00, and the other distances start at 10:00. Registration will not be available on race day. Participants agree that photographs and video footage taken during the event may be used for marketing purposes. The event includes different distances and categories, and online registration is open until the end of August. The event date is September 4, 2027.

name: Bodø Run Festival 2027
description: Bodø Run Festival is an urban, compact running festival in the heart of Bodø city centre, offering a wide range of races for all ages and levels, including 5 km, 10 km, half marathon and relay. The festival combines running with food, entertainment, talks and a party, giving participants a weekend filled with authentic Arctic experiences. The courses are officially measured and offer both city life and spectacular nature, with the chance to set new records on a flat, accessible course. The festival also features mountain races, including Bodøryggen with an ultradistance and a hilly half marathon around Soløyvannet.
course_highlights: Officially measured courses in Bodø city centre, close to the airport, train and boat
Bodøryggen mountain race with views of the Lofoten Wall, Børvasstindan and Bodø city
Hilly half marathon around Soløyvannet, starting and finishing at the athletics track at Mørkved
additional: Bodøryggen mountain race is limited to 400 participants and includes a medal, food at the finish, spa access at Wood Hotel and transport to the start for the 22 km distance. Race bibs can be collected at Sport 1 Stormyra and at the start. A long-sleeved windproof jacket is mandatory for the mountain race. Soløyvannet Rundt has a drinks station and prize-giving with draw prizes. The festival also offers a Pasta Party when registering, and there are regular running groups and morning runs in Bodø throughout the year.

name: Sony Center Maardu City Run 2026
location: Maardu Vaba Aja Keskus, Maardu, Estonia
description: Sony Center Maardu City Run 2026 is a sporting event in Maardu that brings together running enthusiasts of different ages and ability levels. The race takes place around the Maardu Leisure Centre and offers a chance to enjoy urban scenery and stay active with friends and family. The event is organised by Eesti Ööjooks - Night Run Estonia in cooperation with other partners, offering an enjoyable and motivating running experience.
course_highlights: A run around the Maardu Leisure Centre
Urban scenery and cycle and pedestrian paths
A varied course suitable for different ability levels
additional: The registration view names the Maardu Leisure Centre as the event venue.

name: 9. Kristiine Rahvajooks
description: The 9th Kristiine Community Run takes place at the Löwenruh Park playground in Tallinn. It is a family event featuring children’s races for participants up to 10 years old, in addition to the main 5 km distance. The event centre, start and finish are located next to Löwenruh Park, providing a pleasant and safe setting for running enthusiasts. The event aims to promote running as an accessible form of exercise and offer a sporting experience for different age groups.

name: Vikingatrailen
location: Årsunda IP, Årsunda, Sandviken Municipality, Sweden
description: Vikingatrailen is a trail race organized by Årsunda IF, starting at Årsunda IP and finishing at Vikingabyn (Årsjö gård). The race offers several courses of varying lengths and terrain, including a 1 km mini race. The event has been well received, with many participants praising the organization. Participants can access maps, GPX files, and elevation profiles for the courses in advance. Vikingatrailen is a family-friendly running experience close to nature in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: Trail race starting at Årsunda IP and finishing at Vikingabyn (Årsjö gård)
Several courses: 1 km, 5 km, 10 km, and 21 km
Courses are available as GPX files and with elevation profiles
additional: The mini race starts 1 km from the finish, with bus transport to the start. Results and photos are published after the race. The courses are listed as public routes in Garmin Connect.

name: Fugeltindmarsjen 2027
location: Tennes gamle skole to Josefvatn, Balsfjord, Troms, Norway
description: Fugeltindmarsjen is a long-standing annual race, and in 2026 it marked its 47th edition. The race runs from the former Tennes School to Josefvatn, covering approximately 12.5 km and reaching a high point of 540 metres above sea level. It is a trail race suitable for both competitive and recreational runners, with registration available in advance or at the start. Josefvatn IL can assist with transport between the start and finish for participants who need it. The race is included in the Troms Athletics Association’s event calendar.
course_highlights: Course distance: approximately 12.5 km
High point: 540 metres above sea level
Start at the former Tennes School
additional: Registration is available at the start or in advance for the competitive class. Josefvatn IL offers transport from Josefvatn community hall to the start and back after the finish, if needed. In 2026, the recreational start was scheduled for 10:00 and the competitive start for 12:00. The organizers could help transport participants from Josefvatn community hall to Tennes before the start and retrieve cars after the finish.

name: Spring för kulturen
description: Spring for Culture is a cultural run through central Stockholm, bringing together artists, cultural workers and everyone interested to highlight the value of culture. The event is non-competitive and open to all; participants can run, walk, roll or dance along the route. It starts at Hakberget on Gärdet and finishes at the Swedish Parliament, covering approximately 3 km and passing central cultural institutions and places where decisions are made. During the run, the streets fill with music, dance, circus and other forms of cultural expression, creating a lively movement to make culture’s importance in everyday life visible.
course_highlights: Approximately 3 km from Hakberget, Gärdet, to the Swedish Parliament
Passes central cultural institutions and places where decisions are made
The streets fill with music, dance, circus and other forms of cultural expression
additional: The start is by the Protest sculpture at Hakberget, Gärdet. The event is politically independent and aims to build a sense of community and highlight the value of culture in society. Information for 2026 states that the event starts on Gärdet and finishes at Gustav Adolfs torg.

name: 17. ETAPP / Paljassaare poolsaar
description: STAGE 17 / The Paljassaare Peninsula is part of the Stamina Health Run series and takes place on 2 September 2026 in the Paljassaare Beach car park in Tallinn. The race distance is 6.5 km, and the course winds through the scenic landscape of the Paljassaare Peninsula, offering participants an enjoyable challenge and the chance to enjoy nature. The event is suitable for both recreational and experienced runners looking to take part in a sporting event focused on health and fitness. Stamina is the organizer and ensures a smooth, enjoyable race experience.

name: Mägede järve jooks 8. etapp , Järvamaa Järvede jooksud sarjas
description: Mägede Lake Run is the 8th event in the Järvamaa Lakes Run series and takes place in the Mägede sports area. This traditional regional race gives participants the chance to enjoy beautiful scenery and a sporting challenge. The routes wind between lakes and forests, making them suitable for both recreational and experienced runners. The event is part of Järvamaa’s active sports calendar and welcomes all running enthusiasts.

name: Toila rahvajooks
description: Toila People’s Run is part of the Ida-Viru Running Series and takes place at Toila SPA Hotel. This public sporting event offers the chance to enjoy beautiful scenery and a sporting community. The run takes place in early September and is suitable for runners of different levels. It is a traditional event that attracts participants from across the region.
course_highlights: The routes run around Toila SPA
Beautiful views of the sea and nature
Suitable for both recreational and experienced runners
additional: Toila People’s Run is the 7th stage of the Ida-Viru Running Series. The event takes place on Friday and starts at 17:45. The venue is Toila SPA Hotel. The series has 8 stages in total, held in different parts of Ida-Viru.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 28. Aseri Savijooks
description: The Lääne-Virumaa running series is a traditional running and walking series offering distances suitable for different age groups and ability levels. The stages take place in various locations across Lääne-Virumaa, offering runners diverse and interesting courses. The series lets participants enjoy both the competition and the sporting community, as well as the natural surroundings. Aseri Savijooks is one of the series’ events and takes place at Aseri Leisure Centre.

name: Jüri Jaansoni Kahe Silla jooks
description: Jüri Jaanson’s Two Bridges Run is a traditional running event in Pärnu, held on the first weekend of September. It brings together thousands of sports enthusiasts and offers a 10 km run, Nordic walking and an evening run. The event takes place in the beautiful city of Pärnu and around its bridges, providing a sporting experience for participants of all ages. The event is organised by the Pärnu Two Bridges Club, which invites everyone to take part and enjoy being active.

name: 15. Kütioru maastikujooks-kõnd
description: Kütioru Trail Run and Walk is part of the Võrumaa running and walking series, offering a variety of distances for both runners and walkers. The event takes place at Kütioru Ski Centre, and the course is off-road, offering a varied running experience. The series includes different distances, from little ones’ races to main events, suitable for all levels. This traditional event is open to everyone interested in sport who wants to enjoy Võrumaa’s beautiful nature and friendly athletic company.

name: Pärnu Õhtujooks ja Kahe Silla jooksu ratastoolisõit ja lastejooksud
description: Jüri Jaanson’s Two Bridges Run is a traditional sporting event in Pärnu that brings together thousands of running enthusiasts on the first weekend of September. The event takes place in Vaasa Park and offers a range of distances and ways to take part, including an evening run, wheelchair race and children’s races. The Two Bridges Run is known for its beautiful route through the city and along the bridges, offering a sporting challenge and a welcoming atmosphere for all participants. The event is open to recreational and experienced runners alike and celebrates the joy of exercise and community spirit.

name: Tjejmilen
description: Tjejmilen is Sweden’s largest women’s race, offering a wonderful 10 km running experience in the scenic Södra Djurgården area of Stockholm. The race is all about community, strength, and personal goals, and welcomes all women aged 15 and over. Starting groups are divided by running ability to ensure a smooth flow and a positive experience for all participants. The course takes runners through beautiful surroundings, with plenty of crowd support along the way, making it a festive and inspiring day celebrating the joy of running.
course_highlights: 10 km run through scenic Södra Djurgården and central Stockholm
Starting groups divided into 12 levels, from fast runners to walking pace
Option to take a shorter 6 km shortcut from starting group 12
additional: Starting groups are divided into 12 levels to ensure a smooth flow. The option to opt out of timing is available. Late registration is available online until 1 hour before the first start in Stockholm and 2 hours before the start in Sälen and Vemdalen, subject to availability. Payment can be made via online banking, Visa, MasterCard, Swish, or invoice through Klarna.

name: Årsta Gravel Run
organizer: Adam Widén, Stockholms Simfestival och CHPO Brand
description: Årsta Gravel Run is an 8 km race combining trail, gravel and city running around the Årsta forest in Stockholm. It is part of Dockside Swim & Gravel Run and runs alongside a 1,500 m open water swim along Liljeholmskajen, finishing at the same quay. You cannot both run and swim, but you can compete as a team where one swims and one runs and the times are added together. After the races there is a joint party in Plåtparken.
course_highlights: 8 km of trail, gravel and city around the Årsta forest
Finish at Liljeholmskajen
After-party in Plåtparken next to the finish
additional: Dockside Swim & Gravel Run is organised by Adam Widén, Stockholms Simfestival and CHPO Brand, with volunteers mainly from Zinken Löpklubb and Simklubben Neptun. The entry fee includes chip timing, a beer or alcohol-free drink in Plåtparken and a pair of sunglasses. In 2026 the races started at 15:00.

name: Enskede Backyard Kvarterslopp 2026
description: Enskede Backyard Kvarterslopp is a backyard race in the neighbourhood around Fågelkärrskroken in Enskede where the most laps wins. Runners choose between two loops, 4.5 km or 6.7 km, and run as many laps as they want and can manage. The course is available as a GPX file in the Enskede Backyard Strava group. The organisers have announced that the race returns in 2027.
course_highlights: Two loops to choose from, 4.5 km and 6.7 km
Most laps wins
Start and finish at Fågelkärrskroken in Enskede
additional: The date and registration for 2027 have not been published yet. The organisers post updates on Instagram.

name: Lasse-Majaloppet
description: Lasse-Majaloppet is a cross-country ski race organised by Arboga Ski Club, with three distances: 23 km, 13 km and 6 km. The race offers a great opportunity to ski through varied terrain and is a traditional event in Arboga. It welcomes both recreational and competitive skiers.
course_highlights: Three distances: 23 km, 13 km and 6 km
Varied terrain in Arboga
Organised by Arboga Ski Club
additional: The race has been held since the mid-1970s.

name: Rotary End Polio bėgimas
description: The “Rotary End Polio Run” is a charity 5 km run and walk, along with a 400 m children’s run, in the city of Palanga. It aims to help eradicate polio worldwide. The event takes place at Palanga Stadium and on city streets, including pedestrian and cycle paths and the Palanga Bridge. Participants can choose to run or walk, and the event encourages people with disabilities to take part in sport. All funds raised go to Rotary’s polio eradication program, while the organizers cover the event expenses themselves.
course_highlights: 5 km course surface: asphalt, city streets, pedestrian and cycle paths, park, Palanga Bridge
400 m children’s run
Start and finish at Palanga Stadium
additional: Age groups are based on year of birth, and overall winners are not eligible for age-group awards. The time limit for the 5 km run and walk is 100 minutes. The awards ceremony will take place at 12:00. The event also includes a 400 m children’s run.

name: Harstad Summits Trail Marathon
description: Harstad Summits Trail Marathon is a spectacular mountain race held in early September, starting and finishing in central Harstad. The race offers varied, hilly terrain, with trails crossing several local mountain peaks, and is suitable for both experienced runners and recreational runners looking for a wonderful experience in nature. The event is part of Harstadtrippelen, which combines skiing, cycling and running throughout the year, creating an inclusive community celebration with activities for the whole family. After the race, there is an awards ceremony and a chance to socialise in the finish area.
course_highlights: A route crossing several mountain peaks, with varied, hilly terrain
Spectacular views and experiences in nature in the Harstad area
Start and finish in central Harstad, with a community celebration and activities
additional: Distances: Marathon (42 km, 2,100 m elevation gain), Half Marathon (21 km, 950 m elevation gain), 12 km recreational run, 10 km boys/girls, children's race in the city centre. There are aid stations along the course and marked routes, and a banquet is held for volunteers and partners after the race. Prizes are drawn among participants, and there are activities and entertainment for the whole family.

name: Sportland Kõrvemaa Metsajooks 2027
location: Sportland Kõrvemaa Matka- ja Suusakeskus, Anija Parish, Estonia
description: Sportland Kõrvemaa Forest Run is a mass-participation sporting event held in the pristine Kõrvemaa nature reserve. The routes wind along forest and gravel roads, offering participants beautiful views and moderate elevation gain. The event is suitable for the whole family, with children’s races and a youth race alongside the main events. The race centre is conveniently located near Tallinn and offers participants hot soup, a sauna and a hot tub. All finishers receive a fine medal and gifts, while the winners are awarded Sportland gift vouchers.
course_highlights: The 21 km route runs along forest and gravel roads, with about 260 metres of elevation gain
The 10 km route is moderately rolling, with several climbs and descents; the gravel road is open to traffic
The 5 km route is varied and rolling, mainly on a wide forest road, and includes three longer climbs
additional: Children’s races are free and untimed; registration is on site. The 5 km youth race starts at 12:30 alongside the adults’ 5 km race. The entry fee is €15 with pre-registration. A Sportland pop-up shop will be open at the race centre, where runners can stock up on running gear. All participants can enjoy hot soup, and access to the sauna and hot tub is available from 13:00. Chip timing is provided for the 21 km, 10 km and 5 km distances. The race centre opens at 10:00, with registration and race-number collection starting at the same time. The 21 km, 10 km and 5 km races are timed. Participants will receive a medal, a drink and a bar at the finish; soup will be offered to everyone, and the sauna and hot tubs will be open.

name: Hålahult Blackwood Manor TrailRun
description: Hålahult Blackwood Manor TrailRun is a trail race starting and finishing at the former Hålahult sanatorium at the foot of Kilsbergen, 20 km north of Örebro. It is organised by Trailmakaren together with Almby IK and has two courses, 17 km Amboberget with about 400 metres of climbing and 7 km Falleraberget. The trails run between Falleraberget, Hålaberget and Amboberget with views over the Närke plain. The organiser has announced the next edition for Sunday 5 September 2027.
course_highlights: Start across the old stone bridge Suckarnas bro
Views from the Amboberget cliffs and over the Närke plain
360-degree panorama from Hålaberget
additional: The 17 km course has an energy station at about 9 km, and drinks and energy are available at the finish for both courses. After the race runners gather at the Hålahult café. Entries are binding but can be transferred to someone else through the organiser. In 2026 the 17 km cost 350-400 SEK and the 7 km 300-350 SEK depending on the entry date.

name: Valmieras skrējiens
description: The Valmiera Run is an annual running event in Valmiera, offering various distances, including a half marathon and 10 km races. The races take place on certified courses, ensuring accurate distance measurements and a high standard of competition. The event is suitable for both experienced runners and beginners, offering the chance to enjoy running in a beautiful urban setting. The Valmiera Run is part of the Latvian athletics calendar and attracts participants from across Latvia.
course_highlights: Certified half-marathon and 10 km distances
The race takes place within the city of Valmiera
Precisely measured courses with an A-level certificate
additional: The courses are certified through 31.12.2027 with an A-level certificate issued by Arturs Onzuls. The event is part of the Latvian Athletics Association calendar and is organized in accordance with LAA regulations.

name: VI Zarasų pusmaratonis
description: The VI Zarasai Half Marathon is a traditional running event held in Zarasai, at Sėlių Square. The event aims to promote running as a way to improve health and raise the profile of the Zarasai region. Participants can choose from several distances, including the half marathon, 10.5 km, 5 km, 1.2 km and 550 m runs, as well as relay races. The official start and finish are at Sėlių Square, and the routes run through the town, with refreshment stations along the way. The event is open to anyone who has checked their health and follows the rules.
course_highlights: The half-marathon course consists of 2 laps
Start and finish at Sėlių Square, in front of the municipal building
Course routes are publicly available at mappedometer.com
additional: Race bib distribution begins at 9:00 at Sėlių Square. The runners’ warm-up takes place at 11:00, followed by a welcome speech from the Mayor of Zarasai at 11:10. Time limits: half marathon — 3 hours; 10.5 km — 1 hour 30 minutes; 5 km — 60 minutes; 1.2 km — 15 minutes. The first 350 registered participants receive event T-shirts. There are several refreshment stations along the route with water and fruit. The regulations provide for water and fruit stations along the course. Nordic walking is also organized.

name: Blodomloppet Eskilstuna
price_range: 350 kr för 5 eller 10 km; 100 kr för Lilla Blodomloppet (preliminära uppgifter för 2027)

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: därefter sker en höjning på 50 kr (400 kr)

description: Blodomloppet in Eskilstuna is a fun run that highlights the vital importance of blood donation. Participants can choose to walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km, either individually or as part of a team. The race starts and finishes in Stadsparken and follows a scenic route along the riverside promenade and the city streets. There is also Lilla Blodomloppet and Specialomloppet for those who want to take part in shorter distances. Blodomloppet is a social and healthy activity that ends with a shared picnic for participants.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Stadsparken, Eskilstuna
5 km and 10 km routes along the riverside promenade and city streets
Officially measured 5,000 m course by an SFIF course measurer
additional: Registration is available individually or in teams of 3–5 participants, with a picnic for 5 people included. Team members may take part in different distances/classes (except Lilla Blodomloppet). The deadline for team registration is 31/8. Lilla Blodomloppet and Specialomloppet start in Stadsparken and follow shorter routes within the park. The course is officially measured, and timing is provided for the 5 km and 10 km distances. Lilla Blodomloppet is for children up to 12 years old; Specialomloppet is 1.5–3 km.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://blodomloppet.se/vara-lopp/eskilstuna/): 2027-09-06 — "Välkommen till Blodomloppet 2027! ... 6 september 2027" (was estimated 2027-09-06)

name: Self-Transcendence 2 mailin juoksu, Vaasa
description: Self-Transcendence 2 Mile Run Vaasa takes place every Tuesday from May to September at 19:00 on the Hietalahti Peace Mile. The route is a 1-mile park course, run twice. The start and registration are behind the swimming pool. The run offers a fast and pleasant park route suitable for runners of all levels.

name: Skärblackaloppet 2026
location: Folkets Hus, Skärblacka, Norrköping Municipality, Östergötland County, Sweden
description: Skärblackaloppet is an annual town race through beautiful Skärblacka in Östergötland. The event offers a festival atmosphere where everyone can take part, whether they choose to run 6 km, walk 4 km or cheer from the sidelines. The course runs on asphalt, cycle paths, gravel and partly on trails, with the start and finish at Folkets Hus. There are great prizes and exciting features such as the Mericon sprint and prize ceremonies for both runners and walkers.
course_highlights: 6 km run through Skärblacka on asphalt, cycle paths, gravel and trails
4 km walking class without timekeeping, starting and finishing at Folkets Hus
Mericon sprint over the final 300 metres, with a chance to win a gift card
additional: Race numbers can be collected at ICA Supermarket in Skärblacka on the Tuesday before the race between 11:00 and 18:00, or at Folkets Hus no later than one hour before the start. Late registration is available at race-number collection and on race day for an additional fee. Prizes are awarded to the fastest runners, gift cards are available for the Mericon sprint, and there are also prizes for picking up trimmers and tyres along the course. The walking class is not timed, and dogs are not allowed. A first-aid volunteer will be on site. There is also a 4 km walking class.

name: Finlandiaviesti
location: Jyväskylä, Rantaraitti, Jyväskylä, Central Finland, Finland
description: The event offers runners a range of distances, including 5 km, 10 km, a half marathon, and a marathon, and is suitable for runners of all levels. The route follows Jyväskylä’s Rantaraitti, which has been awarded Finland’s most beautiful transport route, offering a flat and fast running experience. Finlandia Marathon is known for its runner-friendly route, excellent atmosphere, and memorable event weekend amid the beautiful scenery of Central Finland.

name: Sormlands 100 Trail Run
description: Sörmlands 100 Trail Run is a running event offering a unique experience through one of Sweden’s most biologically diverse regions. The races range from 8 km to 100 miles and cover a mix of forest trails, technical coastal paths, and fast sections. The event welcomes runners of all ages and abilities and offers a memorable weekend in Nävekvarn, surrounded by beautiful nature and challenging terrain.
course_highlights: A mix of forest trails, technical coastal paths, and fast sections
Distances ranging from 8 km to 100 miles
Beautiful, biologically diverse region along the Sörmlandsleden trail
additional: All distances are cupless, so participants must bring their own cup for drinks. After the race, a sauna and Nävekvarn Folkets Park are available. Well-stocked aid stations offer, among other things, Coca-Cola, Umara, coffee, and locally produced food. GPS tracking and live results are available. Mandatory equipment requirements vary by distance and include a mobile phone, navigation tools, a first-aid kit, and a headlamp for longer distances. Transport from the finish is available for the 50 km distance, with a bus to Nyköping Central Station. Race weekend runs from 10–12 September 2027. Registration opens on 1 December.

name: Sörmlands 100 Trail Run
location: Mariefred, Strängnäs Municipality, Södermanland County, Sweden
description: Sörmlands 100 Trail Run is an ultramarathon offering a unique experience through one of Sweden’s most species-rich regions. The race offers several distances from 8 km up to 100 miles, across varied terrain including forest trails, technical coastal paths, and fast sections. The event welcomes runners of all ages and levels and promises a memorable day in beautiful and challenging natural surroundings. After the race, sauna and locally produced food and drinks are available at Nävekvarn Folkets Park.
course_highlights: A mix of forest trails, technical coastal paths, and fast sections
Beautiful and challenging trail sections on the Sörmlandsleden trail
Well-stocked aid stations with a variety of energy options and drinks
additional: All distances are cupless, so participants must bring their own cup for drinks. Mandatory equipment includes a GPS tracker, a mobile phone with important numbers, a first-aid kit, a rain jacket, and a headlamp with extra batteries. Well-stocked aid stations along the course offer Coca-Cola, Umara, coffee, fruit, chips, and local specialties, among other items. After the race, sauna, locally produced food, and non-alcoholic beer are available. Shuttle buses from the finish of the 50 km race to Nyköping Central Station are available.

name: Hokka-hölkkä, Kangasniemi 12.9.2026
description: Kangasniemi Village Runs 2026 – Hokka is a running event organised jointly by Kangasniemen Kalske and local villages, engaging the entire Kangasniemi area. The event gives participants the chance to enjoy beautiful rural scenery and a welcoming community atmosphere. The runs are suitable for runners of all ages and abilities, and are part of Kangasniemi’s summer sports programme.
course_highlights: The running route follows the roads of Hokka.
The event is open to everyone.

name: Tahko Trail Run
organizer: Kuopio-Tahko Markkinointi Oy ja TAHKOcom Oy
description: Tahko Trail Run is a new trail running event held amid the stunning scenery of Tahkovuori. The event offers four different distance options, suitable for both first-timers and experienced trail runners. The routes wind through varied, nature-rich terrain, with heart-pumping climbs and breathtaking views. The event focuses on memorable experiences, atmosphere, and well-marked routes with aid stations. The finish area has a race-day atmosphere, food, and the option to use the sauna and showers at Break Sokos Hotel Tahko.

name: SaaristoTrail
description: SaaristoTrail is an exciting trail running event in Parainen, offering varied routes amid stunning archipelago scenery. The event features three main distances: 7 km, 14 km and a 21 km half marathon, suitable for both beginner and experienced trail runners. The routes include varied trails, fitness tracks and significant elevation changes, including the steep climbs of Svinövuori, offering unforgettable views and a challenge. The event’s relaxed atmosphere and careful organisation make it an enjoyable experience for all participants.

name: Tallinna Sügisjooks 10 km
location: Vabaduse väljak, Tallinn, Harju County, Estonia
description: Tallinn Autumn Run 10 km is an autumn running event held at Freedom Square in central Tallinn. The start is on 12 September 2026 at 14:00. The event is suitable for both runners and walkers, with timed and untimed participation options. Participants can enjoy a friendly atmosphere and the city’s autumn beauty.
course_highlights: A 10 km route through central Tallinn
Participate by running or walking, with or without timing
Start and finish at Freedom Square
additional: Discounts: 20% off for seniors aged 60 and over and young people under 20. A 10% group discount applies when at least 10 people register together. The event offers discounts for seniors, young people and groups, and is part of the Tallinn Marathon, taking place on 11–13 September 2026.

name: Nike Noortejooks
description: Nike Youth Run is a running event for young people, held at Freedom Square in the heart of Tallinn. It is part of the Swedbank Tallinn Marathon event series and offers young people the chance to take part in a fun, sporting event. The race starts in the evening, creating a pleasant atmosphere and encouraging an active lifestyle among young people. Registration is easy, and early-bird prices are available.
course_highlights: Held at Freedom Square in central Tallinn
Evening start at 18:30
A safe running environment suitable for young people
additional: Registering early can secure lower entry fees. Young people and seniors can also get special discounts in the Tallinn Marathon series. Participants are provided with a safe running environment and well-organised event. The race takes place in Tallinn’s Old Town and at Freedom Square. Participants can join a community of young athletes, and awards are presented to the top finishers.

name: 84. laste Paala järve jooks
description: The 84th Paala Lake Children’s Run is a traditional children’s running event held on the shore of Paala Lake near Viljandi. The event offers distances suited to different age groups, ranging from 300 metres to a two-lap run around the lake. Organised by the JOOSU recreational sports club, it gives children the chance to enjoy being active and spend time in nature. The run starts on 12 September 2026 at 10:00. Prizes and souvenirs are provided for participants.

name: Swedbanki Tallinna Maraton: poolmaraton 21,1 km
description: The Swedbank Tallinn Marathon is Estonia’s largest running and movement festival, taking place on September 10–12, 2027. The event hub and start-finish area are located on the edge of Tallinn’s Old Town, and the course winds through the city’s beautiful parks and coastal areas, offering participants a varied and inspiring running experience. The event is international and brings together thousands of running enthusiasts from Estonia and abroad. The Tallinn Marathon is known for its excellent organization, supportive spectators, and beautiful medals.
course_highlights: The course runs along the edge of Tallinn’s Old Town, a UNESCO World Heritage Site
Passes through several parks and coastal areas
Supportive and lively spectators line the course
additional: 20% discount for seniors aged 60 and over and young people under 20. 10% discount for groups registering at least 10 people at once.

name: Bysjöloppet
description: Bysjöloppet is a highly regarded race organized by Åtvidabergs IF since 1983. The race offers a varied course combining asphalt, gravel roads and forest trails through scenic, gently rolling terrain around Lake Bysjön in Åtvidaberg. The start and finish are at Edbergavallen, and the event offers several distances for both children and adults, with timing for most races. It is a family-friendly and inclusive competition, with medals for everyone who finishes and special commemorative medals for loyal participants.
course_highlights: A varied mix of surfaces: asphalt, gravel roads and forest trails
Scenic terrain around Lake Bysjön with moderate elevation changes
The 10 km course includes challenging trail sections and floodlit trails
additional: Start times: 700 m at 11:30, 1.3 km at 11:40, and 5 km and 10 km at 13:00. Race bibs can be collected from 10:00 on race day at Edbergavallen. Changing facilities, showers and toilets are available at Kanonvallen. A kiosk serving hot dogs, drinks and sweets is located at the event venue. Teams consist of 4–6 participants in any categories and receive a picnic bag from ICA Supermarket to share after finishing. Late registration is available on site from 10:00, with payment by Swish or cash; discount codes cannot be used for on-site late registration. The race has traditionally been held on the second Saturday in September and offers distances for children and adults.

name: Norasjön Runt
description: Norasjön Runt is a classic half marathon in Nora with a long tradition dating back to 1929. The course goes around Lake Norasjön and offers varied scenery, including forests, open fields and sections crossing streams. The race welcomes both competitive runners and recreational runners.
course_highlights: Half marathon course around Lake Norasjön
Varied scenery with forests and open fields
Sections crossing streams
additional: The race has been held since 1929.

name: Gränna StadsTrail
description: Gränna StadsTrail is a recreational race offering a unique nature experience and challenge across three distances: 5, 10 and 21 km. The race features varied terrain, from asphalt to winding trails through beech forest and up to the summit of Grännaberget. The start and finish are centrally located at Gränna Square, where participants can enjoy beautiful views of Lake Vättern and a mass start. All participants receive a unique medal, and all distances are timed. The race is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners who want to combine performance with a nature experience.
course_highlights: 21 km course combining asphalt, trails and gravel roads
Route through beech forest and up to the summit of Grännaberget
Start and finish at Gränna Square, with views over Lake Vättern
additional: Mass start from Gränna Square, through town to the harbor, where timing begins. The event arena is in the center of Gränna, close to shops, cafés and accommodation. The courses may change depending on conditions and permits. Timing and a medal at the finish.

name: USWE Paradiset STHLM
description: USWE Paradiset STHLM is a trail race in the beautiful and rugged Paradiset Nature Reserve in southern Stockholm. The race offers challenging trail running along winding paths, across marshes and boardwalks, where runners experience forest, mountains and sea. Distances are 26 km, 13 km and 6 km, and the 26 km distance is a leg of the Outnorth Trailtour. The race is marked by a strong sense of community and a festive atmosphere after the finish.
course_highlights: Beautiful, wild terrain with rocky outcrops and open pine forest
Small winding paths, marshes and boardwalks
The 26 km distance is a leg of the Outnorth Trailtour
additional: The race offers three distances: 26 km, 13 km and 6 km. The terrain is challenging and gives a strong sense of achievement. 26 km. The race is part of the Outnorth Trailtour.

name: Duvnäsloppet
description: Duvnäsloppet is a family-friendly competitive and recreational race that has been held in Saltsjö-Duvnäs since 2007. The race is primarily intended for residents of Nacka, Värmdö and Saltsjöbaden, but welcomes other participants too. The start and finish are in Ringparken, and the race has strong local roots, with a focus on preserving its character as a family event for all ages. In 2027, the race celebrates 20 years with new start categories and continued community spirit among neighbours and runners.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Ringparken in Saltsjö-Duvnäs
Courses of 1.7 km, 5 km and 10 km (the 10 km course is two laps of the 5 km course)
The course features varied terrain with hills, a waterfront promenade and views around Duvnäs Udde
additional: Timing chips are now integrated into the race bib. Race administration opens the day before and on race day. Participant numbers are limited to preserve the family atmosphere. The children’s race has its own short course around Ringparken.

name: Paltmilen
description: Paltmilen is a 10 km city race in central Piteå organised by Pite Runners. The course is flat and certified and runs along some of the town's most scenic stretches before finishing in the centre via Sweden's first pedestrian street. Start and finish are in Badhusparken, a stone's throw from the centre. 2026 was the second edition.
course_highlights: Flat, certified 10 km course
Finish via Sweden's first pedestrian street
Children's races of about 500 m and 1,500 m
additional: All finishers get a medal and something to drink. Prizes are drawn in the main race, and the top three women and men compete for prize money. Registration is through Jp7an Timing.

name: Umemilen
description: Umemilen is IFK Umeå's big autumn fun run. The race is certified and follows an easy 10 km loop around Lake Nydalasjön in Umeå. Younger runners can take part in Lilla Umemilen. Registration is via Race ID.
course_highlights: Certified 10 km loop around Nydalasjön
Easy, fast course
Lilla Umemilen for younger runners
additional: IFK Umeå publishes the race results on the club website.

name: Enköpingsloppet
description: Enköpingsloppet is an annual running festival in Enköping that brings together hundreds of runners from across Sweden. The event offers several distances for runners of all levels, from a children’s race to longer 10 km races, and is a celebration for the whole city. The courses are scenic and flat, with beautiful views of Enköping’s parks and waterfront areas. There is a group warm-up, music and cheering along the course, as well as post-race refreshments with recovery drinks and snacks.
course_highlights: A scenic two-lap course around Drömparken (5.5 km)
A flat, scenic 10 km course through Enköping, officially measured by the Swedish Athletics Association
A water station halfway along the 10 km course, with music and cheering along the way
additional: Group warm-up approximately 15 minutes before each race starts. Post-race refreshments with recovery drinks and snacks for all runners. Results and finish times are available online immediately after finishing. The event area at ENA-vallen’s IP opens at 10:00. Start times: 11:00 Ajabaja Cancer Race (children’s race), 12:30 APC Race (5.5 km), 14:00 ICA Maxi Mile (10 km). Prize ceremonies take place after each race. The event area is located at ENA-vallen’s IP. The official website lists a different race date for 2027 than the stated date of 11 September.

name: Zilo kalnu Stirnu buks
location: Zilie Kalni Nature Park, Ogre, Latvia

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Divas nedēļas vai agrāk pirms sacensībām

description: Zilo kalnu Stirnu buks is part of the popular Stirnu buks trail-running series, held on Latvia’s most beautiful forest trails. The event offers a range of distances for different ages and fitness levels, allowing participants to enjoy a scenic and challenging trail run. It welcomes both beginners and experienced runners, with awards for the top finishers in different age groups and distances. The Zilo kalnu event takes place in the city of Ogre and is part of a wider series of races held throughout Latvia.
course_highlights: A variety of surfaces: asphalt, gravel roads, forest trails, and off-road terrain
Five different distances are available for different age groups and fitness levels
The event takes place in Ogre, amid beautiful natural scenery and challenging trail sections
additional: Late registration is available on race day until 30 minutes before the distance start. “ENEFIT Taku gājējs” participants start first; hiking participants can set off on the course between 9:00 and 10:30, with no timekeeping. Discounts are available for juniors, seniors, and special groups. Participant profiles are created and managed through the Stirnubuks.lv profile page.

name: Skjervøy 20:1000
description: Skjervøy 20:1000 is a challenging mountain race combining a 20 km distance with 1,000 metres of elevation gain in scenic surroundings on Skjervøy, at the edge of the open sea at 70 degrees north. The race features steep, technically demanding trails, cart tracks and boardwalks across marshland, with spectacular views and varied terrain around Skjervøy centre. It is suitable both for the fittest runners and for those looking for a manageable challenge, with recreational and competitive classes. A shorter 10 km course with 500 metres of elevation gain is also held, as well as a 1 km children’s race. The event has a social focus and aims to inspire more people to experience the island’s wonderful routes.
course_highlights: Steep, technically demanding trails with narrow sections
Cart tracks in hilly terrain and boardwalks across marshland
Wonderful views at 70 degrees north and a varied course around Skjervøy centre
additional: The 1 km children’s race is free, with registration on race day. Race bibs can be collected at Sporten Skjervøy on Thursday, Friday and Saturday before the race. Aid stations with water and cordial are located at 8 km and 12 km on the 20:1000 course, and at 3 km on the 10:500 course; runners must bring their own bottle or cup. Poles are allowed, but runners are responsible for their own safety. Headphones are not allowed. The time limit is 7 hours for the recreational class and 5 hours for the competitive class on the 20:1000. Prizes include cash prizes for the three fastest runners in the competitive class, a prize for a new course record, and draw prizes for all finishers. There is also a sprint prize (Seppalaspurten) on the final 160 metres. The programme lists separate starts for the recreational and competitive classes in the 20:1000 and 10:500. The children’s race is 1 km.

name: Trysilrypa
description: Trysilrypa is Norway’s largest mountain race and walking event for women, held in the beautiful autumn-coloured Trysil Mountains. The event offers distances of 6, 10 and 13 km, with the start and finish at SkiStar Lodge in Fageråsen. Participants can choose to run, hike or speedwalk, and enjoy a weekend filled with nature, fun and a sense of achievement alongside thousands of other women. Trysilrypa is an annual weekend for women that combines physical activity with socialising in mountain terrain.
course_highlights: Routes of 6, 10 and 13 km in beautiful high-mountain terrain
Start and finish at SkiStar Lodge in Fageråsen
Autumn-coloured mountain scenery in Trysil
additional: Participants can choose to run, hike or speedwalk. A weekend for women with a social programme is also held at SkiStar Lodge, the event venue.

name: Skogsløp med innlagt KM terrengløp
description: The forest run, which includes the Troms District Championships in cross-country running, is organized in Bardu by Bardu IL Friidrett, which aims to create activity and enjoyable experiences for athletes of all ages. The race is part of the club’s tradition of cross-country running and athletics activities, and takes place in scenic surroundings with varied terrain. Bardu IL Friidrett works with several clubs in Troms to strengthen the athletics community in the region and offers an inclusive environment for both beginners and experienced runners.
course_highlights: Cross-country running on varied forest terrain
Includes the district championships in cross-country running
Scenic surroundings in Bardu
additional: Bardu IL Friidrett offers an inclusive environment for all ages and ability levels, with training and activities such as athletics school, Steilia Opp, and the TINE relay. The club works with other athletics clubs in Troms to strengthen the community and welcomes more volunteers and athletes to join the team.

name: Tampere Maraton 13.9.2026
description: Tampere Marathon is a true city marathon, run in the heart of Tampere. The event offers a marathon, half marathon, 10 km race, a minimarathon for the youngest members of the family, and a marathon relay for teams of four. The course runs through the city centre and along Tampere’s waterways, mostly on asphalt and partly on gravel paths, offering beautiful urban scenery and a challenge for runners. The start and finish area is at Tampere Stadium, which has good transport connections. Organised by runners for runners, the event offers the joy of achievement to runners of all ages and abilities.

name: Ruskahölkkä
description: Ruskahölkkä is a versatile cross-country running event in Oulainen, offering categories and distances for runners of all ages and fitness levels. The competition is held in the Honkamaja area and includes distances ranging from 0.3 km children’s races to 10 km open races, as well as recreational categories. Prizes are awarded in every category, and there are also prize draws, including a bicycle raffle. Runners have access to changing rooms with showers, and the event is part of Oulaisten Taru’s wide-ranging sporting activities.

name: Hiekkojen Herruus Trail Run
description: Hiekkojen Herruus Trail Run offers fast-paced and suitably challenging routes through Kalajoki’s magnificent pine forests and coastal scenery. The route winds along pine-needle trails and includes technically challenging sections that test runners’ fitness and skills. The race is part of a two-day event, which also features an MTB race and a combined race. Welcome to experience the unique atmosphere of Kalajoki’s sandy terrain and challenge yourself!

name: Mälarömilen
description: Mälarömilen is a recurring running race on Ekerö that welcomes runners of all levels and the whole family. The event offers four different distances, from a children’s race for the youngest runners to the classic 10-kilometre main race. The courses pass through scenic surroundings on paved footpaths and park trails, with the start and finish at Träkvista sports ground. Mälarömilen is organised by Mälarö SOK, and all proceeds go back to the club’s sporting activities.
course_highlights: Pleasant, runner-friendly courses on paved footpaths and park trails
Signs at every kilometre marker
Start and finish at Träkvista sports ground, in scenic surroundings
additional: Late registration is available on race day, subject to availability. There is a drinks station shortly after the start/lap point. Toilets, showers and changing rooms are available in the KOM building at Träkvista sports ground. A first-aid tent is staffed throughout the event. All races start and finish at Träkvista sports ground. Group registration is available for teams and companies.

name: Brotorp Trailrun
location: Skogsluffarnas klubbstuga Brotorp, Bagarmossen, Stockholm, Sweden
description: Brotorp Trailrun is a challenging and enjoyable trail race on a technical 7 km loop through the finest parts of Nackareservatet. The race offers several distances, including a children’s course, 7 km, 14 km and 21 km, with the start and finish at Skogsluffarna’s clubhouse, Brotorp, in Bagarmossen. The courses feature varied terrain, with trails near lakes and hills, marked with orange ribbons and signs. There are aid stations along the course with water, sports drink and bananas, and after the finish, runners in the longer distances are served hamburgers. Timing is provided by Sportident, and prizes are awarded to the top three in each category.
course_highlights: Technical 7 km loop marked with orange ribbons and signs
The course passes through the finest parts of Nackareservatet, with lakes and hills
Aid stations every 3.5 km with water, sports drink and bananas
additional: The start and finish are at the Brotorp clubhouse. Bib collection takes place on race day, at least one hour before the start. Food and refreshments are available at the clubhouse. The time limit for the longest distance is 4 hours; everyone must finish before 14:00. Showers are available, but runners are encouraged to shower at home. The awards ceremony is planned for approximately 12:30. A discount code is available for children running 7 km (50% discount). According to the organizer, children who register for 7 km receive a 50 percent discount with the discount code “barnrabatt”.

name: Vildmarksmilen
description: Vildmarksmilen is a fun trail race through the beautiful natural surroundings of the Hemlingby outdoor recreation area in Gävle. The course is varied, with terrain that changes depending on the weather, making the race challenging but accessible to runners used to narrow trails and off-trail terrain. The start and finish are at Spårcentralen, and the race ends with a steep climb up the Hemlingbyberget ski slope. Vildmark15 is recommended for those looking for a greater challenge, but it is not being held in 2026 due to construction work.
course_highlights: Varied terrain with trails, roots, rocks and marshland
Water station at 5 km and at the finish
A final climb up the Hemlingbyberget ski slope before the finish
additional: Late registration is available on-site until 15 minutes before the start. Bib pickup, late registration, the start and the finish are at Hemlingby Spårcentral. Hemlingbystugan is currently closed, and no food or refreshments are available there. Everyone who completes the race receives a medal, and there are performance and raffle prizes. In 2026, an alternative course route was used due to construction work in the Hemlingby outdoor recreation area, and Vildmark 15 was not held.

name: RUN & RAVE Palanga
description: RUN & RAVE Palanga is a new community initiative for people who love movement, music, and good energy. The event takes place in Palanga and includes mobility training, a 5 km social run with DJ music, an ice bath ritual, and coffee breaks. It’s a great opportunity to meet new people, make connections, and experience summer energy at a single morning event. Registration is required, and participants are invited to bring running shoes, swim shorts, and a towel.

name: Strandmila 2027
description: Strandmila is an inclusive race day in the beautiful Alcoa Environmental Park, where everyone can take part regardless of age or ability. The event features a nature trail for walkers, a children’s race for the youngest participants, and 5 km and 10 km races. It is a free, family-friendly day with prizes for class winners and children’s race participants, as well as a gift-card draw for nature trail participants. The kiosk in FLIK’s clubhouse will be open, making for an active and enjoyable experience for the whole family.
course_highlights: A 5 km nature trail for walkers
A children’s race of approximately 600–800 metres
5 km and 10 km races in Alcoa Environmental Park
additional: Registration via EQ Timing from 25 August or on-site up to 30 minutes before the start. Kiosk sales at FLIK’s clubhouse. Start times: 12:00 nature trail, 13:45 children’s race, 14:00 5 km and 10 km races.

name: Mjärdevistafetten
location: Collegiumparken, Linköping Science Park, Linköping, Sweden
description: Mjärdevistafetten is a lively public relay in Collegium Park at Linköping Science Park. Teams consist of four people, and each runner covers approximately 3 kilometres. The race welcomes both elite teams and recreational groups, with plenty of colour and imagination along the course. After the finish, activities, food for sale, and an awards ceremony with a prize draw await.
course_highlights: Relay course of approximately 3 kilometres per runner
Four runners per team
Course in Collegium Park at Linköping Science Park
additional: According to the existing event information, the race starts at 17:00. After the race, activities, food for sale, and an awards ceremony with a prize draw will be held.

name: Renforsin maraton, Kajaani
description: Renfors Marathon is a charity running event held in Kajaani, with proceeds supporting local youth sports. The event offers a wonderful route alongside Kajaani’s most beautiful river scenery and sights, including near the ruins of Kajaani Castle. Raatihuoneentori serves as the start and finish area, and the route follows the banks of the Kajaani River. In addition to the marathon, the event includes a half marathon, a quarter marathon, and children’s races for different age groups.

name: Kuikka-hölkkä
description: The Central Finland Village Jogging Series is a village running series held in Central Finland, offering participants the chance to enjoy running and a sense of community. The series has been running for several years and attracts runners from across the region. The event is relaxed and suitable for runners of all levels who want to experience the local running atmosphere.

name: AURANMAJA OFFROAD
additional: Auranmaja is currently closed from spring 2026. The proceeds from Auranmaja are used to support Kuivasjärven Aura athletics activities.

name: Kyröö-hölkkä 19.9.2026
description: Kyröö Run is a relaxed running event held in the beautiful rural landscapes of Isokyrö. The event offers suitable distances for both joggers and faster runners, and the race also determines the unofficial Finnish championship medals in gravel running. The start is at the Kyrö Visitor Centre, and the route runs through varied but flat terrain. Join us to enjoy the fun of exercise in good company and run where the asphalt ends!

name: Ylivieska Trail Run – Meleko hyvä polokujuoksutapahtuma
description: Ylivieska Trail Run is a trail-running event held at Törmälä Camp Centre and Rantakalla in Ylivieska. The event offers competitive categories for men and women over 14 km, as well as recreational and hiking categories over 1.5 km, 5 km and 11 km. Prizes are also available in the youth categories, and the youngest children can take part in a free stadium dash. An extended weekend at Jäkälähovi in Kalajoki will be drawn among all participants. The event offers a variety of options and is suitable for trail runners of different abilities.

name: HOKA Messilä Vertical
description: HOKA Messilä Vertical is a unique competition where the goal is to accumulate the most elevation gain within a given time. The race takes place at the Messilä Ski Resort in Hollola, and participants run a 1.2 km course with approximately 90 metres of ascent and descent per lap. There are three categories, with time limits of 1, 2 or 4 hours. The winner in each category is the participant who completes the most laps. The event is open to all ages, and the atmosphere is relaxed but challenging, making it suitable for both first-time and experienced runners.

name: ASTRI KESKUS Narva Sügisjooks 2026
location: Astri Keskus, Narva, Ida-Viru maakond, Estonia
description: Astri Keskus Narva Autumn Run 2026 is a running, walking and hiking event held in Ida-Viru County, inviting everyone who enjoys being active to take part. The event is part of the activities of the Centre of Excellence for Recreational Sport, which aims to promote a healthy and active lifestyle. The Autumn Run offers an opportunity to enjoy exercise and support your mental and physical health. Participants can choose the activity that suits them and share the joy of exercise with others.
course_highlights: Takes place around Astri Keskus in Ida-Viru County
Suitable for running, walking and hiking
An event that encourages participants to be active and promotes health
additional: The event includes running, hiking and walking and takes place on 19 September 2026. Registration is open, and the event is intended for all age groups and ability levels.

name: Jõhvi rahvajooks
organizer: Jõhvi kultuuri- ja spordinõunik Avo Sambla
description: The Jõhvi People’s Run is a traditional running event, taking place for the 39th time at Heino Lipp Stadium in Jõhvi. This year, the course has been updated: in addition to city streets, it also runs through a park and the shops of Pargi Centre. The event offers an exciting and varied running experience over both the 5 km and 10 km distances. Participants can look forward to a friendly atmosphere and a good sporting challenge.

name: 13. Saarepeedi mägede jooks
description: The 13th Saarepeedi Hills Run is a traditional running event held near the Saarepeedi Community Centre. The race gives participants the chance to enjoy beautiful scenery and hilly trails. It is suitable for both recreational and experienced runners looking to test their endurance and agility. The organizers welcome all running enthusiasts to take part and enjoy an active day.
