description: Kung Björn Loppet is a trail race in Uppsala that welcomes elite runners, recreational runners and children of all ages, with families at its heart. The race is held at OK Linné’s clubhouse and offers several distances, including a children’s race, 6 km, 10 km and a trail race of approximately 5 km. The courses consist of gravel roads, forest trails and asphalt, with water stations along the longer distances. After the race, there is an awards ceremony and a prize draw for participants.
course_highlights: Trail race on gravel roads, forest trails and asphalt
Courses of approximately 10 km and 6 km, plus a trail race of approximately 5 km
Two water stations on the 10 km course and one on the 6 km course
additional: Race bibs with electronic chips can be collected from Löplabbet the day before race day or on race day from 09:00. Changing rooms with showers and toilets are available at the event site, but space is limited. A kiosk sells drinks, hot dogs and baked goods. Start groups are available for the 10 km, with a choice of faster and slower groups. Paid parking is available, but public transport and cycling are recommended. The event includes race-bib collection with electronic chips and an awards ceremony.

name: Kistaloppet
location: Jan Stenbecks torg, Kista, Stockholm, Sweden
description: Kistaloppet is a popular running event in Kista, Stockholm, offering races for the whole family, with distances ranging from 400 metres for the youngest participants to 5 km for adults. The race passes through Kista’s distinctive surroundings, including the high-rise buildings of the Million Programme, the green spaces of Järvafältet and the IT cluster that has made Kista known as the Silicon Valley of Northern Europe. The event has a festive atmosphere, with music and entertainment along the course, and an inclusive spirit in which all participants receive a medal. Kistaloppet is organised by Löparakademin, a non-profit organisation that works to promote health and physical activity in suburban communities.
course_highlights: A 5 km measured course through Kista’s Million Programme neighbourhood and green spaces
Start and finish at Jan Stenbecks torg, in central Kista
Entertainment and music stations along the course to keep participants motivated
additional: Race numbers can be collected at the event centre in Kista Galleria, in the premises opposite McDonald’s, on Friday 12:00–18:00 and Saturday 09:15–13:00. Late registration is available on site, subject to availability. There is a water station at the finish. Medical staff will be on site. All participants receive a specially designed medal. Music and DJs along the course create a festive atmosphere. The published information applies to the 2026 edition and does not confirm the date or registration terms for 2027. The 2026 information also lists a 1.6 km untimed Fun Run and children’s races of approximately 1.6 km and 500 metres.

name: Black River Run, 100 miles
location: Västerås SOK clubhouse Orientalen, Västerås, Sweden
description: Black River Run is an ultramarathon in Västerås with several distances, including 100 miles, 50 miles, Instegsultra (48 km), 20 miles and 10 miles. The start, lap point and finish are at Västerås SOK’s clubhouse, Orientalen, which has changing rooms, showers and a sauna. The course consists of a 10-mile (16.1 km) loop with varied surfaces, including technical trails, jogging paths, gravel roads, hiking trails and asphalt. Runners who complete 100 miles in under 24 hours receive a belt buckle, while all other finishers receive a medal. Runners can donate their medal in support of Doctors Without Borders.
course_highlights: Varied surfaces: technical trails, jogging paths, gravel roads, hiking trails and asphalt
One loop is 10 miles (16.1 km)
Start, lap point and finish at Västerås SOK’s clubhouse, Orientalen, with changing rooms, showers and a sauna
additional: If you run 100 miles in under 24 hours, you receive a belt buckle. Runners can opt to forgo their medal in support of Doctors Without Borders; 20 kr per medal is then donated to the organization. Showers and a sauna are also available in the clubhouse near the start/finish. Runners who complete 100 miles within 24 hours receive a belt buckle; all other finishers receive a medal.

name: Klarälvsloppet Run 21k
description: Klarälvsloppet Run 21K is a fast and scenic half marathon on a gently descending, paved trail from Forshaga Learning Center to Karlstad. The course is completely traffic-free and has no steep climbs, providing ideal conditions for setting personal records. The race follows Klarälvsbanan through the Värmland countryside and offers a unique running experience on 90 kilometers of paved nature trail. There are three official refreshment stations along the course with water and sports drinks, and fruit and refreshments await at the finish. The race starts on Saturday at 10:30, with a group warm-up in the start area.
course_highlights: Gently descending paved trail from Forshaga to Karlstad
Completely traffic-free course with no steep climbs
Three official refreshment stations with water and sports drinks
additional: The start and race-bib distribution take place at Forshaga Learning Center from 09:00 to 10:00 on race day. Participants must finish within the time limit of 2:45. A minibus follows the field and picks up participants who do not meet the time limit. Buses run from Karlstad City Library to the start for those who have purchased bus transport. Fruit and refreshments are available at the finish. On-site payments are accepted only by card or Swish. Medical assistance is available at the start, finish, and refreshment stations. The organizer describes the race as a possible “Scandinavia’s fastest half marathon?”.

name: We Run Riga pusmaratons Mežaparkā

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Pasākuma dalības maksa iekļauj iespēju piedalīties visās pasākuma aktivitātēs un skrējienos, tai skaitā vairākās distancēs, ja pasākuma programma to ļauj, We Run Riga oficiālo Nike sporta T-kreklu, piemiņas medaļu un citus atbalstītāju sagatavotos labumus.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Pasākuma dalības maksa iekļauj iespēju piedalīties bērnu skrējienā un citās pasākuma aktivitātēs, We Run Riga oficiālo Nike sporta T-kreklu, piemiņas medaļu un citus atbalstītāju sagatavotos labumus.

description: The We Run Riga Half Marathon in Mežaparks is the biggest running festival of the autumn, taking place on 18 September in Mežaparks, Riga. The event offers a range of distances, including a half marathon, relay, 10 km and 5 km runs, as well as children’s races. Participants receive an official Nike running T-shirt, a commemorative medal and other benefits. The event is suitable for both experienced runners and beginners, and participants can take part in several distances at once, choosing their distance at the starting line.
course_highlights: Half marathon of 21.0975 km in Mežaparks
2 × 10.5 km relay
Races over various distances: 5 km, 10 km and children’s races
additional: Participants can take part in several distances at once, choosing their distance at the starting line. The entry fee includes an official Nike running T-shirt, a commemorative medal and other participant benefits.

name: Ulvøyløpet
organizer: Ulvøy Challenge (Melbu Idrettslag, Stokmarknes Idrettslag og Lekang Ski- og Bygdelag)
description: Ulvøyløpet is a beautiful trail race through Hadseløya’s stunning landscape in the heart of Lofoten and Vesterålen. The race offers two distances, 13 km and 26 km, with varied terrain featuring technical trails, forest roads and open mountain trails. Whether you’re looking for a challenge or a wonderful experience in nature, Ulvøyløpet offers spectacular views and flowing trails that let you pick up the pace. The event has a long tradition and is organised by volunteers in support of local sports clubs and children and young people.
course_highlights: 13 km course with 450 metres of elevation gain, featuring technical and steep trails, forest roads and open mountain trails
26 km course with 1,000 metres of elevation gain and varied terrain, including forest roads, technical trails and mountain landscape
Flowing trails between Moan and Barheia are a highlight of the long course
additional: The recreational class starts between 09:00 and 11:00. Race numbers can be collected at Corner Sport in Stokmarknes or at Stokmarknes Stadium on race day from 08:30. Drop-bag transport from the start to the finish and return transport from Melbu to Stokmarknes after the race are available. There is ample parking at the start and finish, and toilets are available. The café in the finish area is open from 11:00 to 16:30. The prize-giving ceremony takes place at approximately 14:30 at Havfisk Arena, Melbu. The courses are marked with flags and signs, and downloading the GPX file for navigation is recommended. Aid stations offer bananas, cordial, sports drink and water (bring your own cup). Littering along the course is prohibited. A recreational walk along the 13 km course is also available. Walking participants register at Stokmarknes Stadium and may start between 09:00 and 11:00.

name: Kullervo-maraton 2026
location: Joutsenen urheilukeskus, Joutsenon, Lappeenranta, South Karelia, Finland
description: This is a long-standing event offering Finland’s fastest marathon course, which is almost entirely paved and flat. The race offers a marathon, half marathon, 10 km and children’s mini marathon, making it suitable for runners of all abilities. The course is well signposted and has plenty of aid stations. Participants receive on-course refreshments, a medal, coffee, a sweet bun and soup lunch at the race restaurant.

name: KOMIA Kyrkösjärven kierros
description: KOMIA Kyrkösjärvi Loop is Seinäjoki’s legendary and popular running event, taking runners around Kyrkösjärvi. The event venue is Kyrkösjärvi Beach and the Käpälikkö Nature Centre, where the start, finish, parking and event centre are located. The main distance is a 15.4 km route. There is also the shorter, approximately 4.3 km Pikku Kyrkkäri for young people or as a jog, as well as the 400–500 m Mini Kyrkkäri for the youngest family members. The event offers a memorable running experience surrounded by nature and is open to participants in different age groups and categories.

name: Juutuanvaaran kymppi – polkujuoksu Inarissa 2026
location: Juutunvaaran vanha metsä, Inari, Lapland, Finland
description: Juutuanvaara Ten is a new trail-running event in Inari, offering memorable trails of various lengths for all runners. The route runs through the old forest of Juutunvaara, with varied terrain ranging from pine heath to mountain birch woodland and spectacular views of Lake Inari. The race starts at 12:00, and participants are offered honorary prizes and commemorative medals. The event is suitable for both recreational and competitive runners, and participants receive a race sausage and a drink.

name: ENERGIZER Baltic Beach Run 2026
description: ENERGIZER Baltic Beach Run brings runners and walkers to the coastal town of Narva-Jõesuu. The 2026 event was scheduled for September 20, with running and walking on the program. This sporting event, named a beach run, invites participants to take part on either a running or walking route.
course_highlights: Narva-Jõesuu coastal area
Running and walking options
additional: This does not match the date given in the query: 19.09.2027.

name: Rakvere 43. Rahvajooks
description: The 43rd Rakvere Folk Run is a traditional mass-sport event that welcomes all running enthusiasts. The race takes place at Rakvere City Stadium and offers a variety of distance options for both children and adults. The courses have been carefully chosen to provide an enjoyable running experience and promote a healthy lifestyle. The event is open to anyone sufficiently trained to complete their chosen distance.

name: Coop Linköping Runt
description: Coop Linköping Runt is a city race in Linköping, with Trädgårdsföreningen as its meeting place. Runners can come together for a day of exercise and the joy of running in a welcoming setting. The race is organized by Linköpings GIF, and registration for the 2026 edition is open.
course_highlights: Trädgårdsföreningen is the race’s meeting place.
The race takes place in Linköping.
Details of the course route are not available in the sources provided.
additional: Members of Linköpings GIF can participate for free in all categories with the campaign code LGIF2026.

name: Sicklaloppet
description: Sicklaloppet is Nacka’s big autumn running festival, with races for all ages and abilities. The main event is a 10 km recreational race along the beautiful lakeshores of Sickla and Hammarby Sjöstad, starting and finishing at Sickla Köpkvarter. There is also a 5 km Energiloppet, Lilla Sicklaloppet for children up to 12 years old, and Mini Sickla for the youngest runners. The races offer a scenic, fast course, a great atmosphere, and plenty of crowd support. Sicklaloppet is organised by Järla IF Orientering and is a public health event for Nacka and Stockholm.
course_highlights: The course runs along the lakeshores of Sickla and Hammarby Sjöstad
The surface consists of asphalt, gravel, and a wooden boardwalk
Start and finish at Sickla Köpkvarter, with spectators and musical entertainment
additional: The race venue opens at 08:00 at Marcusplatsen in Sickla Köpkvarter, with race-number pickup and on-site registration. Food trucks and partners will be on site. Lilla Sicklaloppet starts at times between 09:15 and 10:15 for different age groups. Sicklaloppet 5 km starts at 11:45, and the 10 km starts at 13:00. The time limit for the 10 km is 1 hour and 15 minutes, with a cut-off at Kyrkviken after approximately 7.5 km. The course has been officially measured by the Swedish Athletics Federation. All races start and finish at Sickla Köpkvarter. The race website describes the 2026 edition.

name: Kraftloppet
description: Kraftloppet is a relay race in Finspång with seven legs totalling about 31 kilometres. All legs start and finish at Grosvads IP, Arena Grosvad, and the race runs through scenic countryside in Finspång municipality. There are legs to suit everyone regardless of age or running form. The main organiser is Finspångs AIK Friidrott. The 2026 edition was held on Sunday 20 September with the start at 11:00.
course_highlights: Seven legs totalling about 31 km
Start and finish for every leg at Grosvads IP, Arena Grosvad
Classes for women's, men's and mixed teams
additional: A team has at least four different runners and one runner may run at most two legs. Mixed teams need at least two women. In 2026 the entry fee was 1,000 SEK per team (1,500 SEK after 12 September) and registration was through AnmälMigNu.

name: 20. ETAPP
description: The 20th stage is part of the running series organized by Stamina Sports Club and takes place on the Järve health trail in Tallinn. This stage gives participants the chance to enjoy a health trail close to the city, well suited to both recreational and experienced runners. The event is traditional and well organized, offering an enjoyable sporting experience and a sense of community. Participants can also enjoy beautiful nature and healthy exercise in the fresh air.

name: Rava järve jooks, Liikumissari 8.Järvamaa Järvede jooksud 9.etapp
description: The Rava Lake Run is part of the Liikumissari 8. Järvamaa Lakes Run Series and takes place by Lake Rava in Järvamaa. Runners of all ages take part, from toddlers to seniors. The race features a single lap around the lake, with prizes awarded to the fastest men and women. It is a traditional, community-focused running event that offers both a sporting challenge and a chance to enjoy nature.

name: TCS Lidingöloppet (Lidingöloppshelgen)
distance_verbose: 30 km, 15 km, 10 km, 5 km, 4 km, 1.7 km
description: TCS Lidingöloppet is the world’s largest cross-country race and a much-loved running challenge held annually on Lidingö since 1965. More than 30,000 runners gather during race weekend to run scenic, hilly courses, from short children’s races to the classic 30 km race, a true test of endurance. The race is a world-class celebration of running and a showcase for the joy of movement and public health, with nature always at its heart. Participants can also enjoy a sports expo featuring partners and exhibitors offering inspiration ahead of the race.
course_highlights: A hilly cross-country course featuring flat meadows, gravel roads and steep climbs
The 30 km race has 522 metres of elevation gain and is open for training around the clock before race day
Aid stations along the course offering sports drink, water, pickled cucumber, buns and bananas
additional: The sports expo at Lidingövallen takes place during race weekend, where participants collect their race bibs and can browse offers and expert advice. Free buses run between Ropsten and Lidingövallen during race weekend. Everyone who completes the race receives a medal featuring a unique Carl Milles design. Photographers are stationed along the course and at the finish, with photos available to purchase after the race. The course profile and elevation gains are presented by Garmin, with the PacePro™ feature for pace planning. Aid stations offer sports drink, water, pickled cucumber, buns and bananas. Lidingöloppet encourages environmentally friendly travel by public transport, bicycle or carpooling. Lidingöloppet weekend includes races for different ages and levels, from a 1.7 km children’s race.

name: 1. Full Moon Backyard Ultra Kymi
description: Backyard Ultra is an ultramarathon in which competitors run a 6.706-kilometre course within an hour. The race continues as long as multiple runners are able to complete a lap in under an hour, and the winner is the one who runs one lap more than the others. The course is either a loop or an out-and-back, and the start area remains the same throughout the race. There is no predetermined time limit, making the event especially challenging and exciting. Backyard Ultra races in Finland are organised in collaboration, and the sport is being actively developed.

name: Vihteljärven ympärijuoksu - 67.
description: Vihteljärvi Round-the-Lake Run is Satakunta’s oldest annual running event held continuously, having been organized since 1960. The event offers a 6.5-kilometer race in several age groups, as well as a fun run without timing. There are also separate shorter-distance races for children. The event is held at Vihteljärvi School in Kankaanpää and offers participants a traditional, community-oriented running experience in scenic surroundings.

name: Kiehimänjoen juoksu 2026
description: Kiehimänjoki Run is a running event held for the fifth time in Paltamo, offering a marathon, half marathon, 10K fitness run and children’s run. The event starts at 11:00, and the race centre is at Kotolinna, where runners can use the facilities, dine, enjoy the saunas and stay overnight. The courses are officially measured, and timing is provided in all categories. Runners can book a recovery massage after the race. On-site registration is available for an additional fee for adults.

name: Lampaloppet 2026
description: The route takes runners through the scenery of Honkavuori and introduces them to Ahto’s historical sites. The event offers a suitable challenge for both competitive runners and more casual participants. The competitive categories are timed, but there is also an untimed jogging category where participants can go at their own pace. Participants have access to drink stations, washing facilities, a sauna, and a Lampaloppet neck warmer.

name: ELKE Tallinn Run - Noblessner 2026
description: The ELKE Tallinn Run takes place in Noblessner, offering the joy of exercise and experiences for the whole family. This beautiful seaside area provides an ideal setting for both sporting activities and an enjoyable day out. Race day begins with a children’s run and offers a choice of distances to suit both beginners and experienced runners. In addition to sports, the programme includes a free concert and a varied programme, creating a wonderful atmosphere for all participants and spectators.
course_highlights: The beautiful seaside area of Noblessner
Views of Noblessner and North Tallinn
A variety of distances for children and adults
additional: Race day begins with the children’s run at 13:00. The 2.5 km and Stebby 5 km distances start at 14:30, and the Neptunas 10 km distance starts at 15:10. The event centre’s programme runs from 11:00 - 17:10. A free concert by INGER takes place at Noblessner Central Square at 13:40. Outdoor seaside setting, family-friendly, includes a run and a concert, autumn event

name: 44. Viking Window Paide-Türi rahvajooks
description: The Viking Window Paide-Türi Fun Run is a traditional mass-participation sporting event that brings together running enthusiasts from Järvamaa and beyond. The course features varied terrain, offering both challenges and beautiful views. The event is suitable for all age groups and, in addition to the main race, includes children’s runs and other active activities. Completing the course between Paide and Türi is an annual highlight that brings the community and sports enthusiasts together.

name: Tjurruset
description: Tjurruset is an annual cross-country race in Karlstad, featuring a course of approximately 10 kilometres with both natural and constructed obstacles. The race is known for its muddy, challenging terrain, with water, steep hills and creative obstacles, creating a fun, spectator-friendly festival. In addition to the main race, there are children’s races, Kalvruset and Minikalvruset, with shorter courses and child-friendly obstacles. Tjurruset attracts both experienced cross-country runners and enthusiastic recreational runners, all of whom enjoy a memorable, muddy experience.
course_highlights: Approximately 10 km course with natural and constructed obstacles
Terrain featuring mud, water and steep hills
Spectator-friendly spots near the muddiest and wettest obstacles
additional: Bib distribution starts at 09:00 at Norra fältet. The warm-up starts at approximately 13:45. The race bib and timing chip are handed out together; the chip is attached to the ankle and discarded after the race. Participants should change at home, as there are no changing rooms on site. Medical assistance is available at the finish and along the course. Late registration is available on site until 45 minutes before the start. Food service and Tjurruset tights are available for purchase in the event area. There is a team competition with teams of up to six people, with the five fastest times counting. Participants should be able to run 10 km on road or asphalt in under 90 minutes. The children’s races include Kalvruset, 2.5 km, and Minikalvruset, approximately 200–400 metres.

name: Gudö Run of Hope
description: Gudö Run of Hope is a beautiful trail race in Tyresö, held in support of the Swedish Childhood Cancer Fund. The race is celebrating its 10th anniversary and welcomes runners of all ages and abilities to run, walk or jog. Participants can choose from several distances, from 1 km to 10 km, as well as a 5 km walk. The event is part of the fight against childhood cancer and offers a meaningful and enjoyable experience in scenic surroundings.
course_highlights: A beautiful trail race in Tyresö
Several distances: 1 km, 3 km, 6 km, 10 km and a 5 km walk
Suitable for runners of all ages, big and small
additional: The race is organised by Gudö Sportklubb in Tyresö. Participants can run, walk or jog. The event encourages donations via Swish and QR code for those who cannot participate. The Swedish Childhood Cancer Fund is the organiser, and the contact persons can be reached via the email address provided. Proceeds go to the Swedish Childhood Cancer Fund.

name: Siguldas kalnu maratons (SKM)
organizer: Biedrība Kalnkāpēju sporta centrs sadarbībā ar IK Adventure Company
description: Sigulda Mountain Marathon (SKM) is Latvia’s hilliest trail race, held in the Sigulda area among steep hills and beautiful views of Gauja National Park. The event offers three distances: a full marathon of approximately 70 km with 3,000 metres of elevation gain, a 35 km half marathon, and a 10+ km mountain cross-country distance that is also suitable for walking. SKM tests both physical and psychological endurance, and the marathon distance is the Latvian Trail Running Championship. Participants receive unique finisher medals, and the course is regularly updated to keep it exciting and challenging.
course_highlights: The steep slalom slopes in the Sigulda hills have an elevation difference of up to 80 metres
The course includes Gauja National Park trails with stairs and impressive views
The full marathon distance is approximately 70 km with 3,000 metres of elevation gain and loss
additional: Participants completing the full marathon distance receive a unique finisher medal forged by blacksmith Jānis Banka. The 35 km and 70 km distances are worth ITRA points (2 and 3 points). The course is regularly adjusted and cleared to ensure the best conditions, taking into account natural conditions and storm damage. The 10+ km mountain cross-country distance is suitable for walking and is not intended for awards. The 2026 programme included approximately 70 km, 35 km, and a shorter distance. Participants in the longer races could earn ITRA points.

name: 62. Daugavpils skrējiens "Daugavpils-Mežciems"
description: The Daugavpils “Daugavpils-Mežciems” Run is a traditional event that promotes a healthy lifestyle and running as a mass-participation sport in Daugavpils and Latvia. The race takes place at Vienības Square in Daugavpils and offers several distances, including 10 km, a 5 km mass-participation run, and children’s races. The course is flat with slight inclines. The surface is mainly asphalt and paving stones, with a few short gravel sections. The event is open to all interested participants, subject to age restrictions, and offers race-bib collection on the day before the event and on race day.
course_highlights: The 10 km course is one loop on asphalt and paving stones
The 5 km mass-participation run and Nordic walking follow one 5 km loop
The terrain is flat, with slight, gradual inclines
additional: Race-bib collection takes place on 25 September from 14:00 to 19:00 and on 26 September from 9:00 at the Daugavpils Tourist Information Centre (Rīgas iela 22). Registration is not available on race day. Participant results are processed by SIA “MANI APĻI”. Results are recorded for the 10 km and 5 km runs for men and women.

name: Skrējiens “Apkārt Lielezeram”
description: The “Around Lielezers” race is a traditional autumn sporting event in Limbaži, bringing runners together for the tenth time. The competition offers two distances—13.7 km and 6 km—with participants able to compete for course records and cash prizes. The event is popular with local and visiting athletes alike, offering exciting competition and a wonderful autumn atmosphere by Lielezers. The organizers give the fastest runners extra motivation with increased cash prizes and the chance to beat previous records.
course_highlights: Two distances—13.7 km and 6 km
A chance to set course records and cash prizes for the fastest runners
A race around scenic Lielezers in Limbaži
additional: The fastest man and woman overall in each distance receive a €100 prize. If course records are broken, an additional €100 or €200 is awarded. The event is organized by Limbaži Municipality. Contact details: Rīgas iela 16, Limbaži; phone +371 64023003 and +371 28398978. At the 2026 competition, cash prizes were planned for the fastest men and women in both distances.

name: 58. Vihtijärvihölkkä
description: Vihtijärvihölkkä is a long-standing running event offering competitors the chance to take part in a half marathon, a 10-kilometre race and shorter distances. The routes pass through varied terrain, and several water stations serve runners along the way. The event is open to different age groups and categories and is held in the Vihtijärvi area. The race has been held 58 times, reflecting its popularity and tradition among locals.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 41. Jooks ümber Porkuni järve
description: Lääne-Virumaa Running Series is a traditional running and walking series offering a variety of distance options for different age groups and ability levels. The stages take place in beautiful locations across Lääne-Virumaa, giving runners both the excitement of competition and an enjoyable sporting experience. The main races, along with the youth and children’s races, are popular and encourage physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. The series’ stages have secured a firm place in runners’ calendars and hearts.

name: TCS Lilla Lidingöloppet (Rosa Bandet-loppet)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: TCS Lilla Lidingöloppet 250 kr till och med 26/9 2027

description: TCS Lilla Lidingöloppet (the Pink Ribbon Race) is an inspiring fun run held amid the beautiful natural surroundings of Lidingö. The race offers two distances, 4 km and 10 km, on gentle courses with an elevation gain of 209 metres. It is part of the Pink Ribbon campaign and aims to promote physical activity and raise awareness of cancer-preventive lifestyle habits. Everyone aged 9 and up is welcome to take part, and part of the entry fee goes directly to the Swedish Cancer Society. The race is an official launch event for the Pink Ribbon campaign and is organised in cooperation with the Swedish Cancer Society.
course_highlights: Gentle courses amid the beautiful natural surroundings of Lidingö
Two distances: 4 km and 10 km, with 209 metres of elevation gain
Course profile presented by Garmin with PacePro functionality
additional: All runners aged 9 and up for the 4 km and 11 and up for the 10 km are welcome. SEK 100 of the entry fee goes directly to the Swedish Cancer Society. All finishers receive a bronze medal featuring a unique Carl Milles design. Marathon Photos photographs participants along the course and at the finish. The course profile is presented by Garmin, with the PacePro™ function for pace planning. The race is part of Tjejklassikern and Kortklassikern. From 2025, there is a 4 km category for ages 9–15.

name: Izskrien Ogri
organizer: Ogres novada sporta centrs sadarbībā ar Ogres novada pašvaldību un biedrību “Sporta klubs SportLat”

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Līdz 14. septembrim dalības maksa 5 km un 10 km distancēm ir 10 eiro

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Līdz 14. septembrim dalības maksa bērnu skrējienam – 3 eiro

description: Izskrien Ogre is an annual running event held in the Birch Avenue Square in Ogre, bringing together experienced runners, families with children, and active-lifestyle enthusiasts. Participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km distances, as well as a children’s run of approximately 500 metres. The event is friendly and suitable for participants of various ages and fitness levels, offering a sporting atmosphere and the chance to enjoy running in an urban setting. It is organized by the Ogre Municipality Sports Centre in cooperation with Ogre Municipality and the “Sporta klubs SportLat” association.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Birch Avenue Square
5 km and 10 km routes through city streets and parks
A short children’s run of approximately 500 metres
additional: On race day, registration for the children’s runs is open from 9:00 to 10:30, while registration for the 5 km and 10 km distances is open until 11:30.

name: Kazdangas taku maratons
location: Atpūtas laukums pie Dzirnezera, Kazdanga, Latvia
description: The Kazdanga Trail Marathon is an annual trail-running event held at the recreation area by Lake Dzirnezers in Kazdanga. The race gives participants the opportunity to enjoy a scenic and challenging trail marathon course, with professional RFID timing. The event is suitable for both experienced trail runners and those looking to test themselves in a natural setting. Traditionally, the race brings together athletes from various places, creating a friendly and sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: A trail marathon course with varied terrain
Beautiful natural scenery by Lake Dzirnezers
Professional timing with RFID equipment

name: 16. ETAPP
description: The 16th stage is part of a recreational running series held in Tallinn. The event centre, start and finish are at Järve Health Trail, offering participants an enjoyable running and Nordic walking experience at the car park by the shared-use path. The route is easily accessible by car and public transport, making it convenient to take part. The series aims to offer everyone an opportunity to spend their free time in an active and healthy way.
course_highlights: Running and Nordic walking on Järve Health Trail
Start and finish at the car park by the Järve shared-use path
Easy access by car and public transport
additional: The event centre, start and finish are at the car park by the Järve shared-use path, at the Viljandi mnt end of Järve Health Trail. Those arriving by car are advised to park at Järve Selver, from where it is about a 400 m walk or jog to the event centre. Those travelling by bus should get off at the Risti stop, from where it is about a 300 m walk to the event centre.

name: Idrettsheialøpet 27
description: Idrettsheialøpet is a short race at Idrettsheia in Salangen, featuring a 1.5 km loop. Previous editions have used varied surfaces, including asphalt, gravel, artificial turf and grass. The course is mostly flat, with a couple of small climbs and descents along the way.
course_highlights: 1.5 km loop at Idrettsheia
Varied surfaces: asphalt, gravel, artificial turf and grass
Mostly flat course with two small climbs and descents per lap

name: Friday Night Run 2026
description: Friday Night Run is an energetic night run in central Tartu, taking place on 2 October at Town Hall Square. The distance is approximately 4 km, along city streets, offering a chance to enjoy the atmosphere of the autumn city with friends. This is not a race; participants can choose to run with or without timing. The event features music and a live concert, creating a lively evening atmosphere.
course_highlights: An approximately 4 km course in central Tartu
The course runs along city streets and park paths
One split-timing point on the timed distance
additional: The race number must be pinned to the chest and visible throughout the distance. The timing chip is attached to the back of the race number and is for single use. Participants have 45 minutes to complete the course; the finish closes at 21:45. The entry fee includes a marked course, race number, timing (if using a chip), services at the finish, and medical assistance if needed. Registration is available online until 2 October at 17:00 and on site until 20:30. The event includes online and on-site registration, medals and T-shirts for participants, and group discounts.

name: Vähäkangas hölkkä
description: Vähäkangas Hölkkä is a traditional running event held around Vähäkangas School in Ylivieska. The competition has categories for different age groups, and the race is 6.2 kilometres long. The event attracts participants from various areas and offers an enjoyable opportunity to compete and exercise together. The results and category listings reflect a diverse group of participants and the community-minded nature of the competition.
course_highlights: The running route is 6.2 kilometres long
The competition is held around Vähäkangas School
Categories for different age groups and genders

name: Loimaan Lenkki
description: Loimaan Lenkki is an autumn running event held in the centre of Loimaa. Four distances are available: 1.2 km, 2.4 km, 5.2 km and 10.4 km, making it suitable for a wide range of runners. The start is at Viljavarastontie 4, and the event offers a great opportunity to get active and enjoy a sense of community. Registration is open, and the event is organized by Loimaan Seudun Nuorkauppakamari.

name: KOMIA Esi-Talvijuoksusarja
description: The KOMIA Pre-Winter Running Series is a six-part winter running series that gives runners of all levels the opportunity to test themselves and track their fitness progress. The fast, flat routes start at Pajuluoma School and offer 2 km, 5 km, and 10 km distances. The series begins with the Pre-Winter Run in early October and continues into spring. The top performers are rewarded at the end of the series, and the races are suitable for recreational and competitive runners alike.

name: Keurusselän Syyslenkki
description: Keurusselkä Autumn Run is a varied autumn event in the beautiful scenery of Keuruu, offering trail running and mountain biking. The trail run has two distances, 6.4 km and 12 km, while mountain biking offers several distances in different categories, including children’s and e-bike categories. The event also includes children’s runs and the option to enjoy the hotel spa as part of the entry fee. The routes pass through the terrain around Resort Keurusselkä and Montosvuori, featuring hilly running and technically varied trails. Participants can also enjoy offers at the hotel restaurant on event day.

name: 16. Tartu Linnamaraton
description: The 16th Tartu City Marathon is a traditional autumn running event held in Tartu, starting on Vabaduse Boulevard and finishing at Town Hall Square. The event features three distances: a full marathon (42 km), a half marathon (21 km), and a 10 km run, suitable for both runners and walkers. The courses pass through the city of Tartu and offer intermediate timing points and strong event support, including transport for participants who withdraw. Participants receive medals and personalized diplomas, and 42 km finishers also receive a finisher T-shirt. The event is part of the Tartu Marathon Classic series and also offers a virtual run.
course_highlights: Start and finish in central Tartu: Vabaduse Boulevard and Town Hall Square
Intermediate timing points on the marathon course at 10 km, 21.1 km, and 30 km
Courses are suitable for both runners and walkers, with separate start groups for Nordic walkers
additional: Entry fees are non-refundable, but upon presentation of a medical certificate by 01.10.27 at 17:00, half of the entry fee will be credited to the participant’s user account. A 30% discount is available to pensioners of the Republic of Estonia and young people up to 18 years old; a 10% discount is available for groups of at least 10 people. Discounts do not apply on the morning of race day. Timing for all distances starts at the starting signal; results for runners and walkers are published together. Transport to the finish is provided for participants who withdraw. Finishers of the 42 km distance receive a finisher T-shirt. The event centre is open at Town Hall Square, where race numbers are distributed and sports goods are sold. Participants receive a medal and a personalized diploma; 42 km finishers also receive a finisher shirt.

name: 15. Tartu Linnamaratoni Lastejooksud
description: The Tartu City Marathon children's races are open to all children, with the joy of taking part as the main goal. Recommended guidelines apply to distances and age groups, but every child is welcome on the course and treated equally. Bib numbers are issued one hour before the start, and the event is not ranked. The event takes place in Tartu Town Hall Square, with registration available both in advance and on site.

name: Broloppet Motala
description: Broloppet Motala is a popular running race organised by Motala AIF Friidrott, starting and finishing in Stadsparken in Motala. The race features a renewed old course that runs through central parts of Motala, offering a pleasant running experience in an urban setting. There are two distances, 5 km and 10 km, with the 10 km race having a separate lane for lapping on the first lap. Water stations are available at the bridge and at the lap point to give runners the best possible support.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Stadsparken, centrally located in Motala
Renewed old course through the city centre
Water stations at the bridge (approx. 3 km) and at the lap point
additional: Late registration takes place on race day, 3/10, from 10:00 to 12:30 at Team Sportia. Race bibs can be collected at Team Sportia on Friday 2/10 from 10:00 to 18:00 and Saturday 3/10 from 10:00 to 12:30. Changing facilities are available at Actic Stora Torget. Bag drop is by the stage.

name: Förbifartspremiären
description: The Förbifartspremiären is a unique race held only once, giving participants the opportunity to run or walk on the new E4 between Hjulsta and Häggvik, both above and below ground. The race offers different classes and distances for all levels, from walking to racing, with the start and finish at the new Akalla interchange in Stockholm. It’s a once-in-a-lifetime experience where you get to be the first to set foot on the new road before it opens to traffic.
course_highlights: The race runs both above and below ground on the new E4 Förbifart Stockholm
Start and finish at the new Akalla interchange
In the recreational class, you can choose an exit after approximately 4, 7 or 12 km
additional: Race bibs are either mailed to participants’ homes or collected on site, depending on the participant’s address. The competitive class starts at 09:00, the recreational class has start times between 10:00 and 17:30, and the walking class Herr Gårman starts between 18:00 and 19:30. The maximum time for the competitive class is 1 hour and 30 minutes. Entry is personal and cannot be transferred. The event area is easiest to reach by metro to Akalla.

name: Avesta Night Sky Run
description: Avesta Night Sky Run is an autumn event organized by Dalaportens OL in Avesta. The race offers an exciting running experience in scenic surroundings and is part of Dalaportens orienteering activities. Participants can register via MittLopp and enjoy a well-organized event with good service. Together with Backyard Ultra, it creates a unique running weekend in October.
course_highlights: Running in scenic surroundings around Avesta
Part of Dalaportens OL’s autumn event
Backyard Ultra with 6.7 km laps and a mass start every hour
additional: Backyard Ultra starts at 11:00 on October 3, on a 6.7 km course that is mostly on a shared walking and cycling path. A new lap starts every hour, with a mass start, and the competition continues until only one participant remains. A refreshment station with drinks and energy supplies is available at the lap point. Registration for Backyard Ultra is by email to AvestaUltra@outlook.com, with an entry fee of 350 kr. Maximum 80 participants. Previous editions have been held together with Avesta Backyard Ultra.

name: Avesta Backyard Ultra
description: Avesta Backyard Ultra is a backyard ultra in Avesta organised by the orienteering club Dalaportens OL. The 6,706 metre lap runs mostly on walking and cycle paths from the Åsbo outdoor area, with start and finish at Slalombacken Åsbo. A new lap starts with a joint start every full hour and the race goes on until only one runner is left. The 2026 edition was held on Saturday 3 October with the start at 11:00.
course_highlights: 6.7 km lap with a joint start every full hour
Start and finish at Slalombacken Åsbo
Results available from every edition since 2018
additional: A well-stocked depot with drinks and energy is at the lap change, but there is no drink station out on the lap. Everyone who completes at least one lap gets a final result. In 2026 entry was by email to AvestaUltra@outlook.com, the fee was 350 SEK and the field was capped at 80.

name: Hiit Out Trailrun 12 km
description: HIIT OUT Trailrun is a trail race offering varied terrain with forest, trails, elevation changes and technical sections in Mellingerum, Oskarshamn. The race focuses not only on finishing time but also on the experience along the way, with a challenge, the joy of running and a wonderful experience in nature. The 12 km distance is one of several course options, suitable for both experienced trail runners and beginners aged 15 and over. The event has a welcoming atmosphere, with dedicated volunteers and spectators.
course_highlights: Varied terrain with forest and trails
Elevation changes and technical sections
A nature-rich experience along the trails
additional: Everyone aged 15 and over is welcome to take part. The race is organised with a focus on the experience and the joy of running, not just race time. Results from previous years show participation in the 8 km, 12 km and 16 km distances. A medal is awarded at the finish.

name: Dubultmaratons Taisnais Ērgļu stacijā
location: Sauriešu dzelzceļa stacija, Saurieši, Ropaži Municipality, Latvia
description: Dubultmaratons Taisnais is an endurance race along the embankment of the former Saurieši–Ērgļi railway line. The routes are marked and easy to follow, and can be completed by running, Nordic walking, or walking while enjoying Latvia’s beautiful natural scenery. The race offers three distances: double marathon (84.4 km), marathon (42.195 km), and half marathon (21.0975 km). It is organized by the Taisnais association in cooperation with the municipalities of Ogre and Madona. The start and finish are at railway stations. The race aims to promote a healthy lifestyle and identify Latvia’s most enduring long-distance runners and Nordic walkers.
course_highlights: The route follows the embankment of the former Saurieši–Ērgļi railway line
A flat sandy path with no climbs, passing through dense forest, open areas, and over river bridges
The start and finish are at railway stations, and the course is clearly marked
additional: Participants must be at least 18 years old. Spectators may accompany participants on foot or by bicycle without disturbing others, but may not help them move along the course. Finish times differ for runners and Nordic walkers in each distance.

name: Noķer vēju
location: Daugava Museum recreation area, Dole Island, Salaspils, Latvia
description: Your autumn half marathon “Catch the Wind” is a traditional running event held on Dole Island in Salaspils, along scenic forest trails. The race offers three distances: 21 km, 10 km and 5 km, allowing you to choose the challenge that suits you best. The start and finish are at the Daugava Museum recreation area, near the “Nēģis” tavern. Participants can expect water stations along the course, a hot meal at the finish, awards in age groups, and a special commemorative gift for the 15th edition.
course_highlights: Scenic forest trails on Dole Island
Water stations along the course
Start and finish near the “Nēģis” tavern at the Daugava Museum recreation area
additional: The 21 km distance consists of 4 laps, the 10 km distance of 2 laps, and the 5 km distance of 1 lap. Participants can look forward to a hot meal at the finish. In the overall 21 km classification, the top 6 women and men are awarded. Water stations are provided along the course, and a hot meal is served at the finish. Registration and race regulations are available at Sportlat.lv.

name: Lāčplēšu kross Rīgas Mežaparkā
description: Lāčplēšu Cross is a patriotic trail and obstacle race held in Riga’s Mežaparks. The event offers a range of distances for both children and adults, with participants following a marked course featuring natural and man-made obstacles. It brings together participants of different ages and fitness levels, including accomplished athletes, and fosters a sense of patriotism and unity through sporting activities. All participants receive a commemorative medal at the finish, and the fastest runners in the main distances receive cash prizes.
course_highlights: Marked course through Mežaparks’ trails and meadows
Natural obstacles: sandy areas, roots and forest terrain
Man-made obstacles on various distances
additional: The event centre is located in the Great Meadow of Mežaparks. During the event, younger participants can take part in craft workshops, try archery and watch knight demonstrations. There are also interactive games about waste sorting and green living. An awards ceremony and a raffle with valuable prizes take place after the races. Participants can buy food and drinks at the event centre.

name: Tromsø Backyard Ultra
description: Tromsø Backyard Ultra is a unique Arctic ultrarun in the heart of Tromsø, where participants run a 6.7 km loop every hour. The race challenges endurance and tactics, as each loop must be completed within an hour to continue. It is suitable for all levels, whether you want to test your limits or take part in a social and motivating training session. The race takes place on Tromsdalen’s beautiful network of trails, mostly on gravel roads with some asphalt, offering a special experience in Northern Norwegian nature.
course_highlights: 6.7 km loop in Tromsdalen
The course is mostly on gravel roads, with some asphalt
Start/finish outside TUIL Arena in Tromsdalen
additional: Race bibs must be collected well before the race. Parking is available at Entrance A or Elvestrand Cemetery. Discounted accommodation may be available at Tromsø Lodge and Camping. Participants run one loop every hour and must be ready at the start line when the next loop begins. All starters receive a participant medal. The winners in the women’s and men’s categories are determined after 24 loops. Distances build up over the loops: 4 loops is approximately 26.8 km, 7 loops approximately 46.9 km, 12 loops approximately 80 km, and 15 loops approximately 100.6 km.

name: Solvalla Trail
location: Solvalla Sports Institute, Nuuksio, Espoo, Finland
description: The event offers runners the chance to enjoy scenic trails on two different distances: 9 km and 18 km. Esbo IF organizes the event, which is suitable for both experienced trail runners and recreational runners. Join us for a fast-paced and memorable trail-running event amid stunning scenery.

name: Hostruset

price_tiers.distance: 5 km Män, Kvinnor, PF19, Veteraner 50+ och Motion

description: Hostruset is a fast 5 km race and fun run held in Örebro, starting and finishing at Björkhagaskolan. The course follows cycle paths around Varbergaskogen and has been officially measured by the Swedish Athletics Association. The race is part of the Södra Svealand Running Series and offers both competitive and recreational classes. There is also a 700-metre children’s race for the youngest participants. Changing rooms and showers are available on site. Due to limited parking, the organisers encourage carpooling or cycling.
course_highlights: Fast 5 km course on cycle paths around Varbergaskogen
Starts and finishes at Björkhagaskolan in Örebro
Officially measured by a course measurer in accordance with the Swedish Athletics Association
additional: Start groups are being tested for the 5 km race: runners expecting to finish in over 25 minutes start at 12:30, and those expecting to finish in under 25 minutes start at 12:45. Race numbers are distributed on race day. Timing is done using transponders, which must be returned after the race; otherwise, a charge of 400 kr applies. The prize ceremony takes place in the start/finish area, with honorary prizes for the top 5 in Men/Women and the top 3 in PF19 and Veteran 50+. Changing rooms and showers are available at Björkhagaskolan. Parking is very limited; carpooling or cycling is recommended.

name: Piebalgas ZELTA skrējiens/pārgājiens
description: The Piebalgas ZELTA run/hike is a unique trail run and hike in the scenic Piebalga area, encompassing hilly meadows, wild trails and sites of cultural and historical significance. The routes pass through the parishes of Jaunpiebalga and Vecpiebalga, using the Zelta Krogs ski trails and visiting places such as the Vēveri Open-Air Museum, the E. Dārziņš Museum “Jāņaskola”, Bricu and Draugoļu lakes, and the area’s highest point, Telviešu Hill. The finish is near the ruins of the historic Zelta Krogs. The event offers various distances for children and adults, as well as a hike without timekeeping.
course_highlights: The route passes through labyrinths of hilly meadows and wild trails
Sights include the Vēveri Open-Air Museum, the E. Dārziņš Museum “Jāņaskola”, and Bricu and Draugoļu lakes
Highest point: Telviešu Hill (261 m); finish near the ruins of Zelta Krogs
additional: Distances: 2.5 km children’s run (up to 12 years old), 11 km people’s run (from age 13), 24 km Zelta run (from age 16), and an 11/24 km hike without timekeeping. The 11 km people’s run is for participants aged 13 and over, the 24 km run for those aged 16 and over, and the 2.5 km children’s run for children up to 12 years old. The hiking distances are not timed.

name: /M.Pirksaare/Türi Tehisjärve jooks, liikumissari 8. Järvamaa Järvede jooksud 11. etapp
description: The Türi Artificial Lake Run is part of the 8th Järvamaa Lakes Running Series, offering a variety of running opportunities for different age groups. The course loops around Rava Artificial Lake and features varied terrain of sand, soil and gravel. The best runners will be awarded, and the event is suitable for both recreational runners and young running enthusiasts. The event takes place on October 7, 2026, by Lake Rava in Järvamaa.

name: Dark Run Lahti
description: Dark Run Lahti is a unique running experience held on a darkening autumn evening amid the stunning scenery of Salpausselkä. The event offers 5 km and 10 km distances suitable for participants of all fitness levels. Runners follow outdoor trails for most of the route by headlamp, and the event also includes the optional Dark Forest horror experience, which adds excitement along the course. The atmospheric event center is located at Lahti Sports Center, and the run is followed by an awards ceremony and prize draws.

name: Joutenlammen Jotos 2026, Kajaani
description: Joutenlammen Jotos is a running event organized by Kajaani Parish and held at the Joutenlampi course center. The event offers three distances: the main 10 km run for adults, a 3 km run for young people, and a children’s run of approximately 1.5 km. The route runs mainly along gravel roads. The event begins at 11:00 with a forest church service, followed by soup lunch. Joutenlammen Jotos is a community-oriented, family-friendly event that invites people of all ages to get active and enjoy nature.

name: Hercules Trail Run
description: Hercules Trail Run is a trail running event being held for the tenth time, inviting runners to experience Porvoo’s most beautiful trails and seaside scenery in the fresh October air. The event offers a variety of route options for all fitness levels, from the 2 km children’s Trail Dash to a 42 km trail run. Race day begins with the children’s Trail Dash and continues with several different distances, taking runners along beautiful and varied trails in the Porvoo area. The entry fee includes a range of services, and photos and videos will be taken during the event and used for event communications.

name: Säkylänharjun polkujuoksu
description: The event offers trail-running enthusiasts a variety of routes, including one that passes through Klopin monttu. The event centre is conveniently located, and the event is known for its proven concept. Participants can choose from different distances and enjoy the tranquillity of nature and varied terrain.

name: 42. Munamäe–Võru maastikujooks-kõnd
description: The 42nd Munamäe–Võru cross-country run and walk is part of the Võrumaa running and walking series, which offers a variety of distances for both runners and walkers. The main distance follows trails and asphalt roads, providing a varied course in the Võru area. The series also includes shorter distances and children’s runs, suitable for participants of all ages. The event takes place at the SA Võru Sports Centre ski base in Kubija, known for its beautiful natural surroundings and good course conditions.

name: Ultunamilen

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Gratis för medlemmar i Upsala IF Friidrott

description: For many years, Ultunamilen was organized by Upsala IF, but in 2026 it will be replaced by Gränbyloppet, held in Gränbyparken in Uppsala. Gränbyloppet focuses on the joy of running and safety in the area, with the start and finish near IFU Arena. The race is part of Terrängserien and offers several categories and distances for young people and adults, on a course that runs through the park and its surroundings.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the intersection northeast of the pergola in Gränbyparken
Course in Gränbyparken with 2.5 km laps (blue course)
The race is held alongside the final event of Terrängserien
additional: All participants must wear a visible race number. The nearest parking is at Gränbystaden. The final day of Terrängserien is held alongside Gränbyloppet for young people aged 14 and under. Results are published around the time of the race.

name: Mental Health Run
description: Mental Health Run is a charity race that aims to highlight the importance of physical activity for mental health. The race takes place at the Swedish Maritime Museum in Stockholm and offers an easy-to-run 5 km course around Djurgårdsbrunnsviken. All participants contribute to psychiatric research, as all proceeds go directly to this cause. Mental Health Run welcomes everyone, regardless of background or fitness level, and promotes community and the joy of movement.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Swedish Maritime Museum
Easy-to-run/walk 5 km course around Djurgårdsbrunnsviken
Course through the scenic surroundings of Djurgården
additional: A medal can be selected as an optional extra when registering. The dog race is a special event where participants run or walk together with their dog, which must be kept on a leash throughout the race. The dog race focuses on the joy of movement and community rather than performance. Participation is at your own risk, and dog owners are responsible for their dogs. Participants in the dog race start at the back of the field. There is also a virtual race from 10–31 October 2027. A medal is included for in-person participants. The deadline to register for the in-person race is 8 October 2027 at 12:00.

name: Umemaran
organizer: Jalles TC Umeå och IFK Umeå
description: Umemaran is a running festival that brings runners together in Umeå and is organized by Jalles TC together with IFK Umeå. The event offers both a marathon and a half marathon on a fast, scenic course that follows the Ume River via Ön on both sides. It has been a tradition since 1973 and also serves as the Northern Norrland Championships for the marathon. Participants are offered refreshments every four kilometres, a medal at the finish, and coffee and a sandwich after the race.
course_highlights: A fast course that follows the Ume River via Ön on both sides
Every kilometre is marked, and the course has been officially measured by an SFIF certified course measurer
Refreshment stations with Umara sports drink and water approximately every four kilometres
additional: Slow runners with finish times of 4:45 or longer may start at 10:00 after registering in advance. Changing facilities and showers are available at Jubileumshallen near the start area. Bibs and chips must be collected no later than 45 minutes before the start at Tegs Centralskola, with collection also available the day before at Team Sportia Ersboda. The prize ceremony takes place immediately after the 21 km race and at approximately 16:20 for the 42 km race in the auditorium at Tegs Centralskola. Everyone who completes the 42 km race has a chance to win a bicycle in a draw at the prize ceremony. The marathon is the Northern Norrland Championships for seniors and veterans.

name: Tjurruset
organizer: Marathongruppen tillsammans med Hässelby SK och Spårvägens FK
description: Tjurruset is a challenging and fun trail race in Norra Djurgården, Stockholm, where participants can choose between 5 or 10 kilometres. The race features muddy sections, trail paths and wet conditions, and is perfect for anyone who doesn’t mind getting dirty and wants a different kind of running experience. Showers and rinse-off facilities are available after the race, and the event is marked by a spirit of community where determination matters more than running technique. Tjurruset is organised by Marathongruppen together with the athletics clubs Hässelby SK and Spårvägens FK, and the surplus goes back to sport.
course_highlights: Terrain with muddy sections and wet conditions
Trail paths in Norra Djurgården
Challenging forest terrain with natural obstacles
additional: Warm showers are available in tents a few minutes’ walk from the finish, along with basic rinse-off facilities right after finishing. There are collection points for clothes that cannot be taken home. Shoes with good grip and clothes you don’t mind getting dirty are strongly recommended, as the mud can suck a shoe off mid-stride. Companies and larger groups can arrange a joint registration and book a company tent.

name: Terräng DM
description: Welcome to the District Championships in cross-country running, held at Nytorp sports field near Hammarby Södra School. The race features a course that is mostly on grass, with a short 70-metre hill on asphalt. Runners in different age groups and masters categories can take part over a range of distances. Bib numbers and check-in are at the race office by the start area.
course_highlights: The course is mostly on grass
A 70-metre hill on asphalt
Start and finish at Nytorp sports field near Hammarby Södra School
additional: Check-in and bib numbers are at the race office beside the start. The events include youth and masters categories. Check-in and bib numbers are collected at the race office next to the start.

name: Gränbyloppet
price_range: 100–200 kr för icke-medlemmar (2026 års priser); gratis för medlemmar i Upsala IF Friidrott
description: Gränbyloppet is organized by Upsala IF Friidrott and takes over from Ultunamilen, with a focus on the joy of running in Gränbyparken in Uppsala. The race takes place in conjunction with Terrängserien and offers several categories and distances for youth and adults. The start and finish are at the intersection just northeast of the pergola in the middle of Gränbyparken, near IFU Arena. The race is open to both members and non-members, with a simple and clear online registration process.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the intersection northeast of the pergola in Gränbyparken
Course in Gränbyparken with a blue 2.5 km loop
The race is held in conjunction with the final event of Terrängserien
additional: All participants must wear a clearly visible race bib. The start and finish are approximately 800 metres from IFU Arena. The nearest parking is at Gränbystaden. The final day of Terrängserien is held in conjunction with Gränbyloppet for youth aged 14 and under. The race takes place in conjunction with Terrängserien, whose final day is aimed at youth aged 14 and under. Information about distances and fees applies to the 2026 edition.
