description: Stirnu buks is a popular trail running series held on Latvia’s most beautiful forest trails, offering a range of distances for participants of different ages and fitness levels. The series aims to bring participants into nature, where they can improve their physical and mental well-being while enjoying scenic routes. The Grand Finale in Priekuļi is one of the series’ final and most anticipated events, bringing together trail runners from all over Latvia. The event welcomes both beginners and experienced athletes, and also offers special distances for young people and children.
course_highlights: Routes and trails with varied surfaces — asphalt, gravel, forest roads and off-road terrain
Five different distances are available for different age groups
The race takes place on scenic trails in Latvia’s forests
additional: Participants can register on the event website in the “Your profile” section. Last-minute registration is available on race day no later than 30 minutes before the start of the relevant distance. “ENEFIT Taku gājējs” participants start first; hiking participants can set off on the course from 9:00 to 10:30, with no timing. After 12:00, fast runners may be encountered on the courses. Discounts are available for juniors, seniors and special groups. Season passes are available at a discount, and the fee varies depending on the time of registration.

name: Bėgimas Gintarinė jūrmylė
organizer: Klaipėdos miesto sporto bėgimo klubas “Gintarinė jūrmylė”
description: “Amber Sea Mile” is an international running race held in beautiful Smiltynė. The event offers a range of distances: 0.5 nautical miles for children, 1 nautical mile for anyone who wants to take part, 3 nautical miles for women, and 6 nautical miles for men and professionals. The start and finish are at the Sports and Wellness Base, and participants are treated to army-style porridge and tea. The race tradition commemorates the winners’ names on a memorial stone raised from the bottom of the lagoon.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 7. Võsu Sügisjooks
description: The Lääne-Virumaa Running Series is a traditional running and walking series that offers a variety of running opportunities for different age groups and ability levels. The stages take place in the Lääne-Virumaa region, offering runners beautiful scenery and an enjoyable sporting experience. Võsu Autumn Run is the 7th stage of the series. It takes place in the Võsu Laine area and is part of a long-running traditional race series. The series aims to motivate people to stay active and enjoy running and recreational sport.

name: 71. Viljandi Linnajooks
description: The Viljandi City Run is a traditional endurance race held every year on the second Sunday of October in the city of Viljandi. The race route goes around Lake Viljandi, and the event is one of Estonia’s oldest sporting competitions, attracting top runners from across the country. In addition to the main race, several recreational sports events take place, including children’s races for different age groups. The Viljandi City Run course is 10.4 km long, offering an energetic and enjoyable experience for both recreational runners and professional athletes.

name: Hässelbyloppet / Lilla Hässelbyloppet
location: Hässelby IP, Loviselundsvägen 100, Hässelby, Stockholm, Sweden

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmälningsavgiften är 175 kr och höjs den 1 oktober till 220 kr.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Anmälningsavgiften är 175 kr och höjs den 1 oktober till 220 kr.

description: Hässelbyloppet is a classic 10 km race held in northwestern Stockholm, featuring a flat, fast course through Hässelby, Grimsta, Råcksta and Vällingby. The race has a long tradition and is organised by Hässelby SK Friidrott. The same day also features Lilla Hässelbyloppet, a children’s and youth race with shorter distances and timing for participants aged 9 and over. The course is officially measured, and the race is sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association. The start and finish are at Hässelby Idrottsplats, near the metro.
course_highlights: Flat, fast 10 km course through northwestern Stockholm
Start and finish at Hässelby Idrottsplats, near the metro
Lilla Hässelbyloppet for children and young people, with timing for participants aged 9 and over
additional: Pacers are available from 37:30 to 60 minutes. Bib pickup opens the day before the race. Lilla Hässelbyloppet offers timing for participants aged 9 and over, and refreshments and snacks after the finish. Hässelbyloppet starts in a large field about 400 metres from Hässelby Idrottsplats. Lilla Hässelbyloppet has bibs and timing for participants aged 9 and over. The start and finish are at Hässelby IP, Loviselundsvägen 100. The official website lists 3 October 2027 as the date of Hässelbyloppet.

name: Latvijas čempionāts krosa skrējienā
description: The Latvian Cross Country Running Championships is a prestigious competition featuring athletes from various age groups, from youth to masters. The competition takes place over different distances and is a significant event in Latvia’s athletics calendar. The event brings together professional athletes and amateurs, offering a challenge and the opportunity to compete for Latvian champion titles. Traditionally, the competition is held in October and is organised by the Latvian Athletics Association.
course_highlights: The competition features different distances for various age groups
Held on cross-country courses with varied surfaces and terrain
An opportunity to compete for Latvian champion titles
additional: The competition includes the U12, U14, U16, U18 and U20 age groups, adults and masters. The event is organised by the Latvian Athletics Association. Previous competitions have been held in Carnikava, while the 2027 competition is planned for Daugavpils.

name: Nummela BackYard Ultra
description: Nummela Backyard Ultra is an ultramarathon running event in which competitors run 6.706-kilometre laps within an hour, continuing for as long as multiple runners are able to keep going. The competition is unique because it has no predetermined finishing time or distance, and the winner is the one who runs one more lap than the others. The event is held at the Polku Hotel in Vihti and offers a challenge for runners who value perseverance and endurance. The competition originated in the United States and is also known as “Just one more Loop.”

name: Night Trail Run 30 km
description: Night Trail Run is a unique trail race in Sollentuna, focused on the experience of darkness and nature. The race offers several distances, including a challenging 30 km course where runners navigate using GPS and a map. The start and finish are at Väsby gård, and the course is marked with reflectors to create a magical atmosphere in the glow of headlamps. The race is open to runners aged 18 and over, with special rules for younger participants on the shorter distances.
course_highlights: Course marked with clear reflectors for a night-running experience
Navigation using GPS and a map on the 21 km and 30 km distances
Start and finish at Väsby gård in Sollentuna
additional: Flexible start time between 18:00 and 19:30 for the 5 km and 10 km. The 21 km and 30 km start on Saturday, October 17, at 16:45 and 16:00, respectively. Minimum age is 18, but participants aged 15–18 may run the 5 km and 10 km if accompanied by an adult. A good headlamp is recommended, preferably with an extra lamp for the 30 km. The time limit for the 30 km is 4 hours and 30 minutes. Aid stations are available along the 21 km and 30 km courses. Previous organizer information states an age limit of 18 and a 4-hour-and-30-minute time limit for the 30 km.

name: 53. Saaremaa kolme päeva jooks
description: The Saaremaa Three-Day Run is a traditional running event in Kuressaare, inviting all running enthusiasts to take part. The competition offers several distance options and age groups, with opportunities for both young people and adults. Registration takes place on site, and the entry fee is affordable, making the event accessible to a wide range of participants. The competition is part of a larger running series, which also includes season standings and an awards ceremony.

name: Hiidenkierros
description: Hiidenkierros is a trail-running event held at Neitvuori in Mikkeli. The routes pass through beautiful and varied terrain, with technical trail sections, rocky terrain and stunning views of Lake Saimaa. The event offers several distances for different age groups, with aid stations and lean-tos along the routes. There is also a group warm-up and a hot lunch at the finish.
course_highlights: Neitvuori rises 100 metres directly from Lake Saimaa
Plenty of technical trail sections and varied terrain
Stunning views of Lake Saimaa, with several lean-tos and campfire spots along the route
additional: The race office and café are open from 9:00 to 18:00. Registration at the race office is available from 9:00 to 10:30, including late registration. Timing is done using chips worn on both feet. The entry fee includes energy and hydration supplies along the route and a hot lunch at the finish. The race centre has a sauna available for short visits, toilets and a race café. The route is well marked with wooden stakes and plastic tape. Gear can be stored at the race centre at your own risk.

name: Saaremaa Kolme Päeva Jooks
description: Saaremaa Three-Day Run is a traditional running competition held in the village of Iide. The competition consists of three stages, where participants can enjoy Saaremaa’s beautiful nature and varied terrain. The competition is open to different age groups and offers a friendly, supportive atmosphere for all running enthusiasts. Participants are provided with electronic timing, reusable race bibs and drinking cups, and a sweet treat and a drink after the run.

name: Stockholm Cross Country
description: Stockholm Cross Country is a cross-country race in Stockholm organized by Turebergs Fri-idrottsklubb. The race offers challenging distances in scenic surroundings on Gärdet, with courses of 2.5 km and 5 km. It is a popular race for both recreational runners and competitive runners looking to test their cross-country ability in a beautiful setting close to the city. The event has a long tradition and attracts runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Cross-country race in scenic surroundings on Gärdet in Stockholm
Two distances: 2.5 km and 5 km
Organized by Turebergs Fri-idrottsklubb

name: Vistakulle Backyard
description: Vistakulle Backyard is a running event in the Vistakulle area near Gränna, organised by Rudu Friskvård in collaboration with Bauer Activities. The race is for those who are a little adventurous and interested in fitness, and places as much emphasis on experiencing nature as on performance. The event is held and offers a memorable course in hilly terrain close to nature.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://baueractivities.se/loppen/vistakulle-backyard/): 2026-10-17 — "17 Oktober 2026 07.00-19.00" (was estimated 2027-05-15)

name: Hellasloppet
description: Hellasloppet is a family-friendly running event offering a wonderful day at Hellasgården, close to the city. The races pass through the beautiful Hellas area, by lakes and hills, along lovely running trails and roads. There are races for all ages, from the very youngest children, who can run 100 metres without registering in advance, to children aged 5–8 on a flat course. The day offers the joy of running, uphill sections, music and a lovely autumn setting, with refreshments and activities for the whole family.
course_highlights: Races through the Hellas area, with lakes and hills
Lovely running trails and roads
Flat course for children aged 5–8
additional: The first race starts at 10:00, and the final start for the 10 km race is expected around 12:00. There is plenty of parking and bicycle parking by the start area. Prize ceremonies take place throughout the day. Athletics activities are available on site, with stations where you can try running, throwing and jumping. All children born in 2022 or later can run 100 m without registering in advance and will receive a medal. Refreshments are available throughout the day. The first race starts at 10:00, and the 10 km race is expected to start around 12:00. The 100-metre race for the youngest children does not require advance registration. Parking is available, and refreshments are served.

name: Night Trail Run (Sollentuna) — Hundtrail / 5 km & 10 km
description: Night Trail Run Hundtrail is a unique evening race in Sollentuna where you can run with your dog over 5 or 10 kilometres. The courses are marked with reflectors, and headlamps are mandatory to create a magical nighttime experience. The race is open to runners aged 18 and over, but young people aged 15 to 18 may participate if accompanied by an adult. It is an unforgettable evening enjoyed by both two- and four-legged participants.
course_highlights: The courses are marked with reflectors
Flexible start time between 18:00 and 19:30 (until 19:00 for 10 km)
Headlamps are mandatory, and dogs must be kept on a leash
additional: A maximum of one dog per runner. Age limit: 18; participants aged 15–18 may take part accompanied by an adult. Dogs must be kept on a leash and be comfortable around other dogs and people. The race takes place in the dark, with narrow passages and frequent encounters with other dogs, so reactive dogs are not recommended. One dog per runner; dogs must be kept on a leash. Flexible start times: 18:00–19:30 for 5 km and 18:00–19:00 for 10 km. Age limit: 18; young people aged 15 and over may participate with a responsible adult.

name: Stockholms Brantaste
description: Stockholm’s Steepest is an intense, energetic race that challenges you to run both up and down the steep slopes of Hammarbybacken. The course is just over 3 km long and includes three climbs, taking you up two different ski slopes. The race is suitable for both experienced runners and beginners who want to test their lactic acid threshold and mental toughness. The finish is at the top of Hammarbybacken, with a fantastic view of Stockholm as the backdrop.
course_highlights: Just over 3 km with three climbs
Up two different ski slopes
Finish at the top of Hammarbybacken with views of Stockholm
additional: Bib collection takes place at the Hammarby Fabriksväg event area from 09:30 on race day. Bibs are personal and must be worn on the chest using safety pins. There are hydration stations along the course. For the relay, teams complete a total of 8 laps of approximately 1 km each, with 2–4 people per team. Children’s races are available for ages 7–12 (approximately 500 m) and ages 0–6 (approximately 300 m; registration via Skistar). The event area is easy to reach by public transport, and parking is limited. The relay covers approximately 8 km for teams of 2–4 people. Brantaste Mini is approximately 500 metres for children aged 7–12, and Valle’s Friends’ Race is approximately 300 metres for children aged 0–6. The start and finish are at Hammarbybacken; the organiser recommends public transport because there is no parking at the hill.

name: Rönninge Backyard Run 2026

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmälan sker på plats och kostar 75 kr

description: Rönninge Backyard Run 2026 is a unique running event celebrating its 5th anniversary. The race consists of a 6,706-metre loop starting at Bubblan in Toredal and running on asphalt and gravel. Participants run as many loops as they can manage over twelve hours, with a start every hour on the hour from 09:00 to 20:00. To continue, runners must complete each loop in under an hour, and the most enduring runner who is fastest on the final loop wins. There are women’s and men’s categories, as well as a MiniBackyard for children and young people who want to run shorter distances.
course_highlights: The loop is 6,706 metres long, with approximately 80% asphalt and 20% gravel
The course includes several longer climbs, including towards Sandbäcksvägen and the promenade
Start and finish at Bubblan in Toredal, with a final flat asphalt stretch leading to the grass field
additional: The race starts every hour on the hour from 09:00 to 20:00, with up to 12 loops over twelve hours. Runners must complete each loop in under an hour to continue. MiniBackyard starts at 14:00 and lasts for a maximum of 45 minutes. Registration for MiniBackyard takes place on site. Coffee and refreshments are served at 20:00 after the final loop. The first start is at 09:00 and the last start is at 20:00. There is also a MiniBackyard with a loop of at least 670 metres; on-site registration costs 75 kr.

name: Bėgimas Graužikai-Kelmė
description: The Graužikai–Kelmė Run is a traditional race in Kelmė District held in memory of Vaidotas Rimkus. The event takes place in October and aims to promote running and athletics in Lithuania, encourage a healthy lifestyle, and increase physical activity among local residents. It attracts runners of all ages, who can choose from several distances, including the 8 km main race. Participants are awarded cups, medals, and commemorative prizes.

name: Krusensterni jooks
description: The Krusenstern Run is a traditional running race that starts at the Purila bus stop and finishes at Hagudi Manor. The race is 4.2 km long and is suitable for schoolchildren, pensioners and adults. The top men and women are awarded prizes, with special prizes also awarded to veteran athletes, the youngest and oldest finishers, and the largest family. Participants take part at their own risk, and all finishers are offered water, a treat and hot tea.

name: Täby Halvmarathon
description: Täby Half Marathon is a fast, easy-to-run half marathon in scenic surroundings, starting and finishing at Näsby Castle. The course offers coastal views along the shores of Värtan, a scenic loop around Lake Rönninge, and a finish back by the sea with views towards Bogesundlandet. The course is officially measured and the race is organized by Täby IS Friidrott. It is ideal for runners looking to end the season on a fast and beautiful course. The race has been very popular in previous years, with limited places, so the organizers encourage early registration.

name: Täljemilen
description: Enhörna IF presents Täljemilen—perhaps autumn’s fastest officially measured 10K, at Geneta Sportfält in Södertälje. The course runs entirely on cycle paths and footpaths and is fully paved, making it very fast and suitable for those chasing a personal best. Water is available at 5 km and at the finish. Instead of medals, the organizer donates a sum to the Swedish Childhood Cancer Fund for every registered runner. Prizes are awarded to the top 3 in both the women’s and men’s categories, and there is also a draw for approximately 20 prizes.

name: Pukinmaki Run Helsinki 18.10.2026
description: Pukinmäki Run is an annual running event held in the Pukinmäki district of Helsinki, offering distances of 1 km for children, 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon. The course is flat and fast, mainly on asphalt and outdoor trails, and loops around the boundaries of Pukinmäki. The event is open to runners of all ages and abilities, offering a chance to enjoy exercise and beautiful nature together with others. The event hub is located at Pukinmäki Sports Park, and refreshments and snacks are available.

name: Coop Tartu jooksuõhtud 2026 IV etapp
description: Coop Tartu Running Evenings is the fourth event in a running series organized by Tartu Ski Club, held in Raadi Park. This is an enjoyable, athletic event that invites running enthusiasts to enjoy autumn scenery and stay active. The series offers various distances and a friendly race atmosphere.
course_highlights: Runs take place on the beautiful and varied terrain of Raadi Park
The routes are suitable for both beginners and experienced runners
An opportunity to enjoy the autumn scenery and fresh air

name: Emili jookseb
description: Emili Runs is a cheerful school community running event held in Kadriorg Park in autumn, with students, teachers and parents taking part. The focus is on the joy of movement and supporting one another, not on speed. This traditional event fosters a sense of togetherness and offers the community enjoyable moments of exercise in the fresh air. The first run took place amid golden leaves and was an inspiring start to the school holiday.

name: Älvsjöloppet night trail
location: Gamla Älvsjö IP, Älvsjö, Stockholm, Sweden
price_range: 250 kr; gratis för medlemmar i OK Älvsjö-Örby
description: Älvsjöloppet Night Trail is an exciting 5 km evening race over hilly terrain in Älvsjöskogen, with 150 metres of elevation gain. The start and finish are at Gamla Älvsjö IP, about a 15-minute walk from Älvsjö station. The course is marked with reflective markers and requires a bright headlamp, preferably at least 1000 lumens, as well as good trail shoes to handle the terrain. After finishing, all runners are treated to sausages and drinks in a friendly atmosphere. The race is organised by OK Älvsjö Örby and is open to everyone, with free entry for club members.
course_highlights: 5 km reflective-marked course over hilly terrain with 150 m of elevation gain
Start and finish at Gamla Älvsjö IP, near Älvsjö station
Requires a bright headlamp and trail shoes with good grip
additional: Race bibs and timing chips are handed out from 18.15 to 18.45. The chip must be returned at the finish. Toilets and changing rooms are available on site. Parking is available in the area and at Herr Stens väg 2, but walking, cycling or running to the start is recommended. Live results and the results list are available at alvsjoloppet.se. After finishing, all runners are treated to sausages and drinks; no other refreshments are available. For 2026, a headlamp of at least 1000 lumens and trail shoes, preferably with metal studs, are recommended.

name: Ambla SK SV suusatajate seeriajooks+kepikõnd
description: Ambla SK SV Skiers’ Series Run + Nordic Walking is a multi-stage running and Nordic walking series held at Kangrumäe in Järva County. The competition consists of five stages: the first four use staggered starts, and the final stage has a mass start. The best four stage results count toward the standings, and participants are divided into different age groups. The competition is intended for runners using ski poles, which can also be borrowed if needed. Everyone who completes all five stages receives a special prize.
course_highlights: Five stages: four staggered starts and a mass start for the final stage
Held at Kangrumäe in Järva County
Only runners using ski poles are included in the competition standings
additional: Age groups range from age 6 to 55+. Ski poles can be borrowed if needed.

name: 3. Holstre-Polli ööjooks
location: Holstre-Polli Sports Centre, Holstre, Viljandi County, Estonia
description: The 3rd Holstre-Polli Night Run takes place on the health and ski trails of Holstre-Polli Sports Centre in Viljandi County. This night run gives participants the chance to experience the wilderness and tranquillity surrounding the sports centre. The event is part of Holstre-Polli Sports Centre’s sports event series and is suitable for both experienced runners and recreational runners. Participants can enjoy a unique night-running experience amid beautiful nature.

name: Tõstamaa jooks
location: Tõstamaa Keskkool, Tõstamaa, Pärnu County, Estonia
description: The Tõstamaa Run is a traditional running event in the Tõstamaa area. In previous editions, the race started by Tõstamaa Secondary School and covered a distance of 7.5 km. The run offers an opportunity to come together and enjoy being active in the Tõstamaa community.
course_highlights: In previous editions, the distance was 7.5 km.
The race started by Tõstamaa Secondary School.
The run takes place in the Tõstamaa area.

name: Yxbacken Extreme Challenge by E2C
description: Yxbacken Extreme Challenge by E2C is one of Östergötland’s most unique and challenging running races, held at the foot of Pernilla Wiberg’s home slope in Yxbacken, Norrköping. The race challenges participants with five laps up a hill with 100 metres of elevation gain over 350 metres, for a total distance of approximately 7 kilometres. Whether you run fast or take it easy, everyone is welcome to take part, and the most important thing is to make it to the top. New this year is also a relay, adding an extra dimension to the race. Children can take part for free in the Lilla Yxbackenloppet by E2C, making it a family-friendly running festival.
course_highlights: Five laps up Yxbacken, with 100 metres of elevation gain over 350 metres per lap
Approximately 7 kilometres in a unique race setting in Östergötland
Start at the foot of Pernilla Wiberg’s home slope
additional: Race bibs can be collected at XXL on Friday 23 October from 14:00 to 18:00, or at the start and finish area no later than one hour before the start. The bib includes a timing chip, which must be used to record your time. All participants who cross the finish line receive a medal sponsored by Energi & Inneklimat. Companies can rent a partner tent at the race venue for team spirit and exposure through Rent a Tent. E2C was title partner for the fourth year in the 2024 edition.

name: VSM terräng
description: The Swedish Cross Country Championships are organised by Västerås FK and the Swedish Athletics Federation at Rocklunda IP in Västerås. The course is 2 km long and consists mostly of grass, with some other surfaces, including fast-running grass and gravel paths. The competition includes several categories, including seniors, youth, masters and para-athletes, with individual races and team competitions. The event also offers the option of pre-booked lunch and good accommodation options close to the venue.
course_highlights: 2 km course consisting mostly of grass, with some other surfaces
Fast-running grass and a 2–3-metre-wide gravel path, crossed four times per lap
Hay-bale obstacles on parts of the course
additional: Race numbers must be collected at the start/finish area at least 60 minutes before the start. Access to the start area opens 10 minutes before the start and closes 2 minutes before. Water is available at the lap point and finish, with Dextrosol at the finish. Changing rooms and showers are available at Expandia Arena. Free parking and local buses are available. Clubs may set up their own tents in the designated area. Pre-booked lunch is served at Good Morning Hotels near the venue. Doping tests may be conducted during the competition weekend. The 2026 event took place at Rocklunda IP in Västerås. The organiser’s website states that Västerås FK handed over hosting duties for the 2027 Swedish Cross Country Championships to Mora.

name: Linghem Dark Halfyard (Ultra) Trail
description: Welcome to the second edition of Linghem Dark Halfyard (Ultra) Trail, a unique and exciting running event in the autumn darkness of Kråksångsskogen. The race consists of 13 laps on a 3.5 km loop, with a maximum of 30 minutes allowed for each lap. After the sixth lap, runners change direction, adding an extra dimension to the competition. This is a small-scale race with a limited number of places, and a headlamp is mandatory because almost the entire race takes place in the dark. All participants who complete at least one lap receive a beautiful wooden medal, and the winners receive unique winner’s medals.
course_highlights: 13 laps on a 3.5 km loop, with a maximum of 30 minutes per lap
Running direction changes after the sixth lap
The course is marked with reflective markers and trail tape; the surface is mostly trails, with approximately 700 metres of gravel
additional: Energy is served during laps 7 and 8 (pizza from a local pizzeria), along with sweets, bananas, crisps, coffee, hot broth, sports drink and water. Facilities are very limited, with self-service energy, a warm fire and approximately 25 sq m of covered shelter. Toilets are outdoors in the forest. Maximum 70 places. Each lap starts every 30 minutes, and anyone who completes a lap faster can rest for the remaining time before the next lap starts. A headlamp and mobile phone are listed as mandatory equipment. The race website lists 70 places.

name: Pärnu Rannajooks

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 10 km ajavõtuga jooks ja retk I voor

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 10 km ajavõtuga jooks ja retk II voor

tiers.label: tier_3
tiers.description: 10 km ajavõtuga jooks ja retk III voor

description: Pärnu Beach Run is a season-ending running and Nordic walking event held in Pärnu’s beautiful beach area. Participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km distances, which run along the seaside promenade and past architectural landmarks characteristic of the city. The course offers beautiful natural scenery and is suitable for both runners and Nordic walkers. Children’s races and virtual runs are also on the programme, allowing people to participate from home.
course_highlights: The course runs through Pärnu’s beach area along the seaside promenade
Beautiful natural scenery and architectural landmarks characteristic of the city
Choose between 5 km and 10 km; suitable for runners and Nordic walkers
additional: The distances can be completed by running or Nordic walking. Children’s races and virtual runs are also held. The course also takes participants along the beach promenade, offering sea views.

name: Sjögarpslunken 2026
description: Sjögarpslunken is a longstanding running race celebrating its 50th anniversary in 2026. The race is organized by Boxholm-Ekeby Ski Club and takes place at Boxholm’s ski stadium. It is a popular event for runners of all ages and abilities, with a beautiful and challenging course. More information and registration will be available closer to race day.
course_highlights: Scenic route around the Sjögarp area
Challenging 14 km course, with a course profile available
The race takes place at Boxholm’s ski stadium
additional: The race celebrates its 50th anniversary in 2026. Links are available to the invitation, race information, start list, and preliminary results from previous years. The course profile and a course map are available to runners. Gathering is scheduled for 09:30.

name: Löfstad Slott Trail
description: Löfstad Castle Trail is an atmospheric trail race held in the autumn darkness around the historic Löfstad Castle. The race offers a unique running experience as participants run through the castle park, along forest trails and over unmarked terrain lit by headlamps. The event consists of two races: the Little Twilight Race for children in the park and Löfstad’s Darkest, a 7-kilometre night race for adults. Löfstad Castle Trail combines nature, history and community in a beautiful and challenging setting.
course_highlights: 7 km night race on gravel roads, trails and unmarked forest terrain
The course is marked with reflectors and course tape
Little Twilight Race: 1,000 metres in the park, with no timing
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 15:00 at the castle courtyard. Löfstad’s Darkest starts at 17:00 and requires a headlamp and trail shoes. The Little Twilight Race is a children’s race with no timing, and all participants receive a prize. The joint awards ceremony takes place after the races. On-site registration is available. Parking is available up to 500 metres from the castle. A headlamp is mandatory for the 7 km race, and trail shoes are recommended. The children’s race is untimed. The start and finish are at Löfstad Castle.

name: Sigulda – Nurmiži – Sigulda (21km)
description: The Sigulda - Nurmiži - Sigulda run is a 21 km half-marathon that passes through the picturesque Sigulda Castle ruins and the surrounding countryside. The event offers a chance to enjoy both historic sites and natural beauty while running or Nordic walking. It is suitable for experienced runners as well as active leisure-seekers looking to challenge themselves and enjoy the beauty of Latvia’s nature. Traditionally, the race brings together athletes and enthusiasts from different places, creating a friendly and inspiring atmosphere.
course_highlights: Start and finish by the Sigulda Castle ruins
The route passes through the Nurmiži area
A run through scenic and historic terrain
additional: The event also includes participation in a Nordic walking hike.

name: Walking Dead Ultra 100 Miles
description: Walking Dead Ultra 100 Miles is a challenging ultramarathon held in Paradiset Nature Reserve in Huddinge. The race offers a unique terrain experience, with scenic views and technical trails that test both endurance and mental strength. It is a well-regarded event for experienced ultrarunners seeking a long-distance challenge in a beautiful setting.
course_highlights: Running in Paradiset Nature Reserve with varied terrain
Technical trails and scenic views
A challenging 100-mile distance
additional: The race also offers 100 km and 65 km distances. According to the available race information, drop bags and toilets are available, along with water, tea, coffee and broth at Torpet Paradiset.

name: Repovesi Trail 2026
description: The event offers three challenging routes: 10 km, 21 km and 42 km, through rugged rocky and forest landscapes and alongside lakes. The 42 km marathon is run twice around the 21 km main course. Participants can enjoy aid stations, natural wells along the route and a meal at the finish after the event.
course_highlights: The routes follow established trails in Repovesi National Park, with rugged cliffs, climbs and lake views.
The 21 km main course is run twice on the 42 km route.
Aid stations on the 21 km and 42 km routes; there are three aid stations on the 42 km route. The 10 km route has no regular aid station.
additional: The race headquarters are at the Lapinsalmi parking area, Riippusillantie 55, 47900 Vuohijärvi. Public toilets and four portable toilets are available at the race headquarters, but there are no washing facilities. Race numbers must be collected from race information before the start. The event is litter-free, so bring your own cup for the aid stations. Running poles are allowed. The cut-off time for 42 km runners to begin their second lap is 14:00. Food and drink are available at the aid stations, but you must bring your own drinking cup. This is a litter-free event: participants must take their own rubbish with them.

name: Pohjoisbaanan maili 2026
location: Käpylä railway station, Käpylä, Helsinki, Finland
description: Pohjoisbaanan maili is an accessible running event held annually at the end of the year, featuring the middle-distance classic, the mile (1,609 metres). The event gives runners the opportunity to compete on a paved route in Käpylä, Helsinki, near Käpylä station. The start is near Tempo Running Store, and the route follows Pohjoisbaana south to the finish by the Hakamäentie bridge. The event is popular and community-oriented, and is organized annually by Helsingin Juoksijat ry.
course_highlights: The route follows the paved Pohjoisbaana southward
The start is next to Käpylä station
The finish is by the Hakamäentie bridge
additional: Changing rooms and toilets are not available, but you can store your belongings in the back room of Tempo Running Store at your own risk.

name: Komia Ilkan Polku
description: KOMIA Ilkan Polku is a unique trail-running event in Ostrobothnia, offering challenging and varied routes through scenic landscapes on the border between Ilmajoki and Kurikka. The event centre is located by Lake Kyrkösjärvi at the Käpälikkö Nature Centre, and several distances are available, from a marathon to the children’s Halloween Run. The routes run mainly along trails and also include gravel roads through villages, with approximately 300 metres of elevation gain. Runners can enjoy refreshment points, bag storage, first aid and prizes, and the event also encourages Halloween-themed costumes.
course_highlights: Varied trails on the Ilkan Polku nature trail
300 metres of elevation gain in total
The route includes approximately 3 km of gravel roads through villages
additional: The event features mass starts, race-number collection from 8:30 to 11:30, bag storage at the finish area, a cafeteria and soup for sale. The children’s Halloween Run is a relaxed 800-metre run, and children may also take part with a parent. Halloween-themed costumes are encouraged, and the best costumes will be awarded prizes. Results are available in real time on the website. The children’s Halloween Run is 800 metres and free of charge. The marathon and relay start at Varpahaiskyläntie 300, Ilmajoki.

name: Jätten Bule-löpet
description: The Jätten Bule Run is a traditional race organised by IFK Österbymo, set in the scenic, enchanting woodland around Österbymo. The race offers three distances: 10 km, 5 km and 2.4 km. Participants run on trails and gravel roads across varied terrain, with beautiful views. The start and finish are at Bulevallen. The race is sanctioned by the Östergötland Athletics Association, with chip timing. Changing rooms, refreshments and race-bib collection are available on site, making for a welcoming, well-organised race day.
course_highlights: The 10 km course winds through enchanting woodland on trails and gravel roads, with both climbs and descents
The 5 km course is a miniature version of the 10 km course, with a new route from 2024, and is marked in blue
The 2.4 km course follows the floodlit trail and is somewhat more challenging
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 09:00 at IFK Österbymo’s clubhouse by the start area. Bulis will lead the warm-up before the children’s race, at approximately 10:00. Timing is by chip. Changing rooms are available in the clubhouse. Refreshments, including coffee and hamburgers, are available at the start area; payment by Swish or cash. The start and finish are at the sports ground in Österbymo. The 10 km and 5 km distances are available both as running and walking.

name: Kilsbergsleden
description: Kilsbergsleden is a running race suitable for all levels, with distances from 5 km to 14.7 km. The race takes place in Karlslund Forest, starting and finishing at Karlslund Sports Centre in Örebro. The shorter distances run on lightly prepared forest terrain, while the longest course follows more natural forest trails with some rocky sections and climbs up and down an esker. The race is part of the Southern Svealand Running Series and offers both recreational and competitive categories.
course_highlights: Lightly prepared forest terrain and floodlit trails for 5 and 10 km
Natural forest trail with rocky sections on the 14.7 km course
The course climbs up and down an esker
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Örebro AIK’s clubhouse at Karlslund Sports Centre. Refreshments are available at the finish and at approximately 9 km, with water and cordial. Changing rooms and showers are available at Karlslund Sports Centre. Parking is available at Karlslund Sports Centre. Coffee and snacks are available for purchase on site. Prize money is awarded to the top three finishers in the competitive category for 14.7 km. The award ceremony takes place at 13:00 at the clubhouse. Refreshments are available at the finish and at approximately 9 kilometres.

name: REINPAULI XXIV MAASTIKUJOOKS
location: Ebavere, Väike-Maarja Parish, Lääne-Viru County, Estonia

name: Pühali maraton
description: The Pühali Marathon is Estonia’s newest marathon, offering a great opportunity to enjoy beautiful nature and test your endurance. The event takes place at Pühali Sports Centre and is suitable for families, friends, and colleagues. It offers a range of distances so everyone can find a challenge that suits them. Participants can use the sauna and spa area at no extra cost, included in the race ticket price. Accommodation is available before and after the event, offering a convenient place to rest and recover.
course_highlights: A scenic trail through the beautiful Estonian countryside
Race centre at Pühali Sports Centre and the area in front of it
Sauna and spa area included in the price for all runners
additional: Seniors and young people up to 18 years old receive a 30% discount on the entry fee with the discount code Pühali2024. Accommodation is available in various holiday homes and campsites. Accommodation can be booked before and after the marathon. The sauna and spa area will be open to runners free of charge on Saturday evening. Registration takes place on Fienta. At previous events, sauna access has been included in the race ticket price.

name: Höstmilen
location: Sörsjön, Kolmårdsskogarna, Åby, Norrköping Municipality, Sweden
description: Höstmilen is a trail race along the paths between Sörsjön and Lillsjön, outside Åby, north of Norrköping. The race offers a challenging course through scenic terrain and an enjoyable experience for all participants. You can choose between a long course of 10.6 km, a shorter course of 5.2 km, and courses for children and young people. The shorter courses start and finish at Lillsjön. The event is organised by OK Kolmården, a ski and orienteering club for all levels and ages.
course_highlights: Trail running on paths between Sörsjön and Lillsjön
Scenic terrain in the Kolmården forests
Challenging courses of both 10.6 km and 5.2 km
additional: Registration closes on 29 October at 23:00. After that, you can register on 31 October from 11:00 to 14:00 at XXL and at the start area on 1 November. There are also classes for children and young people. Race director: Johan Malm. Parking and transport information is available on the website. If you have mild symptoms of illness, you should stay at home. The race has been held since 1971.

name: Ventspils novada Skriešanas seriāls "Ugāle" I posms
location: Ugāles manēža, Ugāle, Ventspils Municipality, Latvia
description: The first stage of the “Ugāle” running series invites you to keep moving in autumn and stay motivated to train. The start is scheduled at the Ugāle indoor track. It’s an opportunity to join the local running series and spend the day actively.

name: Coop Tartu jooksuõhtud 2026 V etapp
description: Coop Tartu Running Evenings is the fifth event in a traditional running series, held on Toomemägi Hill in Tartu. It is an enjoyable, athletic evening run suitable for both recreational and experienced runners. The routes follow the beautiful terrain of Toomemägi, offering participants a pleasant running experience in an urban setting. The event is part of the Coop Tartu Running Evenings series, which brings together running enthusiasts of different age groups.
course_highlights: The runs take place on Toomemägi Hill in Tartu
The routes cross the beautiful terrain of Toomemägi
An evening run in an urban setting
additional: No times are recorded and no rankings are compiled for the children’s runs.

name: Fiz-Kul-Tūre
description: Fiz-Kul-Tūre is a running and Nordic walking series in Valmiera Municipality, held in several stages at different locations, including Valmiera and Rencēni. The autumn stages give participants the chance to enjoy running and Nordic walking in natural surroundings and a pleasant autumn atmosphere. The event welcomes both beginners and experienced athletes, and the best participants in the season’s overall standings are awarded at the end. Fiz-Kul-Tūre promotes an active and healthy lifestyle in Valmiera Municipality.
course_highlights: Courses in the natural surroundings of Valmiera Municipality
Running and Nordic walking across multiple stages
Friendly atmosphere and awards for the season’s overall standings
additional: The Fiz-Kul-Tūre season finale takes place on a late autumn evening, ending on a positive note. Stages are held at different locations in Valmiera Municipality, such as Valmiera and Rencēni. Participants can take part in both running and Nordic walking.

name: Energiruset
description: Energiruset is a family-friendly evening race held in Mariebergsskogen in Karlstad. Participants can choose between two distances, 2 km and 5 km, and run, jog or walk with a headlamp along the unlit trails. The race is an energetic evening where participants defy the autumn darkness and share a sense of community and movement. After the race, all participants are treated to a sausage in a bun as a pleasant finish.
course_highlights: The race takes place in Mariebergsskogen, with parts of the course unlit
Option to run or walk with a headlamp on the 5 km distance
Family-friendly atmosphere with both a competitive class and open start times
additional: There is a 5 km competitive class with a provisional start time of 18:00. Other participants can use the course during the evening and start whenever they like within the stated time window. Headlamps can be purchased when registering.

name: TrailHunt Vooremäe 1000+
location: Vooremäe terviserajad, Kastre Parish, Tartu County, Estonia
description: TrailHunt Vooremäe 1000+ is a trail race on the Vooremäe health trails, offering participants challenges on forest paths and with elevation gain. The race takes place on a 14 km loop, with the marathon distance consisting of three loops. The race centre is located by the new Vooremäe service building, where participants can shower and change clothes after the race. There is one staffed aid station on the course, and timing uses the contactless SPORTIdent system. Competition categories are separate for men and women, with an untimed hiking category.
course_highlights: A 14 km loop; the marathon consists of three loops
One staffed aid station on the course, passed four times
Timing with the contactless SPORTIdent (SI AIR) system
additional: The start number can be found before the race in the start list on the Seiklushunt website. Race materials are distributed at the race centre secretariat. There are 1–2 checkpoints on the course, where the SPORTIdent chip records passage. Showers and changing facilities are available at the race centre after the race. On-site registration is not available.

name: Audru Sildade Jooks
description: Audru Bridges Run is a traditional community sports event held in Audru rural municipality. This nationwide running event gives participants the chance to enjoy beautiful scenery and active exercise. The race is popular with both local runners and those from further afield, and is suitable for athletes of different levels.
course_highlights: The run takes place in the beautiful landscapes of Audru rural municipality
The courses pass through varied terrain and over bridges
Suitable for both recreational and experienced runners
additional: Energy walking is also organized on the longer and shorter distances.

name: Höstrusket
description: Höstrusket is a running race held in Norra Djurgården in Stockholm, part of the Royal National City Park. Participants can choose from three distances: 10 km, half marathon and marathon, all on officially measured courses starting and finishing at Fisksjöängsvägen. The race offers a lovely blend of nature and culture amid the vibrant colours of autumn and is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. It’s a perfect way to finish the running season or kick off winter training, with good support and encouraging pacers along the course.
course_highlights: Officially measured 10 km, half-marathon and marathon courses in Norra Djurgården
The course is mostly flat and fast, with asphalt and gravel surfaces
Two aid stations with water and sports drink along the course
additional: Start and finish at Fisksjöängsvägen, near Ropsten metro station. Race bibs are available at Runners’ Store in Stockholm and at the venue on race day. There are three start groups for the half marathon and four for the 10 km, based on expected finish time. Pacers are available for all distances. Drinks and something to eat are provided after the finish. Showers are available for a small fee at a nearby climbing centre.

name: Iron Backbone Ultra
description: Iron Backbone Ultra is a challenging trail adventure along Järnleden, the backbone of Kristinehamn’s trail network. The race features technical trails and November darkness, creating a tough and exciting challenge for both mental strength and determination. Participants can look forward to a sense of community and an experience of nature in beautiful terrain. The race is organized by Topp & Dröm, who are passionate about making training and competition accessible and enjoyable for all levels.
course_highlights: Technical trails along Järnleden in Kristinehamn
Running in November darkness, with challenging weather conditions
A nature-focused trail adventure that tests mental strength and determination
additional: Mandatory equipment includes a headlamp, mobile phone with emergency number, first-aid kit, race bib, windproof jacket and reflective vest (except for the 16 km class). Recommended equipment includes a running backpack, fluids, warm clothing, extra energy and an emergency blanket. The race is limited to 150 participants and takes place in November. Participants must be properly equipped for the prevailing weather and terrain conditions.

name: Järndammsloppet 10 km
description: Järndammsloppet is an annual cross-country race organised by IFK Sala at Järndammsstugan in Sala. The race offers distances of 10 km and 5 km, as well as a 1 km children’s race without timing. The start and finish are at Järndammsstugan, which has changing rooms and showers. It is a family-friendly event with prizes for the winners in each category and raffle prizes. Coffee and refreshments are available for purchase after the race.
course_highlights: Cross-country race starting and finishing at Järndammsstugan
Distances of 10 km, 5 km and a 1 km children’s race without timing
Changing rooms and showers are available
additional: The 1 km children’s race starts at 11:00, without timing, and all participating children receive prizes. The 5 km and 10 km races start at 11:30, with prizes for the winners in each category and raffle prizes. Changing rooms and showers are available at the event area.

name: Jāņa Daliņa piemiņas skrējiens un soļojums
description: The Jānis Daliņš Memorial Run and Walk is a traditional sporting event held at Jānis Daliņš Stadium in Valmiera. It also marks the season finale of the running series organized by the Valmiera Athletics Club, in which participants have run on both the forest trails along the banks of the Gauja and at the stadium. The event brings together runners and walkers of all levels, offering the chance to take part in a friendly, sporty atmosphere. The series’ most resilient participants receive prizes provided by the club.
course_highlights: The run takes place at Jānis Daliņš Stadium and on the scenic forest trails along the banks of the Gauja
The event is the season finale of the Valmiera Athletics Club’s running series
Participants can take part in both running and walking
additional: The event includes both running and walking disciplines. It is suitable for participants of different ages and fitness levels. Series participants receive prizes from the Valmiera Athletics Club. Participants are to receive a commemorative medal and hot tea at the finish.

name: Rapla talvejooks
location: Rapla Okta Centrum, Mahlamäe 10, Rapla, Estonia
description: Rapla Winter Run is a traditional winter running competition held in the parking lot of Rapla Okta Centrum. There are two distances: 3 km and 5 km, suitable for runners of different levels. The start is at 12:00, and participants can enjoy a winter running experience in the city of Rapla. The competition is open to both adults and young people and takes place in a friendly, sporty atmosphere.
course_highlights: A winter run in the city of Rapla
Distances of 3 km and 5 km
Start and finish in the parking lot of Rapla Okta Centrum
additional: Registration is available on-site at Okta Centrum from 11:00 to 11:30 and online. Participation fees must be paid to the bank account of MTÜ Rapla Jooksuklubi. The competition has individual age-group categories, and the awards ceremony takes place at 13:00. The start is in the parking lot of Rapla Okta Centrum at Mahlamäe 10.

name: Gränsö Trailrun
description: Gränsö Trailrun is a coastal trail race through Gränsö Nature Reserve, starting and finishing at Gränsö Slott in Västervik. The race offers two distances, 8 km and 15 km, both featuring varied, scenic courses with trails, cliffs and oak pastures. It is a race for both beginners and experienced runners who want to enjoy nature or challenge themselves. All finishers receive a medal, and there are aid stations along the course. Gränsö Trailrun is a welcoming, family-friendly experience, with the opportunity to combine the race with dining, spa and an overnight stay at the castle.
course_highlights: More than 90 percent trails and walking paths on both distances
Coastal nature reserve with seaside trails, cliffs and oak pastures
Start and finish at beautiful Gränsö Slott, set in a castle environment
additional: There is an option to choose the Fun Run without timing. The event centre opens at 09:00 at Gränsö Slott. The 8 km race starts at 11:00 and the 15 km race at 11:20. There is one aid station on the 8 km course and two on the 15 km course. All finishers receive a medal. You can combine the race with lunch, a day spa, dinner or an overnight stay at Gränsö Slott. Energy and hydration stations are available along the courses: one on the 8 km course and two on the 15 km course.

name: FalkTrailen

price_tiers.distance: Dam och Herr 5 km och 10 km

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmälningsavgiften är 250kr för herr- och damklasserna.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Barnloppet kostar 20kr som skänks till välgörenhet

description: Falktrailen is a trail race organised by Falkenberg Allstars. The race offers several categories for both women and men over 5 km and 10 km, as well as untimed children’s races. Most of the course follows lovely narrow trails, and trail shoes are recommended. Refreshments are available for purchase during the event, and prizes are awarded to the top three in each category. Part of the entry fee goes to charity supporting families with children in financial hardship in Falkenberg.
course_highlights: Most of the course follows lovely narrow trails
Trail shoes are recommended, but regular running shoes are also suitable
Untimed children’s race, with a prize for every participant
additional: The children’s race starts at 10:00 and is not timed. Registration for the children’s race closes at 9:45. The regular categories are capped at 350 runners. Late registration is available subject to space, and it is not possible to register late on site. 20 kr of each entry fee goes to the Swedish Church’s “Family Diaconia” fundraiser. Start times are listed as between 10:30 and 13:00.

name: Mörkertrail
location: Garphyttan National Park, Lekeberg Municipality, Örebro County, Sweden
description: Mörkertrail is a unique 10 km trail race run in total darkness in Garphyttan National Park in Lekeberg Municipality. Participants run with only a headlamp for guidance along a reflective-marked course that features both technical sections and easy-to-run trails, with plenty of elevation gain. The race offers a special atmosphere where runners can experience the deep darkness, tranquillity and sounds of the forest. After crossing the finish line, participants can enjoy a grilled sausage by the fire in a cosy setting. The start and finish are at the national park car park, and the race starts at 17:00.
course_highlights: 10 km trail race in total darkness with headlamps
Reflective-marked course with both technical and easy-to-run trails
Course with plenty of elevation gain on the edge of Kilsbergen
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 16:00. There will be a short briefing 10 minutes before the start. No on-site late registration. Start and finish at the entrance/car park to Garphyttan National Park. The car park has limited spaces, so please carpool. There is an outdoor toilet but no changing facilities. Bringing your own headlamp with a fully charged battery is mandatory. Sausage and a drink are included after the finish.

name: Patriots Mangaļos Ložmetējkalnā
location: Ziemassvētku kauju muzejs (Christmas Battles Museum), Mangaļi, Valgunde Parish, Latvia
description: Patriots in Mangaļi is a trail running, Nordic walking, and hiking event held in and around the grounds of the Mangaļi Christmas Battles Museum. The event combines active movement with preserving historical memory and paying respectful visits to sites commemorating the Christmas Battles. Participants can choose between 23+ km and 8 km distances for running, Nordic walking, or hiking. Children can take part in a 1 km run or follow a walking trail. Running includes both individual and team rankings, and the 23+ km course has a refreshment point by the Ložmetējkalns observation tower.
course_highlights: 23+ km distance with a refreshment point by the Ložmetējkalns observation tower (~13.7 km)
Distances available for running, Nordic walking, and hiking
Children’s 1 km run and walking trail
additional: The event grounds open at 9:00. Team rankings are available for the 8 km and 23+ km runs. Teams must have 3 participants, including at least one woman. Times are not recorded for Nordic walking or hiking. Participation fees are non-refundable. Each finisher receives a “Patriota ceļa talismans” (Patriot’s Path talisman). The start and gathering point are in the courtyard of the Mangaļi Christmas Battles Museum. The longer distance also includes patrols competing in teams of four.

name: Apkaimju brīvības skrējiens
location: Vienības gatves and Atgāzenes ielas corner, Riga, Latvia
description: The Neighbourhood Freedom Run is an annual run held in Riga’s neighbourhoods, particularly Atgāzene, Torņakalns and Bieriņi. The event aims to mark Latvia’s national holiday, giving participants the chance to experience a sense of freedom as they run through local streets and neighbourhoods. The run is suitable for runners of different levels, offering a full 9.4 km loop as well as the option to choose individual sections. The event is friendly and brings the community together, with stops and symbolic activities such as lighting candles in the sculpture garden by the Mārupīte.
course_highlights: A 9.4 km loop through Atgāzene, Bieriņi and Torņakalns
A stop at the sculpture garden by the Mārupīte, with candle lighting
Average running pace of 7:25 min/km, suitable for runners of different levels
additional: Participants can choose to run the full loop or individual sections. The event also includes symbolic activities, such as lighting candles, which help bring the community together. The meeting is scheduled for 18 November at 11:00.

name: Rembates aplis
location: Rembates pagasta pārvalde, Rembate, Ogres novads, Latvia
description: “Rembate Circuit” is a traditional run in Rembate that brings participants together on November 18 for exercise and to celebrate the holiday. The race is an important local tradition that has continued in Rembate for several decades. The event takes place by the Rembate Parish Administration.

name: Tautas skrējiens “Ieelpo Rēzekni”
description: The “Breathe in Rēzekne” People’s Run is a traditional race held in Rēzekne to celebrate the anniversary of the proclamation of the Republic of Latvia. The route takes runners along the city streets, offering an opportunity to discover Rēzekne’s urban environment and take part in a shared sporting event. It is suitable for participants of different ages and fitness levels, promoting a healthy lifestyle and a sense of community.
course_highlights: A run along the streets of Rēzekne
A traditional event held as part of the celebrations marking the anniversary of the proclamation of the Republic of Latvia
Participants of different ages and fitness levels
additional: Nordic walkers, families and groups of friends are also welcome to take part.

name: Latvijas kontūras skrējiens
location: Valmiera Town Hall Square, Valmiera, Latvia
description: The Latvia Outline Run in Valmiera is a traditional festive run held on 18 November at Valmiera Town Hall Square. Participants can complete a 12.3 km route that passes streets and places connected with the history and culture of Latvia and Valmiera. The event is welcoming to everyone: finish time is not important, and the route can also be completed at a walking pace at any time during the day. During the run, participants can also take part in a quiz dedicated to Latvia’s birthday using the Qrenteerings mobile app, making the event interactive and educational.
course_highlights: A 12.3 km route along Valmiera streets named after notable people
The route passes Valmiera Castle ruins, Vecpuišu Park, Valmiera Olympic Centre and the Music School
12 checkpoints with QR codes for taking the quiz in the Qrenteerings mobile app
additional: The route can be completed at any time that is convenient for you throughout the day. There are no traffic restrictions for the event, so participants must follow the traffic rules. Participants are encouraged to attach a ribbon in the colours of the Latvian flag or another Latvian-themed decoration to their clothing. Some route sections may be difficult to navigate with bicycles and strollers. There are no traffic restrictions, so participants must follow the traffic rules.

name: Köykkyri NUTS
description: NUTS Köykkyri is a relaxed but lively trail running event where you take on Köykkyrin Hill and enjoy good company. Expect hill training, sweat, and a festive pre-Christmas atmosphere, elf-runner style! Experience the thrill of Kempele’s “high altitude” and the true excitement of hill running, with 25 meters of elevation gain. Get ready to dash across the “summit” of Kempele, where every climb is a celebration and every descent deserves applause.

images.alt_text: NUTS Köykkyri polkujuoksukilpailun kuva. Juoksijat juoksevat metsäpolulla.
NUTS Köykkyri -polkujuoksun reitti kartalla. Viisi eri lenkkiä.

name: Lepokallion Lenkki Polkujuoksu
description: Lepokallion Lenkki trail run will be held in Ylistaro on Saturday, November 2, at 11:00. The event offers varied terrain amid beautiful scenery, with trails and natural areas providing runners with stunning views and challenges. Several distances are available, including 5.6 km and 10.8 km, suitable for both beginners and more experienced runners.

name: Sarvilahden Maraton
description: The Sarvilahti Marathon will be held on 25 October 2025 at Rauhala Park in Loviisa. The event offers several races, including a marathon, half marathon, 10 km and 5 km, as well as a 1.6 km children’s course. The marathon consists of two laps of an officially measured half-marathon course. Parking is at the Loviisa Ice Hall, with signs directing participants to the start in the park, about 400 metres away.

images.alt_text: Ryhmä juoksijoita juoksee kilpailussa, jossa on numeroituja kilpailijoita.

name: Helsinki Halloween Run
description: Helsinki Halloween Run is a relaxed Halloween-themed running event for runners of all levels. In 2025, the event takes place on October 25 in Kalasatama, Helsinki! The new route winds through Kalasatama’s urban surroundings and consists of a 5 km loop, run once for the 5 km race and twice for the 10 km race. You can take part competitively against the clock or dress up in your most outrageous Halloween costume.

images.alt_text: Helsingin Halloween-juoksussa osallistujat mime-asussa. Hauska kuva!

name: Tuusula Trailrun
description: Tuusula Trailrun 2024 is a trail running race held on Sunday, 27 October 2024 at 11:00 at the biathlon stadium of Tuusula Sports Centre. The race course winds along the trails of Tuusula Korpikylä and Sammaloja and is marked with blue-and-yellow tape and signs. The entry fee includes the trail race, chip timing, a hot soup and a drink, and access to shower facilities at the ice rink.

images.alt_text: Ryhmä juoksijoita juoksemassa asfaltilla, metsä taustalla.

name: Hiidenhölkkä Nummela
description: As autumn approaches, so does the traditional Hiidenhölkkä, organized this year for the 47th time by Nummelan Tarmo. The Hiidenhölkkä routes—the 10 km and 20 km (2 × 10 km) runs—loop around Nummelanharju and Nummela Airport. Hiidenhölkkä starts at 12:00 and the running event ends at 14:00.

name: Vantaan Kestävyyskierros
distance_verbose: 108 km, 40 km, 30 km, 20 km, 10 km, 9 km, 4 km, 2.5 km, 1500 metriä
description: The Vantaa Endurance Tour 2023 is starting! Sign up for the Vantaa Endurance Tour, where you’ll challenge yourself in five different sports. The tour is suitable for fitness enthusiasts and endurance athletes of all levels, and offers a great opportunity to try completely new sports. In 2023, one registration gives you access to five endurance events in Vantaa, allowing you to focus on training instead of searching for races.

images.alt_text: Hiihtäjä Vantaan kestävyyskierroksen reitillä.  Aurinkoinen päivä ja hyvin hoidettu latu.
Vantaan Kestävyyskierros -logo. Sininen tausta ja keltainen teksti.

name: Valon Kymppi
description: Valon Kymppi is a 10 km running event held every autumn in Jyväskylä. The late start, fading evening light and glow of the city lights along the Rantaraitti create a unique atmosphere for the run. The route has been awarded Finland’s most beautiful transport route. It is flat and fast, and the event centre is Jyväskylä Paviljonki.

images.alt_text: Valon Kymppi -juoksun lähtö Jyväskylässä. Juoksijat valmiina startissa.
Valon Kymppi -juoksija hymyilee ja näyttää peukkua Jyväskylän maisemissa.
Valon Kymppi -juoksija hymyilee ja näyttää peukkua Jyväskylän Rantaraitilla.
Valon Kymppi - Jyväskylän reittikartta. 10km juoksu Rantaraitilla.

name: Nevas Night Run
description: The Nevas Night Run 2026 event will be run or walked on 4 September 2026 in Kalkkiranta, Sipoo. Participants can choose between two distances: 12.5 km and 7 km. The longer distance includes two laps around Byträsket, while the shorter distance is designed for all runners. The revamped event also features new categories and a new start location, bringing participants new challenges and experiences.

images.alt_text: Mainos Nevas Night Run -juoksusta. Juoksija osoittaa banneria, jossa juoksukilpailun logo.
Nevas Night Run logo, jossa juoksijoita ja tähtiä pimeässä.

name: Finlandia Marathon
description: Finlandia Marathon is a running event held in Jyväskylä on 11–12 September 2026. The route follows Jyväskylä’s flat, fast Rantaraitti, which has been awarded the title of Finland’s most beautiful transport route. The event centre is Lutakonaukio and Jyväskylä Paviljonki.

images.alt_text: Finlandia Marathonin lähtö Jyväskylässä. Juoksijat starttaavat.

name: Finlandia Vitonen
description: Finlandia Vitonen is the shortest distance at the Finlandia Marathon and is open to everyone interested in physical activity. Participants can move at their own pace, whether it’s a fast sprint or a leisurely walk. The 5 km route follows Jyväskylä’s Rantaraitti, with the start at Lutakon aukio. The event also features fun, encouraging activities in the start and finish area and along the route.

images.alt_text: Finlandia Vitonen -juoksussa osallistujia. Hyvä kuvaus kilpailusta.

name: Vaasa Maraton
description: Vaasa Marathon will be held on September 6, 2025, at Kaarlen kenttä on Ruutikellarintie in Vaasa. The race start schedule is arranged for different groups, and participants must start their final lap by 3:00 p.m. at the latest. Participants can choose the marathon, half marathon, 10.5 km distance, or the Minimarathon, which is free for children.

name: Masters Athletics Marathon
description: Masters Marathon runners can once again compete with the world’s best runners in their own age groups. WMA is excited to announce that RunInBucharest has accepted the challenge of hosting the World Championships for Masters athletes in 2024. The 2024 World Masters Athletics Marathon Championship will be held on October 13 alongside the Bucharest Marathon, offering a wonderful opportunity to enjoy running in beautiful surroundings, with the course passing the city’s most important landmarks.

images.alt_text: Maratonjuoksijat lähtevät Bukarestin kilpailuun, jossa on tunnusomaista "START"-kyltti.
Bucharestin yö, suihkulähteitä ja valaistuja rakennuksia, jotka sopivat maratonin kontekstiin.

name: Nuuksio Classic Trail
description: Nuuksio Classic is one of Finland’s most iconic trail-running events, offering a unique running experience amid stunning scenery. The race takes place in Nuuksio National Park and attracts runners from Finland and around the world. Participants can choose from different distances, including 42 km and 70 km, and enjoy superb courses, wild forest, and excellent organization. Join us on September 5, 2026!

images.alt_text: Maastojuoksija Nuuksion poluilla järven äärellä, aurinkoisena päivänä.

name: Orimattilan Kymppi
description: The most significant village event to develop in Kuivanto is Kuivannon Kymppi. As a celebration of physical activity, it brings villagers together in late autumn to exercise and organize a sporting event. This outdoor and sporting event, initiated by local residents, was first held in 1981, when 24 participants completed the course. The event has grown into a significant international gathering, with more than 500 participants from countries including Russia, Estonia, Sweden, England and Kenya. Through cooperation between the City of Orimattila and local village associations, the event has been carried forward one year at a time.

name: Matin Muistokymppi
description: Matin Muistokymppi is a running event held on 5 September 2024 in Lieksa. The race gives participants the opportunity to run a 10-kilometer distance through beautiful scenery. The course is designed to be both challenging and enjoyable for runners of all levels. The event is aimed especially at fitness enthusiasts and running fans, and offers an excellent opportunity to enjoy the outdoors and good company. Participants can run or walk, and anyone who wants a time will be timed.

images.alt_text: Juoksijat lähtevät juoksukilpailuun, jossa on paljon osallistujia.
Juoksukilpailu käynnissä, kilpailijat juoksevat märällä asfaltilla.
Ryhmä ihmisiä kävelemässä tai juoksemassa ulkona.

name: Laajavuori Trail Run
description: Welcome to Laajavuori Trail Run, a trail running event in Laajavuori, Jyväskylä, on Saturday, 13 September 2025! This exhilarating event offers stunning routes in the heart of Central Finland’s natural landscape—hills, forests, roots, and breathtaking views. Whether you’re an experienced runner or just starting out on the trails, Laajavuori Trail Run is the perfect way to challenge yourself and enjoy nature while staying active.

images.alt_text: Suomen lippu ja kaunis luontomaisema metsässä ja järvellä.

name: Kaisaniemen Juoksu
description: Kaisaniemi Run will be held on Saturday, 13 September 2025, with 5 km and 21.1 km distances. Registration for the 2025 event is now open – sign up here! The start for both distances is a few minutes’ walk from Eläintarha Sports Field, on Hammarskjöldintie. The courses have been officially measured in accordance with WA standards.

images.alt_text: Nainen juoksee hämärän aikaan. Hyvä kuva juoksusta.

name: Ruskamaraton
description: The Ruskamaraton is being held for the 42nd consecutive year, on the second Saturday in September, September 13, 2025. This event for lovers of exercise, Lapland and joy in Levi has been part of the local culture since 1984. The Ruskamaraton gives participants the opportunity to compete over the 42.195 km distance in different age groups.

images.alt_text: Ruskamaratonin juoksijoita Levillä. Upeat maisemat ja paljon osallistujia.
Ruskamaratonin juoksijoita Levillä. Hyvälaatuinen kuva kilpailusta.
Ruskamaratonin reittikartat ja aikataulut Levillä. Selkeät kartat ja aikataulu.

name: Bladhin Loppet
description: Bladhin Run is making a comeback, and we will hold the race on 13 September 2025. This historic running event winds through the beautiful wooden-house scenery of Kaskinen and offers participants an unforgettable experience. The race features several distances, including 5 km, 10 km, a half marathon, a children’s run (500 m), and a rollator run (150 m).

name: Kohnan Lenkki
description: Kohnan Lenkki 2023 will be held on September 16, 2023, and features several different categories for different age groups. The event includes running distances of varying lengths, such as 0.8 km for children and 9.8 km for adults. There are separate categories for girls, boys, women, and men, ensuring a suitable race for all participants. The event takes place in an area called Kohna in Panelia, Satakunta, through which the Eurajoki River flows.

images.alt_text: Kohnan Lenkki -juoksukilpailun logo, jossa on lintuja oranssilla taustalla.

name: Kaljamaili SM-kisa
description: Peräkylän Ponnistus is hosting the Finnish Beer Mile Championships on Friday, 26.08 at 18:00 at the main track of Pirkkola Sports Park. The rules are simple: run a mile, or just over four laps of the track, and drink one beer before the start of each lap. The fastest to the finish wins. There are two categories: Beer (Official) and Non-alcoholic beer, and both are unisex. The world record under international rules is 4:33.6.

images.alt_text: Kolme ihmistä yleisurheiluradalla, yksi heistä viittoo.

name: Lasse Virén Hölkkä
description: The international 53rd Lasse Virén Fun Run will take place in Myrskylä on Sunday, September 13, 2026, at 12:00. Several distances are available, including a 10.3 km road race, a 21.1 km half marathon, and a 6 km fitness event and hike/pole walk/jog. Welcome to Lasse’s Fun Run!

images.alt_text: Lasse Virén hölkkä -juoksijat maastossa. Kilpailun tunnelmaa.
Lasse Virén hölkkä -juoksija maastossa. Hyvälaatuisen kuvan.
Juoksija Lasse Virén hölkkä -kisassa.  Kaunis maalaismaisema.

name: Visahölkkä
description: Visahölkkä is a traditional running event held in the rural surroundings of Ojakkala on the first Sunday in October. The first Visahölkkä was held in autumn 2007, and participation has settled at between 30 and 50 runners. The event offers several different distances suitable for runners of all ages and abilities, and it is part of the Vihdin Hölkkäkunkkusarja series.

images.alt_text: Visahölkkä-juoksukilpailun kuva. Kaksi juoksijaa juoksee maastossa.

name: Forssan Puistojuoksu
description: Forssa Park Run is an event that has been held since 1985 and has brought runners together for 30 years. The monthly park run draws 100–200 runners of all ages, and its beautiful route winds through the scenery along the Loimijoki River. Runners can choose between a 5.8 km and an 11.2 km route, which passes through the park of the old cotton mill near Forssa city centre. The start and finish are on Keskuskatu, in front of the more than 100-year-old Elävien Kuvien cinema.

images.alt_text: Puistojuoksussa osallistujia nauttimassa liikunnasta kauniissa maisemassa.
Puistojuoksun kausikortti 2024. Juoksijoita ja kuukauden päivämäärät.

name: Tammimäki Juoksu
description: The Tammimäki Run will be held for the second time on Sunday, 8 September at 14:00 in Pappinen. The route is 10.7 km long and includes significant elevation changes. There are two categories (Men and Women), and the top three finishers in each category will receive cash prizes (€100, €60 and €40). The entry fee is €10, and registration takes place at the race centre, Vartiamäentie 15, Pappinen.

images.alt_text: Juoksukilpailu, jossa osallistujat juoksevat märällä asfaltilla.

name: Gennarbyviken Runt
description: Gennarbyviken Runt is a great gravel-road route that loops around Gennarbyviken. This year, a half marathon was held for the first time, and the Kero brothers ran the race at a fast pace. Jaakko Kero won in 1:13:42. There were 64 participants in total, fewer than the previous year. Gennarbyviken Runt has been a popular event for over 60 years.

images.alt_text: Juoksija Gennarbyviken Runt -kilpailussa juoksee soratiellä, numero 115.

name: Arctic Trail Run
description: Arctic Trail Run is a trail running event held on the fell trails of Saariselkä in Urho Kekkonen National Park. The event offers a unique opportunity to explore stunning landscapes where rocky mountains meet thick moss. Participants can enjoy varied routes and challenging weather conditions, making every race day an unforgettable experience.

images.alt_text: Polkujuoksu Saariselän tunturimaisemissa. Juoksijat nousevat mäkeä ylös, vuoristo ja järvi taustalla.
Maisemakuva Arctic Trail Runin reitiltä, tuntureita ja taivas.
Juoksija tunturimaisemassa, jossa on matalaa kasvillisuutta ja sininen taivas.
Polkujuoksija juoksee puusillalla metsäpolulla, jossa on paljon vihreää kasvustoa.

name: NGS Unrestricted Duathlon
description: Unrestricted Duathlon is a new event in the NGS calendar, combining cross-country skiing and gravel riding. The event offers a great opportunity to explore the beautiful autumn scenery and forests.
