name: 55. Pirkan Hölkkä 5.10.2025
description:
A jewel of the running season, the icing on the cake: this long-distance running event, held mainly on trails, takes place every year on the first Sunday in October.

The 33-kilometre route from Valkeakoski to Tampere runs along a varied mix of fitness trails, forest roads and trails. Around five kilometres of the route are on asphalt. In addition to the running categories, you can take part in a walking category, which is not timed. The event is organised jointly by Tampereen Taivaltajat ry and Valkeakosken Retkeilijät ry.

Pirkan Hölkkä dates back to 1970. The route has largely remained as it is today. In recent years, the average number of participants has been around 1,000–1,500.
additional:
You can choose from the age categories Women’s Open, N40, N50, Men’s Open, M40, M50 and M60. The start is at the Sahara sports field in Valkeakoski (Tallikatu 11), where the starting gun will sound at 9:30 on Sunday morning. Late registration at the start is available from 8:00 to 9:00.

The event uses gun time, measured from the starting gun until you cross the finish line. At the start, you can choose a position near the start line according to your target time.

The first 3 km of the race are on streets. For the next 3 km, the route follows the fitness trail in the recreational area as far as Leppäjärventie. After that, the route to Rutajärvi (11 km from the start) consists of varied forest trails and a short section of gravel road. The 3.5 km stretch between Rutajärvi and Vähä-Kausjärvi is on forest roads. Of the 5 km between Vähä-Kausjärvi and Taivalpirtti, the first part is on forest roads, followed by forest trails; after crossing Savontie, the route returns to gravel roads.
From Taivalpirtti onward, the route alternates between gravel roads and forest trails until it reaches the recreational trail around Suolijärvi. The final 3 km follow a gravel-surfaced recreational trail between Hervanta and Koivistonkylä. This section still has a few climbs that will test Finnish grit.

The Pirkan Hölkkä route is marked with blue flagging tape, directional arrows and kilometre signs. The organisers have aimed to include as many forest trails as possible. There are six refreshment stations along the route.

The finish is in Nirva, Tampere, in the grounds of Tampere Adult Education Centre (Kurssikeskuksenkatu 11). Paid bus transport to the start is available from the finish area and Tampere city centre, both in the morning before the start and in the afternoon after you finish. You can include transport and the soup lunch sold at the finish area in your entry fee by selecting these add-ons in our online store.

images.alt_text: Juoksijat venyttelemässä ennen 55. Pirkan Hölkkää, lokakuussa 2025.
Kaksi miestä, joilla on Pirkan Hölkkä -lippikset.

name: Pirkan Kieppi 5.10.2025
description:
The jewel of the running season and the icing on the cake, Pirkan Hölkkä is a long-distance running event held mostly on trails. It takes place every year on the first Sunday in October. Together with TU38, we are organizing the much-requested shorter distance, the 14 km Pirkan Kieppi.

Pirkan Kieppi starts at the Pirkan Hölkkä finish area, in the courtyard of TAKK’s Nirva campus, at 11:30. On-site late registration is open from 10:00 to 11:00.
additional:
The route continues via Lahdesjärvi to Vuores, where it winds through the beautiful scenery of this neighbourhood. It then joins the traditional Pirkan Hölkkä route at the Vormisto aid station, from where runners continue to the finish together with the full-distance participants.

Pirkan Kieppi has two open categories, women (N) and men (M). Timing is based on gun time, from the starting gun to crossing the finish line. At the start, you can choose a spot near the start line according to your target time.

description: The Hiidenkierros trail running event will take place next autumn on Saturday, 18 October. The Hiidenkierros loop route winds through the magnificent scenery of Hiidenportti National Park, with dramatic gorge valleys and beautiful lake views along the way. The route is challenging, but also offers places to take a break, making it an excellent destination for a day trip.

images.alt_text: Hiidenkierroksen maalaismaisemaa: vanhoja rakennuksia ja aitoja.

name: Solvalla Trail
description: Solvalla Trail is a trail running event where the SAUL Finnish Championships are being held for the first time. All age groups compete on the 10-kilometre course, with a choice of 10 or 20 kilometres; participants in the longer race complete the loop twice. The route winds through varied terrain, mostly along narrow trails, and features impressive rocky cliffs, stunning coastal scenery and beautiful forests. The highlight of the course is an almost 75-metre climb to the top of Swinghill.

images.alt_text: Solvalla Trailin reittikartta Nuuksiossa.  Reitti näkyy kartalla sinisenä.
Solvalla Trailin reitti kartalla. Vanha reittikuva.

name: Kaarinan Syysmaraton
description: Kaarina Autumn Marathon is a running event offering several distances for different age groups, including marathon, half marathon, and 10 km races, open to both men and women. The races take place on an approximately 10.5-kilometre loop through beautiful, flat terrain in Kaarina and Piikkiö. A children’s run is also held, with the youngest children running an approximately 150-metre loop and older children an approximately 500-metre loop. All participants receive a medal, and the children’s run is free with no advance registration required.

name: Viikin Viitonen
description: Viikin Viitonen is an event open to everyone, held several times a year. This year, the event will be run on July 1, bringing runners together in the atmosphere of a summer evening. The event has set a new record with 106 participants, and the current maximum number of participants is 150. Advance registration and the entry fee cost 10 euros (incl. 10% VAT).

name: Kankaanpää Maraton
description: Kankaanpää Marathon is a versatile running event offering races over various distances, including the marathon, half marathon, and shorter distances. The event takes place in Kankaanpää and is known for its beautiful scenery and well-maintained courses. Participants can enjoy running surrounded by nature, and the event attracts both recreational and competitive runners. To celebrate its 20th anniversary, the event returns to Niinisalo School, Kievarinkatu 3.

images.alt_text: Kankaanpään maratonin juoksijoita metsätiellä. Hyvä kuva kilpailun tunnelmasta.

name: Pukinmaki Run 1/2 Maraton 10k 5k
description: Pukinmäki Run is an annual running event held in the Pukinmäki district of Helsinki. The officially measured distances are 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon, as well as a 1 km children’s race. The route follows the borders of Pukinmäki and is a flat road course, with approximately 85% asphalt, 10% compacted crushed stone and 5% running track. The course is fast to run, with an elevation difference of just 4.9 metres.

images.alt_text: Kartta Pukinmäki Run -reitistä, jossa näkyy reitti ja maamerkit.

name: Halloween Hike
description: Halloween Hike 2024 gives children the chance to enjoy Halloween without scary elements. The event takes place at Memphis Boo-tanic Garden and offers a safe alternative to traditional door-to-door trick-or-treating. Participants can enjoy craft activities, not-so-scary characters, and treats. Costumes are encouraged, and this year the garden has introduced timed entry, so it’s a good idea to buy tickets in advance.

name: Helsinki Halloween Run
description: Helsinki Halloween Run 2025 takes place on 25.10.2025 in Kalasatama, Helsinki! The event also includes a race for children, Kids Run Helsinki Halloween, with distances of approximately 450 m (for children under 7) and 900 m (for older children). Schedule: 16.00 Race office opens, 17.45 Kids Run 450 m, 18.00 Kids Run 900 m, and 18.30 start of the 5 km and 10 km races. Prizes will be awarded for the best costumes during the event, and a photo wall will be available for capturing the costumes.

name: Mustavuori Vertical
description: Mustavuori Vertical takes over the Mustavuori Ski Resort in Tampere on 28 October 2023! Participants climb the slope by walking, Nordic walking, jogging, bounding or even running. What makes the event special is that each ascent starts together at the bottom. The race is designed to be a challenging, communal experience, where the winner is the one who lasts the longest.

name: Lepokallion lenkki
description: Lepokallio Trail is a 5.8-kilometer hiking route in the varied forest landscapes of Hanhikoski, Ylistaro. It was renovated and is maintained by the Hanhikoski Rural and Home Economics Women's Association. There are two lean-to shelters along the route, Lepokallio Shelter and Pururata Shelter, both with a fire pit and firewood. The route is accessible year-round and offers an easy outing through varied terrain, including bright pine forests and atmospheric spruce forests.

images.alt_text: Laavu lumisessa metsässä, osa Lepokallion lenkki -polkujuoksureittiä.

name: Tuusula Trailrun
description: Tuusula Trailrun 2024 trail race will be held on Sunday, 27 October 2024 at 11:00 at the biathlon stadium of Tuusula Sports Centre. The route runs along the trails of Tuusula’s Korpikylä and Sammaloja, offering varied terrain and wide, runnable trails. Trail running shoes or studded shoes are the most suitable, but the route can also be run safely in regular running shoes. There are water stations on the course at the 5 km, 10 km and 15 km marks, and the route is marked with ribbons, signs and chalk.

images.alt_text: Ilmakuva urheilukeskuksesta, mahdollisesti Tuusula Trailrunin lähtöpaikka.

name: Hiidenhölkkä Nummela
description: As autumn approaches, so does the traditional Hiidenhölkkä, which is being held for the 47th time this year. Hiidenhölkkä–Nummelan Tarmo. The 10 km and 20 km (2 x 10 km) Hiidenhölkkä routes circle Nummelanharju and Nummela Airport. Hiidenhölkkä starts at 12:00, and the running event ends at 14:00.

name: Sarvilahden Maraton
description: Sarvilahti Marathon offers participants several different running distances, including the marathon, half marathon, and 5- and 10-kilometer routes. The marathon and half marathon follow the same route, with the half marathon completed twice. The event provides electronic timing, and the maximum time for the marathon is 6 hours. All participants receive a medal, but medals cannot be guaranteed for those who register late.

name: Vantaan Kestävyyskierros
description: At the Vantaa Endurance Series, you can challenge yourself in five different events. The series is suitable for fitness enthusiasts and endurance athletes of all levels, and offers a great opportunity to try completely new sports. The Vantaa Endurance Series consists of Vantaa Ski Race, Vantaa Off-trail Challenge orienteering, Vantaa Triathlon, Seutula Loop and Vantaa Marathon. The events are standalone competitions, but together they make up the Vantaa Endurance Series.

name: Fiskarin Halloween 10K
description: Helsinki Halloween Run 2025 takes place on 25 October 2025! The event also includes a children’s race, Kids Run Helsinki Halloween, with distances of approximately 450 m (for children under 7) and 900 m (for older children). The route is officially measured, and the competition has 5 km and 10 km categories for men and women. The best Halloween costume will be awarded a prize!

images.alt_text: Halloween-teemainen kuva juoksutapahtumaan. Musta linna, lepakkoja ja kurpitsa. Teksti: Halloween Hölkkä 5.11.2022.

name: Riston Hölkkä
description: Risto’s Run is held in Suomusjärvi, Salo, every year on the Sunday after All Saints’ Day. The event is named after Risto Nuuroks, a four-time World Championship medalist in orienteering who won silver in the individual event in 1978. Competitive and recreational categories are available for runners of all abilities, and the routes pass through rural landscapes, mostly on gravel roads. Risto’s Run will next be held on 2 November 2025, with the race headquarters at Sisumaja.

name: Fiskarsin Maraton Rasepori
description: Fiskars Marathon Raasepori will be held on 20.06.2025, starting from the Fiskari Athletes’ lodge. The race starts at 10:00. The entire route follows gravel roads, offering runners a range of distances, including 15 km, 7 km, 1.5 km and 0.5 km. The event is a perfect opportunity for both beginners and experienced runners seeking a challenge and beautiful scenery. All participants receive a commemorative medal.

images.alt_text: Fiskarsin kylä lintuperspektiivistä, jossa sijaitsee juoksureitti.

name: Tampere Races
description: Tampere Marathon 2025 will be run on Sunday, August 31. You can choose to run the marathon, half marathon, quarter marathon (10.5 km), or take part in the marathon relay, run in teams of four. Children have their own Mini Marathon event at Tampere Stadium. The course has changed compared with previous years due to construction work in the city, and runs mainly on asphalt and partly on gravel paths.

name: Fiskarsin Maraton Raseporis 2026
description: The Fiskars Marathon in Raseborg 2026 is an exciting running event that gives participants the opportunity to experience magnificent scenery and a sense of community. The event attracts runners of all levels and is an excellent opportunity to test your fitness and enjoy running. The marathon is designed to offer unforgettable moments for both competitors and spectators.

name: Itämeri Maraton
description: Baltic Sea Marathon will be run and walked on Saturday, October 4, 2025. The distance options are the marathon, half marathon, and quarter marathon (10.5 km). The official time limit is six (6) hours for the full marathon and 5.5 hours for the half marathon and quarter marathon. The course is officially measured, and the start and finish area are at Keskuskoulu, Halmstadinkatu 2. Advance registration closes on Tuesday, September 30, 2025, at 24:00.

name: Keurusselän Syyslenkki
description: Keurusselkä Autumn Run takes place on the grounds of Hotel Keurusselkä and in the sports park, mainly following ski trails. The event is held on Saturday, October 4 at 11:00, with 6 km and 10 km routes. The start and finish are at Hotel Keurusselkä, and a prize containing local products will be raffled among runners in both distances. The entry fee is €15, which includes use of the hotel spa after the run.

images.alt_text: Ilmaristen Metsäpirtti, Lieto, Suomi. Ilmaristen Ympärijuoksu tapahtumapaikka.

name: Pirkan Hölkkä & Kieppi

It starts at 11:30 from the Pirkan Hölkkä finish area, in the yard of TAKK’s Nirva campus. The approximately 14 km Pirkan Kieppi through the beautiful autumn scenery of Vuores and Hervanta is suitable for anyone with a good basic level of fitness. There is no rush at the event, and participants can enjoy being outdoors and the refreshments provided at the aid stations.

name: Paraisten Lenkki
description: Come celebrate the 60th anniversary run of the Pargas Run with us on Sunday, October 6, 2024. The race follows the traditional 10.35 km course, starting and finishing at Pajbacka Sports Field, which also has changing rooms and showers. To mark the occasion, all participants will receive a gold commemorative medal and a unique Pargas Run T-shirt. After the finish, coffee, juice, and layer cake will be served to all participants.

description: Fiskars Marathon Rasepori will be held on 20.06.2025 in Raseborg, starting from the Fiskari Athletes’ lodge at Kalliomäentie 4. The race starts at 10:00, and the race office opens at 8:30. Several distances are available: 15 km, 7 km, 2 km and 0.6 km for different age groups. The route winds through beautiful scenery along gravel roads, giving runners the chance to enjoy nature and peaceful trails.

name: Pilvimaja Night Trail
description: Pilvimaja Night Trail is a unique trail running event held in the Vaasa area. The event gives runners the chance to experience beautiful scenery and the calming effects of nature in the dark, on a reflective-marked course. The distance is approximately 13 km, and the event takes place on Friday, October 31, 2025, at 20:00.

images.alt_text: Pilvimaja Night Trail Run logo. Polkujuoksutapahtuma Skatilassa, Suomessa.
Kartta reitistä, jossa näkyy polkujuoksureitin kulku ja etäisyydet.

name: Nuuksio Pikkujoulu Ultra
description: Nuuksio Pikkujoulu Ultra takes place on Saturday, November 16, 2024, at Folkhälsan Solvalla Sports Institute, starting at 9:00 a.m. The competition category follows the backyard-style format, with simultaneous starts; the final start is at 4:00 p.m. and the finish closes at 5:00 p.m. In the recreational category, you can run at your own pace for as many laps as you like. There is also a shortened course of approximately 5 km, offering the atmosphere of a mass start. This event is a great opportunity to try ultrarunning amid the beautiful scenery of Nuuksio. Refreshments include mulled berry juice, warm juice, gingerbread cookies, and other light snacks.

images.alt_text: Nuuksio Pikkujoulu-ultra reitin kartta. Selkeä kuvaus reitistä.

name: Teivocup I
description: Teivo Cup I was run on 26 November 2011 in sunny weather, with temperatures a few degrees above zero. The race had 80 runners, who competed on a route that was icy in places. There was a good turnout in the youth categories. In the girls’ 11-year-old category, Mila Manninen (KU-68) ran the fastest time, 4:10. In the boys’ 11-year-old category, Miska Manninen (KU-68) was the fastest in 4:13. In the men’s 5 km, Jarkko Järvenpää improved the previous course record by two seconds, running 14:54.

name: Voimaa Metsästä
description: The distances at the Voimaa Metsästä event range from 6 to 21 kilometres, with a separate 2 km distance for children. Each distance follows its own marked, continuous trail route, and no part of the route is run more than once. The 2024 routes have undergone a thorough update, and the new event centre is located in the former premises of the UKK Institute. All routes are mostly off-road trails, with short sections on gravel roads.

name: Teivocup
description: Teivocup is a winter-season test-run race series held around Teivo Racecourse once a month from November to April. Each race is 5 km, with men’s and women’s categories. The second race of the current season will take place on Saturday, 13 December 2025, followed by a Christmas party for members in the Takkahuone at Lamminpää Lodge from 14:00 to 18:00.

name: Radioaseman Maraton
description: The Radioaseman Ultra Marathon (100 km) was held in Pori on 23 September 2023, on the Itä-Pori fitness trail at Radioasemantie 1, 28330 Pori. The route was 2 km long and ran around Pori’s old shortwave radio station. The event offered several distances: 100 km, 50 miles, 50 km as a team, 50 km individual, marathon 42.2 km, and half marathon 21.1 km.

description: Haaga Run will be held for the ninth time on 8 November 2025! The event is organized in collaboration by Runner's High and FC POHU. The distances are 5 km and 10 km, and the start is at Lassila Sports Park (Laurinniitynpolku 2, 00440 Helsinki).

description: Welcome to follow the sold-out event at Nummelanharju! The event takes place on October 11, 2025, starting at 10:00 at Nummelanharju in Vihti. This is a Silver competition, whose winner earns a direct spot in the 2026 Satellite World Championships. The winner receives a €500 cash prize, and second place receives €300. All participants will receive a NUBU sauna bench towel and a wooden participation medal.

name: Hercules Trail Run 11.10
description: Hercules Trail Run, held for the ninth time, invites runners to Porvoo’s stunning trails! The day begins with the children’s Polkuralli, where those born in 2013–2025 can run a 2 km route through the beautiful natural surroundings of the Mustijoki River. One hour later, the 7 km, 14 km and 21 km races start in staggered waves. The route is designed for runners and outdoor enthusiasts of all levels, offering a unique opportunity to enjoy Porvoo’s finest trails on the second Saturday of October.

name: NAMI-matka
description: The NAMI run takes place on Saturday, 11 October 2025, at 9:00 at the Kyötikkälä Sports Centre in Kangasala. There are several distances to choose from: 100 km, 50 km, the marathon, and a nonstop option where you can run as many kilometres as you like. The course is precisely measured at 2 km, and refreshments are always close by. All runners are offered soup and coffee at the finish, and participants receive a medal.

name: Suojuoksun Elämyskisa
description: We are pleased to announce that construction work on the solar power plant being built at Ojassuo will once again allow the Suojuoksu to be held this year. The Suojuoksu will take place at Ojassuo in Kauklaisten on Saturday, 12 October 2024 at 1 p.m. Come and challenge yourself and your running fitness at this slightly different running event, and experience a running event like no other. Welcome, whether you’re coming from near or far, and whether you’re a seasoned runner or a first-timer!

name: Joutenlammen Jotos
description: Joutenlammen Jotos is an accessible outdoor event for all ages, where you can choose how to take part. Runners can enter a timed 10-kilometre race, which requires advance registration. The entry fee is 20 euros and includes soup for lunch, childcare during the race, and the chance to use the sauna. There is also a free run for children, along with fun arts and crafts and play activities.

name: Joensuu Night Run
description: Joensuu Night Run 12h is run on an officially measured 325.336-metre mondo track in Joensuu on 16–17 November 2024. The race starts on Saturday at 20:00 and ends at 8:00 on Sunday morning, with the running direction changed every three hours. The event is an IAU Bronze Label competition, with women’s and men’s categories and a minimum age of 18.

images.alt_text: Joensuun yöjuoksun kuva kilpailijoista radalla. Tulostietoja näkyvissä.

name: Vantaan Maantiejuoksucup 1
description: The MKFacade Road Running Cup was run in beautiful but windy weather, with 347 runners taking part. A total of 412 people registered for the first race, 233 of whom had purchased a race pass before registration day. There were 179 late entries, which caused a little congestion, but 347 runners ultimately received a result.

name: Talvisarjajuoksu Rovaniemi
description: The traditional RDS Winter Series Run is back! The first race will take place on Saturday, 4 October at 11:00 on the familiar and safe Koskenkylä route. The third race in the Winter Series Run will be held on Saturday, 13 December 2025 at 11:00 on the Koskenkylä route. New this year: a 2 km fitness category open to everyone.

images.alt_text: Talvinen juoksutapahtuma Rovaniemellä, juoksijoita lähtöviivalla. RDS-logo näkyy.

name: Forssan Puistojuoksu ja -kävely

The beautiful route winds through the scenery along the Loimijoki River, and participants can choose between a 5.8 km and an 11.2 km route. It passes near the centre of Forssa, through the park at the old cotton mill and along the Loimijoki River. The start and finish are on Keskuskatu, in front of Elävien kuvien, a cinema more than 100 years old.

All distances—10 km, half marathon and marathon—are officially measured. Race headquarters are located at Valkeavuori School, and the event takes place on 18 October 2025. Everyone who finishes their fifth marathon receives a silver medal, and those who finish their tenth receive a gold medal.

The course is designed to offer beautiful scenery and varied terrain, making the run both enjoyable and challenging. The marathon course is officially measured and meets international standards, making it possible for competitors to set personal records.

The course loops around the boundaries of Pukinmäki on flat roads and paths, approximately 85% of which are paved. It is a fast course with only 4.9 metres of elevation gain, making it ideal for all runners.

description:

The first half of the route follows the seashore, offering beautiful views of Kopli Bay.

The route also passes through the Paljassaare Conservation Area, a beautiful nature reserve known for birdwatching. We then continue through the Tallinn Water property, where you can see how water is treated, before returning to the promenade.

description:
Why take part in the Kõrvemaa Forest Run?

- Probably the most beautiful trails, surrounded by unspoilt nature.
- 100% of the course is in a stunning nature reserve.
- Give your body and mind a boost.
- Bring the whole family: activities and childcare are organised for the little ones, too.
- A convenient, compact event centre close to Tallinn.
- Free soup, a smoothie and other surprises from our partners for everyone.
- Of course, there’ll also be a hot sauna and, for the bolder participants, a hot tub.
- You can also take part with your whole work team to boost team spirit and health.
- Together, we’re helping improve public health in Estonia.

The Sportland pop-up shop will be open all day, so you can top up your running gear if you’ve forgotten something at home or want the best functional gear for the course. Every finisher will receive a great medal, a GRAM drink and a Nicks bar. Winners will receive Sportland credit, a sapling and gifts from our partners. The season’s best in each age group and the season’s best team will also be recognised.

Want to enjoy a private sauna with your group? Rent the Iglusaun by the pond! Would you like to stay overnight in Kõrvemaa? Check availability at Kuuse Elamusmajad.
course_highlights: 100% of the course runs through a stunning nature reserve
Trail running in unspoilt nature, with a mix of climbs and descents
Routes suitable for beginners and experienced runners alike
additional:
Register online at iseteenindus.sportlandkorvemaa.ee or through the Sportos platform, where Stebby is also available as a payment method.

The event takes place on Sunday, 27.09.2026. On race day, you can register at the start venue from 10.00. Registration closes 30 minutes before the start.

Seniors (aged 60+) and young people (aged up to 17) receive a 50% discount on the main distances when registering in advance. The discount is applied automatically during registration based on year of birth. The minimum discounted price is 15 EUR; the discount will not reduce the price below this amount. The discount does not apply to youth races, which already have a special price of 15 EUR. Only one discount can be used at a time; the system always applies the larger discount.

A 10% discount applies when registering at least 5 people together. A 20% discount applies when registering at least 10 people together. If you are registering from the same company, club or group of friends, be sure to enter your team name, as we will award the best team to take part in the series at the end of the season.

name: Swedbanki Tallinna Maraton
description:
Swedbank Tallinn Marathon and Tallinn Autumn Run invite you to register!

Estonia’s largest running and movement festival, the Swedbank Tallinn Marathon, takes place from September 11 to 13. The programme of this event, which brings together thousands of active people, includes the classic marathon (42.195 km) and marathon relay, half marathon (21.1 km), Tallinn Autumn Run (10 km), Nike Youth Run (5 km), Welcome Run and Limpa Kids’ Runs.

The Tallinn Marathon’s event centre and start-finish area are located on the edge of Tallinn’s Old Town, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The course runs along streets and cycle and pedestrian paths, passing interesting places and offering a colourful overview of Estonia’s capital.

Over the years, more than 340,000 active people have taken part in the Tallinn Marathon across its various distances. The record for international participants at Estonia’s largest sporting event by number of participants was set in 2025, when runners came from as many as 93 countries.

Take this opportunity to be part of Estonia’s most spectacular movement event!

name: 41. Jõulumäe Metsajooks
description:
The Jõulumäe Forest Run takes place on the third Sunday of November, 15 November, bringing running enthusiasts from Pärnu County and beyond together for the 41st time in the scenic Jõulumäe dune pine forest. It is one of Jõulumäe’s oldest and most beloved races. Come celebrate this sporting tradition with us—it’s a day when the entire pine forest fills with happy participants, supporters cheering on the runners, and autumn colours.

The Forest Run is open to everyone who enjoys being active. In addition to the traditional 9 km main race, the programme includes shorter races for children (500 m, 1,000 m and 2,000 m). This year, jogging has been added alongside recreational walking. No times are recorded for these 5.6 km distances; participants can enjoy the activity for themselves.

Runners compete in 18 age categories. Early registration is open until 12.11.2026 at 23:59.

Recommendations:

To avoid unnecessary rushing on site, early registration is strongly recommended.
By registering early, you help ensure the event is better organised—we know to expect you and can plan accordingly. You’ll also have more time to get ready on site.
If registering on site, please arrive promptly and adhere to the registration schedule.

name: Nyårsloppet
description:
For the 43rd time, Vallentuna Friidrott invites everyone—from elite athletes to recreational runners and children—to take part in a winter race on the streets and squares in central Vallentuna. Participants and spectators may be met with challenging ice, slushy snow, wonderfully crisp winter weather or a fast asphalt course.
Nyårsloppet is a great way to get a little active before the New Year’s meal and the year’s reflections. And as some people say: “What you do on New Year’s Eve sets the tone for the rest of the year!” So take the opportunity to get active, bring a friend and run or jog around the course.

name: Craft Idre Fjällmaraton
description:
Become unbeatable
We believe everyone has the right to feel unbeatable at some point. Not in relation to anyone else, but in relation to yourself. Unbeatable because you achieved something you didn’t think was possible. Because you dared to do something you didn’t think you could. Because you ventured into unknown territory and won. You won over that little voice telling you that you can’t.

name: Nyårsloppet Vallentuna
description:
The New Year’s Race is a perfect way to get active during the days between Christmas and New Year. For the 42nd time, Vallentuna Friidrott is inviting runners to take part on New Year’s Eve, with everyone from elite athletes to those who prefer a more relaxed pace. A winter race can mean challenging conditions or fast asphalt—we never know until race day. Keep an eye on the weather forecast and read our information. Statistically, conditions have been favourable for running in most years, as the results from previous years show.

Above all, the New Year’s Race is a lovely way to get together to round off the old year and have something to talk about at the celebrations later in the day.

You’re welcome too—we’ll see you there!
additional: Please remember that the New Year’s Race is a winter race, and conditions can vary from year to year. In some years, spiked shoes may be recommended.

name: Sollentuna Winter Marathons
description:
Welcome to SWM!
Experience the adrenaline of running on ice! Sollentuna Winter Marathon offers three spectacular races in one day, with Arena Edsvik creating a festive atmosphere and Edsberg Castle, dating back to the 1630s, providing a royal setting.

NEW! - Winter X 10K - SOLO
A fast-paced 10K winter race on and around the ice of Edsviken, with up to 4 km of spectacular ice running before you sprint to the finish at Arena Edsvik. The race starts at 12:00!

Winter Half Marathon 21K - TEAM & SOLO
A beautiful and challenging half marathon on and around Edsviken, with up to 7 km of spectacular ice running. The race starts at 12:00!

Winter 21K - CANICROSS
All runners with dogs get the chance to experience magical ice running with their four-legged best friend! Only 50 spots for dog teams—first come, first served. Flexible start between 11:45 and 12:00.

Winter Kids Run by Team Rynkeby Täby 1.5K
A fun race for children born in 2014 or later, on wintry roads around Edsberg Castle. All proceeds go directly to the Swedish Childhood Cancer Fund through Team Rynkeby Täby. Start at 11:00.

Together, we support the Swedish Childhood Cancer Fund
Thanks to you, we will donate up to 25,000 kr to the Swedish Childhood Cancer Fund through our volunteers in Team Rynkeby Täby. Thank you!

RUN ON ICE!

name: STHLM Trail Marathon
description:
A warm welcome to the second edition of STHLM TRAIL MARATHON
All races take place on a very scenic course, approximately 15 km long. Each lap will offer you nearly 500 metres of elevation gain. Expect beautiful views and challenging running, mostly over hilly terrain and mostly on trails, sometimes off-trail, but also on a couple of gentler sections where you can stretch out and run for a few hundred metres.

New for 2026
• Be on the start line as early as April! This time we’re holding the event in early spring, so mark 18 April in your calendar now.
• Kids Trail, a free race for our younger runners (born in 2014 or later).
• Hjärnloppet, a virtual race lasting 18 days, where the entire entry fee goes directly to Hjärnfonden and vital research into epilepsy.
• Course preview runs. On two occasions, we’ll run through the first and second parts of the course.
• Virtual running sessions in the Heyey app to help you stay in shape all the way to the start line in April.

What’s not new for 2026
• The course, a challenging and very scenic route in the area around Lake Flaten.
• Sprint and Ultra, two trail races that challenge you a little extra.
• Grit, the ultimate test, which we don’t think anyone can complete. If you prove us wrong, you’ll win both honour and fame, as well as some prize money.
additional: All information on the organiser’s website

name: Östgöta Ultra Trail
description: At Östgöta Ultra Trail, the mind is stimulated while the body gets a workout. We chose the area west of Kisa for its beautiful viewpoints, trails and lakes to enhance this experience. On your way to the finish, you’ll make your way over logs and rocks, meet friendly volunteers and travel by boat. Once you reach the finish, you’ll get food, drinks and a medal, and have time to chat and hang out with other runners.

name: Mattila Trail Run
description: On Saturday, September 26, 2026, the Mattila Trail Run will take place, following its successful debut in 2025. The race runs through the beautiful Finnskogen forest in Värmland, across marshes, over boardwalks, and through a mix of old-growth and managed forest. Some sections take you past cultural sites, as much of the route passes through the historic cultural heritage of Finnskogen. Enjoy a memorable trail-running experience with plenty of challenging climbs and, in some places, technical trails. Welcome to a true adventure!

name: Fredsloppet
description: Fredsloppet 2026 is a peace and solidarity race held at several locations in Sweden, including Stockholm, between 15 August and 18 October 2026. The event is more than a running race; it is an expression of peace, justice and solidarity, supporting Palestinian and Cuban organisations. Participants can choose from different distances, including 5 km and 10 km, as well as walking categories and mini peace races for children. The event encourages people to organise their own Fredsloppet races, and the surplus goes to peace and solidarity work.
course_highlights: Several locations in Sweden, including Stockholm
Distances for all ages and levels, including children’s and family races
Focus on peace, solidarity and justice, supporting Palestinian organisations
additional: 75% of the proceeds go to Palestinian aid, and the event celebrates its 40th anniversary in 2026. Participants can register via fredsloppet.se. The event includes water stations, medals and the option to register on the day.

description:

Gather your friends, colleagues and teammates, and come to Olstorp. There are races for everyone, big and small.

name: Ultra Caballo Blanco Suecia
description:
Only the 100-mile race starts on Friday (08:00); the 100 km and 50-mile races start on Saturday (06:00).
All three races have their own routes (they have nothing in common with CBMR, which takes place on the same day). The 50-mile and 100-mile races have some staffed aid stations, which are also shared with the 100 km race, which has its own stations as well. The 100-mile race is virtually entirely unsupported, apart from a few unmanned water stations. You also pass a well-stocked country store and a church with water and toilets.
All three races offer the option of a drop bag.
The courses are completely unmarked, so you navigate using a downloaded GPX file...
additional:
We don’t have paper cups, so bring a cup!
Hot food, drinks, coffee and cake are served after the finish.

The entry fee includes 120:-, which is sent to a children’s race in Urique, Mexico!

name: Caballo Blanco Memorial Run (CBMR)
description:
This is the route that Caballo Blanco (aka Micah True) and I ran on 2011-09-26, when he was visiting Sweden at my invitation. In spring 2012, we received the news that he had died. We then organised a memorial race on 2012-09-22. It became a tradition, and eventually the race offered 1, 2 or 4 laps of the route, which is approximately 11 km and has approximately 150 metres of elevation gain.
See also Ultra Caballo Blanco Suecia — an ultra race held at the same time.
An article I wrote quite a while ago, when we introduced the 50-mile race:
https://redsports.se/CBM/TheStory.html
additional:
The 4-lap race starts at 12:00, while the 1- and 2-lap races start at 15:00.
Please note that you must bring your own cup/mug.
The entry fee includes drinks, energy products, and a hot meal with coffee and cake after the race.

name: GUM - Gotland Ultramarathon
description:
One of Sweden’s most beautiful ultramarathons. The race starts at 9:00 at Hallshuk in northern Gotland, and the course heads south along the coast, with the sea on your right all the way to Visby. The route is approximately 50 km, with very varied terrain.

There is also a Half-GUM (28 km), starting at 11:00 in Lickershamn.

name: XC-race Linköping
description: Linköping XC-race is an annual cross-country race organised by Linköpings OK in Vidingsjön, Linköping. The race offers a marked 5 km loop through varied terrain, including trails and marshland, and is open to both recreational runners and competitive classes. Participants can choose between 5 km, 10 km for men and women, and a 5 km recreational class. The 10 km races cover two laps. The event is known for its challenging, muddy terrain, and the start and finish are at Vidingsjö Motionscentrum.

name: Västerås Marathon
description:
NEW RACE 2026

Västerås Marathon offers three distances — 42 km, 21 km and 10 km — on a flat, fast course through the heart of the city and along the beautiful shores of Lake Mälaren. The course is a loop course, with 10 km per lap.
Experience the joy of running in a well-organised race for all levels.

The race is for everyone who enjoys running, from beginners to elite athletes. All ages and paces are welcome, and generous time limits will be set for completing the race.

A warm welcome!

name: Kilterrängen
description: Are you among those who prefer trails to asphalt? Whether you’re a curious beginner, a recreational runner, or an elite runner, Kilterrängen is for you. Starting and finishing at Frykstahöjden in Kil, this 16 km trail race ends with a few tough kilometres full of hills, including the notorious ski slope. The course is just as suitable for running at full speed as for jogging, walking with poles, or hiking. You can also choose to run 6 km, with the same tough finish as the longer course.

name: Oskarshamn backyard 6h 2026
description:
A Backyard race lasting under 6 hours.

One 6.7 km lap every hour for 5 hours. In the 6th hour, one 8.7 km lap. 42.195 km in total. If you complete the race, you will have covered a marathon! The first to finish the final lap wins.


Registration: https://raceid.com/sv/races/15069/about

name: Å-stadsloppet
description:
Å-stadsloppet runs through both Örebro’s neighborhoods and scenic areas such as Rynningeviken and Wadköping.

The 5, 10 and 21.1 km courses have all been officially measured by federation course measurer Bertil Sundin.

name: Uppsala Marathon
description:
UPPSALA MARATHON
17 OCTOBER 2026
Through centuries of history – one step at a time
MARATHON • HALF MARATHON • MARATHON RELAY
Celebrate 10 years with us!
Challenge yourself and experience one of Sweden’s most popular races in beautiful autumnal Uppsala. Run the marathon or half marathon, or gather family, friends or colleagues and take part in the marathon relay.
Uppsala Marathon is turning 10!
Over 42,195 metres, the course takes you through some of Uppsala’s most historic, scenic and remarkable surroundings. From the castle and Carolina Hill to the River Fyris, the city centre and leafy green spaces – a unique combination of running, history, culture and a festive atmosphere.
Whether you’re an experienced marathon runner or taking part for the first time, you’re warmly welcome to help write the next chapter in the race’s history.
All participants are invited to enjoy a post-run gathering, and all finishers receive a technical T-shirt and this year’s exclusive 10th-anniversary medal.
More information and registration:
https://www.uppsalamarathon.se/

description: A flat course with no hills, offering the chance to achieve good times along the river in central Eskilstuna. Start and finish in the city park.

name: Fjällmaraton Sälen by EQPE
description: Fjällmaraton Sälen by EQPE is the trail adventure for those who love experiences, running and beautiful nature. Choose to run 42 km, 21 km or 10 km, and the children can also take part in Barnens Fjällmaraton. Along mountain trails, paths, boardwalks and gravel roads, nature will challenge you on your way to the finish and the After Run at Experiumtorget in Lindvallen. Fjällmaraton Sälen by EQPE is a deluxe running challenge! Join us and experience the joy of running in the mountains!

name: Tänndalen 100 miles
description: Tänndalen 100 Miles is a runnable road race, set in landscapes that feel like true mountain running. The roads are quiet, often with more reindeer than cars, and the surroundings offer an almost otherworldly stillness. It’s a journey through both nature and history, where every step is buoyed by the vast mountains, crisp air and silence.

description: Noskrien Ziemu is a winter running, hiking, and Nordic walking series held in various locations across Latvia, including Ropaži Municipality. The event takes place whatever the weather, offering participants the chance to run or hike through urban areas, forests, meadows, and along gravel roads. The aim is to promote a healthy lifestyle and popularize running in winter, as well as support Latvia’s trail running team. Participants can expect high standards of quality and safety, and the opportunity to compete in the season standings and receive commemorative medals.
course_highlights: Routes run through urban areas, forests, meadows, and along gravel roads
The event takes place whatever the weather—ice, snow, rain, or frost
Start and finish are at the Ropaži Sports and Culture Centre
additional: Race numbers can be collected from 09:30 to 10:50. The start and finish are at the Ropaži Sports and Culture Centre (Sporta iela 2-k-1, Ropaži). After the event, participants receive a 10% discount at Ozolgravas café (Rīgas iela 4, Ropaži) upon showing their race number. Participant limit: 800. Departure from Riga at 8:30, arrival in Ropaži at around 9:30, return trip at 15:30 after the awards ceremony. It is strictly forbidden to enter the event centre indoors wearing shoes with spikes or dirty shoes.

name: Šiaulių Bėgimas
description: The renewed and unique representative Šiauliai Run 2024 will take place on September 22 at 12:00. THE BIG START. The project’s main goal is to promote physical activity and sport by encouraging an active, fulfilling way to spend leisure time, fostering community spirit and a healthy lifestyle. The run will follow the city’s central streets, passing places significant to Šiauliai’s history. It is for people of all ages, from recreational runners to professionals. The program includes a 700 m children’s run, a 1236 m run commemorating the date of the Battle of the Sun, and 5 km and 10 km runs.

name: Bėgimas Sporto Dienai
description: On January 12, 2025, we invite you to the traditional run commemorating Freedom Defenders’ Day on January 13. The race distances and route remain unchanged: the 8-kilometer race starts at 20:00 from the Giruliai TV Tower, and the 3-kilometer race starts at around 20:20 from the Summer Stage. The first 700 participants to finish will receive medals with an exclusive design, and teamsport.lt has prepared prizes for the fastest runners.

name: Gintarinė jūrmylė Krosas
description: The international running competition “Gintarinė jūrmylė 2024” will take place in Klaipėda on October 12, 2024. Participants can choose the 8 km distance, which starts at 13:10 from the Giruliai TV Tower. The route follows the bicycle path, and runners will turn toward Liepų Street by the Summer Concert Stage.

name: Graužikai - Kelmė Race
description: The “Graužikai–Kelmė” V. Rimkus Memorial Run took place on October 28, 2023, in Kelmė, marking the 50th anniversary of this traditional event. This year, more than 200 runners from across Lithuania and guests from Ukraine took part. Vitalij Kuznetsov was the fastest in the 8 km race. The fastest woman was Aurika Balsytė, who is from Kelmė District. There was also a 1.8 km race, in which Lukas Mikavičius performed best, and a 200 m race for young children.

name: Panevėžio maratonas
description: The Panevėžys Marathon 2024 will take place in Panevėžys, Lithuania, and registration will open on September 13, 2024. Anyone who has registered and had a health check may participate. Participants can choose from various distances: a 400 m walk, 2.8 km, 5 km, 10 km, half marathon, and marathon, with different age requirements.

images.alt_text: Bėgikas kerta finišo liniją Panevėžio maratone, džiaugdamasis pergale.

name: Klubbmesterskap 5k
description: The Club Championship 5K is a running competition that is part of Tjøme Running Club’s events. The courses are officially measured, and the race is run over a distance of 5 km. This championship gives members the opportunity to compete for club championship titles and set club records. The race takes place at the beautiful Grønneset by Ånøya on Wednesday, June 25, with the start from 18:00, and is designed to challenge both beginners and experienced runners.

name: Adventsløpet
description: Adventsløpet is a family-friendly race in Bodø organised by Bedriftsidretten i Nordland together with Flygt Bil. Start and finish are inside the Flygt Bil car showroom, and the course is a well-known, fast route on Tokleløypa. You choose between 5 km and 10 km, one or two laps, and decide yourself whether to walk, jog or run. There will be lights, music, warmth, mulled wine and a Christmas atmosphere.
course_highlights: Start and finish inside the Flygt Bil showroom
One lap is 5 km, two laps 10 km
Lights, music and mulled wine during Advent
additional: The organiser encourages everyone to run with a reflective vest and a headlamp. After the race there is a small get-together for the participants.

name: Barfrostløpet
description: Barfrostløpet on 7 November 2026 offers three distances: 1,500 m, 5,000 m and 10,000 m, as well as a 4.3 km fun run, Run4Fun. The start and finish for all distances are outside Tanabru kindergarten, opposite the health centre, on marked, paved routes in central Tanabru. Age limits apply to the different competition classes, with participants ranging from 4 to 85 years old. Changing rooms will be open at Tana multipurpose hall. Food will be served, and there will be a season-opening chat after the race at Tanabru school, near the multipurpose hall.

name: Jessheim Vintermaraton
description: Jessheim Winter Marathon takes place on Sunday, November 9 in Jessheim. The marathon and half marathon will meet at the entrance to Myrvegen, where there will be a merge section of over 1 km so everyone can find a good position. This means both the marathon and half marathon runners will be on the course at the same time.
